titleZh: 01 1.1 Generation：Prefill 与 Decode
titleEn: 01 1.1 Generation: Prefill and Decode
textZh: 1.1 Generation：Prefill 与 Decode  Autoregressive LLM 不是一次生成整段答案，而是反复预测下一个 Token。在线推理要把 Prefill 与 Decode 分开看：前者处理输入前缀并建立上下文状态，后者逐 Token 生成并复用已有 KV。  FIG.1.1 · INFERENCE LIFECYCLE 从文本到下一个 Token 1 · TOKENIZE Text → Token IDs 使用目标模型对应 tokenizer；Token 数决定上下文、成本与缓存身份。 2 · PREFILL Input tokens → hidden state 输入批量处理，通常主导 TTFT 中的模型前缀计算。 3 · LOGITS Vocabulary scores 输出层为候选 Token 产生 logits。 4 · SAMPLE Temperature / Top-p 采样策略控制变化性，不提供真实性。 5 · DECODE Next token → repeat 逐 Token 生成；输出越长，顺序 Decode 越多。  核心规则 Prefill and Decode are different performance regimes; diagnose them separately.
textEn: 1.1 Generation: Prefill and Decode  An autoregressive LLM does not generate an entire answer at once. It repeatedly predicts the next token. Online inference should separate Prefill from Decode: Prefill processes the input prefix and establishes context state; Decode generates tokens sequentially while reusing prior KV state.  FIG.1.1 · INFERENCE LIFECYCLE From text to the next token 1 · TOKENIZE Text → Token IDs Use the target model's tokenizer; token count drives context, cost, and cache identity. 2 · PREFILL Input tokens → hidden state Input tokens are processed together and often dominate model-side prefix work before the first token. 3 · LOGITS Vocabulary scores The output layer produces logits over candidate tokens. 4 · SAMPLE Temperature / Top-p Sampling controls variability; it does not create truth. 5 · DECODE Next token → repeat Generation proceeds token by token; longer outputs require more sequential decode steps.  Core rule Prefill and Decode are different performance regimes; diagnose them separately.

titleZh: 01 1.2 Transformer：理解 Q/K/V，而不是把 Attention 当数据库
titleEn: 01 1.2 Transformer: Understand Q/K/V without treating attention as a database
textZh: 1.2 Transformer：理解 Q/K/V，而不是把 Attention 当数据库  Transformer 通过多层 Attention 与前馈变换构造上下文表征。Attention 的核心是 Q/K 的兼容度打分，再用归一化权重聚合 V；它描述网络内部依赖，不等于事实检索或验证。  Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax(QKᵀ / √dₖ) V  架构 信息可见性 典型用途 关键修正 Encoder-only bidirectional classification · embedding · labeling 更偏表征学习 Decoder-only causal open-ended autoregressive generation 主流生成架构之一，不是唯一生成架构 Encoder–Decoder encoder bidirectional + decoder causal translation · summarization · seq2seq 同样可以生成  RoPE 通过位置相关旋转把相对位置信息带入 Attention，但不保证无限长度可靠外推；FlashAttention 通过 IO-aware tiling 避免在 HBM 中物化完整 N×N score matrix，改变的是精确 Attention 的实现效率，而不是语义定义。
textEn: 1.2 Transformer: Understand Q/K/V without treating attention as a database  A Transformer builds contextual representations through repeated attention and feed-forward transformations. Attention scores Q/K compatibility and uses normalized weights to aggregate V; it models internal dependencies, not factual retrieval or verification.  Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax(QKᵀ / √dₖ) V  Family Visibility Typical use Correction Encoder-only bidirectional classification · embedding · labeling Representation-oriented Decoder-only causal open-ended autoregressive generation A dominant generation architecture, not the only one Encoder–Decoder encoder bidirectional + decoder causal translation · summarization · seq2seq Also supports generation  RoPE injects relative-position structure through position-dependent rotations, but it does not guarantee unlimited reliable extrapolation. FlashAttention uses IO-aware tiling to avoid materializing the full N×N score matrix in HBM; it changes the implementation efficiency of exact attention, not its semantic definition.

titleZh: 01 1.3 Token 与 Context：字符是 UI 数量，Token 才是 Runtime 数量
titleEn: 01 1.3 Tokens and Context: characters are a UI quantity; tokens are a runtime quantity
textZh: 1.3 Token 与 Context：字符是 UI 数量，Token 才是 Runtime 数量  Token 可能是单词、子词、字节片段、标点、空格敏感片段或代码片段；具体划分由 tokenizer 决定。因此不能把固定字符数/单词数换算规则当作工程事实。  FIG.1.2 · CONTEXT BUDGET Context Window 是共享预算，不是 RAG 专属容量 INSTRUCTIONS System / Developer 核心约束、角色与任务协议。 CAPABILITIES Tool schemas / examples 工具定义与 few-shot 也占 Token。 EVIDENCE History / Memory / RAG 历史、记忆与检索证据必须竞争同一预算。 RESERVE Output / reasoning 必须为输出和必要的推理预算预留空间。 容量 ≠ 利用率 长 Context 能装下更多 Token，但相关证据是否被可靠利用仍是模型、长度、位置和 Prompt Layout 的经验问题。  当 Prompt + 文档超窗时，优先考虑 rerank、减少 top-k、去重、结构化 state、分解任务、压缩或 staged synthesis。Lost in the Middle 说明相关信息位置在某些长上下文任务中会影响性能，因此应做 position-sensitive eval，而不是机械地把重要内容永远放在两头。
textEn: 1.3 Tokens and Context: characters are a UI quantity; tokens are a runtime quantity  A token may be a word, subword, byte fragment, punctuation, whitespace-sensitive fragment, or code fragment; the tokenizer decides. Fixed character-to-token or word-to-token ratios are not engineering facts.  FIG.1.2 · CONTEXT BUDGET The context window is a shared budget, not RAG-only capacity INSTRUCTIONS System / Developer Core constraints, role and task contract. CAPABILITIES Tool schemas / examples Tool definitions and few-shot examples also consume tokens. EVIDENCE History / Memory / RAG History, memory and retrieved evidence compete for the same budget. RESERVE Output / reasoning Reserve space for output and any required reasoning budget. Capacity ≠ utilization A long context can hold more tokens, but reliable evidence use remains an empirical property of the model, length, evidence position, and prompt layout.  When prompts plus documents exceed the window, consider reranking, smaller top-k, deduplication, structured state, task decomposition, compression, or staged synthesis. Lost in the Middle shows that evidence position can affect performance on some long-context tasks, so run position-sensitive evals rather than mechanically placing all important content at the edges.

titleZh: 01 1.4 Sampling：Temperature / Top-p 只控制变化性
titleEn: 01 1.4 Sampling: Temperature and top-p control variability
textZh: 1.4 Sampling：Temperature / Top-p 只控制变化性  机制 控制什么 不解决什么 Temperature 分布 sharpness / randomness 事实缺失、错误检索、权限、业务有效性、工具副作用 Top-p 进入采样候选集的累计概率质量  常见误区 Temperature = 0 ≠ truth. 低温可以降低采样变化，但不能把错误知识、错误 Evidence 或错误 Tool Result 变成正确答案，也不保证跨后端/版本 bit-for-bit 一致。
textEn: 1.4 Sampling: Temperature and top-p control variability  Mechanism Controls Does not solve Temperature Distribution sharpness / randomness Missing facts, bad retrieval, authorization, business validity, tool side effects Top-p Cumulative probability mass admitted to sampling  Common trap Temperature = 0 ≠ truth. Low temperature can reduce sampling variance, but it cannot turn wrong knowledge, evidence, or tool results into truth, nor guarantee bit-for-bit identity across every backend or model version.

titleZh: 01 1.5 Embeddings：Similarity 是候选生成，不是 Correctness
titleEn: 01 1.5 Embeddings: similarity generates candidates; it does not prove correctness
textZh:
1.5 Embeddings：Similarity 是候选生成，不是 Correctness  Embedding 把文本或对象映射到向量空间。Dot Product 同时受方向与向量 magnitude 影响；Cosine 会归一化 magnitude。若向量已经 L2-normalized，Dot Product 与 Cosine 可以产生相同 ranking——但这是具体 embedding family 的性质，不是所有向量模型的默认定律。  x · y = ||x|| ||y|| cos θ

cos(x,y) = (x · y) / (||x|| ||y||)  Dense retrieval 容易把主题相近但动作相反、版本不同、日期不同的内容放在一起。因此生产检索通常需要 Authorization / Metadata → Exact/BM25/Dense → Rerank → Evidence Validation。
textEn:
1.5 Embeddings: similarity generates candidates; it does not prove correctness  Embeddings map text or items into a vector space. Dot product depends on both direction and magnitude, while cosine normalizes magnitude. If vectors are L2-normalized, dot product and cosine can produce identical rankings—but that is a property of a particular embedding family, not a universal default.  x · y = ||x|| ||y|| cos θ

cos(x,y) = (x · y) / (||x|| ||y||)  Dense retrieval can place topically similar but operationally opposite, differently versioned, or differently dated items together. Production retrieval therefore typically needs Authorization / Metadata → Exact/BM25/Dense → Rerank → Evidence Validation.

titleZh: 01 1.6 Base、Instruct 与 Post-training
titleEn: 01 1.6 Base, instruct, and post-training
textZh: 1.6 Base、Instruct 与 Post-training  Base model 主要学习 next-token continuation；Instruct / aligned model 在预训练之后继续做行为适配。Post-training 可能包含 SFT、preference data、reward modeling、RL-based optimization、DPO 或安全训练，不应把 instruct 简化成“等于 RLHF”。  FIG.1.3 · POST-TRAINING PATHS Preference optimization 不是单一路线 CLASSIC RLHF SFT → Reward Model → PPO 奖励模型提供 proxy；策略优化需要防止过度偏离 reference。 DPO Preference pairs → direct objective 在特定 formulation 下直接优化 preference，不单独训练 RM 再跑 PPO。 ORIGINAL GRPO Group samples → relative advantage 原始 DeepSeekMath GRPO 用组内 reward 统计建立相对 advantage，避免单独 critic/value model。 保护指标 Preference win-rate 上升时仍要单独保护 factuality、task success、safety 和 calibration；代理指标变好不等于真实目标全都变好。
textEn: 1.6 Base, instruct, and post-training  A base model primarily learns next-token continuation. Instruct/aligned models receive additional behavioral adaptation after pretraining. Post-training may include SFT, preference data, reward modeling, RL-based optimization, DPO, or safety training; instruct should not be reduced to 'equals RLHF'.  FIG.1.3 · POST-TRAINING PATHS Preference optimization is not a single pipeline CLASSIC RLHF SFT → Reward Model → PPO A reward model provides a proxy; policy optimization needs control against excessive drift from the reference. DPO Preference pairs → direct objective Under its formulation, directly optimizes preferences without separately training a reward model and then PPO. ORIGINAL GRPO Group samples → relative advantage Original DeepSeekMath GRPO uses group-relative reward statistics and avoids a separate critic/value model. Protected metrics Even when preference win-rate improves, protect factuality, task success, safety, and calibration separately; a better proxy does not mean every real objective improved.

titleZh: 01 1.7 Hallucination：Plausibility 天生存在，Truthfulness 需要工程化
titleEn: 01 1.7 Hallucination: plausibility is native; truthfulness must be engineered
textZh: 1.7 Hallucination：Plausibility 天生存在，Truthfulness 需要工程化  Hallucination 可能来自参数知识缺失/过时、Prompt 不完整、Retrieval 失败、Context 冲突、Tool Result 错误、unsupported inference，或系统本应拒答却强迫模型继续生成。  缓解方式 获得什么 付出什么 Grounding / RAG 外部 Evidence 与可更新事实 检索延迟、索引维护、Context Token、召回失败 Scope + Abstention 不确定时不猜 Coverage 下降与 false refusal Verification / Tool 外部检查或 deterministic evidence 额外延迟、成本和 verifier failure
textEn: 1.7 Hallucination: plausibility is native; truthfulness must be engineered  Hallucination can come from missing/stale parametric knowledge, underspecified prompts, retrieval failure, contradictory context, bad tool results, unsupported inference, or an application forcing an answer when it should abstain.  Mitigation Gain Cost Grounding / RAG External evidence and fresh facts Retrieval latency, index maintenance, context tokens, retrieval failure Scope + Abstention Do not guess under insufficient evidence Lower coverage and false-refusal risk Verification / Tool External check or deterministic evidence Additional latency, cost, and verifier failure modes

titleZh: 01 1.8 Prompt vs RAG vs Fine-tuning：先诊断 Failure Type
titleEn: 01 1.8 Prompt vs RAG vs fine-tuning: diagnose the failure type first
textZh: 1.8 Prompt vs RAG vs Fine-tuning：先诊断 Failure Type  问题类型 首选杠杆 为什么 指令 / 风格 / 输出格式 Prompt / Few-shot 最快、最便宜、最容易回滚 缺少动态 / 私有 / 可追溯事实 RAG / Tool / External Context 知识可更新、可授权、可引用 长期重复的行为缺口 Fine-tuning / Adaptation 把稳定行为模式写入模型参数 模型能力上限 更强/更专用模型或架构变化 Prompt 不能制造不存在的能力  记忆法 Prompt for behavior · RAG for changing evidence · Fine-tuning for repeated behavior.  LoRA 通过冻结 base weights、训练低秩更新矩阵来降低可训练参数量；QLoRA 把 quantized frozen base 与 LoRA adapters 结合。4-bit weights 不代表总训练内存一定缩小 4 倍，因为 activations、optimizer、adapter 和临时 buffer 仍然存在。
textEn: 1.8 Prompt vs RAG vs fine-tuning: diagnose the failure type first  Failure type First lever Why Instruction / style / output format Prompt / Few-shot Fastest, cheapest, easiest to roll back Missing dynamic/private/provenance-sensitive facts RAG / Tool / External Context Knowledge remains updatable, authorizable, and citable Repeated stable behavioral gap Fine-tuning / Adaptation Move stable behavioral patterns into model parameters Capability ceiling Stronger/specialized model or architecture change Prompting cannot create missing capability  Recall Prompt for behavior · RAG for changing evidence · Fine-tuning for repeated behavior.  LoRA freezes base weights and trains low-rank update matrices to reduce trainable parameters. QLoRA combines a quantized frozen base with LoRA adapters. Four-bit weights do not imply total training memory is exactly four times smaller because activations, optimizer state, adapters, and temporary buffers still exist.

titleZh: 01 1.9 Structured Output：结构正确不等于任务正确
titleEn: 01 1.9 Structured Output: correct shape does not mean correct task semantics
textZh:
1.9 Structured Output：结构正确不等于任务正确  Prompt-only JSON
→ JSON mode
→ strict schema / constrained decoding
→ semantic validation
→ permission / risk gate
→ host execution  当前 OpenAI Structured Outputs 在支持的 API / JSON Schema subset 上可以使用 strict schema 约束结构；JSON Mode 只保证有效 JSON。无论哪一种，都不能把 schema-valid 直接当成 factually correct、business-valid 或 authorized。  三层边界 Syntax validity ≠ semantic validity ≠ authorization.
textEn:
1.9 Structured Output: correct shape does not mean correct task semantics  Prompt-only JSON
→ JSON mode
→ strict schema / constrained decoding
→ semantic validation
→ permission / risk gate
→ host execution  Current OpenAI Structured Outputs can enforce a strict schema on supported APIs and JSON Schema subsets; JSON Mode guarantees valid JSON only. Neither allows schema-valid output to be treated as automatically factually correct, business-valid, or authorized.  Three boundaries Syntax validity ≠ semantic validity ≠ authorization.

titleZh: 01 1.10 Latency 与 Cache：先分解链路
titleEn: 01 1.10 Latency and caching: decompose the path first
textZh:
1.10 Latency 与 Cache：先分解链路  Client / Network
→ Gateway / Queue
→ Prompt Assembly / Retrieval
→ Prefill / TTFT
→ Decode
→ Tool / Validation
→ Final Delivery  高价值优化通常来自：减少输出 Token、在质量允许时用更小/更快模型、减少无效输入、减少串行请求、并行独立步骤、复用缓存。Streaming 主要降低 perceived latency，并不一定降低总计算或 task completion time。  Cache 复用什么 主要边界 Application Cache 数据、结果、组装后的 artifact 业务 invalidation Prompt / Prefix Cache 匹配前缀的 Prefill 工作 Token-level prefix identity / provider policy KV Cache 单次 Decode 中历史 K/V Context length / memory Semantic Cache 语义相似请求的 response / tool result 语义等价与 freshness
textEn:
1.10 Latency and caching: decompose the path first  Client / Network
→ Gateway / Queue
→ Prompt Assembly / Retrieval
→ Prefill / TTFT
→ Decode
→ Tool / Validation
→ Final Delivery  High-value latency improvements usually come from fewer output tokens, smaller/faster models where quality allows, less useless input, fewer sequential requests, parallel independent work, and caching. Streaming mainly improves perceived latency; it does not necessarily reduce total compute or task completion time.  Cache What it reuses Main boundary Application Cache Data, results, assembled artifacts Business invalidation Prompt / Prefix Cache Prefill work for matching prefixes Token-level prefix identity / provider policy KV Cache Past K/V within a generation Context length / memory Semantic Cache Responses/tool results for semantically similar requests Semantic equivalence and freshness

titleZh: 01 1.11 Model Selection 与 Migration Eval
titleEn: 01 1.11 Model Selection and migration evaluation
textZh:
1.11 Model Selection 与 Migration Eval  模型选择是多目标工程决策：Task quality、modality、tool/structured-output support、context behavior、latency、throughput、cost、privacy、hosting、version lifecycle 都需要进入 Task Contract。Self-host 也不能只比较 GPU 小时价与 API Token 价，还要计算 utilization、capacity headroom、SRE、安全、升级、可用性和质量差距。  Production baseline
→ frozen eval set
→ candidate model replay
→ per-example + slice diff
→ tool/schema compatibility
→ latency + cost
→ shadow / canary
→ ship / hold / rollback  发布原则 Model behavior is a versioned dependency; treat migration like a production release.
textEn:
1.11 Model Selection and migration evaluation  Model selection is a multi-objective engineering decision. Task quality, modality, tool/structured-output support, context behavior, latency, throughput, cost, privacy, hosting, and version lifecycle all belong in the task contract. Self-hosting cannot be decided by comparing GPU hourly price with API token price alone; utilization, capacity headroom, SRE, security, upgrades, availability, and quality gap all matter.  Production baseline
→ frozen eval set
→ candidate model replay
→ per-example + slice diff
→ tool/schema compatibility
→ latency + cost
→ shadow / canary
→ ship / hold / rollback  Release principle Model behavior is a versioned dependency; treat migration like a production release.

titleZh: 01 1.13 Canonical Rules
titleEn: 01 1.13 Canonical Rules
textZh: 1.13 Canonical Rules  必须记住 Characters are a UI quantity; tokens are a model-runtime quantity. A long context window is capacity; evidence utilization is empirical. Sampling controls variability; it does not create truth. Semantic similarity is candidate generation, not correctness. Syntax validity is not semantic validity, and semantic validity is not authorization. Capacity, selection, and reuse are separate design axes.
textEn: 1.13 Canonical Rules  Must remember Characters are a UI quantity; tokens are a model-runtime quantity. A long context window is capacity; evidence utilization is empirical. Sampling controls variability; it does not create truth. Semantic similarity is candidate generation, not correctness. Syntax validity is not semantic validity, and semantic validity is not authorization. Capacity, selection, and reuse are separate design axes.

titleZh: 01 ML Foundations：从 Gradient 到泛化与数值稳定
titleEn: 01 ML foundations: optimization, generalization and numerical stability
textZh:
ML Foundations：从 Gradient 到泛化与数值稳定 FDE INDEPENDENT RESEARCH 依据 FDE 公开考点独立研究，不是付费标准答案。示例为教学假设，并非客户性能实测。 这一组题回答“为什么训练 loss 变好，实际业务不一定变好”，并把数据泄漏、数学损失和模型行为分开。  Q24 · 梯度下降调低 Loss，为什么线上却变差？  Gradient Descent 更新 θ ← θ − η∇L。η 控制步长；训练目标与客户效用并非同一量。核对训练曲线、有效数据、独立验证集、下周未见客户切片。  Q25 · Bias/Variance 与数据泄漏怎么区分？  症状 证据 处理 训练与验证都差 欠拟合 / 数据或目标不正确 核对数据与容量 训练好验证差 过拟合、漂移、泄漏都可能 先按时间/实体检查拆分 未来统计被用于预处理 真正的数据泄漏 先切分再 Fit  Q26 · Entropy、Cross Entropy、KL、Perplexity 有何区别？  Entropy H(p) = - Σ p log p
CrossEntropy H(p,q) = - Σ p log q
KL(p||q) = H(p,q) - H(p)
Perplexity = exp(mean token NLL) [natural logs]  可验证的边界 KL 不对称；Perplexity 只有在 tokenizer/样本/归约一致时才适宜比较。Loss 减少不等于 RAG Faithfulness 提升。  Q27 · MLP、Activation、Loss、BatchNorm / LayerNorm 的约束是什么？  Linear 后接非线性才能表达复杂非线性；PyTorch CrossEntropyLoss 接 raw logits；BCEWithLogitsLoss 通过稳定的 log-sum-exp 组合处理二分类；BatchNorm 与 LayerNorm 的统计轴不同。  Q28 · LoRA / Self-training 能保证不会遗忘吗？  不能。要在旧任务、新任务及高风险权限切片上对比；伪标签会自我强化错误，封存 holdout 与人类抽检不能跳过。  Q29 · Convex 优化与 Vision 任务为什么不能混在一起谈？  一般深度网络的非凸目标无通用全局最优保证。Classification、Detection、Segmentation 的标注粒度与指标不同；OCR 表格抽取不能只报图片分类准确率。  第一手资料 : scikit-learn leakage · PyTorch CrossEntropyLoss · PyTorch BCEWithLogitsLoss
textEn:
ML foundations: optimization, generalization and numerical stability FDE INDEPENDENT RESEARCH Independently researched from public FDE topics, not paid answer keys. All scenarios are instructional, not measured customer deployments. These questions separate improvements in training loss from customer value, data leakage, numerical objectives and actual model behavior.  Q24 · Why can lower training loss produce worse production results?  Gradient descent updates θ ← θ − η∇L. Learning rate sets step size; training loss is not customer success. Inspect train/validation curves and independent future customer slices.  Q25 · How do you distinguish bias, variance and data leakage?  Symptom Evidence Action Train and validation both weak Underfit or incorrect target/data Audit data and capacity Train good, holdout weak Overfit, drift or leakage Check temporal/entity splits first Future information enters preprocessing Actual data leakage Split before fitting preprocessing  Q26 · How do entropy, cross-entropy, KL and perplexity differ?  Entropy H(p) = - Σ p log p
CrossEntropy H(p,q) = - Σ p log q
KL(p||q) = H(p,q) - H(p)
Perplexity = exp(mean token NLL) [natural logs]  Verified boundary KL is asymmetric; compare perplexity with consistent tokenization/data/reduction. Lower loss does not prove better RAG faithfulness.  Q27 · What are the contracts of MLP, activation, loss and normalization?  Nonlinear activations add MLP expressivity. PyTorch CrossEntropyLoss expects logits, BCEWithLogitsLoss uses stable log-sum-exp, and BatchNorm and LayerNorm use different axes/statistics.  Q28 · Do LoRA or self-training guarantee no forgetting?  No. Evaluate old/new tasks and security slices; self-training can amplify pseudo-label errors. Holdout separation and human review remain necessary.  Q29 · Why distinguish convex optimization and different vision tasks?  Non-convex deep networks lack general global-optimum guarantees. Classification, detection and segmentation require different labels/metrics; OCR table extraction is not image classification.  Primary references : scikit-learn leakage · PyTorch CrossEntropyLoss · PyTorch BCEWithLogitsLoss

titleZh: 01 模型基础：从 Prompt 到多模态与隐私
titleEn: 01 Model foundations: prompting, modalities and privacy
textZh: 模型基础：从 Prompt 到多模态与隐私 企业模型面试不仅考术语，还要区分训练、推理、身份可信、隐私保障及真实验收证据。 FDE VERIFIED BOUNDARY · OCT 2026 根据公开考点独立撰写，不是会员答案。真实平台事实有链接来源；案例与门禁是设计建议，不代表实际客户测试。 Q58 · Prompt Engineering / Chain-of-Thought 提示词改上下文，不修改模型权重。结构化约束、来源与拒判条件属于运行契约；CoT 不是事实证明，也不等于可审计的隐藏模型推理。 失败/验收： 测试：诱导性 PDF + 订单号只差一位，核验工具权限和证据。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ Q59 · Inference-Time Compute / Scaling Laws 更多验证调用或搜索深度可能提高部分任务质量，但会增加成本与延迟。预训练 Scaling Laws 不保证任意追加推理 Token 都有效。 失败/验收： 比较同一 Holdout 的正确成功任务率、p95、总成本，设置停止预算。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ Q60 · Multimodal VLM / Speech / Diffusion VLM 判断图片/文本；ASR 是音频到文字；TTS 是文字到音频；Diffusion 是迭代生成机制。它们的标注、性能与隐私指标不同。 失败/验收： 扫描票据测试字段 Exact Match；语音测试错听数字与取消延迟。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ Q61 · Constitutional AI / RLAIF AI 反馈可以帮助构造训练偏好，但模型自评不授予生产 Tool 权限，也不替代人工和外部安全策略。 失败/验收： 让 AI Judge 偏爱越权操作，Host 仍应阻断，独立审查偏好偏差。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ Q62 · Differential Privacy / Federated Learning / Interpretability DP 需要明确 ε/δ、剪裁、噪声和 accountant；Federated Learning 只说明数据在本地训练，不保证更新没有泄漏；可解释性分析不等于隐私证明。 失败/验收： 核对 FL 安全聚合，追踪 DP 预算组合，区分解释结果与身份策略。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ 不能把术语命中当掌握 审计表中的 H 只表示此考点能在所属章节定位。还需逐项检查机制、反例、实现、指标与一手证据。
textEn: Model foundations: prompting, modalities and privacy Model interview drills distinguish training from inference, trusted evidence from model text, privacy mechanisms from promises and real acceptance tests. FDE VERIFIED BOUNDARY · OCT 2026 Independently written from public topic names, not membership answers. Provider facts link to first-party references; examples and gates are engineering proposals, not customer tests. Q58 · Prompt Engineering / Chain-of-Thought Prompts alter input context, not weights. Preserve schema/evidence/abstention contracts; chain-of-thought text is not proof of truth or an auditable hidden trace. Failure / acceptance: Test: hostile PDF and near-identical IDs must not change trusted tool authorization. Source / boundary ↗ Q59 · Inference-Time Compute / Scaling Laws More test-time work can help some tasks but increases cost/latency. Pretraining scaling laws do not guarantee benefits from arbitrary extra reasoning tokens. Failure / acceptance: Compare approved success, p95 and total cost on the same holdout; cap work. Source / boundary ↗ Q60 · Multimodal VLM / Speech / Diffusion VLM interprets image/text; ASR transcribes audio, TTS produces speech, diffusion denoises iteratively. Metrics, privacy and inputs differ. Failure / acceptance: Test exact invoice fields and spoken numerals; measure latency/interruption. Source / boundary ↗ Q61 · Constitutional AI / RLAIF AI feedback may train preferences, but self-critiques do not grant production tool permissions or substitute for human governance. Failure / acceptance: Even when a judge favors an unsafe action, host policy must deny it. Source / boundary ↗ Q62 · Differential Privacy / Federated Learning / Interpretability DP needs ε/δ, clipping, noise and accounting. Federated learning keeps local training data local but updates can leak. Interpretability is not a privacy guarantee. Failure / acceptance: Test secure aggregation, privacy budget composition and identity boundaries. Source / boundary ↗ Terminology is not mastery H in the curriculum audit only means the topic is locatable. Mechanism, counterexample, implementation, metric and primary evidence still require review.

titleZh: 02 能力对比
titleEn: 02 Comparison
textZh: 能力 原理 优势 局限 / 陷阱 Exact 字段确定性匹配 快、稳定、可解释 不懂改写与同义；“精确”通常也需要规范化（E4307 / E-4307 / Error E 4307 → uppercase、去空格、连字符、alias） BM25 词法匹配 + 相关性排序 快、便宜、可解释、对稀有词敏感 不理解语义；“How can I get my money back?” vs “Refund and reimbursement policy” 词重合少则召回差； 不是主键查询 Dense Embedding 向量相似度 处理改写、发现词面不同但语义相近的内容 对编号 / 版本号不稳； cancel subscription 与 renew subscription 主题相近但动作相反 ；换模型需重建索引 Graph 实体关系遍历 多跳与影响分析：Supplier A → Material X → Product Y 需先建实体与关系；实体消歧与更新成本高 Metadata 属性过滤 降无关召回、防旧版本污染、多租户隔离、改善延迟成本 相关性过滤过严会漏召回；Tenant / ACL 授权约束不能为召回率让步
textEn: Capability Principle Strengths Limitations / Traps Exact Deterministic field matching Fast, stable, and explainable Does not understand paraphrases or synonyms; “exact” matching usually still requires normalization (E4307 / E-4307 / Error E 4307 → uppercase, remove spaces, normalize hyphens, alias mapping) BM25 Lexical matching + relevance ranking Fast, cheap, explainable, and sensitive to rare terms Does not understand semantics; “How can I get my money back?” vs “Refund and reimbursement policy” may have weak recall when lexical overlap is low; not a primary-key lookup Dense Embedding vector similarity Handles paraphrases and finds semantically similar content with different wording Unstable for identifiers / version numbers; cancel subscription and renew subscription are topically similar but semantically opposite in action ; changing the embedding model requires rebuilding the index Graph Entity-relation traversal Multi-hop and impact analysis: Supplier A → Material X → Product Y Requires entity/relation construction first; entity disambiguation and updates are costly Metadata Attribute filtering Reduces irrelevant recall, prevents stale-version contamination, isolates tenants, and improves latency/cost Overly strict relevance filters can hurt recall; tenant and ACL constraints must never be relaxed to improve recall

titleZh: 02 Permission-Aware RAG：三道有证据的面试题 §2.FDE
titleEn: 02 Permission-Aware RAG: three independently verified interview answers
textZh:
Permission-Aware RAG：三道有证据的面试题 §2.FDE 企业 RAG 最危险的失败未必是召回不足，而是越权读取。区分授权身份、候选集过滤、检索质量与数据权限更新。 SOURCE BOUNDARY 以下是根据 FDE 网站公开考点独立撰写的问题与答案，不是付费题目的官方答案。产品细节以链接的官方文档为准；设计建议属于 Handbook 综合判断。 Q1 · 如何确保 RAG 不泄漏其他租户的文档？  由可信服务验证身份并计算有效权限，在检索前约束合法候选集；授权通过后才能进入 rerank、LLM context、缓存与日志。模型不能自行决定谁有权限。  Trusted caller identity → policy/tenant scope
→ authorized retrieval candidates
→ authorized rerank → evidence → answer
→ tenant-scoped cache, redacted traces  风险 必须验证 混合租户文档 候选集、Prompt、日志全部不出现越权文档 旧 ACL / 共享缓存 撤权后缓存与源内容一致地拒绝访问 模型传入 tenant_id 请求身份不得由模型覆盖  核心判断 Security filter 是查询条件，不是认证机制。Azure 文档明确说明基于字符串的 security-trimming 不提供身份认证本身。  Q2 · 向量检索的 Pre-filter 与 Post-filter 哪个更可靠？  当用户只可见 1% 文档时，先全局 top-k 后过滤可能得到空结果，即使可访问集合内有答案。Pre-filter 可改善授权集合内召回，但高度选择性的过滤可能增加 ANN 遍历成本。  方法 效果与取舍 Pre-filter 合法候选集内检索；选择性高时成本上涨 Post-filter 先 ANN 后过滤；小 k 易漏掉合法相关文档 Strict post-filter（预览） 全局 top-k 后过滤；对高选择性权限风险最大  Q3 · 权限撤销之后如何防止旧索引仍然放行？  追踪源权限到索引的同步窗口，必要时在取回源文档时重新授权；建立撤权到拒绝的 SLO，并对缓存、异步任务和引用执行隔离。无法确认权限版本时对敏感资源 fail closed。  核心判断 最关键的回归测试：Alice 已撤权，搜索索引、缓存和下游工具都不能再次向她提供旧文档。  官方核验来源 : Azure document ACL · Security trimming · Vector filter modes · Hybrid override
textEn:
Permission-Aware RAG: three independently verified interview answers §2.FDE Enterprise RAG can fail through unauthorized reads before relevance failures. Separate trusted identity, candidate filtering, retrieval quality and permission propagation. SOURCE BOUNDARY These independently authored questions and answers derive from public FDE topics, not from any private paid answer. Platform facts follow first-party references; design advice is handbook synthesis. Q1 · How do you prevent cross-tenant RAG leakage?  Validate the caller with trusted identity infrastructure and constrain eligible documents before reranking, prompting, caching or logging. The LLM cannot grant access.  Trusted caller identity → policy/tenant scope
→ authorized retrieval candidates
→ authorized rerank → evidence → answer
→ tenant-scoped cache, redacted traces  Risk Test Mixed-tenant documents No forbidden material in candidates, prompt or logs Stale ACL / shared cache Revocation reflected in caches and source checks Model-supplied tenant_id Agent cannot override trusted tenant identity  Engineering rule A security filter is a query predicate, not authentication: Microsoft's string-based security trimming does not itself validate identity.  Q2 · What changes when you pre-filter versus post-filter vector search?  If a user can see 1% of the index, global top-k followed by filtering can return nothing despite a valid answer in the authorized subset. Prefiltering improves authorized recall but may increase ANN traversal cost.  Mode Consequence Pre-filter Search eligible corpus; selective predicates can cost more Post-filter ANN first; small k can miss permitted relevant documents Strict post-filter (preview) Filter global top-k; highest false-negative risk  Q3 · How do you handle source ACL revocation after indexing?  Measure source-to-index ACL sync lag and reauthorize document fetches where necessary. Define revocation-to-denial objectives covering caches, async jobs and citations; fail closed for sensitive content when policy freshness is unknown.  Engineering rule Critical regression: after Alice loses access, neither the index, cache nor downstream tool may return the revoked document.  Verified first-party sources : Azure document ACL · Security trimming · Vector filter modes · Hybrid override

titleZh: 02 Retrieval 的生产事实：Index、版本和授权
titleEn: 02 Production retrieval: index, versioning and authorization
textZh: Retrieval 的生产事实：Index、版本和授权 真正的企业检索失败通常发生在候选集、索引新鲜度和授权边界，而不只是 embedding 相似度。 FDE VERIFIED BOUNDARY · OCT 2026 根据公开考点独立撰写，不是会员答案。真实平台事实有链接来源；案例与门禁是设计建议，不代表实际客户测试。 Q40 · Vector Databases 向量索引用 ANN 找语义近邻，但精确订单号必须 SQL/Exact。向量近邻分数不能充当权限或事实证明。 失败/验收： 另一租户的高相似文档不能进入 reranker 或上下文。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ Q41 · Embedding Versions and Drift 文档编码器、Query 编码器、Chunker 和距离度量必须版本一致。同维向量不一定共享语义空间。 失败/验收： Shadow index 对比授权 Recall@k，回滚时同时切换编码器与索引。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ Q42 · Index Freshness and Staleness Windows 区分 Source Commit、CDC、Embedding、Index Visible 与 Cache Invalidated。撤销权限和内容新鲜度是不同 SLI。 失败/验收： 检索后、获取段落前撤权：必须 Fail Closed 或重新验证源权限。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ Q43 · ColBERT Late Interaction ColBERT 让 Query 与 Document 的 Token 表示在后段按 MaxSim 交互，保留细粒度匹配，但索引/计算比单向量方案更复杂。 失败/验收： 只在术语/关系召回困难时测试增益；比较 index 大小、nDCG 与查询 p95。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ 不能把术语命中当掌握 审计表中的 H 只表示此考点能在所属章节定位。还需逐项检查机制、反例、实现、指标与一手证据。
textEn: Production retrieval: index, versioning and authorization Enterprise retrieval often fails at candidate eligibility, index freshness or authorization before model relevance. FDE VERIFIED BOUNDARY · OCT 2026 Independently written from public topic names, not membership answers. Provider facts link to first-party references; examples and gates are engineering proposals, not customer tests. Q40 · Vector Databases Vector ANN finds semantic neighbors; exact order IDs need SQL/exact lookup. Similarity never proves authorization or business truth. Failure / acceptance: Ensure highly similar cross-tenant documents never reach reranker/context. Source / boundary ↗ Q41 · Embedding Versions and Drift Document and query encoders, chunking and metrics must be version-matched. Equal dimensions do not imply compatible embedding spaces. Failure / acceptance: Compare authorized Recall@k and switch both encoder and index on rollback. Source / boundary ↗ Q42 · Index Freshness and Staleness Windows Distinguish source commit, CDC, embedding, visible index and cache invalidation. Permission revocation is a distinct SLI from content freshness. Failure / acceptance: Revoke between retrieval and fetch; fail closed or reauthorize. Source / boundary ↗ Q43 · ColBERT Late Interaction ColBERT matches query/document token embeddings via late MaxSim interaction, preserving fine-grained terms with greater index and scoring cost. Failure / acceptance: Test only where terminology requires it; measure nDCG, index size and p95. Source / boundary ↗ Terminology is not mastery H in the curriculum audit only means the topic is locatable. Mechanism, counterexample, implementation, metric and primary evidence still require review.

titleZh: 03 五步落地流程
titleEn: 03 Five-step Implementation Flow
textZh: 五步落地流程  FIG.3.1 混合检索流水线 STEP 1 Documents：Exact/Keyword 字段 · BM25 索引 · Dense 向量索引 · Graph 关系库 ① 双索引与字段设计 STEP 2 ② Query Analysis query_type · domain · entities · identifiers · time_scope · risk · required evidence STEP 3 ③ 权限与元数据过滤：Identity → Tenant / Role / ACL → Authorized Candidate Space NODE Exact Results NODE BM25 Results NODE Dense Results STEP 4 ④ Fusion（RRF）→ Reranker BM25 score = 12.6 与 cosine = 0.81 量纲不同，不能直接相加 → 按排名融合 STEP 5 ⑤ 评估 检索：Recall@K · Hit Rate@K · MRR · NDCG · Precision@K 系统：E2E correctness · Citation support · No-answer accuracy · Latency P50/P95 · Cost/query  90 秒核心表达 BM25 and dense retrieval are complementary rather than competing approaches. In enterprise RAG, I would combine exact lookup, lexical retrieval, and dense retrieval, apply permission and metadata filters, fuse the candidate lists using RRF or a learned ranker, and rerank the strongest candidates. The final design should be validated on a representative business evaluation set rather than chosen by intuition.
textEn: Five-step Implementation Flow  FIG.3.1 Hybrid Retrieval Pipeline STEP 1 Documents: Exact/Keyword fields · BM25 index · Dense vector index · Graph relationship store ① Dual Indexes and Field Design STEP 2 ② Query Analysis query_type · domain · entities · identifiers · time_scope · risk · required evidence STEP 3 ③ Permission and Metadata Filtering: Identity → Tenant / Role / ACL → Authorized Candidate Space NODE Exact Results NODE BM25 Results NODE Dense Results STEP 4 ④ Fusion（RRF）→ Reranker BM25 score = 12.6 and cosine = 0.81 are on different scales and must not be added directly → fuse by rank STEP 5 ⑤ Evaluation Retrieval: Recall@K · Hit Rate@K · MRR · NDCG · Precision@K System: E2E correctness · Citation support · No-answer accuracy · Latency P50/P95 · Cost/query  90-second Core Answer BM25 and dense retrieval are complementary rather than competing approaches. In enterprise RAG, I would combine exact lookup, lexical retrieval, and dense retrieval, apply permission and metadata filters, fuse the candidate lists using RRF or a learned ranker, and rerank the strongest candidates. The final design should be validated on a representative business evaluation set rather than chosen by intuition.

titleZh: 03 Query Routing：让不同 Query 走最合适的路径 §3.3
titleEn: 03 Query Routing: Send Different Queries Down the Most Appropriate Path
textZh: Query Routing：让不同 Query 走最合适的路径 §3.3  Routing 解决的不是“系统支持多少种 Retriever”，而是： 当前请求需要什么证据、应该调用哪条数据路径、何时并行、何时澄清、何时停止。  低质量回答 “Exact、BM25、Dense、Graph 和数据库都跑一遍，再看哪个好。”——作为所有请求的默认策略，就没有体现 Query 类型差异、数据源边界、延迟成本预算、权限风险与恢复策略。  Query 类型 示例 首选路径 说明 精确标识符 WO-8827391 的进度 Exact field / DB lookup 主键、工单号、订单号优先做规范化后的确定性查询 关键词 / 术语 公司年假政策 BM25 + Metadata 固定术语、政策名称、稀有词适合词法检索 语义 / 流程 差旅费怎么报销？ Dense + BM25 fallback 需要理解改写、口语和同义表达 数值聚合 去年 12 月库存周转率 SQL / OLAP / Analytics 需要过滤、聚合和计算，不能靠向量相似度生成数值 关系 / 多跳 供应商 A 停产影响哪些产品？ Graph + 原文支持 沿实体关系或 BOM 链路展开 混合问题 WO-8827391 为什么还没完成？ Exact/DB + BM25/Dense 既要定位工单，又要理解状态原因 信息不足 “它现在怎么样？” Clarify 缺少实体或时间范围时先补齐输入，不盲目检索 非知识库闲聊 帮我润色这句话 Skip retrieval 不依赖企业事实可不检索； 企业事实查询不应随意绕过知识库  特别纠正 编号查询的首选通常 不是 BM25 ，而是 keyword/term query 或数据库精确查询。BM25 可以作为容错召回，但不是主键查询的替代品。  FIG.3.2 四层请求分流 STEP 1 Layer 1 · No Retrieval 翻译 · 改写 · 格式转换 · 普通闲聊 STEP 2 Layer 2 · Deterministic Retrieval Exact field · Database · SQL · Metadata STEP 3 Layer 3 · Knowledge Retrieval BM25 · Dense · Graph STEP 4 Layer 4 · Hybrid / Composed Retrieval 多路召回 · RRF · Reranker · 工具链组合 可跳过： 翻译、改写、格式转换、闲聊。 不应跳过： 公司政策、账户状态、实时库存、订单进度、合规结论。高风险问题即使模型“知道”，也应从权威来源取证。  FIG.3.3 Router 完整执行流程 STEP 1 User Query STEP 2 Query Analyzer Intent / Entity / Identifier / Time / Calculation / Risk STEP 3 Authorization + Capability Check STEP 4 Route Plan Exact | SQL | BM25 | Dense | Graph | Hybrid | Clarify | No Retrieval STEP 5 Retriever / Tool Execution STEP 6 Fusion + Reranking（when needed） STEP 7 Evidence Sufficiency + Answer Policy
textEn: Query Routing: Send Different Queries Down the Most Appropriate Path §3.3  Routing is not about “how many retrievers the system supports.” It answers: What evidence does the current request need, which data path should be called, when should paths run in parallel, when should the system clarify, and when should it stop?  Low-quality Answer “Run Exact, BM25, Dense, Graph, and the database every time, then choose the best.” As a default for all requests, this ignores query-type differences, data-source boundaries, latency/cost budgets, permission risks, and recovery strategies.  Query Type Example Preferred Path Explanation Exact Identifier Status of WO-8827391 Exact field / DB lookup For primary keys, work-order IDs, and order IDs, prefer normalized deterministic lookup Keyword / Terminology Company annual-leave policy BM25 + Metadata Fixed terminology, policy names, and rare terms are well suited to lexical retrieval Semantic / Process How do I reimburse travel expenses? Dense + BM25 fallback Requires understanding paraphrases, colloquial language, and synonyms Numerical Aggregation Inventory turnover last December SQL / OLAP / Analytics Requires filtering, aggregation, and calculation; vector similarity must not be used to invent the number Relationship / Multi-hop Which products are affected if Supplier A stops production? Graph + source-text support Expand along entity relationships or the BOM chain Hybrid Question Why is WO-8827391 still unfinished? Exact/DB + BM25/Dense Must both locate the work order and understand the reason for its status Insufficient Information “How is it doing now?” Clarify If the entity or time range is missing, complete the input first instead of retrieving blindly Non-knowledge-base Chitchat Please polish this sentence Skip retrieval Retrieval can be skipped when no enterprise facts are needed; queries about enterprise facts should not casually bypass the knowledge base  Important Correction For identifier queries, the preferred path is usually not BM25 , but a keyword/term query or exact database lookup. BM25 can be used as tolerant recall, but it is not a replacement for primary-key queries.  FIG.3.2 Four-layer Request Routing STEP 1 Layer 1 · No Retrieval translation · rewriting · format conversion · ordinary chitchat STEP 2 Layer 2 · Deterministic Retrieval Exact field · Database · SQL · Metadata STEP 3 Layer 3 · Knowledge Retrieval BM25 · Dense · Graph STEP 4 Layer 4 · Hybrid / Composed Retrieval multi-retriever recall · RRF · Reranker · tool-chain composition May skip retrieval: translation, rewriting, format conversion, chitchat. Must not skip retrieval: company policy, account status, real-time inventory, order progress, compliance conclusions. For high-risk questions, even if the model “knows,” evidence should come from an authoritative source.  FIG.3.3 Complete Router Execution Flow STEP 1 User Query STEP 2 Query Analyzer Intent / Entity / Identifier / Time / Calculation / Risk STEP 3 Authorization + Capability Check STEP 4 Route Plan Exact | SQL | BM25 | Dense | Graph | Hybrid | Clarify | No Retrieval STEP 5 Retriever / Tool Execution STEP 6 Fusion + Reranking（when needed） STEP 7 Evidence Sufficiency + Answer Policy

titleZh: 03 Router 的演进路径 从规则到持续训练
titleEn: 03 Router Evolution Path
textZh: Router 的演进路径 从规则到持续训练  S0 确定性解析 Regex · identifier parser · schema validation S1 规则路由 业务规则 · 关键词 · 字段存在性 · 风险条件 S2 轻量学习路由 Logistic Regression · 小分类器 · Embedding 原型 S3→S4 LLM Fallback + 反馈驱动 长尾 / 组合意图交 LLM；日志与人工纠错持续更新  推荐策略不是“一开始就上最复杂模型”：先统计真实 Query 分布 → 规则覆盖高频低歧义 → 小模型处理可学习边界 → LLM 只接低置信长尾 → 日志建训练集。“规则覆盖 80%”“20 条规则 + 误路由 >10% 再升级”是经验启发， 不是通用标准 。  EMB Embedding / 小模型 Router 优势 延迟低 · 成本稳定 · 适合高并发与固定意图集 · 原型样本快速冷启动 局限 组合意图难 · 新领域需更新样本 · 相似度 ≠ 业务可执行性 LLM LLM Router 优势 零样本与长尾理解强 · 能提取实体、约束、多步骤需求 · 适合复杂组合请求 局限 延迟成本高 · 输出需 Schema Validation · 仍可能选不存在 / 无权限 / 不适用的路径  常见生产组合 Rules / Exact Parser → Lightweight Router → LLM Fallback for ambiguous tail。
textEn: Router Evolution Path From Rules to Continuous Training  S0 Deterministic Parsing Regex · identifier parser · schema validation S1 Rule-based Routing business rules · keywords · field presence · risk conditions S2 Lightweight Learned Routing Logistic Regression · small classifier · embedding prototypes S3→S4 LLM Fallback + Feedback-driven Improvement Send long-tail / combined intents to the LLM; continuously update from logs and human corrections  The recommended strategy is not “start with the most complex model”: first measure the real Query distribution → cover frequent, low-ambiguity cases with rules → let a small model handle learnable boundaries → use the LLM only for low-confidence long-tail cases → build a training set from logs. Heuristics such as “rules cover 80%” or “upgrade after 20 rules + >10% misrouting” are practical examples, not universal standards 。  EMB Embedding / Small-model Router Strengths Low latency · stable cost · suitable for high concurrency and fixed intent sets · quick cold start from prototype examples Limitations Hard for combined intents · new domains require updated examples · similarity ≠ business executability LLM LLM Router Strengths Strong zero-shot and long-tail understanding · can extract entities, constraints, and multi-step needs · suitable for complex combined requests Limitations Higher latency/cost · outputs require Schema Validation · may still choose nonexistent / unauthorized / inapplicable paths  Common Production Combination Rules / Exact Parser → Lightweight Router → LLM Fallback for ambiguous tail。

titleZh: 03 路由失败与恢复
titleEn: 03 Routing Failure and Recovery
textZh: 路由失败与恢复  FIG.3.4 Router 不是单点真理，需要显式恢复链 STEP 1 Primary Route STEP 2 无可信候选 STEP 3 Query Rewrite / Alias 扩展 STEP 4 Secondary Route STEP 5 Hybrid Retrieval STEP 6 Clarify / Refuse / Escalate routing_failure 选错数据路径 retrieval_failure 路径对但没召回 data_failure 数据缺失/过期/无权限 generation_failure 证据对但生成错  EVAL 路由评估（不只测分类准确率） Router Top-1 / Top-K Accuracy · No-route / Clarify Accuracy · Identifier Extraction Accuracy · Per-route Recall@K 与 NDCG · Oracle-route Gap / Route Regret （当前 Router 与离线最佳可用路径差多少，比意图分类准确率更接近业务结果）· E2E Answer Correctness · Task Success · Fallback Rate · Latency P50/P95 · Cost/query · Unauthorized Route Rate CACHE 延迟、缓存与版本治理 为 Router 单独设 P50/P95 SLO；规则/小模型解决高频；LLM 只处理长尾；慢路径设 timeout + fallback。 Cache Key 至少包含： normalized_query · user/tenant/role · router_version · capability_registry_version · index_version · knowledge_snapshot。知识库或工具能力更新后需 TTL 或版本化失效。  项目映射 · 诚信边界 Bakery BI 的 router_agent.py + skill_loader.py 可证明你已有 小规模路由实践 （意图路由、Skill contract、fallback、数据依赖），但它不是大规模企业检索 Router；AutodidactAgent 的核心是 Case-Based Reasoning Retriever ，不应说成完整多路径 Query Router。  映射话术 I have implemented routing at a smaller application level and designed retrieval logic in a case-based agent. I have not yet operated a large production router across SQL, BM25, dense, and graph systems, but I understand how I would evolve and evaluate that architecture.  必背 Query routing is not about choosing the fanciest retriever. It is about selecting the cheapest reliable evidence path for the current request, while preserving a fallback when that decision is uncertain.  DECISION TREE · ROUTING MATRIX Query Routing：先判断证据形状，再选检索路径 ID ➜ Exact；语义 ➜ Hybrid；关系 ➜ Graph/Tool；信息不足 ➜ Clarify。 STRATEGY EVIDENCE SHAPE DECISION 4 BRANCHES CASE 1 EXACT ID 精确标识符？ 订单号 · VIN · 工单号 Exact / DB / Term Query YES ➜ 确定性匹配优先 CASE 2 SEMANTICS 自然语言语义？ 改写 · 同义词 · 流程问法 BM25 + Dense → Fusion → Rerank YES ➜ 词法与语义互补融合 CASE 3 RELATIONS 关系 / 聚合 / 实时数据？ 多跳 · SQL 聚合 · 实时库存 Graph / Database / Tool YES ➜ 相似度不替代真实计算 CASE 4 UNCERTAIN 输入信息是否足够？ 实体 · 时间 · 权限 · 风险 Clarify / Abstain / Escalate NO ➜ 不确定时不盲目检索 WHY : 不同证据形状需要不同检索能力。 GATE : 先判断证据需求，再选 Retriever。 FAILURE : “所有路径都走一遍”不是路由。  Retrieval Budget ≠ Context Budget 新增 · 2026-08-28 “召回 20 个文档，但 Context 放不下”不是简单把 TopK 调小，而是要把 召回广度、精排候选和最终上下文容量 拆成三个独立预算。 FIG.3.8 Retrieve Broadly → Rank Precisely → Pack by Token Budget STEP 1 Broad Retrieval K_retrieve · protect recall STEP 2 Filter + Dedup ACL · metadata · near-duplicate STEP 3 Rerank K_rerank · precision STEP 4 Coverage Selection diversity · MMR · sub-question coverage STEP 5 Context Packing K_context · explicit token budget
textEn: Routing Failure and Recovery  FIG.3.4 The router is not a single point of truth; it needs an explicit recovery chain STEP 1 Primary Route STEP 2 No trustworthy candidates STEP 3 Query Rewrite / Alias Expansion STEP 4 Secondary Route STEP 5 Hybrid Retrieval STEP 6 Clarify / Refuse / Escalate routing_failure: selected the wrong data path retrieval_failure: selected the right path but retrieved nothing useful data_failure: data is missing / stale / unauthorized generation_failure: evidence is correct but the generated answer is wrong  EVAL Routing Evaluation (not just classification accuracy) Router Top-1 / Top-K Accuracy · No-route / Clarify Accuracy · Identifier Extraction Accuracy · Per-route Recall@K and NDCG · Oracle-route Gap / Route Regret (how far the current Router is from the best available offline path; this is closer to business outcome than intent-classification accuracy) · E2E Answer Correctness · Task Success · Fallback Rate · Latency P50/P95 · Cost/query · Unauthorized Route Rate CACHE Latency, Caching, and Version Governance Give the Router its own P50/P95 SLO; use rules/small models for frequent cases; reserve the LLM for the long tail; give slow paths timeout + fallback. Cache Key should include at least: normalized_query · user/tenant/role · router_version · capability_registry_version · index_version · knowledge_snapshot. When the knowledge base or tool capabilities change, invalidate by TTL or version.  Project Mapping · Honesty Boundary Bakery BI’s router_agent.py + skill_loader.py can demonstrate that you already have small-scale routing experience (intent routing, Skill contracts, fallback, data dependencies), but it is not a large-scale enterprise retrieval Router; AutodidactAgent’s core is Case-Based Reasoning Retriever , so it should not be presented as a complete multi-path Query Router.  Mapping Script I have implemented routing at a smaller application level and designed retrieval logic in a case-based agent. I have not yet operated a large production router across SQL, BM25, dense, and graph systems, but I understand how I would evolve and evaluate that architecture.  Must Remember Query routing is not about choosing the fanciest retriever. It is about selecting the cheapest reliable evidence path for the current request, while preserving a fallback when that decision is uncertain.  DECISION TREE · ROUTING MATRIX Query Routing: Choose the Retrieval Path from Evidence Shape ID ➜ Exact; semantics ➜ Hybrid; relations ➜ Graph/Tool; missing info ➜ Clarify. STRATEGY EVIDENCE SHAPE DECISION 4 BRANCHES CASE 1 EXACT ID Exact identifier? Order ID · VIN · work order ID Exact / DB / Term Query YES ➜ Prefer deterministic matching CASE 2 SEMANTICS Natural-language semantics? Paraphrases · synonyms · process questions BM25 + Dense → Fusion → Rerank YES ➜ Fuse lexical and semantic retrieval CASE 3 RELATIONS Relationships / aggregation / real-time data? Multi-hop · SQL aggregation · real-time inventory Graph / Database / Tool YES ➜ Similarity does not replace actual computation CASE 4 UNCERTAIN Is the input sufficient? Entity · time · permissions · risk Clarify / Abstain / Escalate NO ➜ Do not retrieve blindly when uncertain WHY : Different evidence shapes require different retrieval capabilities. GATE : Determine evidence needs first, then choose the retriever. FAILURE : “Run every path” is not routing.  Retrieval Budget ≠ Context Budget New · 2026-08-28 “20 documents were retrieved, but the Context cannot fit them” is not solved by simply lowering TopK. You need to separate retrieval breadth, reranking candidates, and final context capacity into three independent budgets. FIG.3.8 Retrieve Broadly → Rank Precisely → Pack by Token Budget STEP 1 Broad Retrieval K_retrieve · protect recall STEP 2 Filter + Dedup ACL · metadata · near-duplicate STEP 3 Rerank K_rerank · precision STEP 4 Coverage Selection diversity · MMR · sub-question coverage STEP 5 Context Packing K_context · explicit token budget
