titleZh: 03 多轮 RAG：指代消解、会话状态与独立检索 Query §3.7
titleEn: 03 Conversational RAG: Referential resolution, state, and standalone retrieval queries
textZh: 多轮 RAG：指代消解、会话状态与独立检索 Query §3.7  “它”“这个”“第二条”这类表达对人类依赖会话即可理解，但对 Retriever 往往不是完整 Query。生产级多轮 RAG 不应把全部历史直接拼给检索器，而应先把会话转换成结构化状态，再恢复当前轮的独立检索语义。  FIG.3.7 · CONVERSATIONAL RETRIEVAL CONTROL 先恢复可检索语义，再做 Query Routing Referent Resolution 解决“当前 Query 到底在说谁/什么”；Router 再决定走 Exact、BM25、Dense、Hybrid 或 Tool。 1 User Turn + State 当前原始问句 + topic / entity / correction / constraints 2 Topic / Correction 保留兼容状态；失效旧 topic-scoped entities 3 Resolve Referent 把代词、省略、序号恢复成明确实体与约束 4 Standalone Query 生成专供检索使用的完整 Query，不替换用户原话 5 Route + Retrieve Exact · BM25 · Dense · Hybrid · Tool 6 Entity Validate 检查返回 Evidence 的 entity / version / department / policy 是否仍匹配  Failure 发生位置 典型表现 referent_resolution_failure Pre-retrieval “它 / 第二条”指错对象 state_staleness Conversation state 用户纠正或换题后，旧实体仍继续生效 rewrite_constraint_loss Query formation 改写漏掉部门、时间、产品、版本等关键约束 evidence_entity_mismatch Post-retrieval 目标是 Product B，却召回 Product A context_pollution Generation context 无关历史或旧前提干扰最终回答  CANONICAL RULE Conversation history is not retrieval state. 把对话压成明确的 topic / entity / constraint state，再从相关状态生成 standalone retrieval query。Topic switch 失效的是 topic-scoped working state，不是所有 Memory。  EVAL 不要只看最终 Answer。单独评估 Referent Accuracy、Standalone Query Constraint Recall、Target-document Recall@K、Topic-switch State Leakage Rate 和 Entity-mismatch Rate，才能定位问题发生在 state、rewrite、retrieval 还是 generation。  来源说明：本节依据用户提供的多轮 RAG 指代丢失工程总结整理。来源中的“轮次越多成本线性增长”被保留为实现风险，而不是固定成本公式；本手册另外补充 failure taxonomy、evaluation slices，以及与 Chapter 07 Working State / Context Compression 的边界。
textEn: Conversational RAG: Referential resolution, state, and standalone retrieval queries §3.7  Expressions such as ‘it’, ‘this’, or ‘the second one’ are easy for humans to resolve from conversation, but they are often incomplete retrieval queries. Production conversational RAG should convert conversation into structured state and reconstruct the current turn into standalone retrieval semantics before search, rather than indiscriminately concatenating the entire history.  FIG.3.7 · CONVERSATIONAL RETRIEVAL CONTROL Recover retrieval semantics before query routing Referent resolution determines what the current query is actually referring to; the router then chooses Exact, BM25, Dense, Hybrid, or a tool. 1 User Turn + State Raw turn + topic, entity, correction, and constraint state 2 Topic / Correction Retain compatible state; invalidate stale topic-scoped entities 3 Resolve Referent Resolve pronouns, ellipsis, and ordinal references into explicit entities and constraints 4 Standalone Query Create a complete retrieval-only query without replacing the user's original wording 5 Route + Retrieve Exact · BM25 · Dense · Hybrid · Tool 6 Entity Validate Verify that returned evidence still matches the resolved entity, version, department, and policy constraints  Failure Where it happens Typical symptom referent_resolution_failure Pre-retrieval ‘It / the second one’ resolves to the wrong object state_staleness Conversation state Old entities remain active after a correction or topic switch rewrite_constraint_loss Query formation Rewrite drops key department, time, product, or version constraints evidence_entity_mismatch Post-retrieval The target is Product B but the evidence belongs to Product A context_pollution Generation context Irrelevant history or stale premises pollute the final answer  CANONICAL RULE Conversation history is not retrieval state. Reduce conversation into explicit topic, entity, and constraint state, then form the standalone retrieval query from relevant state. A topic switch invalidates topic-scoped working state, not every kind of memory.  EVAL Do not evaluate only the final answer. Measure referent accuracy, standalone-query constraint recall, target-document Recall@K, topic-switch state leakage rate, and entity-mismatch rate so failures can be localized to state, rewrite, retrieval, or generation.  Source note: this section engineering-reframes the user-provided summary on referential loss in multi-turn RAG. The source's claim that cost grows linearly with turns is retained as an implementation risk rather than a fixed cost law; the handbook additionally adds a failure taxonomy, evaluation slices, and the boundary with Chapter 07 working state and context compression.

titleZh: 03 Query Rewriting、Expansion 和 HyDE：防止改写事实
titleEn: 03 Query rewriting, expansion and HyDE without changing facts
textZh: Query Rewriting、Expansion 和 HyDE：防止改写事实 Query 改写必须固定不变量。尤其在企业流程中，订单号、否定词和租户身份不允许因为语义改写丢失。 FDE VERIFIED BOUNDARY · OCT 2026 根据公开考点独立撰写，不是会员答案。真实平台事实有链接来源；案例与门禁是设计建议，不代表实际客户测试。 Q44 · Query Rewriting / Expansion / HyDE Rewrite 澄清省略语义，Expansion 补同义词，HyDE 生成假想文档的向量再检索真实语料；假想文档不能引用为证据。 失败/验收： 保证 order_id/否定语义保持不变，对比真正授权文档 Recall@k 与误召回。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ 不能把术语命中当掌握 审计表中的 H 只表示此考点能在所属章节定位。还需逐项检查机制、反例、实现、指标与一手证据。
textEn: Query rewriting, expansion and HyDE without changing facts Query rewriting must preserve invariants: IDs, negation and trusted scope cannot be lost. FDE VERIFIED BOUNDARY · OCT 2026 Independently written from public topic names, not membership answers. Provider facts link to first-party references; examples and gates are engineering proposals, not customer tests. Q44 · Query Rewriting / Expansion / HyDE Rewriting resolves ellipsis; expansion adds variants; HyDE embeds a hypothetical passage to retrieve real evidence. Hypothetical text is not citeable evidence. Failure / acceptance: Preserve exact IDs/negation and compare authorized recall and false positives. Source / boundary ↗ Terminology is not mastery H in the curriculum audit only means the topic is locatable. Mechanism, counterexample, implementation, metric and primary evidence still require review.

titleZh: 04 Threshold 怎么设
titleEn: 04 How to Set the Threshold

titleZh: 04 关键指标与权衡
titleEn: 04 Key Metrics and Trade-offs
textZh: 关键指标与权衡  Coverage Selective Risk Unsafe Answer Rate False Refusal Rate Citation Correctness Citation Completeness Conflict Detection Rate Evidence Sufficiency Accuracy  Risk–Coverage Curve 拒答更多会降低覆盖率，但只有优先拒绝错误答案才可能降低选择性风险。因此要实测 风险-覆盖曲线 ，而不是单点准确率。  高质量拒答模板 I could not find sufficient evidence in the approved knowledge sources to answer this reliably. I found general information about the process, but not the specific threshold you asked about. Please provide the relevant policy version or ask an authorized expert to confirm it. 包含：找到什么 · 缺少什么 · 为什么不能回答 · 下一步。但 不能泄漏 “存在某个你无权访问的敏感文件”。
textEn: Key Metrics and Trade-offs  Coverage Selective Risk Unsafe Answer Rate False Refusal Rate Citation Correctness Citation Completeness Conflict Detection Rate Evidence Sufficiency Accuracy  Risk–Coverage Curve More refusals reduce coverage, but selective risk falls only if the policy preferentially rejects wrong answers. Measure the risk–coverage curve , not a single accuracy point.  High-quality Refusal Template I could not find sufficient evidence in the approved knowledge sources to answer this reliably. I found general information about the process, but not the specific threshold you asked about. Please provide the relevant policy version or ask an authorized expert to confirm it. Include: what was found · what is missing · why the system cannot answer · the next step. But must not reveal “there is a sensitive file you are not authorized to access.”

titleZh: 05 第一层 · Parsing：先分类，再选解析路径
titleEn: 05 Layer 1 · Parsing: Classify First, Then Choose the Parsing Path
textZh: 第一层 · Parsing：先分类，再选解析路径  NATIVE 原生文本 PDF 直接读取 text span · font · bounding box · page coordinate · reading order candidate。 重点：保留位置和版式信息 ，为结构恢复提供依据。 SCAN 扫描件 PDF 本质是图片容器，需 OCR 输出：识别文本 · bbox · confidence · 页旋转 · 语言。低置信区域不能悄悄入库：重新识别 / 换模型 / 标低质量证据 / 人工复核。 MIXED 图文混排 PDF Layout parser + 图/图表抽取 + Vision-language 理解。输出不应只是“这是一张图”，而应形成可检索语义： “Figure 4 shows an approval workflow: request → manager review → finance review → payment release.”  核心原则 Choose the extraction method by document and page type; do not force every PDF through one parser.
textEn: Layer 1 · Parsing: Classify First, Then Choose the Parsing Path  NATIVE Native-text PDF Directly extract text span · font · bounding box · page coordinate · reading-order candidates. Focus: preserve positional and layout information to support structure reconstruction. SCAN Scanned PDF Essentially an image container; OCR should output recognized text · bbox · confidence · page rotation · language. Low-confidence regions must not silently enter the index: re-recognize / switch models / mark as low-quality evidence / send for human review. MIXED Mixed text-and-image PDF Use a layout parser + image/chart extraction + vision-language understanding. The output should not merely say “this is an image”; it should produce retrievable semantics: “Figure 4 shows an approval workflow: request → manager review → finance review → payment release.”  Core Principle Choose the extraction method by document and page type; do not force every PDF through one parser.

titleZh: 05 第二层 · Structure Reconstruction：恢复文档语义
titleEn: 05 Layer 2 · Structure Reconstruction: Recover Document Semantics
textZh:
第二层 · Structure Reconstruction：恢复文档语义  FIG.5.2 结构树 + 定位基因 Document
 ├── Chapter
 │    ├── Section
 │    │    ├── Paragraph
 │    │    ├── Table
 │    │    └── Figure
 │    └── Footnote
 └── Appendix

 每个信息点携带“定位基因”：
 document_id · page · section_path
 paragraph_id · table_id · figure_id
 bounding_box 多栏阅读顺序： 按页面对象顺序抽取会出现“左栏一段 → 右栏一段”交错，必须恢复列、块与正确阅读顺序，并把标题层级附着到正文。 页眉页脚： 跨页重复模式识别后删除正文副本，或保留为专门 metadata，避免反复进入 Embedding。 表格： 恢复 row / column / header / merged cell / unit / caption / 跨页续表关系，存为 Markdown / CSV / JSON / DB 行，支持精确查询、范围过滤、数值比较、聚合。 图像： 绑定 figure number · caption · 周围段落 · page · section · vision 描述。 必背 Structure reconstruction turns page objects into traceable document semantics.
textEn:
Layer 2 · Structure Reconstruction: Recover Document Semantics  FIG.5.2 Structure Tree + Location Metadata Document
 ├── Chapter
 │    ├── Section
 │    │    ├── Paragraph
 │    │    ├── Table
 │    │    └── Figure
 │    └── Footnote
 └── Appendix

 Each information unit carries “location metadata”:
 document_id · page · section_path
 paragraph_id · table_id · figure_id
 bounding_box Multi-column Reading Order: Extracting by raw page-object order can interleave “left-column paragraph → right-column paragraph.” Recover columns, blocks, and correct reading order, and attach title hierarchy to body text. Headers and Footers: Detect repeated cross-page patterns and remove their body-text duplicates, or retain them only as dedicated metadata so they do not repeatedly enter embeddings. Tables: Recover row / column / header / merged cell / unit / caption / cross-page continuation relationships. Store as Markdown / CSV / JSON / DB rows to support exact queries, range filters, numerical comparisons, and aggregation. Images: Bind figure number · caption · surrounding paragraphs · page · section · vision description. Must Remember Structure reconstruction turns page objects into traceable document semantics.

titleZh: 05 第三层 · Semantic Chunking 与 Hybrid Index
titleEn: 05 Layer 3 · Semantic Chunking and Hybrid Index
textZh: 第三层 · Semantic Chunking 与 Hybrid Index  CHUNK 结构感知切片规则 同一标题下连续段落 → 一个或多个语义 chunk · 完整条款尽量保持完整 · 完整表格单独结构化 · 图 + caption + 描述绑定为 figure chunk · 超长章节在子标题/段落边界继续切。 权衡： 过小 → 缺上下文、检索碎片化；过大 → 召回不精确、上下文成本高。 Contextual Enrichment 孤立 chunk “Revenue decreased by 12%.” → 补充短上下文（来自第 3 章 Currency Risk，描述 2025 财年汇率影响）。 原文与模型生成的上下文必须分开存储 ，避免把生成摘要误当原始证据。 信息类型 索引路径 自然语言段落 Dense + BM25 合同条款与术语 BM25 + Dense 编号、日期、版本 Exact / Keyword fields 结构化表格 SQL / 结构化存储 + lexical 章节、页码、权限 Metadata filter 跨实体关系 Optional graph index  { "document_id" : "policy-2026-de" , "page" : 17 , "section_path" : [ "3 Risk Factors" , "3.2 Currency Risk" ], "content_type" : "paragraph" , "language" : "en" , "version" : "2026" , "valid_from" : "2026-01-01" , "access_scope" : "finance-eu" }  核心原则 Do not embed everything in the same way. Index according to the information type and the expected query operation.
textEn: Layer 3 · Semantic Chunking and Hybrid Index  CHUNK Structure-aware Chunking Rules Continuous paragraphs under the same heading → one or more semantic chunks · keep complete clauses together when possible · store complete tables separately in structured form · bind image + caption + description as a figure chunk · split very long sections again at subheading/paragraph boundaries. Trade-off: Too small → missing context and fragmented retrieval; too large → imprecise recall and higher context cost. Contextual Enrichment For an isolated chunk “Revenue decreased by 12%.” → add a short context prefix (from Chapter 3 Currency Risk, describing the FX impact in fiscal year 2025). Store source text separately from model-generated context to avoid treating generated summaries as original evidence. Information Type Indexing Path Natural-language paragraphs Dense + BM25 Contract clauses and terminology BM25 + Dense Identifiers, dates, versions Exact / Keyword fields Structured tables SQL / structured storage + lexical retrieval Sections, pages, permissions Metadata filter Cross-entity relationships Optional graph index  { "document_id" : "policy-2026-de" , "page" : 17 , "section_path" : [ "3 Risk Factors" , "3.2 Currency Risk" ], "content_type" : "paragraph" , "language" : "en" , "version" : "2026" , "valid_from" : "2026-01-01" , "access_scope" : "finance-eu" }  Core Principle Do not embed everything in the same way. Index according to the information type and the expected query operation.

titleZh: 05 第四层 · Agent Tool Chain：按需翻阅
titleEn: 05 Layer 4 · Agent Tool Chain: Read on Demand
textZh: 第四层 · Agent Tool Chain：按需翻阅  FIG.5.3 受控工具执行过程 STEP 1 分析问题需要哪些证据 STEP 2 search_pdf(query, filters) STEP 3 read_page / read_section STEP 4 extract_table / analyze_chart STEP 5 quote_source(chunk_id) STEP 6 生成答案 → Claim Verification 好处： 上下文更小成本更低 · 工具调用可记录可重放 · 表格图表由专门工具处理 · 证据不足时可继续翻页 · 每步可定位失败原因。 约束： input schema · permission checks · maximum calls · allowed scope · timeout · logging · idempotency。  必背 The agent decides what evidence it needs; deterministic document tools control how that evidence is retrieved.
textEn: Layer 4 · Agent Tool Chain: Read on Demand  FIG.5.3 Controlled Tool Execution Flow STEP 1 Analyze what evidence the question requires STEP 2 search_pdf(query, filters) STEP 3 read_page / read_section STEP 4 extract_table / analyze_chart STEP 5 quote_source(chunk_id) STEP 6 Generate Answer → Claim Verification Benefits: Smaller context and lower cost · tool calls are logged and replayable · tables/charts use specialized tools · when evidence is insufficient, the agent can continue reading · each step exposes the failure point. Constraints: input schema · permission checks · maximum calls · allowed scope · timeout · logging · idempotency。  Must Remember The agent decides what evidence it needs; deterministic document tools control how that evidence is retrieved.

titleZh: 05 底线一 · Page-level Citations 与 Claim Verification
titleEn: 05 Hard Requirement 1 · Page-level Citations and Claim Verification
textZh: 底线一 · Page-level Citations 与 Claim Verification  FIG.5.4 引用校验流程 STEP 1 Draft answer STEP 2 Extract claims STEP 3 Match each claim to evidence STEP 4 Check entailment & scope STEP 5 Remove / qualify / refuse 无支持 claim 例：文档只说 “The policy may be reviewed annually.” ，系统不能扩写为 “The policy is updated every year.” 。 Citation correctness （引用是否真的支持 Claim）＋ Citation completeness （所有关键 Claim 是否都有引用）。合同、财报、风控、合规场景，缺页码和原文证据的答案不应视为完成。
textEn: Hard Requirement 1 · Page-level Citations and Claim Verification  FIG.5.4 Citation Validation Flow STEP 1 Draft answer STEP 2 Extract claims STEP 3 Match each claim to evidence STEP 4 Check entailment & scope STEP 5 Remove / qualify / refuse unsupported claims Example: if the document only says “The policy may be reviewed annually.” , the system must not expand it into “The policy is updated every year.” 。 Citation correctness (does the citation actually entail the Claim?) + Citation completeness (do all key Claims have citations?). In contracts, financial reports, risk control, and compliance, an answer without page numbers and source evidence should not be considered complete.

titleZh: 05 底线二 · 分层评测闭环
titleEn: 05 Hard Requirement 2 · Layered Evaluation Loop
textZh: 底线二 · 分层评测闭环  层 指标 Parsing OCR Character / Word Error Rate · OCR confidence coverage · Reading-order accuracy · Page classification accuracy Structure Heading hierarchy accuracy · Table cell accuracy · Header/footer removal accuracy · Figure-caption association accuracy Retrieval Page Recall@K · Chunk Recall@K · Table Retrieval Recall · MRR / NDCG · Metadata-filter correctness Evidence & Answer Evidence sufficiency accuracy · Citation correctness / completeness · Answer correctness · False refusal rate · Unsafe answer rate  FIG.5.5 错误诊断树：答案错误 → 失败在哪一层？ 正确页面没进索引 → Parsing / ingestion failure 页面存在但没被召回 → Retrieval failure 召回正确但表格解析错 → Structure / table failure 证据正确但结论超原文 → Generation / verification failure 证据不足仍回答 → Decision-policy failure  必背 A production evaluation should tell us which stage failed, not only that the final answer was wrong.  权限、版本与生命周期 Tenant isolation · Document-level ACL · Page/section 限制 · Version validity · Superseded 文档 · Retention/deletion · Index refresh · Audit trail。权限过滤尽量发生在 检索前 ，返回前再校验一次。版本冲突结合 valid_from/valid_to · supersedes · region · BU · source authority；仍无法确认有效版本 → 明确拒答或升级，而不是随机选一篇相关文档。  90 秒英文答案（见第 11 章 · 可复制） A production PDF RAG system is more than text extraction followed by embeddings. I would design it as a four-layer document-intelligence pipeline… Every important claim must be supported by a page-level citation. 完整版在 。  诚信映射 不应声称已完整上线生产级 PDF RAG。可说： “My direct experience is stronger in retrieval workflows, case-based reasoning, validation, fallback logic, structured artifacts, and tool-oriented agent systems. I understand how those principles extend to PDF RAG: parsing and structure recovery must be separated from retrieval, evidence must preserve provenance, and the agent should use controlled tools rather than treating the whole document as one prompt.”
textEn: Hard Requirement 2 · Layered Evaluation Loop  Layer Metric Parsing OCR Character / Word Error Rate · OCR confidence coverage · Reading-order accuracy · Page classification accuracy Structure Heading hierarchy accuracy · Table cell accuracy · Header/footer removal accuracy · Figure-caption association accuracy Retrieval Page Recall@K · Chunk Recall@K · Table Retrieval Recall · MRR / NDCG · Metadata-filter correctness Evidence & Answer Evidence sufficiency accuracy · Citation correctness / completeness · Answer correctness · False refusal rate · Unsafe answer rate  FIG.5.5 Failure Diagnosis Tree: wrong answer → which layer failed? The correct page never entered the index → Parsing / ingestion failure The page exists but was not retrieved → Retrieval failure The correct evidence was retrieved but the table was parsed incorrectly → Structure / table failure The evidence is correct but the conclusion exceeds the source text → Generation / verification failure The system answered despite insufficient evidence → Decision-policy failure  Must Remember A production evaluation should tell us which stage failed, not only that the final answer was wrong.  Permissions, Versions, and Lifecycle Tenant isolation · Document-level ACL · Page/section restrictions · Version validity · Superseded documents · Retention/deletion · Index refresh · Audit trail. Permission filtering should happen as early as possible, ideally before retrieval , with another validation before returning the result. Resolve version conflicts using valid_from/valid_to · supersedes · region · BU · source authority; if the valid version still cannot be determined → explicitly refuse or escalate instead of randomly choosing a related document.  90-second English Answer (see Chapter 11 · copyable) A production PDF RAG system is more than text extraction followed by embeddings. I would design it as a four-layer document-intelligence pipeline… Every important claim must be supported by a page-level citation. Full version in 。  Honest Project Mapping Do not claim that you have already deployed a complete production-grade PDF RAG system. You can say: “My direct experience is stronger in retrieval workflows, case-based reasoning, validation, fallback logic, structured artifacts, and tool-oriented agent systems. I understand how those principles extend to PDF RAG: parsing and structure recovery must be separated from retrieval, evidence must preserve provenance, and the agent should use controlled tools rather than treating the whole document as one prompt.”

titleZh: 05 Grounded Document Agent：从 PDF 检索到可验证证据链 §5.Y
titleEn: 05 Grounded Document Agent: From PDF retrieval to a verifiable evidence chain
textZh: Grounded Document Agent：从 PDF 检索到可验证证据链 §5.Y  长文档问答的目标不只是找到相似文本，而是让每个回答都能沿着 Evidence Chunk → Page / Section → Source Document 反向追溯。公开项目示例使用 LlamaParse 解析长 PDF，并让本地 Ollama 模型完成检索与回答，同时返回精确页面引用；生产系统应在这个基础上继续补齐证据充分性判断、引用校验与拒答边界。  FIG.5.Y Grounded Document Agent = provenance-preserving retrieval + support gate + citation verification 解析质量决定检索上限；Grounding 质量取决于答案是否被原始证据真正支持，而不是页面上是否出现了一个 citation 字符串。 1 · PARSE 结构化解析，而不是只抽纯文本 尽量保留 page boundary、heading hierarchy、table、figure、reading order 与可定位的 layout metadata。 2 · INDEX Chunk 不能切断 provenance 每个 EvidenceChunk 至少携带 document_id、page、section、chunk_id 与 parser provenance；布局敏感任务再保留 bbox / element metadata。 3 · RETRIEVE 检索 Evidence Bundle，而不是孤立相似片段 查询可组合 semantic retrieval、keyword / metadata filter、reranking，并在需要时读取相邻页或同一 section 的连续上下文。 4 · SUPPORT GATE 先判断证据够不够，再决定是否回答 不足时应扩展检索、重写 query、检查相邻 section，或者直接 abstain；不要把“检索到了东西”误当成“足够支持答案”。 5 · ANSWER 只基于当前 Evidence Bundle 生成 回答中的关键 claim 应映射回一个或多个 source span，并携带 page / section citation。 6 · VERIFY 验证 claim ↔ evidence，而不是只验证 citation 存在 Citation Presence 只是第一层；更重要的是 Citation Correctness 与 Claim–Evidence Entailment。失败时修复回答、重新检索或拒答。  GROUNDING CONTRACT Citation Presence ≠ Citation Correctness。页面号存在，只能证明系统打印了引用；真正的可靠性要求引用页面支持对应 claim，并且用户能够回到原文验证。 PARSING CEILING Document QA quality ≈ Parsing × Retrieval × Evidence Selection × Generation × Citation Verification。解析阶段把表格、阅读顺序或页边界破坏之后，后面的 embedding 与 LLM 很难恢复原始语义。
textEn: Grounded Document Agent: From PDF retrieval to a verifiable evidence chain §5.Y  The goal of long-document QA is not merely to find similar text, but to make every answer traceable through Evidence Chunk → Page / Section → Source Document. The public project example uses LlamaParse to parse long PDFs and local Ollama models for retrieval and answering while returning exact page citations; a production system should extend this with evidence-sufficiency checks, citation validation, and abstention boundaries.  FIG.5.Y Grounded Document Agent = provenance-preserving retrieval + support gate + citation verification Parsing quality sets the upper bound for retrieval. Grounding quality depends on whether the answer is actually supported by source evidence, not whether a citation string merely appears beside it. 1 · PARSE Parse structure, not just plain text Preserve page boundaries, heading hierarchy, tables, figures, reading order, and locatable layout metadata whenever possible. 2 · INDEX Chunking must preserve provenance Each EvidenceChunk should carry at least document_id, page, section, chunk_id, and parser provenance; layout-sensitive tasks should also keep bbox or element metadata. 3 · RETRIEVE Retrieve an evidence bundle, not isolated similar fragments A query may combine semantic retrieval, keyword or metadata filters, reranking, and neighboring-page or same-section context when continuity matters. 4 · SUPPORT GATE Judge evidence sufficiency before deciding to answer If support is insufficient, expand retrieval, rewrite the query, inspect neighboring sections, or abstain. Do not confuse 'something was retrieved' with 'the answer is supported.' 5 · ANSWER Generate only from the current evidence bundle Each material claim should map back to one or more source spans and carry page or section citations. 6 · VERIFY Verify claim ↔ evidence, not merely citation presence Citation Presence is only the first layer. More important are Citation Correctness and Claim–Evidence Entailment. On failure, repair the answer, retrieve again, or abstain.  GROUNDING CONTRACT Citation Presence ≠ Citation Correctness. A page number only proves that the system printed a citation; reliability requires the cited source to support the corresponding claim and to remain inspectable by the user. PARSING CEILING Document QA quality ≈ Parsing × Retrieval × Evidence Selection × Generation × Citation Verification. Once parsing destroys table structure, reading order, or page boundaries, stronger embeddings and LLMs usually cannot reconstruct the original semantics reliably.

titleZh: 05 EvidenceChunk：把 provenance 当成一等数据
titleEn: 05 EvidenceChunk: Treat provenance as first-class data
textZh: EvidenceChunk：把 provenance 当成一等数据  Field 为什么需要 生产用途 document_id 区分来源与版本 权限、去重、更新与 lineage page / section 保留人类可验证的位置 页面引用、邻页扩展与 section-aware retrieval chunk_id 为证据建立稳定标识 缓存、评估、回放与错误分析 bbox / element 保留视觉文档的局部位置 表格、图像、highlight 与 multimodal verification parser_provenance 知道文本是如何被解析出来的 parser regression、版本比较与重建索引 retrieval_score 记录为何进入 Evidence Bundle threshold、reranking、eval 与 failure analysis  AGENTIC BOUNDARY 普通 RAG 可以是一次 retrieve → generate；Agentic Document QA 的价值从“检索变成决策过程”开始：系统根据当前证据决定继续检索、扩大范围、查看相邻页面、重写查询或拒答。这个循环应保持 bounded，并把停止条件、最大检索轮数和权限边界写清楚。  FAIL 常见错误：把 citation 当装饰 只检查“有没有 [Page 17]”会放过错误引用。更可靠的评估单位是 claim：每个关键 claim 是否有匹配 evidence，evidence 是否真的蕴含该 claim。 GATE 正确边界：证据不足时允许不回答 Grounded system 的目标不是最大化 answer rate，而是最大化 supported answer rate。证据不足时 abstain，是可靠性机制，不是失败。  SOURCE / SCOPE 来源示例：AI Engineering 的 Hands-On: Build a Grounded Document Agent。公开项目说明确认了 long-PDF QA、LlamaParse、Ollama 与精确页面引用。上面的 support gate、claim–evidence verification、bounded re-retrieval 与 abstention 是本手册基于生产 RAG / Agent reliability 原则做的工程化扩展，而不是对原教程逐句复述。 AI Engineering source .  相关章节：证据不足时的选择性回答与拒答见 Chapter 04；bounded agent loop、停止条件与恢复边界见 Chapter 08。 Ch.04 · Ch.08
textEn: EvidenceChunk: Treat provenance as first-class data  Field Why it matters Production use document_id Distinguishes source and version Permissions, deduplication, updates, and lineage page / section Preserves a human-verifiable location Page citations, neighboring-page expansion, and section-aware retrieval chunk_id Creates a stable evidence identifier Caching, evaluation, replay, and error analysis bbox / element Preserves local position in visual documents Tables, figures, highlights, and multimodal verification parser_provenance Records how the text was produced Parser regression analysis, version comparison, and index rebuilds retrieval_score Records why the chunk entered the evidence bundle Thresholding, reranking, evals, and failure analysis  AGENTIC BOUNDARY Ordinary RAG may be a single retrieve → generate pass. Agentic Document QA begins when retrieval becomes a decision process: the system uses current evidence to decide whether to retrieve again, widen scope, inspect neighboring pages, rewrite the query, or abstain. Keep this loop bounded, with explicit stopping conditions, retrieval limits, and permission boundaries.  FAIL Common failure: treating citations as decoration Checking only whether '[Page 17]' exists will miss incorrect citations. A better evaluation unit is the claim: does every material claim have matching evidence, and does that evidence actually entail the claim? GATE Correct boundary: allow no-answer when evidence is insufficient A grounded system should not maximize answer rate; it should maximize supported answer rate. Abstaining when evidence is insufficient is a reliability mechanism, not a failure.  SOURCE / SCOPE Source example: AI Engineering's Hands-On: Build a Grounded Document Agent. The public project description confirms long-PDF QA, LlamaParse, Ollama, and exact page citations. The support gate, claim–evidence verification, bounded re-retrieval, and abstention above are handbook production extensions based on RAG and agent reliability principles rather than a line-by-line restatement of the tutorial. AI Engineering source .  Related chapters: see Chapter 04 for selective answering and abstention under insufficient evidence, and Chapter 08 for bounded agent loops, stopping conditions, and recovery boundaries. Ch.04 · Ch.08

titleZh: 06 Capability Architecture：Skill、Workflow、MCP 与 Tool 各自在哪一层 §6.A
titleEn: 06 Capability Architecture: where Skill, Workflow, MCP, and Tools belong
textZh: Capability Architecture：Skill、Workflow、MCP 与 Tool 各自在哪一层 §6.A  这一章不只是“如何选 Skill”。生产系统还要区分能力契约、控制流程、协议接入和真实副作用执行；否则很容易把 Skill、MCP、Function Calling 和 Tool 混成同一层。  FIG.6.A1 · CAPABILITY ARCHITECTURE 从业务意图到真实执行：五层能力栈 上层决定“应该做什么”，下层负责“通过什么协议、由谁真正执行”；授权与验证贯穿边界。 LAYER 1 Business Goal / User Intent 目标、风险、当前状态、用户权限决定需要哪类能力。 LAYER 2 Skill Contract / Capability Registry when_to_use · when_not_to_use · inputs/outputs · permission · risk · owner · version LAYER 3 Workflow / State Machine / Policy Gate 决定执行顺序、缺失输入、审批、重试、停止和恢复；Skill 不等于一个裸 Tool Call。 LAYER 4 MCP / Function Calling / API Interface 负责 capability exposure、schema、discovery、transport 或 structured action proposal；它们不是最终业务授权。 LAYER 5 Host Execution → Tool / API / DB / Service Host 做 schema validation、authorization、idempotency、timeout、logging，并承担真实副作用。 边界原则 Protocol exposes capabilities; Skill defines reusable task procedure; Workflow controls execution; Host owns authority and side effects.
textEn: Capability Architecture: where Skill, Workflow, MCP, and Tools belong §6.A  This chapter is not only about selecting a Skill. A production system must separate capability contracts, control flow, protocol access, and real side-effect execution; otherwise Skill, MCP, function calling, and tools collapse into one ambiguous layer.  FIG.6.A1 · CAPABILITY ARCHITECTURE From business intent to real execution: a five-layer capability stack Upper layers decide what should be done; lower layers define how capability access is exposed and who actually executes it. Authorization and validation cross every boundary. LAYER 1 Business Goal / User Intent Goal, risk, current state, and user permissions determine which capability is needed. LAYER 2 Skill Contract / Capability Registry when_to_use · when_not_to_use · inputs/outputs · permission · risk · owner · version LAYER 3 Workflow / State Machine / Policy Gate Controls execution order, missing inputs, approvals, retries, stopping, and recovery. A Skill is not a raw tool call. LAYER 4 MCP / Function Calling / API Interface Provides capability exposure, schemas, discovery, transport, or structured action proposals; these are not the final business-authorization decision. LAYER 5 Host Execution → Tool / API / DB / Service The host performs schema validation, authorization, idempotency, timeouts, and logging, and owns real side effects. Boundary rule Protocol exposes capabilities; Skill defines reusable task procedure; Workflow controls execution; Host owns authority and side effects.

titleZh: 06 Soft Hierarchical Routing 与两阶段路由
titleEn: 06 Soft Hierarchical Routing and Two-stage Routing
textZh: Soft Hierarchical Routing 与两阶段路由  HIER Domain → Capability → Operation → Version 不要第一层只选一个 Domain——上层误判会让正确 Skill 永远不可见。 保留 Top-M Domains： {"domains":[{"name":"data_science","score":0.78},{"name":"engineering","score":0.74}]} Hierarchy should reduce the search space without creating an irreversible early decision.  FIG.6.1 两阶段路由 STEP 1 User Request STEP 2 候选生成：Exact / BM25 / Dense / Tags STEP 3 Candidate Fusion → Permission / Availability Filter STEP 4 Reranker 不只看 Query↔Description，还看：current goal · task state · available/missing inputs · permission · risk · cost · recent tool results STEP 5 Decision Gate DIRECT_SKILL · MULTI_SKILL_PLAN · CLARIFY · NO_MATCH · APPROVAL_REQUIRED · REJECT  必背 A router that always returns a skill is not reliable. 一个可靠 Router 必须允许 No Match ，否则它做的是强制分类。  FIG.6.2 Skill Match ≠ 授权：完整顺序 STEP 1 Intent STEP 2 Capability STEP 3 Candidate Skills STEP 4 Skill Match STEP 5 Permission STEP 6 Risk STEP 7 Input Validation STEP 8 Approval STEP 9 Execution Skill match is not authorization.  REG Skill Registry 与治理 保存：skill_id · version · domain · tags · input/output schema · when_to_use / when_not_to_use · examples · hard negatives · permissions · risk · owner · health · status · cost。 治理重叠： Merge · Deprecate · Rename · Narrow scope · Parameterize · Add negative boundaries。例：generate_daily/weekly/monthly_report → generate_periodic_report(period) 。 Prefer parameterized skills over duplicated skills. EVAL 路由评估与失败归因 Candidate Recall@K · Top-1 Routing Accuracy · MRR · No-Match Accuracy · Clarification Accuracy · Multi-Skill Planning Accuracy · Unauthorized Skill Exposure · E2E Task Success · Latency · Cost。 区分失败类型： Retriever / Reranker / Input / Execution / Tool Failure——选对 Skill 但 API 超时，是 Tool Failure，不是 Routing Failure。  MCP 与 Skill：协议层 vs 能力层 补强 MCP Skill 核心 标准化暴露/发现工具、资源与上下文 封装“如何完成一类任务”的可复用能力契约 关注点 连接、Schema、Discovery、Transport 适用边界、输入输出、流程、验证、版本 不负责 不天然保证业务授权、幂等、事务与任务成功 不天然定义跨进程/跨系统通信协议 工程上可以组合成： MCP 负责把能力可靠地“接进来”，Skill 负责描述什么时候以及怎样使用这项能力。 边界 Protocol exposes capabilities; skills encode reusable task procedures. Neither one replaces authorization, validation, or orchestration. FIG.6.3 · CAPABILITY STACK MCP / Skill / Workflow / Tool 能力分层架构 职责边界分层：业务目标 ➜ 可复用过程 ➜ 状态编排 ➜ 标准接入 ➜ 真正执行。 ARCHITECTURE 5-LAYER STACK LAYER 1 GOAL Business Goal 用户真正要完成的最终业务交付目标。 Outcome 01/05 LAYER 2 PROCEDURE Skill Contract 可复用的“如何解决一类任务”的标准能力包。 Procedure 02/05 LAYER 3 CONTROL Workflow FSM 状态机、执行顺序、重试、分支与终止条件。 Orchestrator 03/05 LAYER 4 ACCESS MCP Access 标准化工具发现、Schema 协议与连接接入。 Protocol 04/05 LAYER 5 EXECUTION Tool / API / DB 真正产生业务副作用或读取外部数据源。 Side Effects 05/05 PITFALL · MCP 不是 Agent MCP 解决“能力怎样接入”；不会自动完成规划、授权、回滚和任务评估。 PITFALL · Skill 不是 Prompt 成熟 Skill 还应包含触发条件、typed I/O、工具依赖、验证、失败行为与版本。 FIG.6.4 · EXECUTION CONTRACT Function Calling：模型提议，Host 执行（受控执行契约闭环） Function calling 是结构化 action proposal，不是授权系统。权限、超时、重试、参数校验与副作用状态对齐由 Host 控制。 CONTRACT 7 STEPS SECURITY HOST GATE 01 SCHEMA Tool Schema 定义动作与参数契约 → 02 PROPOSAL Model Proposal 生成 tool + args（无执行权） → 03 VALIDATE Schema Validate type / required / enum → 04 AUTH GATE Authorization Gate 身份 · 权限 · 风险评估 (HITL) Pass Authorization & Dispatch to Host ↴ 05 EXECUTE Host Execute 安全沙箱调用 Tool / API / DB → 06 VERIFY Result Validate 结构规范与业务合规校验 → 07 DECISION Continue / Fallback 继续推进 · 重试 · 澄清或升级 GATE MCP 接入与鉴权边界 MCP 负责能力接入与发现， 不替代 Host 权限和业务校验 。 FAILURE 错误分类与重试策略 Timeout / 5xx 可做 bounded retry； 4xx / permission denied 不应重试 。 POLICY 副作用状态对齐 (Reconciliation) 副作用状态不确定时， 先 reconciliation，再决定是否重试 。
textEn: Soft Hierarchical Routing and Two-stage Routing  HIER Domain → Capability → Operation → Version Do not let the first layer select only one Domain—the correct Skill becomes permanently invisible after a top-level mistake. Keep Top-M Domains: {"domains":[{"name":"data_science","score":0.78},{"name":"engineering","score":0.74}]} Hierarchy should reduce the search space without creating an irreversible early decision.  FIG.6.1 Two-stage Routing STEP 1 User Request STEP 2 Candidate Generation: Exact / BM25 / Dense / Tags STEP 3 Candidate Fusion → Permission / Availability Filter STEP 4 Reranker Do not look only at Query↔Description; also consider current goal · task state · available/missing inputs · permission · risk · cost · recent tool results STEP 5 Decision Gate DIRECT_SKILL · MULTI_SKILL_PLAN · CLARIFY · NO_MATCH · APPROVAL_REQUIRED · REJECT  Must Remember A router that always returns a skill is not reliable. A reliable Router must allow No Match , otherwise it is doing forced classification.  FIG.6.2 Skill Match ≠ Authorization: Complete Sequence STEP 1 Intent STEP 2 Capability STEP 3 Candidate Skills STEP 4 Skill Match STEP 5 Permission STEP 6 Risk STEP 7 Input Validation STEP 8 Approval STEP 9 Execution Skill match is not authorization.  REG Skill Registry and Governance Store: skill_id · version · domain · tags · input/output schema · when_to_use / when_not_to_use · examples · hard negatives · permissions · risk · owner · health · status · cost. Govern Overlap: Merge · Deprecate · Rename · Narrow scope · Parameterize · Add negative boundaries. Example: generate_daily/weekly/monthly_report → generate_periodic_report(period) 。 Prefer parameterized skills over duplicated skills. EVAL Routing Evaluation and Failure Attribution Candidate Recall@K · Top-1 Routing Accuracy · MRR · No-Match Accuracy · Clarification Accuracy · Multi-Skill Planning Accuracy · Unauthorized Skill Exposure · E2E Task Success · Latency · Cost。 Distinguish Failure Types: Retriever / Reranker / Input / Execution / Tool Failure—if the correct Skill was chosen but the API timed out, that is a Tool Failure, not a Routing Failure.  MCP vs Skill: Protocol Layer vs Capability Layer Expanded MCP Skill Core Standardize the exposure/discovery of tools, resources, and context Encapsulate a reusable capability contract for “how to complete a class of tasks” Focus Connection, Schema, Discovery, Transport Applicability boundaries, inputs/outputs, procedure, validation, versioning Does Not Provide Does not inherently guarantee business authorization, idempotency, transactions, or task success Does not inherently define inter-process / inter-system communication protocols They can be combined in engineering: MCP reliably “connects” capabilities; a Skill describes when and how to use a capability. Boundary Protocol exposes capabilities; skills encode reusable task procedures. Neither one replaces authorization, validation, or orchestration. FIG.6.3 · CAPABILITY STACK MCP / Skill / Workflow / Tool Capability Hierarchy Layered capability stack: Goal → Procedure → Control → Access → Execution. ARCHITECTURE 5-LAYER STACK LAYER 1 GOAL Business Goal The business outcome the user actually needs. Outcome 01/05 LAYER 2 PROCEDURE Skill Contract Reusable procedure for solving a class of tasks. Procedure 02/05 LAYER 3 CONTROL Workflow FSM State, order, retry, branching, and stop conditions. Orchestrator 03/05 LAYER 4 ACCESS MCP Access Standardized discovery, schema, connection, and resources. Protocol 04/05 LAYER 5 EXECUTION Tool / API / DB Executes side effects or reads external facts. Side Effects 05/05 PITFALL · MCP is not the agent MCP solves capability access; it does not automatically provide planning, authorization, rollback, or task evaluation. PITFALL · A Skill is not just a prompt A mature Skill also defines triggers, typed I/O, tool dependencies, validation, failure behavior, and versioning. FIG.6.4 · EXECUTION CONTRACT Function Calling: The model proposes; the host executes Function calling is a structured action proposal, not an authorization system. CONTRACT 7 STEPS SECURITY HOST GATE 01 SCHEMA Tool Schema Define action and parameter contracts → 02 PROPOSAL Model Proposal Generate tool + args (no execution authority) → 03 VALIDATE Schema Validate type / required / enum → 04 AUTH GATE Authorization Gate Identity · permissions · risk assessment (HITL) Pass Authorization & Dispatch to Host ↴ 05 EXECUTE Host Execute Invoke Tool / API / DB in a secure sandbox → 06 VERIFY Result Validate Validate schema and business compliance → 07 DECISION Continue / Fallback Continue · retry · clarify · or escalate GATE MCP Integration and Authorization Boundary MCP handles capability integration and discovery, but does not replace host permissions or business validation 。 FAILURE Error Classification and Retry Strategy Timeout / 5xx may use bounded retry; 4xx / permission denied should not be retried 。 POLICY Side-effect State Reconciliation When side-effect state is uncertain, reconcile first, then decide whether to retry 。

titleZh: 06 Intent Routing：不要让一种机制吃掉全部流量 §6.B
titleEn: 06 Intent Routing: do not make one mechanism handle all traffic
textZh: Intent Routing：不要让一种机制吃掉全部流量 §6.B  生产级意图识别不是“规则还是大模型”的二选一，而是按置信度、任务复杂度、风险与成本逐层升级。便宜且确定的请求应尽早退出；只有真正模糊或组合式任务才进入高成本 planner。  FIG.6.B1 · COST-AWARE ROUTING CASCADE 从确定性 Fast Path 到结构化 Planner 每一层都必须有置信度出口；不确定性进入下一层，而不是被强行分类。 INPUT User Turn + State 先更新 current task、active entity、filled slots、corrections 与 topic-scoped state。 FAST PATH Deterministic Gate Exact mapping · regex · FSM · typed command。只接稳定、低歧义、高置信边界。 CONTEXT State-aware Router Referent resolution · continuation/topic shift · lightweight classifier / semantic match · confidence gate。 ESCALATE Structured LLM Planner 处理 ambiguous / compositional / multi-step 请求；输出 typed capability/tool proposal，而不是只猜一个 Intent label。 CONTROL Permission · Risk · Input Gate → Host Capability match 之后仍需 authorization、schema、approval、idempotency 与 result validation；Host 才拥有真实执行权。 升级原则 Escalate by uncertainty, task complexity, and risk—not by a fixed technology ladder.  FIG.6.B1A · ROUTING FUNNEL ECONOMICS 越往下流量越少，歧义、复杂度和单请求成本越高 漏斗不是为了强行追求某个流量比例，而是让简单稳定的问题尽早退出，把昂贵推理预算留给真正需要它的长尾请求。 L1 · WIDE Deterministic Fast Path 高频 · 低歧义 · 低单位成本。只收 stable command / regex / FSM / typed action，不把边缘例外不断塞进规则库。 L2 · CORE Context-aware Router 承担主要常规语义流量。依赖 state freshness、referent resolution、continuation/topic shift 与轻量 classifier / semantic match。 L3 · NARROW Structured LLM Planner 低流量 · 高歧义 · 高单位成本。用于 cross-domain、compositional、multi-step 和 dynamic tool choice，输出结构化 capability / tool proposal。 方向 L1 L2 L3 Traffic share high medium low Ambiguity low medium high Task complexity low medium high Unit latency / cost low medium high ANTI-PATTERN Rule Black Hole 每个新边缘案例都变成 regex / exception，最终产生 precedence、conflict、test surface 与 ownership debt。 ANTI-PATTERN LLM Front Door 所有请求默认先走最昂贵模型，导致不必要的 latency、cost 和 output variance，并把确定性问题也暴露给概率模型。 漏斗原则 Reduce average decision cost without hiding uncertainty or turning the fast path into a rule warehouse.  FIG.6.B2 · ROUTING DECISION BOUNDARIES Intent、Capability 与 Authorization 是三个不同决策 1 Intent Understanding 用户想完成什么？当前 turn 是否依赖旧 state / entity / slot？ 2 Capability Routing 哪个 Skill / Workflow / Tool 组合能够完成该目标？允许 DIRECT、MULTI、CLARIFY、NO_MATCH。 3 Authorization / Execution 用户现在是否被允许调用它？风险是否要求审批？参数是否完整？Host 是否可以安全执行？ 层 主要指标 常见失败 Fast Path precision · conflict rate · unmatched rate rule_conflict Context Router referent accuracy · continuation accuracy · calibration state_staleness · forced_route Planner capability selection · argument correctness · plan completeness planner_failure System task success · P50/P95 · cost/success · escalation share unauthorized_route · execution_failure  路由机制与退出条件  下面是机制选择表；实际顺序由流量、任务状态和风险决定。关键词命中也要检查否定、引用和实体，例如“不要退款，只查订单”。  机制 适用边界 退出条件 规则 / typed action 明确、稳定且上下文一致 冲突或缺少实体 → context router 向量示例路由 与已标注意图相似；含正例和 hard negatives 按 Route 聚合；低相似度或小 margin → clarify / no match 封闭决策模型 候选答案可预定义，例如 Jev Choice 校准 gate 不通过 → review / escalate LLM / planner 模糊、跨域或多步任务 输出 typed plan；执行前仍检查权限和输入 反问 / no match 缺少用户信息、意图冲突或超范围 问“申请退款还是查询订单？”；范围外明确 no match  分数需要校准  自报 confidence、向量相似度和 token logprobs 都不能直接当成业务正确概率。logprobs 是否可用取决于 model、endpoint 和 reasoning mode；多 token 标签要比较完整序列，不能只取首 token 或截断候选。  隔离示例库、校准集与测试集，按模板、用户或时间去重划分。检索 few-shot 示例的收益要测每类 precision / recall、校准和自动处理覆盖率；71%→93% 未获可复现来源支持。  OpenAI Agents SDK handoff  Python SDK 的 Agent(..., handoffs=[refund_agent, order_agent]) 将转交目标暴露为模型可选工具。triage agent 是分诊角色，不是特殊类。默认 Refund Agent 对应 transfer_to_refund_agent；默认描述是 Handoff to the {agent.name} agent to handle the request. 后接 handoff_description，且可 override。  handoff 转移当前分支控制权；agent as tool 让 manager 保留最终回复责任。清晰描述只是一个因素，工具包装仍需模型选择，不自动降低延迟。小候选集合可以直接路由，规模和混淆度增长时再引入检索。  默认传递历史，按数据边界筛选/脱敏。Python input_type 只约束转交 metadata，不替换接收 Agent 输入或动态选目的地；is_enabled 控制候选可见性。依赖解析参数的授权应在 on_handoff 开始检查，拒绝时抛出失败；Host Policy 始终保留执行权限边界。  多意图与有界恢复  同时要求多件事应按业务优先级、风险和依赖拆成计划；分不清意图才反问。超范围时返回 OUT_OF_SCOPE + reason + unresolved_goal，或配置 return handoff。Host 限制 handoff_count、总 turn / latency budget，检测相同 agent / goal / state 的无进展循环；耗尽后 clarify / escalate，不能换 Agent 绕过拒绝。  意图数量增长时沿用 soft hierarchy / Top-M domains；是否分层看召回、混淆、上下文成本和维护负担，20 个不是硬阈值。SDK、模型与数字的核验日期为 2026-10-03。  OpenAI SDK orchestration · Python handoffs · Model parameter compatibility
textEn: Intent Routing: do not make one mechanism handle all traffic §6.B  Production intent recognition is not a rules-versus-LLM choice. Escalate by confidence, task complexity, risk, and cost. Cheap deterministic requests should exit early; only ambiguous or compositional tasks should reach the expensive planner.  FIG.6.B1 · COST-AWARE ROUTING CASCADE From deterministic fast paths to a structured planner Every layer needs an uncertainty exit. Unresolved requests escalate instead of being forced into a label. INPUT User Turn + State Update current task, active entity, filled slots, corrections, and topic-scoped state first. FAST PATH Deterministic Gate Exact mapping · regex · FSM · typed command. Admit only stable, low-ambiguity, high-confidence boundaries. CONTEXT State-aware Router Referent resolution · continuation/topic shift · lightweight classifier / semantic match · confidence gate. ESCALATE Structured LLM Planner Handles ambiguous, compositional, and multi-step requests; emits typed capability/tool proposals rather than only guessing an intent label. CONTROL Permission · Risk · Input Gate → Host Capability matching is followed by authorization, schema checks, approvals, idempotency, and result validation. The host owns real execution authority. Escalation rule Escalate by uncertainty, task complexity, and risk—not by a fixed technology ladder.  FIG.6.B1A · ROUTING FUNNEL ECONOMICS As requests move down the funnel, traffic falls while ambiguity, complexity, and per-request cost rise The funnel is not about forcing a target traffic percentage. It lets simple, stable requests exit early and reserves expensive reasoning budget for the long tail that actually needs it. L1 · WIDE Deterministic Fast Path High-volume, low-ambiguity, low unit cost. Admit stable commands, regex/FSM, and typed actions without endlessly encoding edge cases into the rule set. L2 · CORE Context-aware Router Handles most routine semantic traffic. Quality depends on state freshness, referent resolution, continuation/topic-shift detection, and lightweight classification or semantic matching. L3 · NARROW Structured LLM Planner Low-volume, high-ambiguity, high unit cost. Use for cross-domain, compositional, multi-step, and dynamic-tool-choice requests, producing structured capability or tool proposals. Dimension L1 L2 L3 Traffic share high medium low Ambiguity low medium high Task complexity low medium high Unit latency / cost low medium high ANTI-PATTERN Rule Black Hole Every new edge case becomes another regex or exception, creating growing precedence, conflict, test-surface, and ownership debt. ANTI-PATTERN LLM Front Door Every request starts with the most expensive model, adding unnecessary latency, cost, and output variance while exposing deterministic problems to probabilistic behavior. Funnel rule Reduce average decision cost without hiding uncertainty or turning the fast path into a rule warehouse.  FIG.6.B2 · ROUTING DECISION BOUNDARIES Intent, capability, and authorization are three different decisions 1 Intent Understanding What is the user trying to achieve? Does this turn depend on prior state, entities, or slots? 2 Capability Routing Which Skill, Workflow, or Tool combination can satisfy the goal? Allow DIRECT, MULTI, CLARIFY, and NO_MATCH. 3 Authorization / Execution May this user invoke it now? Does risk require approval? Are arguments complete? Can the host execute safely? Layer Primary metrics Typical failures Fast Path precision · conflict rate · unmatched rate rule_conflict Context Router referent accuracy · continuation accuracy · calibration state_staleness · forced_route Planner capability selection · argument correctness · plan completeness planner_failure System task success · P50/P95 · cost/success · escalation share unauthorized_route · execution_failure  Routing mechanisms and exit conditions  Choose mechanisms using traffic, task state, and risk. Keyword matches must account for negation, quotations, and entities: “Do not refund; just check my order” should not trigger a refund route.  Mechanism Use when Exit condition Rules / typed actions Explicit, stable, context-consistent request Conflict or missing entity → context router Semantic example routing Similar to labeled intents; include positives and hard negatives Aggregate by route; low similarity or small margin → clarify / no match Closed decision model Predefined answer set, such as Jev Choice Calibration gate fails → review / escalate LLM / planner Ambiguous, cross-domain, or multi-step task Emit a typed plan; check permissions and inputs before execution Clarify / no match Missing user information, ambiguous intent, or out of scope Ask “Request a refund or check an order?”; return no match outside scope  Scores need calibration  Self-reported confidence, vector similarity, and token logprobs are not automatically business correctness probabilities. Logprobs support depends on model, endpoint, and reasoning mode. Compare complete multi-token labels; do not use only the first token or a truncated candidate list.  Separate the example library, calibration set, and test set; split and deduplicate by template, user, or time. Evaluate retrieved few-shot examples using per-intent precision/recall, calibration, and automation coverage. The claimed 71%→93% gain has no verified reproducible source.  OpenAI Agents SDK handoff  Python Agent(..., handoffs=[refund_agent, order_agent]) exposes transfer targets as model-selectable tools. A triage agent is a role, not a special class. Refund Agent defaults to transfer_to_refund_agent. The default description is Handoff to the {agent.name} agent to handle the request. followed by handoff_description; both defaults can be overridden.  A handoff transfers control of the current branch; an agent as tool leaves the manager responsible for the final reply. Clear descriptions are one factor. Tool wrapping still requires model selection and does not automatically reduce latency. Direct routing can suit small candidate sets; introduce retrieval as scale and ambiguity grow.  History is forwarded by default; select or redact it at data boundaries. Python input_type constrains transfer metadata, not the recipient input or dynamic destination. is_enabled controls candidate visibility. Check argument-dependent authorization at the start of on_handoff and raise on denial. Host policy remains the execution boundary.  Multi-intent and bounded recovery  Plan simultaneous tasks using business priority, risk, and dependencies; clarify ambiguous intent. Return OUT_OF_SCOPE with a reason and unresolved goal, or configure a return handoff. The host bounds handoff count, turns, and latency, detects repeated agent/goal/state without progress, and clarifies or escalates on exhaustion. Changing agents cannot bypass a denial.  Use soft hierarchy and Top-M domains as the intent space grows. Decide using recall, confusion, context cost, and maintenance burden; 20 intents is not a hard threshold. SDK, model, and numerical claims were checked on 2026-10-03.  OpenAI SDK orchestration · Python handoffs · Model parameter compatibility

titleZh: 06 System-One Decision Models：把 Jev 放进 Routing Cascade §6.C
titleEn: 06 System-One Decision Models: placing Jev inside the routing cascade
textZh: System-One Decision Models：把 Jev 放进 Routing Cascade §6.C  Jev 更适合被理解为一种 typed probabilistic decision layer，而不是更小的聊天模型。它处理答案空间预先定义的 Noul / Choice / Score 决策；开放式生成、复杂规划和多步推理继续交给 System-Two LLM。  FIG.6.C1 · SYSTEM-ONE + SYSTEM-TWO 快决策负责封闭判断，慢推理负责开放任务 这不是模型代际替换，而是把不同任务形状放进不同执行层。 STATE User / Program State 自然语言、结构化业务状态、Agent trace 或其他待判断输入。 SYSTEM ONE Typed Probabilistic Decisions Noul · Choice · Score 输出预定义类型、概率与 confidence，适合 classify / route / score / gate。 GATE Confidence + Policy 高置信、低风险可以直接分支；低置信、缺信息或高风险进入 clarify / review / escalation。 SYSTEM TWO General LLM Planner 开放式生成、组合意图、多步骤规划、代码与报告等不能提前枚举答案空间的任务。 CONTROL Authorization · Validation · Host 无论哪种模型作出决策，真实副作用仍由权限、schema、审批、验证和 Host 控制。 架构原则 Closed decision → typed probabilistic fast path. Open reasoning → general planner.  FIG.6.C2 · DECISION PRIMITIVES 三种 primitive 对应三种可编程决策形状 Primitive 输出 适合 Noul 命题为真的概率 [0,1]；阈值决定 yes/no risk gate · condition · escalation Choice 给定候选集合上的分布 + confidence intent · route · capability / tool choice Score scale rating + level distribution + confidence quality · risk · priority · relevance 关键边界 Type-safe ≠ semantically correct. 输出不会跑出 schema，不代表业务判断一定正确；confidence calibration、fallback、slice eval 与高风险人工复核仍然需要。  维度 System-One / Jev-shaped General LLM / System-Two-shaped 答案空间 预定义、typed 开放文本 / 代码 / 计划 核心动作 classify · choose · score · gate generate · reason · synthesize · plan 主要优势 直接进入代码分支；显式概率 / confidence 表达能力强；能处理开放和组合任务 主要限制 无法自由生成任意内容 延迟 / 成本更高，输出自由度增加验证负担  FIG.6.C3 · TASK-SHAPE SELECTION 先问能不能用代码，再问是不是 Decision Model 有限答案空间并不自动意味着需要模型。真正的 Jev-shaped task 是“预定义输出 + 模糊语义判断”。 DETERMINISTIC Code 规则可以可靠计算：金额阈值、权限、allowlist、预算上限、状态机合法转移。 FUZZY + BOUNDED Decision Model 答案集合已知，但边界需要语义判断：风险、意图、相关性、质量、是否继续。 OPEN OUTPUT Generative LLM 输出无法预先枚举：代码、报告、解释、研究、规划、组合式推理。 三层分工 Deterministic truth → code. Fuzzy bounded judgment → decision model. Open-ended work → generative LLM. 并行边界 对同一 state 的独立判断可以 batch / parallelize；如果 B 依赖 A 生成出的新 evidence，workflow 仍必须保留 causal order。Parallel sampling 减少不必要的串行生成，不消除真实数据依赖。  FIG.6.C4 · Jev vs. Generative LLMs BEFORE 生成式模型包办所有任务 Single LLM → Plan · Write code · Route model · Research · Score result · Tool approval? · Task complete? · Progress? AFTER 按职责拆分生成、决策与执行 Generative Model · 编码、规划、研究、开放生成 Jev · 模型路由、风险检查、进度、完成判断；类型化概率 Runtime · 权限、预算上限、允许列表、执行或拦截 职责分离不代表模型判断自动可靠；执行边界仍由 Runtime 掌握。  Agent Loop：五个有边界的决策检查点  AI Engineering 2026-09-23 的 Jev 文章以修复代码 Bug 的 Agent 为例：开放式工作交给主 LLM，执行前后和每一轮循环中的模糊但封闭判断可交给 Decision Model，最终权限与执行权始终留在 Runtime。  检查点 模型辅助判断 代码控制 / 证据边界 01 · 路由 下一步选哪个模型、哪些工具相关？ 能力允许列表、模型与成本预算 02 · 执行前 完整命令是否有风险、是否需要审批？ 校验参数、权限、sandbox、人工批准；分数不能授权 03 · 执行后 结果质量是否足够继续？ 先核验 exit code、测试和产物，再做语义判断 04 · 循环 是否陷入重复 search / open？是否有进展？ 硬性最大轮数、超时、重试与花费上限 05 · 验收 目标完成了吗、回答有依据吗？ 真实测试结果、diff、验收条件，不能只信 Agent 自评  例如 rm -rf ./build 的风险依赖上下文，但能否执行必须依赖真实权限和路径检查。让通用 LLM 返回 JSON 仍是受约束生成；Jev 的产品定位是直接返回预定义的类型化概率判断。两者都不能把类型正确等同于业务正确。  来源 · Jev Clearly Explained（2026-09-23）  Jev confidence 的含义  Choice confidence 是候选分布相对均匀分布的归一化集中度，并非正确率：confidence = (p_max − 1/n) / (1 − 1/n)。三个候选中 p_max = 0.6 时 confidence = 0.4。Score 还考虑等级距离，Noul 没有单独 confidence；概率校准仍需在本地留出集分片验证。  产品状态与性能来源  实现例 2026-10-07 官方核验 工程边界 TypeSafe AI Jev 官网保留 early access；发布文报告 70–500 ms 厂商通常从美国西海岸测量；未独立复现，不是 P95 / SLA OpenAI Decisions API DevDay 官方公告：Luna + text/image + 预定义答案；发布时 limited preview 未核实广泛开放、公开 endpoint contract 或 150 ms；不假设与 Jev 同 schema Claude Sonnet 5.5 / Opus 5.5 官方名称已确认；Sonnet 为较快、较低成本的补充 作为当期例子；用任务 eval 选择，避免固定简单/困难分界  性能仍需在自己的流量上测 accuracy、calibration、P50/P95、cost/success 与下游任务成功。90% confidence ≠ 90% 经验正确率。  2026-10-07 补充核对 AI Engineering《Jev vs LLM Clearly Explained》：其 Jev 延迟、价格和速度表引用 TypeSafe 自己的公开数字，因此这里继续按 vendor-reported evidence 处理，不当作独立 benchmark 或 SLA。  TypeSafe confidence · Jev launch evidence · AI Engineering comparison · OpenAI DevDay recap · Claude Sonnet 5.5
textEn: System-One Decision Models: placing Jev inside the routing cascade §6.C  Jev is better understood as a typed probabilistic decision layer, not a smaller chat model. It handles predefined Noul, Choice, and Score decisions; open generation, complex planning, and multi-step reasoning remain System-Two LLM work.  FIG.6.C1 · SYSTEM-ONE + SYSTEM-TWO Fast decisions handle closed judgments; deliberative reasoning handles open tasks This is not a model-generation replacement story; it assigns different task shapes to different execution layers. STATE User / Program State Natural language, structured business state, agent traces, or other inputs that require a decision. SYSTEM ONE Typed Probabilistic Decisions Noul · Choice · Score Returns predefined types, probabilities, and confidence for classify / route / score / gate decisions. GATE Confidence + Policy High-confidence, low-risk cases can branch directly; uncertain, incomplete, or high-risk cases go to clarify, review, or escalation. SYSTEM TWO General LLM Planner Open generation, compositional intents, multi-step planning, code, reports, and tasks whose answer space cannot be enumerated in advance. CONTROL Authorization · Validation · Host Regardless of which model makes the decision, real side effects remain controlled by permissions, schemas, approvals, validation, and the host. Architecture rule Closed decision → typed probabilistic fast path. Open reasoning → general planner.  FIG.6.C2 · DECISION PRIMITIVES Three primitives map to three programmable decision shapes Primitive Output Best fit Noul Probability of truth [0,1]; policy thresholds determine yes/no risk gate · condition · escalation Choice distribution over a defined candidate set + confidence intent · route · capability / tool choice Score scale rating + level distribution + confidence quality · risk · priority · relevance Critical boundary Type-safe ≠ semantically correct. Staying inside the schema does not guarantee a correct business judgment; confidence calibration, fallback, slice-based evaluation, and high-risk human review are still required.  Dimension System-One / Jev-shaped General LLM / System-Two-shaped Answer space predefined, typed open text / code / plans Core operation classify · choose · score · gate generate · reason · synthesize · plan Primary advantage direct software branching; explicit probability / confidence high expressive power; handles open and compositional tasks Primary limitation cannot freely generate arbitrary content higher latency / cost; output freedom increases validation burden  FIG.6.C3 · TASK-SHAPE SELECTION Ask whether code is enough before choosing a decision model A finite answer space does not automatically require a model. A Jev-shaped task is a predefined output space plus fuzzy semantic judgment. DETERMINISTIC Code Use code when the rule can be computed reliably: amount thresholds, permissions, allowlists, spend limits, or legal state transitions. FUZZY + BOUNDED Decision Model Use a decision model when the answer set is known but the boundary requires semantic judgment: risk, intent, relevance, quality, or whether to continue. OPEN OUTPUT Generative LLM Use a generative LLM when outputs cannot be enumerated in advance: code, reports, explanations, research, planning, or compositional reasoning. Three-layer rule Deterministic truth → code. Fuzzy bounded judgment → decision model. Open-ended work → generative LLM. Parallelism boundary Independent judgments over the same state can be batched or parallelized. If B depends on new evidence produced by A, the workflow must preserve causal order. Parallel sampling removes unnecessary serial generation; it does not remove true data dependencies.  FIG.6.C4 · Jev vs. Generative LLMs BEFORE Generative model for everything Single LLM → Plan · Write code · Route model · Research · Score result · Tool approval? · Task complete? · Progress? AFTER Separate generation, decisions and execution Generative Model · Coding, planning, research, open-ended generation Jev · Model routing, risk checks, progress, completion; typed probabilities Runtime · Permissions, spend limits, allowlist, execute or block Responsibility separation does not make model judgments inherently correct; Runtime still owns execution boundaries.  Agent loop: five bounded decision checkpoints  The September 23 AI Engineering Jev article uses a bug-fixing agent to illustrate the split: the main LLM handles open-ended work; a decision model may help with fuzzy bounded checks before, after, and between actions; the runtime always retains permission and execution authority.  Checkpoint Bounded model judgment Code controls / evidence boundary 01 · Routing Which model and tools fit the next step? Capability allowlist, model and spend budget 02 · Before action Is the exact command risky, and does it warrant approval? Validate arguments, permissions, sandbox and human approval; a score cannot authorize 03 · After action Is the result good enough to continue? First verify exit codes, tests, and artifacts, then assess semantic quality 04 · Loop Is the agent repeating search/open steps or making progress? Hard iteration, timeout, retry, and spend caps 05 · Acceptance Is the task complete and the answer grounded? Actual tests, diffs, acceptance criteria; never rely only on agent self-assessment  For example, the risk of rm -rf ./build depends on context, but execution permission must come from actual access and path checks. JSON from a generic LLM remains constrained generation; Jev instead targets direct typed probabilistic judgments over predefined answers. Neither guarantees semantic correctness merely by producing a valid type.  Source · Jev Clearly Explained (2026-09-23)  What Jev confidence means  Choice confidence measures concentration relative to a uniform distribution, not correctness: confidence = (p_max − 1/n) / (1 − 1/n). With three options and p_max = 0.6, confidence = 0.4. Score also accounts for level distance; Noul has no separate confidence. Validate probability calibration on local held-out slices.  Product status and performance sources  Implementation example Official verification · 2026-10-07 Engineering boundary TypeSafe AI Jev Website retains early access; launch post reports 70–500 ms Vendor measurements typically run from the US West Coast; not independently reproduced or a P95/SLA OpenAI Decisions API Official DevDay announcement: Luna, text/images, predefined answers; limited preview at launch Broad availability, a public endpoint contract, and 150 ms were not verified; do not assume Jev-compatible schemas Claude Sonnet 5.5 / Opus 5.5 Official names confirmed; Sonnet is positioned as a faster, lower-cost complement Time-sensitive examples; select using task evals rather than fixed simple/hard boundaries  Measure accuracy, calibration, P50/P95, cost per success, and downstream task success on your own traffic. A 90% confidence value does not mean 90% empirical accuracy.  Supplemental review on 2026-10-07 of AI Engineering's 'Jev vs LLM Clearly Explained': its Jev latency, pricing, and speed figures are sourced from TypeSafe's own published numbers, so they remain vendor-reported evidence rather than an independent benchmark or SLA.  TypeSafe confidence · Jev launch evidence · AI Engineering comparison · OpenAI DevDay recap · Claude Sonnet 5.5

titleZh: 06 Agent 协议边界：Tool Calling、AG-UI、AP2
titleEn: 06 Agent boundaries: tool calls, AG-UI and payments
textZh: Agent 协议边界：Tool Calling、AG-UI、AP2 模型只能提议动作；可信 Host 决定是否执行。AG-UI 负责 UI 事件，AP2 不是自动授权转账。 FDE VERIFIED BOUNDARY · OCT 2026 根据公开考点独立撰写，不是会员答案。真实平台事实有链接来源；案例与门禁是设计建议，不代表实际客户测试。 Q45 · Tool / Function Calling + AG-UI CH06 §6.6 已说明 Function Calling 提案/执行分离。AG-UI 连接 Agent Backend 与 Frontend 的状态/事件，不是 MCP Tool API 或资源鉴权。 失败/验收： 伪造 tool_success 与 UI Approved 事件不能提交真实支付操作。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ Q46 · AP2 Agent Payments Protocol 支付必须有明确 Payer/Amount/Merchant/Operation ID、可审计批准和网关幂等/对账；模型生成的支付理由不等于授权。 失败/验收： Gateway 超时状态未知，必须查 Receipt 或按契约用同一业务键重试。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ 不能把术语命中当掌握 审计表中的 H 只表示此考点能在所属章节定位。还需逐项检查机制、反例、实现、指标与一手证据。
textEn: Agent boundaries: tool calls, AG-UI and payments Models propose actions; trusted hosts authorize. AG-UI transports UI interaction and AP2 does not automatically authorize payments. FDE VERIFIED BOUNDARY · OCT 2026 Independently written from public topic names, not membership answers. Provider facts link to first-party references; examples and gates are engineering proposals, not customer tests. Q45 · Tool / Function Calling + AG-UI CH06 §6.6 already covers proposed tool calls vs host execution. AG-UI connects agent backend and frontend events, not the MCP tool boundary or resource authorization. Failure / acceptance: Forged UI tool_success/approval event must not commit a transaction. Source / boundary ↗ Q46 · AP2 Agent Payments Protocol Payment needs payer/amount/merchant/operation ID, auditable mandate, gateway idempotency and reconciliation. Model text is not authorization. Failure / acceptance: On timeout, reconcile receipt or retry same key only under contract. Source / boundary ↗ Terminology is not mastery H in the curriculum audit only means the topic is locatable. Mechanism, counterexample, implementation, metric and primary evidence still require review.

titleZh: 07 Short-term → Long-term Memory Promotion
titleEn: 07 Short-term → Long-term Memory Promotion
textZh: Short-term → Long-term Memory Promotion  FIG.7.4 Memory Promotion Pipeline STEP 1 Working State STEP 2 Candidate Extraction STEP 3 Importance + Stability STEP 4 Dedup + Conflict Check STEP 5 Long-term Store + Provenance  短期记忆不是自动“变成”长期记忆。只有满足稳定性、复用价值、用户授权和低冲突风险的信息才应 Promotion；临时工具输出、未验证推断和敏感信息默认不晋升。
textEn: Short-term → Long-term Memory Promotion  FIG.7.4 Memory Promotion Pipeline STEP 1 Working State STEP 2 Candidate Extraction STEP 3 Importance + Stability STEP 4 Dedup + Conflict Check STEP 5 Long-term Store + Provenance  Short-term memory should not automatically “become” long-term memory. Promote only information that is stable, reusable, user-authorized, and low-conflict; temporary tool outputs, unverified inferences, and sensitive information should not be promoted by default.

Context Compression 的触发机制  Token budget approaching threshold

textEn:
Context Compression Triggers  Token budget approaching threshold

titleZh: 07 Cross-session Memory：跨会话记住的是受治理的状态 §7.X
titleEn: 07 Cross-session Memory: persist governed state, not raw utterances
textZh: Cross-session Memory：跨会话记住的是受治理的状态 §7.X  “预算不能超过 5000”是否应该跨会话记住，先看 scope 与 durability：它可能只是当前任务约束，也可能是项目级硬约束或稳定用户偏好。Memory 的核心不是存储介质，而是 promotion、scope、provenance、conflict 和 retrieval policy。  FIG.7.X1 · CROSS-SESSION MEMORY GOVERNANCE 写入要晋升，读取要路由，冲突要保留 lineage 长历史摘要只是 Context View。真正 durable 的约束应有结构化 scope、provenance、validity 与 supersession。 WRITE 01 Candidate Extraction 从用户显式陈述、Tool observation 或模型推断中提取候选记忆，并先标记 source_kind。 WRITE 02 Scope + Durability Gate 判断 task / thread / project / user / tenant scope，以及 temporary / stable / expiring。只有真正 durable 的信息进入长期存储。 STORE Durable Memory + Provenance 保存 value 之外，还保存 source、confidence、valid_from / valid_to、supersedes、sensitivity 和 owner。 READ Memory Route + Filters 当前 Decision 先决定需要哪类 Memory，再做 scope、permission、validity、relevance 过滤；不是对所有历史做一次全局向量搜索。 CONFLICT Authority + Supersession explicit correction、scope specificity、source authority、valid time 与 confidence 一起决定当前有效值；newer 不自动等于更 authoritative。 核心原则 Write selectively. Read selectively. Expire explicitly. Correct with lineage.  FIG.7.X2 · SAME SENTENCE, DIFFERENT MEMORY LIFETIME 同一句“预算 ≤5000”，可能属于三种不同生命周期 表达 Scope 落点 何时失效 “这次采购预算 ≤5000” current_task Working State 任务完成 “Atlas 本季度预算 ≤5000” project:atlas Project-scoped durable constraint valid_to / 明确修改 “以后旅行单次预算都 ≤5000” user Structured Profile 用户更新偏好 LONG CONTEXT ≠ DURABLE MEMORY Lost in the Middle 说明长上下文存在位置敏感性，但跨会话真正需要的是 persisted state / memory lifecycle。如果信息根本没有被持久化，新 Thread 里就无从召回。
textEn: Cross-session Memory: persist governed state, not raw utterances §7.X  Whether “budget must not exceed 5000” should survive across sessions depends first on scope and durability: it may be a current-task constraint, a durable project constraint, or a stable user preference. Memory architecture is about promotion, scope, provenance, conflict, and retrieval policy—not merely storage.  FIG.7.X1 · CROSS-SESSION MEMORY GOVERNANCE Promote on write, route on read, preserve lineage on conflict A long-history summary is only a Context View. Durable constraints need structured scope, provenance, validity, and supersession. WRITE 01 Candidate Extraction Extract candidate memories from explicit user statements, tool observations, or model inferences, and label source_kind first. WRITE 02 Scope + Durability Gate Resolve task, thread, project, user, or tenant scope plus temporary, stable, or expiring durability. Only truly durable information enters long-term storage. STORE Durable Memory + Provenance Persist not only the value but also source, confidence, valid_from / valid_to, supersedes, sensitivity, and owner. READ Memory Route + Filters The current decision determines which memory class is needed, followed by scope, permission, validity, and relevance filtering—not one global vector search over all history. CONFLICT Authority + Supersession Explicit correction, scope specificity, source authority, valid time, and confidence determine the active value together; newer does not automatically mean more authoritative. Core rule Write selectively. Read selectively. Expire explicitly. Correct with lineage.  FIG.7.X2 · SAME SENTENCE, DIFFERENT MEMORY LIFETIME The same “budget ≤5000” statement can belong to three different lifetimes Statement Scope Memory target When it expires “This purchase must stay under 5000.” current_task Working State Task completion “Atlas has a quarterly budget cap of 5000.” project:atlas Project-scoped durable constraint valid_to / explicit correction “For future trips, keep each budget under 5000.” user Structured Profile User changes the preference LONG CONTEXT ≠ DURABLE MEMORY Lost in the Middle shows position sensitivity in long contexts, but cross-session continuity requires persisted state and a memory lifecycle. If information was never persisted, a new thread has nothing to recall.

titleZh: 07 Enterprise Knowledge Context：企业知识是受治理的上下文 §7.K
titleEn: 07 Enterprise Knowledge Context: enterprise knowledge is governed context
textZh: Enterprise Knowledge Context：企业知识是受治理的上下文 §7.K  企业知识基础设施的目标不是把更多文本塞进向量库，而是把组织概念、规则、流程、案例和实时事实变成可版本化、可授权、可追溯的 Agent Context。  FIG.7.K1 · KNOWLEDGE CONTEXT LIFECYCLE Source → Organize → Process → Serve → Govern → Agent Context SOURCE 文档 · 流程 · 规则 · 案例 · 数据 provenance · owner · raw version ORGANIZE / PROCESS classify · relate · index · structure 不是所有内容都向量化；保留层级、关系、适用范围和事实结构。 SERVE RAG · API · Structured Query · File Search 按数据形状、时效、权限和失败语义选择供给方式。 GOVERN version · permission · validity · correction owner · expiry · supersede · lineage · usage feedback CONTEXT 可解释、可验证、可授权的任务上下文 Agent 使用的是经过治理的 evidence，不是无来源文本堆积。 核心原则 Enterprise knowledge is governed context, not merely retrieved text.
textEn: Enterprise Knowledge Context: enterprise knowledge is governed context §7.K  Enterprise knowledge infrastructure is not about pushing more text into a vector store. It turns organizational concepts, rules, workflows, cases, and live facts into versioned, authorized, traceable agent context.  FIG.7.K1 · KNOWLEDGE CONTEXT LIFECYCLE Source → Organize → Process → Serve → Govern → Agent Context SOURCE Documents · workflows · rules · cases · data provenance · owner · raw version ORGANIZE / PROCESS classify · relate · index · structure Do not vectorize everything. Preserve hierarchy, relationships, scope, and structured facts. SERVE RAG · API · Structured Query · File Search Choose the serving path by data shape, freshness, permission, and failure semantics. GOVERN version · permission · validity · correction owner · expiry · supersede · lineage · usage feedback CONTEXT Explainable, verifiable, authorized task context The agent consumes governed evidence, not an untraceable pile of text. Core rule Enterprise knowledge is governed context, not merely retrieved text.

titleEn: 07 Context window: budgets and business invariants
textZh: Context Window 管理：预算与业务不变量 CH07 原已有压缩、Memory 和 Context Budget；本节明确何种内容可以压缩，何种身份/事实绝不能由模型改写。 FDE VERIFIED BOUNDARY · OCT 2026 根据公开考点独立撰写，不是会员答案。真实平台事实有链接来源；案例与门禁是设计建议，不代表实际客户测试。 Q47 · Context Window Management 大量上下文不保证正确：授权身份不可由摘要改变，精确 ID/否定词要保留；历史记忆必须有来源、TTL 和权限范围。 失败/验收： 多轮将订单 42 更正为 43 后，压缩不能把旧 ID 带回。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ 不能把术语命中当掌握 审计表中的 H 只表示此考点能在所属章节定位。还需逐项检查机制、反例、实现、指标与一手证据。
textEn: Context window: budgets and business invariants CH07 already covers compression and memory budgets; this section separates compressible history from protected identity and evidence. FDE VERIFIED BOUNDARY · OCT 2026 Independently written from public topic names, not membership answers. Provider facts link to first-party references; examples and gates are engineering proposals, not customer tests. titleZh: 08 Root Cause 与最小范围修复（D-I-R）
titleEn: 08 Root Cause and Minimum-scope Repair (D-I-R)
textZh:
Root Cause 与最小范围修复（D-I-R）  FIG.8.2 Dependency-aware Invalidation STEP 1 Failure STEP 2 Diagnose：定位最早出错的 Artifact STEP 3 Invalidate：只失效下游依赖 STEP 4 Regenerate：保留有效 Artifact，重生成最小范围 例：只修改服装 → Character Costume v2 → 只失效受影响的 shots。 Regenerate from the earliest incorrect artifact, not from the beginning.  ASYNC 异步生成与任务状态 Orchestrator → Queue → Worker → Artifact → Event → Resume。状态：QUEUED · RUNNING · SUCCEEDED · FAILED · CANCELLED；前端经 SSE / WebSocket / Polling 接收进度。 Idempotency： 生成任务需去重与对账；服务支持时使用 idempotency key。超时不代表任务未开始，重试前先查询执行状态。 COST 并行化与成本控制 可并行： independent shots · audio variants · preview。 必须串行： continuity-dependent shots · 上游未 lock。 Parallelize independent shots; serialize continuity-dependent shots. 成本：Preview → Validate → Final Render；决策稳定前用低成本模型；复用 Character/Scene Asset；图片动画替代全视频；Retry 上限；项目预算。 Generate cheaply until creative decisions stabilize.  FIG.8.3 Workflow State Machine（状态属于数据库 / Workflow Engine，不属于 LLM） DRAFT BRIEF_VALIDATED STORY_APPROVED ASSETS_LOCKED STORYBOARD_APPROVED GENERATION VALIDATION TARGETED_REPAIR POST REVIEW PUBLISH Human-in-the-loop Gate： Brief approval · Character approval · 高风险内容 · Final publish；可提供 Fast Mode / Professional Mode。  Multi-Agent：拆在 Operational Boundary，而不是 Persona Boundary USE 值得拆 权限边界不同 · 工具/运行环境不同 · 子任务可独立评估 · 有真实并行收益 · 需要独立 Critique · 不同模型/成本策略 · 高风险隔离。 AVOID 不值得拆 仅因为“研究员/经理/评论家”听起来高级；所有 Agent 共享同一状态和工具；没有独立验收；通信开销高于专业化收益。 原则 I split agents at operational boundaries, not personality boundaries. 15 分钟 Agent System Design 节奏 0–2 min   Clarify user / task / SLA / risk / data
2–4 min   Define success metrics
4–8 min   Draw architecture
8–11 min  Failure modes + recovery
11–13 min Latency / cost / quality trade-offs
13–15 min Evaluation + rollout + observability FIG.8.6 Generic Agent System Skeleton STEP 1 User STEP 2 Router STEP 3 Agent / Workflow STEP 4 RAG + MCP / Tools STEP 5 State / Memory STEP 6 Validation / Guardrails 旁路：Trace → Eval → Dashboard → Human Escalation。
textEn:
Root Cause and Minimum-scope Repair (D-I-R)  FIG.8.2 Dependency-aware Invalidation STEP 1 Failure STEP 2 Diagnose: locate the earliest incorrect Artifact STEP 3 Invalidate: invalidate downstream dependencies only STEP 4 Regenerate: keep valid Artifacts and regenerate the minimum scope Example: changing only clothing → Character Costume v2 → invalidate only affected shots. Regenerate from the earliest incorrect artifact, not from the beginning.  ASYNC Asynchronous Generation and Task State Orchestrator → Queue → Worker → Artifact → Event → Resume. States: QUEUED · RUNNING · SUCCEEDED · FAILED · CANCELLED; the frontend receives progress via SSE / WebSocket / Polling. Idempotency： Generation jobs need deduplication and reconciliation; use idempotency keys when the provider implements them. A timeout does not prove the job never started. COST Parallelization and Cost Control Can Run in Parallel: independent shots · audio variants · preview。 Must Run Sequentially: continuity-dependent shots · upstream work not yet locked. Parallelize independent shots; serialize continuity-dependent shots. Cost control: Preview → Validate → Final Render; use low-cost models until decisions stabilize; reuse Character/Scene Assets; animate images instead of generating full video when possible; cap retries; set a project budget. Generate cheaply until creative decisions stabilize.  FIG.8.3 Workflow State Machine (state belongs to the database / workflow engine, not the LLM) DRAFT BRIEF_VALIDATED STORY_APPROVED ASSETS_LOCKED STORYBOARD_APPROVED GENERATION VALIDATION TARGETED_REPAIR POST REVIEW PUBLISH Human-in-the-loop Gate： Brief approval · Character approval · high-risk content · Final publish; can provide Fast Mode / Professional Mode.  Multi-Agent: Split at Operational Boundaries, Not Persona Boundaries USE Worth Splitting Different permission boundaries · different tools/runtime environments · independently evaluable subtasks · real parallelism benefits · need independent Critique · different model/cost strategies · high-risk isolation. AVOID Not Worth Splitting Only because “researcher / manager / critic” sounds sophisticated; all Agents share the same state and tools; no independent acceptance criteria; communication overhead exceeds specialization benefits. Principle I split agents at operational boundaries, not personality boundaries. 15-minute Agent System Design Structure 0–2 min   Clarify user / task / SLA / risk / data
2–4 min   Define success metrics
4–8 min   Draw architecture
8–11 min  Failure modes + recovery
11–13 min Latency / cost / quality trade-offs
13–15 min Evaluation + rollout + observability FIG.8.6 Generic Agent System Skeleton STEP 1 User STEP 2 Router STEP 3 Agent / Workflow STEP 4 RAG + MCP / Tools STEP 5 State / Memory STEP 6 Validation / Guardrails Side path: Trace → Eval → Dashboard → Human Escalation.
