titleZh: 08 Loop vs Graph：局部自治循环 vs 显式编排拓扑 §8.X
titleEn: 08 Loop vs Graph: Local Autonomy vs Explicit Orchestration Topology
textZh: Loop vs Graph：局部自治循环 vs 显式编排拓扑 §8.X  不要把 Loop 和 Graph 当成两代互相替代的技术。Loop 是一个 Agent 在局部任务中的自治控制模式；Graph 是把多个工作单元、决策边界和恢复路径组织成显式拓扑。  FIG.8.X 先把单个 Loop 做到可控，再在结构边界出现时拆成 Graph 默认从最小可控循环开始。只有当协调复杂度要求显式拓扑时，才增加 Graph 的控制流复杂度。 LOOP 一个连贯目标内的局部自治 Goal → Observe → Reason / Plan → Act → Verify → Stop or iterate。适合共享上下文、单一权限边界、明确验证方式与显式停止条件。 GRAPH 跨边界工作的显式协调 Router → bounded work units → branch / join → checkpoint → validation → recovery。适合并行分支、不同上下文或权限域、可审计决策点与独立恢复。 START Bounded Agent Loop 先让状态、停止条件、验证和失败恢复可控。 BOUNDARY 结构性边界出现 并行 · 不同权限 · 不同上下文 · branch / join · checkpoint / resume · failure isolation · human approval SPLIT 把边界拆成显式 Graph 节点与边 只增加解决真实协调问题所需的控制流复杂度。  UPGRADE 什么时候从 Loop 升级为 Graph 看结构信号，而不是看流行词：并行轨道；不同 context / memory / permission；显式 branch / join；checkpoint / resume；failure isolation；需要审计的控制点；高风险动作的人审边界。 NODE Graph Node 不等于 Agent Loop 节点可以是 deterministic function、retrieval step、tool execution、policy gate、human approval、sub-workflow，也可以是 agent loop。Graph 定义的是拓扑，不要求每个节点都自治。  INTERACTIVE · ARCHITECTURE EXPLORER 你的任务真的需要 Graph 吗？ 勾选真实存在的协调边界。右侧会实时给出最小足够架构，并高亮 Loop 或外层 Graph 拓扑。 结构信号 需要并行分支 多个工作单元可以或必须同时推进 上下文 / Memory 需要隔离 不同工作单元不应共享完整上下文 存在不同权限域 工具、数据或动作必须由边界隔开 Branch / Join 控制流需要显式分支后再汇合 Checkpoint / Resume 执行需要持久化并从中间状态恢复 Failure Isolation 局部失败需要独立恢复而不是整体重跑 Human Approval 高风险动作需要显式人审边界 重置 推荐架构 Bounded Agent Loop 0 structural signals LOCAL BOUNDED LOOP Goal → Plan → Act → Verify → Done ↺ 未通过验证时，在显式预算与停止条件内迭代 OUTER EXPLICIT GRAPH Router → Work A Work B → Join → Checkpoint Policy Gate  CANONICAL RULE Use the least control-flow complexity that still makes state, stopping conditions, permissions, and recovery explicit.  PITFALL A graph does not repair a broken loop. 如果单个循环的状态、验证、停止条件或工具策略本身有问题，套上一层 Graph 只会得到更复杂、同样不可靠的系统。  来源说明：本节吸收并工程化重写了 AI Engineering 于 2026-08-13 发布的 Loop vs Graph 文章；其中“Graph 是更高一层组织方式”的直觉被保留，但这里进一步明确：Graph node 可以是确定性步骤、Gate、Tool、子工作流或 Agent Loop，而不必都是 Loop。 AI Engineering · Loop vs Graph Engineering Clearly Explained
textEn: Loop vs Graph: Local Autonomy vs Explicit Orchestration Topology §8.X  Do not treat loops and graphs as two generations of competing technology. A loop is a local autonomous control pattern for an agent; a graph is an explicit topology for organizing work units, decision boundaries, and recovery paths.  FIG.8.X Make the single loop controllable first; split into a graph only when structural boundaries appear Start with the smallest controllable loop. Add graph-level control-flow complexity only when coordination complexity requires explicit topology. LOOP Local autonomy around one coherent goal Goal → Observe → Reason / Plan → Act → Verify → Stop or iterate. Best when context is shared, the permission boundary is unified, verification is clear, and the stopping condition is explicit. GRAPH Explicit coordination across structural boundaries Router → bounded work units → branch / join → checkpoint → validation → recovery. Best for parallel branches, different context or permission domains, auditable decision points, and independent recovery. START Bounded Agent Loop First make state, stopping conditions, verification, and failure recovery controllable. BOUNDARY A structural boundary appears parallelism · different permissions · different contexts · branch / join · checkpoint / resume · failure isolation · human approval SPLIT Split the boundary into explicit graph nodes and edges Add only the control-flow complexity needed to solve a real coordination problem.  UPGRADE When to upgrade from a loop to a graph Look for structural signals, not trend vocabulary: parallel tracks; different context, memory, or permission domains; explicit branch / join; checkpoint / resume; failure isolation; auditable control points; and human approval boundaries for high-risk actions. NODE A graph node is not necessarily an agent loop A node can be a deterministic function, retrieval step, tool execution, policy gate, human approval, sub-workflow, or an agent loop. A graph defines topology; it does not require every node to be autonomous.  INTERACTIVE · ARCHITECTURE EXPLORER Does your task actually need a graph? Select only the coordination boundaries that actually exist. The recommendation updates live and highlights the smallest sufficient architecture: a loop, a gated loop, or an outer graph. Structural signals Parallel branches are required Multiple work units can or must progress concurrently Context or memory must be isolated Different work units should not share the full context Different permission domains exist Tools, data, or actions must be separated by explicit boundaries Branch / Join Control flow must explicitly branch and later join Checkpoint / Resume Execution must persist and resume from intermediate state Failure Isolation Local failures need independent recovery instead of rerunning everything Human Approval High-risk actions require an explicit human approval boundary Reset Recommended architecture Bounded Agent Loop 0 structural signals LOCAL BOUNDED LOOP Goal → Plan → Act → Verify → Done ↺ If verification fails, iterate within an explicit budget and stopping condition OUTER EXPLICIT GRAPH Router → Work A Work B → Join → Checkpoint Policy Gate  CANONICAL RULE Use the least control-flow complexity that still makes state, stopping conditions, permissions, and recovery explicit.  PITFALL A graph does not repair a broken loop. If the loop itself has broken state handling, verification, stopping conditions, or tool policy, wrapping it in a graph only creates a more complex system with the same underlying failure.  Source note: this section incorporates and engineering-reframes the Loop vs Graph article published by AI Engineering on 2026-08-13. It preserves the intuition that graphs organize work at a higher level, while making the stricter distinction that a graph node may be deterministic work, a gate, a tool call, a sub-workflow, or an agent loop. AI Engineering · Loop vs Graph Engineering Clearly Explained

titleZh: 08 LangChain vs LangGraph：抽象层，而不是二选一 §8.Y
titleEn: 08 LangChain vs LangGraph: Abstraction layers, not mutually exclusive choices
textZh: LangChain vs LangGraph：抽象层，而不是二选一 §8.Y  “LangChain 做链，LangGraph 做复杂 Agent”只能算历史直觉。当前 LangChain 更偏高层 Agent / Application Framework 与组件生态；LangGraph 更偏低层 Stateful Orchestration Runtime。更关键的是，LangChain 的 create_agent() 本身建立在 LangGraph 上。  FIG.8.Y0 · MODEL CALL VS APPLICATION STATE 单次模型调用不会自动变成可恢复的工作流状态 消息历史回答“之前发生了什么”；Workflow State 还必须回答“执行现在在哪里、接下来允许做什么”。 MODEL CALL Input → Model → Output 模型只基于当前可见输入计算输出；持久化业务状态需要应用或运行时显式管理。 WORKFLOW STATE Task · Tool Results · Retry · Approval · Next Step 复杂 Agent 需要保存任务进度、中间结果、失败状态、审批状态和下一步，而不只是聊天记录。 LANGGRAPH State → Node → Patch → Route → Checkpoint 把执行状态和转移显式化，使 branch、loop、retry、interrupt / resume 与 HITL 成为可检查的控制流。  FIG.8.Y1 · ABSTRACTION STACK 先选最高层、但仍能显式表达关键控制边界的抽象 LANGCHAIN Models · Tools · Retrievers · Runnables · Middleware · create_agent() 标准接口、第三方集成、可组合组件和预构建 Agent 架构。适合快速获得常见能力，而不是重复造基础组件。 LANGGRAPH State · Nodes · Reducers · Edges · Scheduler · Checkpoints 当 orchestration 本身成为业务逻辑：自定义 State、branch/join、循环、恢复、持久化、HITL、长期运行任务。 COMMON PATTERN LangChain components inside LangGraph nodes 生产里最常见的不是二选一，而是用 LangChain 提供能力，用 LangGraph 显式组织控制流。  需求 优先选择 原因 Prompt → Model → Parser / RAG LangChain Runnable / LCEL 标准组件组合 Standard tool-calling agent LangChain create_agent() 使用预构建 Agent Graph Custom State / branch / join / recovery LangGraph 控制流就是业务逻辑 Checkpoint / resume / complex HITL LangGraph 需要显式持久化执行状态 Custom workflow + standard tools/models LangChain + LangGraph 能力与编排分层  FIG.8.Y2 · EXECUTION MODEL 真正理解 LangGraph，要能解释 State Patch、Reducer、调度和 Checkpoint 1 State schema · current values 2 Node State → Partial<State> 3 Reducer merge state patches 4 Route edge · condition · command 5 Scheduler next tasks · super-step 6 Checkpoint thread · snapshot · resume  CANONICAL LangChain and LangGraph are abstraction layers, not mutually exclusive competitors. 当前 LangChain Agent 建立在 LangGraph 上；标准架构优先用 LangChain，当 orchestration 本身成为应用逻辑时再下沉到 LangGraph。  CHECKPOINT BOUNDARY Checkpoint 保存的是执行 State Snapshot，不是自动事务。外部数据库、支付、邮件等 Side Effect 仍需要 idempotency / reconciliation；恢复语义发生在 checkpoint / super-step 边界，而不是任意程序指令位置。  核验来源：LangChain / LangGraph 官方 README、LangChain Core Runnable Reference、create_agent Reference、StateGraph Reference 与 Checkpointer 文档。文章按 2026-09-17 当前官方语义整理。
textEn: LangChain vs LangGraph: Abstraction layers, not mutually exclusive choices §8.Y  “LangChain is for chains and LangGraph is for complex agents” is only a historical intuition. Today LangChain is the higher-level agent/application framework and component ecosystem, while LangGraph is the lower-level stateful orchestration runtime. Crucially, LangChain's create_agent() itself is built on LangGraph.  FIG.8.Y0 · MODEL CALL VS APPLICATION STATE A model invocation does not automatically become recoverable workflow state Message history answers what happened before; workflow state must also answer where execution is now and what may happen next. MODEL CALL Input → Model → Output The model computes from the input visible to the invocation; durable business state must be managed explicitly by the application or runtime. WORKFLOW STATE Task · Tool Results · Retry · Approval · Next Step Complex agents must retain task progress, intermediate results, failure state, approvals, and next steps—not only chat history. LANGGRAPH State → Node → Patch → Route → Checkpoint Makes execution state and transitions explicit so branches, loops, retries, interrupt/resume, and HITL become inspectable control flow.  FIG.8.Y1 · ABSTRACTION STACK Choose the highest-level abstraction that still keeps important control boundaries explicit LANGCHAIN Models · Tools · Retrievers · Runnables · Middleware · create_agent() Standard interfaces, integrations, composable components, and prebuilt agent architecture. Use it to avoid rebuilding common capabilities. LANGGRAPH State · Nodes · Reducers · Edges · Scheduler · Checkpoints Use it when orchestration itself becomes application logic: custom state, branch/join, loops, recovery, persistence, HITL, and long-running execution. COMMON PATTERN LangChain components inside LangGraph nodes In production the common pattern is not either/or: LangChain supplies capabilities while LangGraph makes control flow explicit.  Requirement Prefer Why Prompt → Model → Parser / RAG LangChain Runnable / LCEL Standard component composition Standard tool-calling agent LangChain create_agent() Use the prebuilt agent graph Custom State / branch / join / recovery LangGraph Control flow is application logic Checkpoint / resume / complex HITL LangGraph Explicit execution-state persistence is required Custom workflow + standard tools/models LangChain + LangGraph Separate capabilities from orchestration  FIG.8.Y2 · EXECUTION MODEL To understand LangGraph, explain state patches, reducers, scheduling, and checkpoints 1 State schema · current values 2 Node State → Partial<State> 3 Reducer merge state patches 4 Route edge · condition · command 5 Scheduler next tasks · super-step 6 Checkpoint thread · snapshot · resume  CANONICAL LangChain and LangGraph are abstraction layers, not mutually exclusive competitors. Current LangChain agents are built on LangGraph. Prefer LangChain for the standard architecture, then drop down to LangGraph when orchestration itself becomes application logic.  CHECKPOINT BOUNDARY A checkpoint persists execution state; it is not an automatic transaction. External database, payment, email, or other side effects still require idempotency and reconciliation. Resume semantics are checkpoint/super-step semantics, not arbitrary instruction-pointer semantics.  Verified against the official LangChain and LangGraph READMEs, LangChain Core Runnable reference, create_agent reference, StateGraph reference, and checkpointer documentation, using the current semantics as of 2026-09-17.

titleZh: 08 Coding Agent Engineering：从写代码转向定义、指挥与验证 §8.7
titleEn: 08 Coding Agent Engineering: From writing code to specifying, directing, and verifying
textZh: Coding Agent Engineering：从写代码转向定义、指挥与验证 §8.7  Coding Agent 并没有消除软件工程流程，而是重新分配工程师的注意力：更少时间花在手写代码，更多时间花在决定做什么、设计架构、写清 Spec、校准 Agent 自主权、验证结果，以及把反馈带回前面的阶段。它们也可以承担数据分析、系统操作等非代码执行任务，因此真正需要治理的是整个 execution loop，而不只是 code generation。  FIG.8.7 Coding Agent 工作流仍然是软件工程，只是执行者与注意力分布发生变化 Planning → Execution → Deployment & Monitoring 不是一次性流水线。验证或监控失败时，应该返回更早的阶段修正 Spec、架构、上下文或执行计划。 1 · PLAN 研究、理解代码库、写 Spec、拆计划 先明确需求、技术设计、架构、约束与验收标准，再审视关键假设、安全风险与是否过度设计。Greenfield 原型可以轻量；复杂 Brownfield 系统需要更严格的规划与验证。 2 · EXECUTE 构建、测试、验证，并校准自主权 决定哪些步骤需要高频人机往返，哪些可以委托成较大工作块；同时管理上下文、权限、并行 Agent 与人的注意力预算。 3 · DEPLOY / OBSERVE 通过 Gate 上线，再用证据驱动下一轮 使用 CI/CD 与必要的人审 Gate 部署；让 Agent 协助观察日志、发现问题、提出修复，但高风险副作用仍需要明确权限、验证与回滚边界。  ITERATIVE, NOT LINEAR Verification 失败不只是“再生成一次代码”。它可能意味着 Spec 不清、架构假设错误、上下文过期、任务拆分不合理或验证器本身不够好。Monitoring 暴露的问题同样可能要求回到 Planning，而不是只在生产环境里打补丁。
textEn: Coding Agent Engineering: From writing code to specifying, directing, and verifying §8.7  Coding agents do not remove the software-engineering workflow; they redistribute engineering attention. Less time is spent typing code, while more time moves to deciding what to build, designing the architecture, writing a clear spec, calibrating agent autonomy, verifying results, and feeding later evidence back into earlier stages. They can also perform non-code execution such as data analysis and system operations, so the engineering problem is to govern the whole execution loop rather than code generation alone.  FIG.8.7 The coding-agent workflow is still software engineering; what changes is who executes and where human attention goes Planning → Execution → Deployment & Monitoring is not a one-way pipeline. When verification or monitoring fails, return to an earlier stage to revise the spec, architecture, context, or execution plan. 1 · PLAN Research, understand the codebase, write the spec, decompose the plan Clarify requirements, technical design, architecture, constraints, and acceptance criteria before execution. Then interrogate assumptions, security risks, and overengineering. A greenfield prototype may need a light spec; a complex brownfield system needs much more rigorous planning and validation. 2 · EXECUTE Build, test, verify, and calibrate autonomy Decide which steps need tight human-agent iteration and which can be delegated as larger work units. At the same time, manage context, permissions, parallel agents, and the finite budget of human attention. 3 · DEPLOY / OBSERVE Deploy through gates, then use evidence to drive the next iteration Deploy through CI/CD and human gates where appropriate. Agents can watch logs, surface issues, and propose fixes, but high-risk side effects still need explicit permission, verification, and rollback boundaries.  ITERATIVE, NOT LINEAR A verification failure is not merely a signal to regenerate code. It may reveal an unclear spec, a wrong architecture assumption, stale context, poor task decomposition, or an inadequate verifier. Problems found in monitoring may likewise require returning to planning rather than patching production locally.

titleZh: 08 五项核心能力：真正的稀缺资源是工程判断
titleEn: 08 Five core skills: engineering judgment is the scarce resource
textZh: 五项核心能力：真正的稀缺资源是工程判断  能力 工程师真正要决定什么 薄弱时的典型失败 Directing the workflow 规划多深、何时开始执行、何时回退、何时保留 Human Ownership；如何选择架构、写 planning artifacts / Spec，并在速度、成本、技术风险与人工投入之间权衡。 Agent 很快地把错误问题做完，或者在没有验收标准的情况下持续漂移。 Enabling agent autonomy 每个阶段需要多少自主权；什么时候交互式盯紧，什么时候委托大块工作或 bounded loop，什么时候并行多个 Agent，以及如何管理 Context、权限、Gate 与 Blast Radius。 把“自主运行时间长”误当成熟度，导致错误更快扩散、上下文失真或高风险动作失控。 Reviewing the work 什么证据能证明完成：自动测试、行为与功能验证、截图或 Artifact、Eval Set、LLM-as-judge、Agentic Code Review、安全/架构审计，以及哪些关键点仍需要人工判断。 Agent 自己宣布完成就被当成完成，或者测试只验证实现细节而没有验证真实目标。 Customizing the agent and its environment 如何用 Skills、Plugins、MCP、Hooks 与项目级说明文件提供工具和 Standing Context；如何跨 Session 保存必要状态、沉淀复盘，并清理过时能力与 Agent-generated debt。 每个 Session 都重新解释项目，Agent 频繁丢背景，工具权限过宽，旧 Skill 与新模型能力互相冲突。 Coding agent foundations 理解 Agent 如何搜索代码、检索上下文、使用 Context Window、调用工具与 Subagent，以及 Harness 如何约束模型行为与上下文成本。 看不出 Agent 为什么过度设计、遗漏约束、提前停止或在错误上下文里继续自信执行。  AUTONOMY 自主权是阶段级控制变量，不是成熟度徽章 高自主权适合可验证、可回滚、Blast Radius 小的工作；高风险规划、权限变更、生产副作用和不可逆动作应保留更强的人类 Gate。 CONTEXT Context 是工程基础设施，不是一次性 Prompt 项目约束、架构假设、代码风格、数据访问模式和当前 Spec 应有稳定、可维护的载体。需求中途变化时，必须更新 Agent 实际读取的 Context，而不是只在人的脑中更新。  CANONICAL RULE A coding agent is not an autonomous coder; it is an execution component inside a human-directed, testable, permissioned engineering loop. Verification 属于 Execution 本身，而不是完成之后才补做的后处理。  CANONICAL RULE Coding agents lower the cost of implementation; they raise the value of specification, verification, and engineering judgment.  PITFALL Long-running autonomy is not a quality metric. 真正重要的是：目标是否清晰、Context 是否正确、权限是否受控、Verification 是否可信，以及工程师是否知道什么时候介入、回退或停止。  CH08 → CH09 · CONTROL PLANE Chapter 08 负责 Coding Agent 的 Build / Execute：规划、委托、工具、状态、自主权与恢复。Chapter 09 负责外层 Reliability Control Plane：Validation、Eval、Observability、Release Gate、Monitoring 与生产证据回流。Reviewing the work 因此不应停在本地 Code Review，而要一直延伸到生产后的 regression protection。  来源说明：本节依据 Andrew Ng 于 2026-09-04 发布的《AI Engineering Skills Map: Using coding agents》整理。原文把 Coding Agent 工作归纳为 Planning → Execution → Deployment & Monitoring，并提出五项核心能力：Directing the workflow、Enabling agent autonomy、Reviewing the work、Customizing the agent and its environment、Coding agent foundations。控制闭环、CH08 → CH09 边界与上述 canonical rules 是本手册基于原文和既有可靠性模型做的工程化抽象，不作为 Andrew Ng 的直接引语。 Andrew Ng · AI Engineering Skills Map: Using coding agents · Andrew Ng · Writing
textEn: Five core skills: engineering judgment is the scarce resource  Skill What the engineer actually decides Typical failure when weak Directing the workflow How deeply to plan, when to start executing or step back, when to retain human ownership, how to choose the architecture and write planning artifacts or specs, and how to trade off speed, cost, technical risk, and human effort. The agent quickly completes the wrong problem or keeps drifting without concrete acceptance criteria. Enabling agent autonomy How much autonomy each stage deserves; when to stay interactive, when to delegate a larger work unit or bounded loop, when to run agents in parallel, and how to manage context, permissions, gates, and blast radius. Long autonomous runs are mistaken for maturity, so mistakes spread faster, context drifts, or high-risk actions escape control. Reviewing the work What evidence proves completion: automated tests, behavioral and functional checks, screenshots or artifacts, eval sets, LLM-as-judge, agentic code review, security and architecture audits, and which critical points still require human judgment. The agent's own claim of completion is accepted as proof, or tests validate implementation details without validating the real objective. Customizing the agent and its environment How to provide tools and standing context with skills, plugins, MCP, hooks, and project-level instruction files; how to preserve necessary state across sessions, capture retrospectives, and prune obsolete capabilities and agent-generated debt. Every session starts from scratch, the agent repeatedly loses project context, tool permissions are too broad, or stale skills conflict with newer model capabilities. Coding agent foundations Understand how the agent searches code, retrieves context, uses its context window, calls tools and subagents, and how the harness constrains model behavior and context cost. You cannot diagnose why the agent overengineers, misses constraints, stops too early, or keeps executing confidently with the wrong context.  AUTONOMY Autonomy is a stage-level control variable, not a maturity badge High autonomy fits work that is verifiable, reversible, and low-blast-radius. High-risk planning, permission changes, production side effects, and irreversible actions should retain stronger human gates. CONTEXT Context is engineering infrastructure, not a one-off prompt Project constraints, architecture assumptions, code style, data-access patterns, and the current spec need stable, maintainable carriers. When requirements change mid-project, update the context the agent actually reads rather than changing only the human mental model.  CANONICAL RULE A coding agent is not an autonomous coder; it is an execution component inside a human-directed, testable, permissioned engineering loop. Verification is part of execution itself, not post-processing added after the work is supposedly complete.  CANONICAL RULE Coding agents lower the cost of implementation; they raise the value of specification, verification, and engineering judgment.  PITFALL Long-running autonomy is not a quality metric. What matters is whether the goal is clear, the context is correct, permissions are bounded, verification is trustworthy, and the engineer knows when to intervene, step back, or stop.  CH08 → CH09 · CONTROL PLANE Chapter 08 owns Coding Agent build and execution: planning, delegation, tools, state, autonomy, and recovery. Chapter 09 provides the outer reliability control plane: validation, evals, observability, release gates, monitoring, and production evidence feedback. Reviewing the work therefore should not stop at local code review; it extends into post-release regression protection.  Source note: this section is based on Andrew Ng's AI Engineering Skills Map: Using coding agents, published on 2026-09-04. The source organizes coding-agent work around Planning → Execution → Deployment & Monitoring and names five core skills: Directing the workflow, Enabling agent autonomy, Reviewing the work, Customizing the agent and its environment, and Coding agent foundations. The control-loop framing, CH08 → CH09 boundary, and canonical rules above are handbook engineering abstractions built from the source and the handbook's existing reliability model; they are not presented as direct quotations from Andrew Ng. Andrew Ng · AI Engineering Skills Map: Using coding agents · Andrew Ng · Writing

titleZh: 08 Agent Project Engineering Lifecycle：从 Demo 到可维护系统 §8.P
titleEn: 08 Agent Project Engineering Lifecycle: from demo to maintainable system
textZh: Agent Project Engineering Lifecycle：从 Demo 到可维护系统 §8.P  能调用模型和 Tool 只说明执行链路存在。真正可维护的 Agent 项目还需要任务契约、仓库规范、运行拓扑、能力契约、状态生命周期、评估证据和生产反馈。  FIG.8.P1 · AGENT PROJECT ENGINEERING LIFECYCLE 十个教学步骤，收敛成五个工程阶段 这不是一次性的 waterfall。Eval、Trace 与 Production Failure 都可以把工作送回更早的错误层。 DEFINE Task Contract + Repository Contract + Architecture Goal · Input · Output · Boundary · Success Criteria；再明确目录、测试命令、依赖/Secret 规则、模块职责和失败路径。 BUILD Agent · Tools · Skills · Context / Memory · Prompt Agent 负责不确定判断；Workflow 负责显式控制；Tool 提供单一能力；Skill 固化方法；State/Memory 管信息生命周期；Prompt 作为版本化行为配置。 VERIFY Test + Eval Test 验证程序契约；Eval 验证任务行为。固定 Dataset 让模型、Prompt、Skill 与 Workflow 版本可以被真正比较。 OPERATE Deploy · Trace · Monitor 把 request、workflow state、Agent decision、Tool I/O、版本、Token、Latency、Cost 与 Task Outcome 连到同一条可诊断链路。 LEARN ↺ Root Cause → Dataset → Fix → Regression 生产证据应回到最早错误层：错误 State 修 State；错误 Tool 修 Tool；过时数据源修数据源；不是所有问题都回去改 Prompt。 工程目标 Make uncertain model behavior reliably serve a bounded, testable, observable business task.  FIG.8.P2 · RESPONSIBILITY BOUNDARIES 别把所有东西都叫 Agent 长期可维护性来自责任边界：谁负责判断、谁负责执行、谁保存状态、谁验证成功。 组件 负责什么 不应该偷偷负责什么 Workflow 顺序、分支、重试、回退、停止 开放式业务判断 Agent 不确定判断、规划、诊断、选择 隐式拥有全部流程和权限 Tool 单一、可测试的外部操作 完整任务方法 Skill 经过验证的可复用任务方法 协议或最终授权 Context / State 当前任务真正需要的信息与执行状态 无限历史堆积 Memory 经筛选的长期有用信息 所有临时结果和错误 Test / Eval 程序契约 + 任务行为证据 凭感觉判断“更聪明” 项目规范 Coding Agent 的项目指令文件应保持精炼，并指向真正的架构、测试和产品文档。以 Codex 为例，AGENTS.md 是官方支持的项目指令机制，但它不是所有 Agent 工具的统一标准。  FIG.8.P3 · AGENT ENGINEER CAPABILITY STACK 不是会几个框架，而是能不能把业务目标交付成可运营系统 四层能力形成一条闭环：业务定义目标，架构承载执行，可靠性提供证据，交付让系统持续演进。 1 · BUSINESS 业务拆解与流程设计 KPI · current workflow · automation boundary · human gate · exception path · Task Contract。不要先问用什么框架，先问成功是什么。 2 · ARCHITECTURE 运行时与能力架构 Tool / schema · Workflow · Agent · State · Context · Memory · Routing · Permission · failure semantics 3 · RELIABILITY 评估、可观测性与稳定性 task success · tool failure · latency · cost/success · human escalation · trace · alert · fallback · regression gate 4 · DELIVERY 工程交付与持续迭代 versioning · CI/CD · environment separation · rollout · rollback · runbook · incident diagnosis · production learning BUSINESS PROBLEM “Support cost is too high” 先转成 bounded outcome / KPI / automation boundary。 SYSTEM Task Contract → Runtime Architecture 选择 Workflow / Agent / Tool / State，而不是让框架反向定义业务。 EVIDENCE Eval → Trace → Release Gate 证明任务成功、失败位置、成本和风险，而不是“感觉还不错”。 PRODUCTION LEARNING ↺ Operate → Diagnose → Regression → Improve 上线后才获得真实 failure distribution；证据回流到最早错误层。 能力边界 Agent engineering competence is the ability to turn an ambiguous business objective into a bounded, testable, observable, operable system. 版本兼容 模型升级后 Prompt 是否仍可用，不能靠假设；固定 regression suite 后再比较 task success、safety、latency 与 cost。
textEn: Agent Project Engineering Lifecycle: from demo to maintainable system §8.P  Calling a model and tools only proves that an execution path exists. A maintainable Agent project also needs a task contract, repository conventions, runtime topology, capability contracts, state lifecycles, evaluation evidence, and production feedback.  FIG.8.P1 · AGENT PROJECT ENGINEERING LIFECYCLE Ten teaching steps collapse into five engineering phases This is not a one-way waterfall. Evals, traces, and production failures can route work back to the earliest incorrect layer. DEFINE Task Contract + Repository Contract + Architecture Goal · Input · Output · Boundary · Success Criteria; then define repository conventions, validation commands, dependency/secret rules, module responsibilities, and failure paths. BUILD Agent · Tools · Skills · Context / Memory · Prompt Agents handle uncertain decisions; workflows own explicit control; tools expose single capabilities; skills encode methods; state/memory manage information lifecycles; prompts become versioned behavior configuration. VERIFY Test + Eval Tests validate program contracts; evals validate task behavior. A fixed dataset makes model, prompt, skill, and workflow versions genuinely comparable. OPERATE Deploy · Trace · Monitor Connect request, workflow state, Agent decisions, tool I/O, versions, tokens, latency, cost, and task outcome into one diagnosable execution path. LEARN ↺ Root Cause → Dataset → Fix → Regression Production evidence should return to the earliest wrong layer: fix state when state is wrong, fix tools when tools fail, fix stale sources when evidence is stale—not every problem belongs in the prompt. Engineering goal Make uncertain model behavior reliably serve a bounded, testable, observable business task.  FIG.8.P2 · RESPONSIBILITY BOUNDARIES Do not call every responsibility an Agent Long-term maintainability comes from responsibility boundaries: who decides, who executes, who stores state, and who verifies success. Component Owns Should not silently own Workflow Order, branching, retries, fallback, stopping Open-ended business judgment Agent Uncertain judgment, planning, diagnosis, selection Implicit ownership of all flow and authority Tool A single testable external operation A full task procedure Skill A validated reusable task method Protocol transport or final authorization Context / State Task-relevant information and execution state Unlimited transcript accumulation Memory Curated durable information Every temporary result and error Test / Eval Program contracts + task-behavior evidence Judging improvement by intuition Repository instructions Coding-agent repository instructions should stay concise and point to the real architecture, test, and product documentation. Codex officially supports AGENTS.md, but that filename is not a universal standard across all Agent tools.  FIG.8.P3 · AGENT ENGINEER CAPABILITY STACK The differentiator is not framework count, but turning a business objective into an operable system Four capability layers form one loop: business defines the objective, architecture carries execution, reliability supplies evidence, and delivery keeps the system evolving. 1 · BUSINESS Business decomposition & workflow design KPI · current workflow · automation boundary · human gate · exception path · Task Contract. Ask what success means before choosing a framework. 2 · ARCHITECTURE Runtime & capability architecture Tool / schema · Workflow · Agent · State · Context · Memory · Routing · Permission · failure semantics 3 · RELIABILITY Evaluation, observability & reliability task success · tool failure · latency · cost/success · human escalation · trace · alert · fallback · regression gate 4 · DELIVERY Engineering delivery & continuous iteration versioning · CI/CD · environment separation · rollout · rollback · runbook · incident diagnosis · production learning BUSINESS PROBLEM “Support cost is too high” Translate first into bounded outcomes, KPIs, and automation boundaries. SYSTEM Task Contract → Runtime Architecture Choose workflow, agent, tools, and state; do not let the framework define the business problem backwards. EVIDENCE Eval → Trace → Release Gate Prove task success, failure location, cost, and risk instead of relying on intuition. PRODUCTION LEARNING ↺ Operate → Diagnose → Regression → Improve Production reveals the real failure distribution; route evidence back to the earliest incorrect layer. Capability boundary Agent engineering competence is the ability to turn an ambiguous business objective into a bounded, testable, observable, operable system. Version compatibility Do not assume prompts remain compatible after a model upgrade; run a fixed regression suite and compare task success, safety, latency, and cost.

titleZh: 08 Agent Architecture Selection：Pattern，不是七档成熟度 §8.AS
titleEn: 08 Agent Architecture Selection: patterns, not seven maturity tiers
textZh: Agent Architecture Selection：Pattern，不是七档成熟度 §8.AS  Single Agent、ReAct、Plan & Execute、Multi-Agent、Route + Skill、Shared State 与 Graph Workflow 不是同一维度的互斥架构。生产系统通常组合它们，真正的选型依据是控制流、状态、权限、恢复、成本与延迟。  FIG.8.AS1 · AGENT ARCHITECTURE PATTERN SPACE “七种架构”其实分属五个控制维度 不要问“我属于哪一档”，而要问“我的系统在哪些维度需要更强控制”。 ACTORS Single Agent ↔ Multi-Agent 决定需要几个独立决策主体，以及是否存在真实的 Context、权限、工具、评估或并行边界。 DECISION ReAct ↔ Plan & Execute 局部一步一决策，还是先做全局分解再执行、验证与重新规划。 CAPABILITY Router + Skill 当能力集合可枚举、边界可描述、路由可评估时，把开放推理压缩成候选能力选择。 STATE Shared State / Blackboard-like 多个 Worker 围绕共享工作对象协作，需要 typed state、ownership、merge/reducer、version 与 conflict policy。 CONTROL Graph / Durable Workflow 当 branch、join、loop、checkpoint、resume、HITL、恢复与审计路径本身就是业务契约时，把拓扑显式化。 组合原则 Agent architectures are composable control patterns, not a maturity ladder.  FIG.8.AS2 · FAILURE-DRIVEN SELECTION 从真实失败模式反推控制 Pattern 只有当新的控制结构解决了已观察到的问题，它的复杂度才值得。 失败 / 需求 优先考虑 为什么 Small tool set · short horizon Bounded Single Agent 最小协调开销 Next action depends on fresh observation ReAct-style loop 逐步动态决策 Long task · global decomposition Plan & Execute 分离规划与执行，并允许 re-plan Large known capability catalog Router + Skill 可检索、可授权、可评估 Context / permission isolation Multi-Agent / Subgraph 真实 operational boundary Shared work state conflicts Typed Shared State 明确 ownership、reducer 和 version Branch / join / loop / HITL Graph Workflow 控制拓扑成为业务规则 Crash must not restart the whole job Durable Workflow Runtime 恢复保证优先 框架 ≠ Pattern LangGraph 是 stateful Agent orchestration；Temporal 强调 durable workflow execution；Prefect 是 workflow orchestration；n8n 是 workflow automation。选择 runtime 时看 execution guarantee 和 integration model，而不是都贴上“Agent Graph”标签。
textEn: Agent Architecture Selection: patterns, not seven maturity tiers §8.AS  Single Agent, ReAct, Plan & Execute, Multi-Agent, Route + Skill, Shared State, and Graph Workflow are not mutually exclusive architectures on one axis. Production systems usually compose them; control flow, state, permissions, recovery, cost, and latency drive the choice.  FIG.8.AS1 · AGENT ARCHITECTURE PATTERN SPACE The seven architectures actually span five control dimensions Do not ask which tier you belong to; ask which dimensions of your system need stronger control. ACTORS Single Agent ↔ Multi-Agent Decides how many independent decision makers are needed and whether real context, permission, tool, evaluation, or parallelism boundaries exist. DECISION ReAct ↔ Plan & Execute Choose between local step-by-step decisions and global decomposition followed by execution, verification, and replanning. CAPABILITY Router + Skill When capabilities are enumerable, bounded, and evaluable, reduce open-ended reasoning into explicit capability selection. STATE Shared State / Blackboard-like Multiple workers collaborate around shared work state, requiring typed state, ownership, merge/reducer rules, versioning, and conflict policy. CONTROL Graph / Durable Workflow When branch, join, loop, checkpoint, resume, HITL, recovery, and audit paths are application contracts, make the topology explicit. Composition rule Agent architectures are composable control patterns, not a maturity ladder.  FIG.8.AS2 · FAILURE-DRIVEN SELECTION Select control patterns from observed failure modes A new control structure is worth its complexity only when it solves an observed problem. Failure / requirement First pattern to consider Why Small tool set · short horizon Bounded Single Agent Minimum coordination overhead Next action depends on fresh observation ReAct-style loop Stepwise dynamic decisions Long task · global decomposition Plan & Execute Separate planning from execution and allow replanning Large known capability catalog Router + Skill Retrievable, authorizable, and evaluable Context / permission isolation Multi-Agent / Subgraph Real operational boundaries Shared work state conflicts Typed Shared State Explicit ownership, reducers, and versions Branch / join / loop / HITL Graph Workflow Control topology becomes application logic Crash must not restart the whole job Durable Workflow Runtime Recovery guarantees first Framework ≠ pattern LangGraph is stateful Agent orchestration; Temporal emphasizes durable workflow execution; Prefect is workflow orchestration; n8n is workflow automation. Choose runtimes by execution guarantees and integration model rather than labeling all of them Agent Graph frameworks.

titleZh: 08 Multi-Agent Conflict Control：冲突要进 Control Plane §8.R
titleEn: 08 Multi-Agent Conflict Control: route disagreement into the control plane
textZh: Multi-Agent Conflict Control：冲突要进 Control Plane §8.R  生产级 Multi-Agent 不追求“Agent 永远不冲突”，而是把冲突分类成 authority、quality、resource 三类，并分别用权限、证据、状态机与并发控制解决。  FIG.8.R1 · CONFLICT CONTROL MATRIX 先问冲突属于哪一层，再决定怎么仲裁 冲突类型 真正问题 错误默认 生产控制 Authority 谁有权决定下一步？ 职位高的 Agent 自动正确 authority matrix · evidence · policy / human escalation Quality 结果是否真的满足标准？ 再叫一个 Judge 发表意见 read-only verifier · reproducible evidence · bounded repair Resource 谁能修改共享资源，什么时候修改？ Prompt 里提醒“别改同一文件” ownership · isolation · CAS · merge / validation gate 多数票边界 Three votes are not three independent observations. Count independent evidence before counting Agent opinions.  FIG.8.R2 · MULTI-AGENT HARNESS CONTROL Evidence → Authority → State Transition → Recovery 意见可以来自模型，但真正的执行权、状态转换和共享资源修改必须由 Harness 明确控制。 01 Finding / Artifact Worker / Specialist 返回结论，但同时携带 evidence、uncertainty、artifact version 与 blocking risk。 02 Verifier 优先用 test / command / structured check；模型 Judge 只在需要语境判断时进入，并输出 PASS / FAIL / PARTIAL + evidence。 03 Authority Gate Lead 可拥有 orchestration authority，但 truth authority 来自 evidence；高风险、越权或超 Scope 决策进入 Policy / Human Gate。 04 State / Concurrency Gate Task DAG、owner、revision / CAS、write-scope warning、workspace isolation 与 merge gate 约束共享状态修改。 05 Repair / Escalate / Complete Repair Loop 必须有 attempt budget；超过预算、证据不足或权限不够时显式 ESCALATE，而不是无限 Reviewer ↔ Worker 循环。 DEEPSEEK HARNESS 当前实验性 Agent Teams 一手资料支持 shared task DAG、monotonic revision + CAS、Lead-only teammate lifecycle 与 write-scope overlap warning；但 writeScopes 明确只是 advisory，不是 lock，而且默认共享 checkout，不会自动创建 Git worktree。 最终原则 A reliable Multi-Agent system is not one where Agents rarely disagree; it is one where disagreement has a deterministic resolution path.  FIG.8.R3 · FOUR-LAYER CONSISTENCY MODEL 一致性不是 Agent 观点相同，而是四层都有明确提交语义 Communication topology 可以灵活，但 State、Execution、Artifact、Decision 的 authoritative path 必须可检查、可拒绝 stale/duplicate、可审计。 STATE CONSISTENCY One authoritative commit path authoritative store · versioned snapshot · revision/CAS · single writer / transaction / workflow engine。重点是 local view 不等于 committed state。 EXECUTION CONSISTENCY Duplicate delivery must not mean duplicate effect task id · lease · dedupe · idempotency · reconciliation。Lock 解决 mutual exclusion；幂等解决重复业务副作用，两者不能混为一谈。 ARTIFACT CONSISTENCY Candidate → Validate → Commit schema · provenance · lineage · integrity · acceptance。并行结果先 normalize / conflict-detect / validate，再产生 committed artifact，而不是直接 concat。 DECISION CONSISTENCY Evidence + Authority + Policy 允许合理分歧存在；deterministic verifier、contextual judge、authority matrix、policy 与 human escalation 决定 committed action。 视频里的强结论 生产级改写 子 Agent 禁止直接通信 可以通信，但不能绕过 authoritative state / policy / side-effect commit path 所有 Agent 必须看到最新数据 按边界定义 consistency contract；有时同一 versioned snapshot 更正确 加分布式锁就不会重复 lock ≠ idempotency · dedupe · reconciliation Validator 保证唯一准确答案 Validator 分类 agreement / conflict / insufficient evidence，并允许 escalation 最终原则 Communication may be flexible; commit semantics must be explicit.
textEn: Multi-Agent Conflict Control: route disagreement into the control plane §8.R  Production Multi-Agent systems do not aim for agents that never disagree. They classify conflicts into authority, quality, and resource conflicts, then resolve them with permissions, evidence, state machines, and concurrency control.  FIG.8.R1 · CONFLICT CONTROL MATRIX Classify the conflict before choosing a resolution mechanism Conflict type Actual question Weak default Production control Authority Who is authorized to decide the next step? Higher-ranked agent is automatically correct authority matrix · evidence · policy / human escalation Quality Does the artifact actually satisfy the acceptance criteria? Ask another Judge for one more opinion read-only verifier · reproducible evidence · bounded repair Resource Who may mutate shared resources, and when? Prompt everyone not to touch the same file ownership · isolation · CAS · merge / validation gate Voting boundary Three votes are not three independent observations. Count independent evidence before counting Agent opinions.  FIG.8.R2 · MULTI-AGENT HARNESS CONTROL Evidence → Authority → State Transition → Recovery Opinions may come from models, but execution authority, state transitions, and shared-resource mutation must be controlled explicitly by the harness. 01 Finding / Artifact Workers and specialists return conclusions together with evidence, uncertainty, artifact versions, and blocking risks. 02 Verifier Prefer tests, commands, and structured checks. Use a model judge only when contextual judgment is needed, returning PASS / FAIL / PARTIAL plus evidence. 03 Authority Gate The Lead may own orchestration authority, while truth authority comes from evidence. High-risk, unauthorized, or out-of-scope decisions route to a Policy or Human Gate. 04 State / Concurrency Gate Task DAGs, ownership, revision/CAS, write-scope warnings, workspace isolation, and merge gates constrain shared-state mutation. 05 Repair / Escalate / Complete Repair loops need an attempt budget. When the budget is exhausted, evidence is insufficient, or authority is missing, escalate explicitly instead of looping forever between reviewer and worker. DEEPSEEK HARNESS Current first-party material for the experimental Agent Teams supports a shared task DAG, monotonic revisions with CAS, Lead-only teammate lifecycle controls, and write-scope overlap warnings. But writeScopes are explicitly advisory rather than locks, and the default is a shared checkout with no automatic Git worktree creation. Final rule A reliable Multi-Agent system is not one where Agents rarely disagree; it is one where disagreement has a deterministic resolution path.  FIG.8.R3 · FOUR-LAYER CONSISTENCY MODEL Consistency is not model agreement; each of four layers needs explicit commit semantics Communication topology may be flexible, but the authoritative paths for state, execution, artifacts, and decisions must be inspectable, reject stale or duplicate work, and remain auditable. STATE CONSISTENCY One authoritative commit path authoritative store · versioned snapshot · revision/CAS · single writer / transaction / workflow engine. The key boundary is that a local view is not committed state. EXECUTION CONSISTENCY Duplicate delivery must not mean duplicate effect task id · lease · dedupe · idempotency · reconciliation. Locks address mutual exclusion; idempotency addresses duplicate business effects. They are different guarantees. ARTIFACT CONSISTENCY Candidate → Validate → Commit schema · provenance · lineage · integrity · acceptance. Parallel outputs are normalized, conflict-checked, and validated before a committed artifact is produced instead of being concatenated directly. DECISION CONSISTENCY Evidence + Authority + Policy Meaningful disagreement may remain. Deterministic verifiers, contextual judges, authority matrices, policy, and human escalation determine the committed action. Over-strong claim Production-grade rewrite Subagents must never communicate directly Agents may communicate, but not bypass authoritative state, policy, or side-effect commit paths Every agent must always see the latest data Specify consistency per boundary; sometimes one versioned snapshot is more correct A distributed lock prevents duplicates lock ≠ idempotency · dedupe · reconciliation A validator guarantees one uniquely correct answer Validators classify agreement, conflict, or insufficient evidence and may escalate Final rule Communication may be flexible; commit semantics must be explicit.

titleZh: 08 Effective Agent Harness：Simplicity · Transparency · ACI §8.Z
titleEn: 08 Effective Agent Harness: Simplicity · Transparency · ACI
textZh: Effective Agent Harness：Simplicity · Transparency · ACI §8.Z  优秀 Agent 不是“最强模型 + 最多工具 + 最复杂框架”。模型提供能力上限，Harness 决定 Context、Tool、State、Environment Feedback、Validation 与 Human Control 如何把能力转成稳定执行。  FIG.8.Z1 · EFFECTIVE AGENT PRINCIPLES Anthropic 的三原则可以直接落成 Harness 设计问题 SIMPLICITY 只为真实 failure mode 增加复杂度 single call → tool loop → workflow → graph → multi-agent。升级必须能解释解决了哪个 state、recovery、permission、parallelism 或 observability 问题。 TRANSPARENCY 展示 Plan · Action · Evidence · State 透明不是暴露 hidden CoT，而是让 todo、工具调用、结果、diff、测试、retry、approval 与 completion evidence 可观察、可纠偏。 ACI Agent-Computer Interface Tool name、schema、参数语义、错误模型与返回证据本身就是 Prompt Engineering；重复错误优先通过 interface constraint 消除。  FIG.8.Z2 · HARNESS CONTROL LOOP 模型输出不是完成证据，Environment Feedback 才能闭环 1 Plan / Decide 选择下一步，不把规划本身当真相。 2 Tool / Action 通过清晰 ACI 执行 bounded action；Host / Policy 保留真实权限。 3 Observe Ground Truth tool result · test · diff · browser observation · retrieval evidence · policy result 4 Update State / Verify 根据真实环境证据继续、修复、回退、升级或停止。 5 Trace → Eval → ACI Repair 把重复工具错误聚类，修 name/schema/default/error message/validation，再跑 regression。  FIG.8.Z3 · ACI / PI IMPLEMENTATION NOTES 实现案例要保留产品边界，不把具体设计误写成通用定律 案例 当前可验证事实 可复用原则 Pi Tool Surface default: read · bash · edit · write; prompt rules follow enabled tools Prompt inventory 与 executable capability inventory 不应漂移 Pi edit unique oldText · same-original multi-edit · diff/patch evidence 把 deterministic bookkeeping 移出模型 action space Pi path relative OR absolute 不要把产品实现误写成绝对路径通则 Anthropic SWE-bench Tool relative-path errors → required absolute path Poka-yoke repeated failure at the interface Pi Session JSONL · id/parentId tree · compaction preserves raw history Audit history ≠ active model context ≠ summary 工具最小化 Minimize overlapping ways to express the same action. 目标是减少语义重叠和选择歧义，不是机械追求 tool count 最小。 透明边界 Expose plans, actions, state transitions, evidence, and concise reasoning summaries when useful. 不要让系统依赖 hidden Chain-of-Thought 才能调试或审计。  FIG.8.Z4 · HARNESS EVOLUTION 模型越强，Harness 不一定越少：它会从“代偿”迁移到“治理” 部分旧逻辑会被 Model / Provider Runtime 吸收，但 autonomy、blast radius 和真实资源访问越大，系统越需要明确的权限、状态、成本、审计与恢复保证。 COMPENSATORY HARNESS 弥补模型能力缺口 format repair · rigid retry loops · weak-planning scaffolds · argument normalization · basic self-correction GOVERNANCE / RUNTIME HARNESS 约束更强的行动能力 permission · sandbox · durable state · budget · timeout · audit · approval · recovery · tenant boundary MODEL CAPABILITY ↑ 一些补偿逻辑被模型 / SDK / Provider Runtime 吸收 structured arguments · tool dispatch · handoffs · sessions · simple retry/self-correction · built-in shell/computer primitives AUTONOMY / BLAST RADIUS ↑ 系统保证变得更重要，而不是更少 谁能做什么、状态是否持久、成本是否受控、失败如何恢复、动作能否审计，这些都必须由 runtime contract 明确承担。 问题 模型能力 Harness 保证 能不能想出下一步？ planning / reasoning — 允不允许做？ — permission / policy / approval 崩溃后还能继续吗？ — state / checkpoint / reconciliation 会不会无限烧钱？ — budget / rate / timeout / cancellation 出了问题能解释吗？ — observable trace / artifact / evidence 最终原则 Model improvement removes some scaffolding; it does not remove the need for runtime guarantees. TRACE BOUNDARY 记录 observable trajectory：tool calls、handoffs、guardrails、state transitions、errors、artifacts、latency/cost；不要把 private hidden Chain-of-Thought 当成 Harness 必须落盘的数据。  外部核验日期：2026-09-28。来源包括 Anthropic Building Effective Agents、Pi 当前源码与 Session 文档、Anthropic claude-cookbooks、12-factor-agents，以及 OpenAI Harness Engineering。产品事实作为 implementation evidence，核心规则保持 vendor-neutral。
textEn: Effective Agent Harness: Simplicity · Transparency · ACI §8.Z  A strong agent is not the strongest model plus the most tools and the most complex framework. The model supplies capability; the harness determines how context, tools, state, environment feedback, validation, and human control convert that capability into reliable execution.  FIG.8.Z1 · EFFECTIVE AGENT PRINCIPLES Anthropic's three principles map directly to harness design questions SIMPLICITY Add complexity only for real failure modes single call → tool loop → workflow → graph → multi-agent. Each upgrade should solve a concrete state, recovery, permission, parallelism, or observability problem. TRANSPARENCY Expose Plan · Action · Evidence · State Transparency is not exposing hidden chain-of-thought. Make todos, tool calls, results, diffs, tests, retries, approvals, and completion evidence observable and steerable. ACI Agent-Computer Interface Tool names, schemas, parameter semantics, error models, and returned evidence are themselves prompt engineering. Repeated errors should first be attacked with interface constraints.  FIG.8.Z2 · HARNESS CONTROL LOOP Model output is not completion evidence; environment feedback closes the loop 1 Plan / Decide Choose the next step without treating the plan itself as ground truth. 2 Tool / Action Execute a bounded action through a clear ACI while the host and policy layer retain real authority. 3 Observe Ground Truth tool result · test · diff · browser observation · retrieval evidence · policy result 4 Update State / Verify Use real environment evidence to continue, repair, roll back, escalate, or stop. 5 Trace → Eval → ACI Repair Cluster repeated tool failures, repair names, schemas, defaults, error messages, or validation, then rerun regression evaluation.  FIG.8.Z3 · ACI / PI IMPLEMENTATION NOTES Keep implementation boundaries explicit instead of turning product details into universal laws Example Currently verified fact Reusable principle Pi Tool Surface default: read · bash · edit · write; prompt rules follow enabled tools Prompt inventory and executable capability inventory should not drift Pi edit unique oldText · same-original multi-edit · diff/patch evidence Move deterministic bookkeeping out of the model's action space Pi path relative OR absolute Do not turn a product implementation into a universal absolute-path rule Anthropic SWE-bench Tool relative-path errors → required absolute path Poka-yoke repeated failure at the interface Pi Session JSONL · id/parentId tree · compaction preserves raw history Audit history ≠ active model context ≠ summary Tool minimalism Minimize overlapping ways to express the same action. The goal is to reduce semantic overlap and choice ambiguity, not mechanically minimize tool count. Transparency boundary Expose plans, actions, state transitions, evidence, and concise reasoning summaries when useful. Do not make debugging or auditing depend on hidden chain-of-thought.  FIG.8.Z4 · HARNESS EVOLUTION As models get stronger, harness work does not simply disappear; it shifts from compensation to governance Some older scaffolding may move into the model or provider runtime, but greater autonomy, blast radius, and real-resource access increase the need for explicit permission, state, cost, audit, and recovery guarantees. COMPENSATORY HARNESS Compensate for model capability gaps format repair · rigid retry loops · weak-planning scaffolds · argument normalization · basic self-correction GOVERNANCE / RUNTIME HARNESS Govern stronger action capability permission · sandbox · durable state · budget · timeout · audit · approval · recovery · tenant boundary MODEL CAPABILITY ↑ Some compensating logic moves into the model, SDK, or provider runtime structured arguments · tool dispatch · handoffs · sessions · simple retry/self-correction · built-in shell/computer primitives AUTONOMY / BLAST RADIUS ↑ System guarantees become more important, not less Who may do what, whether state is durable, whether cost is bounded, how failures recover, and whether actions are auditable must all be owned by an explicit runtime contract. Question Model capability Harness guarantee Can it figure out the next step? planning / reasoning — Is it allowed to do it? — permission / policy / approval Can it resume after a crash? — state / checkpoint / reconciliation Can it consume unbounded cost? — budget / rate / timeout / cancellation Can failures be explained and audited? — observable trace / artifact / evidence Final rule Model improvement removes some scaffolding; it does not remove the need for runtime guarantees. TRACE BOUNDARY Trace observable trajectory—tool calls, handoffs, guardrails, state transitions, errors, artifacts, latency, and cost. Do not make private hidden chain-of-thought a required harness log.  External verification date: 2026-09-28. Sources include Anthropic's Building Effective Agents, current Pi source and session documentation, Anthropic claude-cookbooks, 12-factor-agents, and OpenAI Harness Engineering. Product facts are implementation evidence; the core rules remain vendor-neutral.

titleZh: 08 Long-Running Multi-Agent Handoff：接力必须先验证再提交 §8.S
titleEn: 08 Long-Running Multi-Agent Handoff: validate before committing the handoff
textZh: Long-Running Multi-Agent Handoff：接力必须先验证再提交 §8.S  长周期 Multi-Agent 的关键不是让每个 Agent 自己记住做到哪，而是让 Agent 可以随时消失，而 Workflow State、已验证 Artifact 和合法状态转移仍然持续存在。  FIG.8.S1 · DURABLE HANDOFF PROTOCOL Candidate ≠ Committed Artifact；Agent 说 done ≠ Workflow 已推进 01 · READ Committed State + Versioned Inputs Worker 读取 durable workflow state、revision、owner/lease 与已经提交的 input artifact，不直接把上一 Agent 的自由文本当作事实。 02 · PRODUCE Candidate Artifact Agent 在 bounded task 内工作，输出 typed candidate artifact；此时它还不能让下游开始。 03 · VALIDATE Schema → Semantic → Integrity → Acceptance 先检查结构可解析，再检查业务 invariant，再确认引用的文件/证据真实存在，必要时验证实际任务目标是否达成。 04 · COMMIT Artifact Commit + Atomic State Transition 验证通过后把 Artifact 标为 authoritative，并用 CAS、single writer、transaction 或 workflow engine 提交合法 transition。 05 · PUBLISH Next Task Becomes Runnable 只有 committed state 才发布给下游；失败则 repair、retry 或 escalate，不让 invalid candidate 静默传播。 核心顺序 produce → validate → commit → publish downstream  FIG.8.S2 · STATE SEPARATION 不要把 Workflow State、Artifact 和 Agent Context 混进一个 Conversation WORKFLOW STATE Where execution is now stage · status · revision · owner · lease · retry · approval · next transitions ARTIFACT STORE What work actually exists artifact_id · version · lineage · checksum · schema · validation_status · storage_uri AGENT CONTEXT What this worker needs now prompt · retrieved context · tool results · scratch state · local plan 恢复边界 Agent 进程崩溃不应让 Workflow State 或已验证 Artifact 一起消失。恢复依赖 durable state / checkpoint / event history，而不是模型“记得上次做到哪”。  FIG.8.S3 · FAILURE / RECOVERY MATRIX 不是所有失败都叫“回滚 checkpoint” 失败 优先处理 为什么 Schema invalid repair / rerun current stage 上游已验证产物通常无需重做 Evidence missing repair reference / rerun producer 从最早失效 Artifact 修复 Worker crashed lease expiry → reconcile → reassign 进程死亡不等于副作用未发生 Stale state write reject revision / reload CAS / explicit concurrency control External side effect uncertain idempotency · reconciliation · compensation Checkpoint 不能撤销现实世界 Repeated repair failure bounded escalation 避免 Agent 无限互相打回  FIG.8.S4 · LONG-RUNNING OPERATIONS 跨小时/跨天还要解决 Lease、版本兼容与 Handoff Metrics LEASE Who owns the task now? owner · lease_token · heartbeat · expires_at · reassignment VERSIONING Can old state run on new code? workflow_version · schema_version · prompt/tool/policy version · migration / pinning METRICS Is the handoff reliable? handoff failure · resume success · stale-write reject · duplicate side effect · time in stage 总原则 Agents may be ephemeral; workflow state and validated artifacts must be durable.  外部核验日期：2026-09-28。LangGraph 当前 Persistence 文档支持 checkpoint-based graph-state persistence 与 failure recovery；Temporal 当前 Durable AI / Workflow 文档支持基于持久 Event History 的 crash recovery、multi-day workflow、version-aware deterministic replay 与 compensation pattern。它们是实现证据，不代表所有系统必须采用同一种 checkpoint 机制。
textEn: Long-Running Multi-Agent Handoff: validate before committing the handoff §8.S  The key to long-running multi-agent work is not asking each agent to remember its own progress. Agents should be disposable while workflow state, validated artifacts, and legal state transitions remain durable.  FIG.8.S1 · DURABLE HANDOFF PROTOCOL Candidate ≠ committed artifact; an agent saying done ≠ a committed workflow transition 01 · READ Committed State + Versioned Inputs The worker reads durable workflow state, revision, ownership or lease, and committed input artifacts rather than treating the previous agent's free text as fact. 02 · PRODUCE Candidate Artifact The agent performs bounded work and emits a typed candidate artifact. Downstream work is not runnable yet. 03 · VALIDATE Schema → Semantic → Integrity → Acceptance Validate structural parseability, then business invariants, then referenced files and evidence, and when needed verify the stage's actual acceptance criteria. 04 · COMMIT Artifact Commit + Atomic State Transition After validation, mark the artifact authoritative and commit the legal transition using CAS, a single writer, a transaction, or workflow-engine-owned state. 05 · PUBLISH Next Task Becomes Runnable Only committed state is published downstream. Failures route to repair, retry, or escalation instead of silently propagating an invalid candidate. Core ordering produce → validate → commit → publish downstream  FIG.8.S2 · STATE SEPARATION Do not collapse workflow state, artifacts, and agent context into one conversation WORKFLOW STATE Where execution is now stage · status · revision · owner · lease · retry · approval · next transitions ARTIFACT STORE What work actually exists artifact_id · version · lineage · checksum · schema · validation_status · storage_uri AGENT CONTEXT What this worker needs now prompt · retrieved context · tool results · scratch state · local plan Recovery boundary An agent process crash should not erase workflow state or validated artifacts. Recovery depends on durable state, checkpoints, or event history—not on the model remembering where it stopped.  FIG.8.S3 · FAILURE / RECOVERY MATRIX Not every failure should be described as rolling back a checkpoint Failure Preferred response Why Schema invalid repair / rerun current stage Validated upstream artifacts usually remain valid Evidence missing repair reference / rerun producer Repair from the earliest invalid artifact Worker crashed lease expiry → reconcile → reassign A dead process does not imply the side effect did not occur Stale state write reject revision / reload CAS / explicit concurrency control External side effect uncertain idempotency · reconciliation · compensation A checkpoint cannot undo the external world Repeated repair failure bounded escalation Avoid endless agent-to-agent repair loops  FIG.8.S4 · LONG-RUNNING OPERATIONS Multi-hour and multi-day workflows also need leases, version compatibility, and handoff metrics LEASE Who owns the task now? owner · lease_token · heartbeat · expires_at · reassignment VERSIONING Can old state run on new code? workflow_version · schema_version · prompt/tool/policy version · migration / pinning METRICS Is the handoff reliable? handoff failure · resume success · stale-write reject · duplicate side effect · time in stage Final rule Agents may be ephemeral; workflow state and validated artifacts must be durable.  External verification date: 2026-09-28. Current LangGraph Persistence documentation supports checkpoint-based graph-state persistence and failure recovery; current Temporal Durable AI and Workflow documentation supports crash recovery from durable event history, multi-day workflows, version-aware deterministic replay, and compensation patterns. These are implementation evidence, not a claim that every system must use the same checkpoint mechanism.

titleZh: 08 Cancellation、Interruption 与 Steering：停止的是 Runtime，不是 UI §8.T
titleEn: 08 Cancellation, Interruption, and Steering: stop the runtime, not just the UI
textZh: Cancellation、Interruption 与 Steering：停止的是 Runtime，不是 UI §8.T  用户点停止之后，真正需要回答的是：哪些工作属于这次 run、取消信号传到哪里、已经开始的副作用处于什么状态、会话协议如何修复，以及新输入是 Cancel、Steer 还是 Follow-up。  FIG.8.T1 · CANCELLATION SCOPE Cancel 是层级 Runtime Signal，不是一个全局 Boolean 父 scope 取消时终止 owned descendants；单个 child 的取消不应无条件杀掉 siblings 或整个 session。 ROOT · RUN SCOPE Cancel Request → Stop New Work 用户取消、Timeout、Policy、Supersession 或 Host Shutdown 都可以触发 scope，但 reason 必须保留。 MODEL Stream / Retry / Backoff abortable request · retry wait · compaction · next model call TOOLS Tool Batch / Tool Child dispatch boundary · per-tool child signal · no new calls after cancel OS / REMOTE JOB Owned Execution Tree process group · container job · browser session · remote cancel handle SUBTASK Foreground vs Detached Foreground 通常继承 parent；Background 必须有独立 lifetime 与 cancel handle。 核心规则 Every blocking boundary must either accept cancellation directly or race against a cancellation signal.  FIG.8.T2 · INTERRUPTED TOOL TRUTH MODEL 中断后先判断 Tool 执行到哪，再决定是否 Retry NOT STARTED Rejected / Cancelled Before Run 没有副作用，可以给协议补 cancelled/rejected result，再重新决策。 STARTED · ABORTED Partial / Unknown Effect 工具已经开始，不能声称“没执行”；需要检查文件、进程、远端系统或业务状态。 RESULT LOST Completed? Ack Missing 远端动作可能已提交但本地没拿到结果；先 reconcile，禁止 blind retry。 COMPLETED Trusted Result Available 有完整、可信的 result，正常提交给 conversation / workflow state。 SIDE-EFFECT BOUNDARY Cancellation changes control flow; it does not retroactively erase side effects. TRANSCRIPT REPAIR 补齐 tool_result 是为了恢复 provider protocol；synthetic result 必须写真实 execution state，不能为了让下一轮 API 接受就伪造“没有执行”。  FIG.8.T3 · USER CONTROL SEMANTICS Cancel、Steer、Follow-up 不是同一个“用户又发消息了” CANCEL Terminate Current Scope 停止新工作 → 终止 owned execution → reconcile → repair protocol → quiescent。 STEER Change Next Decision 当前 action/result protocol 到达安全边界后注入；已经发生的 Tool / side effect 仍然要进入下一次决策。 FOLLOW-UP Queue After Completion 当前 run 完成 pending work 后再启动新的要求，适合“做完这个，再做那个”。 SAFE INJECTION BOUNDARY tool_use → tool_result → steering → next model call 不要把普通用户消息任意插进尚未闭合的 Tool 协议单元；先让 action/result correlation 变成 coherent state。 最终原则 Cancellation is complete only when the execution scope is quiescent and its state is trustworthy.  FIG.8.T4 · CANCELLATION LIFECYCLE UI 可以先显示 Cancelling，但 Runtime 不能立刻标成 CANCELLED RUNNING Work Is Active CANCEL_REQUESTED Stop Launching New Work TERMINATING Abort Requests · Stop Tools · Kill Owned Jobs RECONCILING Repair Transcript · Verify Side Effects QUIESCENT CANCELLED / FAILED / HUMAN ACTION 两种延迟 cancel_ack_latency 衡量 UI/Runtime 多快接受取消； cancel_to_quiescence_latency 衡量真正停止并恢复可信状态需要多久。  外部核验日期：2026-10-06。OpenAI Codex 当前源码使用层级 CancellationToken，并在一次性 exec cancellation 时对 process group 先 terminate、等待 50ms grace period、再强制 kill；Pi 当前官方文档把 abort / steer / follow-up 分成不同控制语义；Anthropic 当前 Tool Use 文档要求 tool_use / tool_result 协议完整，TypeScript SDK 的 BetaToolRunner 支持 AbortSignal。上述均是 implementation evidence，通用规则保持 vendor-neutral。
textEn: Cancellation, Interruption, and Steering: stop the runtime, not just the UI §8.T  After the user presses stop, the runtime must answer which work belongs to this run, how cancellation propagates, what state already-started side effects are in, how the conversation protocol is repaired, and whether new input means cancel, steer, or follow up.  FIG.8.T1 · CANCELLATION SCOPE Cancellation is a hierarchical runtime signal, not a global boolean Cancelling a parent scope stops owned descendants; cancelling one child should not automatically kill siblings or the whole session. ROOT · RUN SCOPE Cancel Request → Stop New Work User cancellation, timeout, policy, supersession, or host shutdown may trigger the scope, but the reason must be preserved. MODEL Stream / Retry / Backoff abortable request · retry wait · compaction · next model call TOOLS Tool Batch / Tool Child dispatch boundary · per-tool child signal · no new calls after cancel OS / REMOTE JOB Owned Execution Tree process group · container job · browser session · remote cancel handle SUBTASK Foreground vs Detached Foreground work usually inherits the parent; background work needs an explicit independent lifetime and cancel handle. Core rule Every blocking boundary must either accept cancellation directly or race against a cancellation signal.  FIG.8.T2 · INTERRUPTED TOOL TRUTH MODEL After interruption, determine how far the tool executed before deciding to retry NOT STARTED Rejected / Cancelled Before Run No side effect occurred; repair the protocol with a cancelled/rejected result and make a new decision. STARTED · ABORTED Partial / Unknown Effect The tool started, so the runtime cannot claim it never ran; inspect files, processes, remote systems, or business state. RESULT LOST Completed? Ack Missing The remote action may have committed even though the local result was lost; reconcile before any retry. COMPLETED Trusted Result Available A complete trustworthy result is available and can be committed into conversation or workflow state normally. SIDE-EFFECT BOUNDARY Cancellation changes control flow; it does not retroactively erase side effects. TRANSCRIPT REPAIR Synthetic tool results repair the provider protocol. They must encode the real execution state rather than falsely claiming no execution merely to make the next API request valid.  FIG.8.T3 · USER CONTROL SEMANTICS Cancel, steer, and follow-up are not the same event CANCEL Terminate Current Scope Stop new work → terminate owned execution → reconcile → repair protocol → become quiescent. STEER Change Next Decision Inject at a safe action/result boundary; already-observed tool work and side effects still belong in the next decision. FOLLOW-UP Queue After Completion Start the new request only after the current run finishes its pending work—useful for 'after this, do that.' SAFE INJECTION BOUNDARY tool_use → tool_result → steering → next model call Do not inject arbitrary user messages into an unresolved tool protocol unit; first restore a coherent action/result state. Final rule Cancellation is complete only when the execution scope is quiescent and its state is trustworthy.  FIG.8.T4 · CANCELLATION LIFECYCLE The UI may show Cancelling immediately, but the runtime should not mark the run CANCELLED yet RUNNING Work Is Active CANCEL_REQUESTED Stop Launching New Work TERMINATING Abort Requests · Stop Tools · Kill Owned Jobs RECONCILING Repair Transcript · Verify Side Effects QUIESCENT CANCELLED / FAILED / HUMAN ACTION Two latencies cancel_ack_latency measures how fast the runtime acknowledges cancellation; cancel_to_quiescence_latency measures how long it takes to actually stop and return to trustworthy state.  External verification date: 2026-10-06. Current OpenAI Codex source uses hierarchical CancellationToken values and, for one-shot exec cancellation, terminates the process group, waits a 50ms grace period, then force-kills remaining members. Current Pi documentation separates abort, steer, and follow-up semantics. Anthropic's current Tool Use documentation requires a complete tool_use/tool_result protocol, and its TypeScript BetaToolRunner supports AbortSignal. These are implementation evidence; the durable rules remain vendor-neutral.

titleZh: 08 Agent Engineering Craft：DAG 拓扑、权限隔离与可测性
titleEn: 08 Agent engineering craft: DAG ordering and testable tool boundaries
textZh:
Agent Engineering Craft：DAG 拓扑、权限隔离与可测性 FDE INDEPENDENT RESEARCH 依据 FDE 公开考点独立研究，不是付费标准答案。示例为教学假设，并非客户性能实测。 Q38 · 有环的 Agent DAG 可以直接执行吗？  identity → authorize → read → explain
                       ↘ review → write

Kahn's topological sort: O(V + E)
If output count != vertex count → cycle detected.  依赖图有环就不能拓扑排序；在任何副作用之前先拒绝。动态 ReAct 循环可以合理地重复工具调用，但需要预算/停止策略，不属于固定 DAG 的循环。  Q39 · Mock 通过就证明 Agent 没有越权吗？  不。依赖注入让 Policy 和 Reader 可替换，测试未授权时调用数必须是 0；真正的身份验证和存储 RLS 仍需独立集成验证。  可验证的边界 区别“验证调用顺序”与“验证资源授权”：Fake 只能证明代码路径在测试输入下满足预期，不能替代生产 Resource Policy。  第一手资料 : unittest.mock · unittest
textEn:
Agent engineering craft: DAG ordering and testable tool boundaries FDE INDEPENDENT RESEARCH Independently researched from public FDE topics, not paid answer keys. All scenarios are instructional, not measured customer deployments. Q38 · Can an agent dependency DAG execute a cycle?  identity → authorize → read → explain
                       ↘ review → write

Kahn's topological sort: O(V + E)
If output count != vertex count → cycle detected.  A fixed DAG with cycles must be rejected before side effects. A bounded dynamic ReAct loop can revisit tools; that is a separate runtime contract.  Q39 · Does a passing mock prove an agent cannot bypass permissions?  No. Dependency injection allows policy and reader fakes; unauthorized requests must invoke the reader zero times. Real identity verification and storage-level RLS still need integration tests.  Verified boundary A fake can prove a code path under test inputs, not resource-side authorization of a deployed system.  Primary references : unittest.mock · unittest

titleZh: 09 Reliability Control Plane：把 Runtime、Eval、Release 与 Monitoring 放进同一张图 §9.A
titleEn: 09 Reliability Control Plane: place runtime, eval, release, and monitoring in one architecture
textZh: Reliability Control Plane：把 Runtime、Eval、Release 与 Monitoring 放进同一张图 §9.A  本章的 Dataset、Evaluator、Trace、Release Gate、Monitoring 和 Cost 不是六套独立机制。它们共同构成 Runtime 外围的控制面：在执行前约束，在执行中观测，在执行后判定，并把生产证据送回下一轮 Build/Test。  FIG.9.A1 · RELIABILITY CONTROL PLANE Runtime 是数据面；Reliability / Eval / Observability 是控制面 不要把“跑 Agent”和“证明 Agent 可以安全上线”混成同一条流水线。 DATA PLANE · RUNTIME Request → Agent / Workflow → Model / Tool → Validation → Response / Action 这里发生真实用户请求、工具调用、状态变化和副作用。 BEFORE / DURING Policy + Validation schema · permission · safety · HITL · retry/fallback boundary DURING Observability trace · thread · state · tool · token · latency · cost · version metadata AFTER Evaluation dataset · code evaluator · LLM judge · pairwise · human · trajectory / E2E RELEASE CONTROL Experiment / Regression → Release Gate → Shadow / Canary → Promote or Rollback 发布决策同时看 Task Success、风险违规、P95、Cost / Success 与关键 Slice；不是只看一个平均分。 PRODUCTION LEARNING LOOP Monitor → Detect Signal → Inspect Trace → Root Cause → Curate Dataset / Evaluator → Fix → Re-evaluate Monitoring 只有把生产行为变成可复现的测试证据，才真正闭环。 架构原则 Runtime produces behavior. The control plane constrains, measures, judges, releases, and learns from that behavior.
textEn: Reliability Control Plane: place runtime, eval, release, and monitoring in one architecture §9.A  Datasets, evaluators, traces, release gates, monitoring, and cost are not six independent mechanisms. Together they form the control plane around runtime: constrain before execution, observe during execution, judge after execution, and return production evidence to the next Build/Test cycle.  FIG.9.A1 · RELIABILITY CONTROL PLANE Runtime is the data plane; reliability, eval, and observability form the control plane Do not collapse running the agent and proving that it is safe to ship into one pipeline. DATA PLANE · RUNTIME Request → Agent / Workflow → Model / Tool → Validation → Response / Action This is where real user requests, tool calls, state transitions, and side effects occur. BEFORE / DURING Policy + Validation schema · permission · safety · HITL · retry/fallback boundary DURING Observability trace · thread · state · tool · token · latency · cost · version metadata AFTER Evaluation dataset · code evaluator · LLM judge · pairwise · human · trajectory / E2E RELEASE CONTROL Experiment / Regression → Release Gate → Shadow / Canary → Promote or Rollback Release decisions combine task success, high-risk violations, P95 latency, cost per success, and critical slices rather than one average score. PRODUCTION LEARNING LOOP Monitor → Detect Signal → Inspect Trace → Root Cause → Curate Dataset / Evaluator → Fix → Re-evaluate Monitoring closes the loop only when production behavior becomes reproducible test evidence. Architecture rule Runtime produces behavior. The control plane constrains, measures, judges, releases, and learns from that behavior.

titleZh: 09 9.1–9.3 结构化输出、验证门与失败恢复

textEn: 9.1–9.3 Structured Outputs, Validation Gates, and Failure Recovery  OUT Structured Outputs + Validation Gates Model outputs pass a Schema: JSON Schema · Pydantic · Typed Objects · Enums; avoid executing free-form output directly. Validation Types: Schema · Business-rule · Permission · Artifact · Claim verification · Safety。 The model proposes completion. The harness checks an explicit acceptance contract. textEn: 9.4 Building an Evaluation System from 0 to 1  Evaluation is not a test script run once before release; it is R&D infrastructure across the Agent lifecycle. It ≠ one Judge Prompt ≠ one offline accuracy table ≠ one QA pass. It must answer three questions: ① Is the current version better than the baseline? ② In which scenarios did it regress, and why? ③ Is the evidence sufficient to support release, rollback, or continued experimentation?  Agent Type Primary Business Outcome Important Supporting Metrics Customer-service Agent resolution rate · human escalation rate · satisfaction factual correctness · policy compliance · response time Coding Agent test pass rate · task completion rate Patch correctness · regression count · Token and runtime cost RAG Agent rate of correct answers supported by evidence Citation · refusal accuracy · Recall@K Data-analysis Agent calculation accuracy · actionability of insights SQL correctness · data freshness · chart consistency Workflow Agent end-to-end workflow success rate tool success rate · retry rate · human takeover rate  Must Remember Evaluation is useful only when its result changes an engineering or product decision. Before building, define the Release Decision: allow merging a Prompt change? allow switching models? allow expanding traffic? trigger human review? automatically block release? automatically roll back?  FIG.9.1 Complete Evaluation System Architecture (two data planes: Dataset supports repeatable runs and version comparison; Trajectory Store records what actually happened in a specific execution; the two must not be conflated) Dual-data-plane architecture: the evaluation dataset plane (Golden Testsets) handles offline regression and version scoring; the execution trajectory plane (Trajectory Store) handles online diagnosis and failure attribution DATA PLANES DATASET vs TRAJECTORY CIRCUIT CONTINUOUS FLYWHEEL INGESTION & PRIVACY INPUT LAYER Real User Requests · Online Logs · Bad Cases · User Corrections Trace Collection + Privacy Filter (end-to-end redacted collection and traffic mirroring) PLANE A BENCHMARK Dataset Manager Synthetic · Human · Real · Edge · Safety PLANE B OBSERVABILITY Trajectory Store Inputs · State · Tool Calls · Outputs · Errors · Versions FLYWHEEL REGRESSION ↺ Regression Loop Feed bad cases back into regression cases EXECUTION AGENT RUNTIME Agent Runtime：LLM + Prompt + Memory + Tools + Workflow + Policy JUDGE 1 DETERMINISTIC Rule Judge Schema · exact numeric values · unit tests · regex assertions JUDGE 2 SEMANTIC LLM Judge Rubric criteria · chain-of-thought reasoning · faithfulness scoring JUDGE 3 HUMAN REVIEW Human Judge Double-blind annotation · disputed-sample adjudication · consistency calibration METRICS MULTI-DIMENSIONAL Metrics：Quality · Safety · Cost · Latency · Business KPI ANALYTICS DASHBOARD Dashboard + Slice Comparison Multi-slice comparison, version baseline comparison, and trend monitoring GATE CI/CD GATE Release Gate：Ship / Canary / Hold / Rollback Automated release gates and canary rollout CLOSED LOOP EVOLUTION Error Analysis + Root Cause → Dataset Evolution (back to Dataset Manager) Attribution analysis drives continuous dataset evolution and self-healing  DATA Dataset Manager: More Than a Golden Set Sources Synthetic · Human-authored · Historical Production · Online Bad Cases · Boundary · Safety/Permission · Adversarial · No-answer/Clarification Maintain at least four sets Development (daily Prompt/Tool/Workflow development) · Regression (must pass on every release; derived from real historical failures) · Holdout (the team should not repeatedly inspect it, to reduce overfitting) · Online Shadow (compare old and new versions on real traffic without affecting users) A golden set should be curated, deduplicated, versioned, and sliced—not merely accumulated. { "case_id" : "eval_000184" , "input" : "..." , "expected_outcome" : "..." , "reference_evidence" : [ "doc_12#p7" ], "slice" : [ "refund" , "conflicting_policy" , "de-DE" ], "risk_level" : "high" , "source" : "production_bad_case" , "annotation_status" : "adjudicated" , "dataset_version" : "evalset_2026_07_29" } Can 20–50 examples be enough to start? titleZh: 09 Judge Routing：Rule / LLM / Human 是路由，不是替代
titleEn: 09 Judge Routing: Rule / LLM / Human Is Routing, Not Replacement
textZh:
Judge Routing：Rule / LLM / Human 是路由，不是替代  FIG.9.2 Judge 决策树 STEP 1 能用确定性规则判定吗？（Schema · 精确数值 · 单测 · SQL 结果 · 引用存在 · 禁用工具 · 权限违规 · 延迟/成本预算） NODE Yes → Rule Judge Deterministic · Cheap · Fast · Easy to debug NODE No，但校准后的模型可按 Rubric 判定？（Helpfulness · 完整性 · 政策解释 · 语义支持 · 语气 · 轨迹质量）→ LLM Judge 必须有 Rubric · 参考例 · 输出 Schema · Temperature 控制 · Judge 版本 · 校准集 · 人工一致性度量 NODE No / 高风险 / 分歧 → Human Review + Adjudication Double annotation · Reviewer guidelines · Inter-rater agreement（人工 Judge 也非天然无误）  ✗ 低质量："Is this answer good? Score 1–5."
 ✓ 拆成可观察标准：
 Correctness  关键事实与证据一致？方向/数值错？
 Completeness 覆盖全部子问题？遗漏影响决策？
 Grounding   每个 Claim 有证据？引用蕴含 Claim？
 Policy      遵守权限、拒答、升级规则？
 Actionability 用户能据此完成下一步？

 // Judge 推荐输出
 { "score": 3, "pass": false,
   "failed_criteria": ["citation_does_not_support_claim"],
   "evidence": ["答案说 30 天，引用政策写 14 天"],
   "repair_hint": "取当前德国政策并回答两个子问题" } 必背 Evaluators should produce repair instructions, not only scores. Metrics 不要放进同一个平均数，分五类看： Outcome：Task Success · Answer Correctness · No-answer Acc · Citation Support Process：Tool Selection · Argument Correctness · Plan Completion · Recovery · Loop Rate Efficiency：Latency P50/P95/P99 · Token · Cost/Success · Retry · Cache Hit Safety：Policy Violation · Unauthorized Retrieval · Sensitive Exposure · False Refusal/Allow Business：CSAT · Deflection · Conversion · Time Saved · Support Cost 总览同时展示 Overall + Query Slice + Risk Slice + Language/Region + Tool/Workflow Version + New vs Regression。  OFFLINE 离线评估 比较版本时固定数据、Judge、模型设置、工具快照及可用的随机种子，以减少混杂；种子不保证完全确定性，还需重复运行并报告不确定性。 Version Dataset Judge 结果 Baseline Regression v12 Judge v4 82.1% Candidate A Regression v12 Judge v4 85.4% Candidate B Regression v12 Judge v4 84.8% ONLINE 在线评估 关注：Distribution Shift · Tool Reliability · Latency · User Corrections · Fallback · Human Escalation · Business Outcomes。 模式： Shadow（新版本运行不影响用户）→ A/B Test → Canary（小比例真实流量）→ Human Review Sampling → Continuous Monitoring + 告警。 线上反馈有偏差： 点赞 ≠ 一定正确；不投诉 ≠ 一定成功；人工接管 ≠ 一定是 Agent 失败 → 与可验证结果、人工审查、业务数据组合使用。  release_gate : task_success_rate :

Dashboard ≠ Gate： Dashboard 解释发生了什么变化（Release Comparison · Slice Breakdown · Cost/Latency · Safety · Judge Agreement · Failure Clusters · Regression Cases · Online Drift）；Release Gate 把指标变成显式发布决策。
