titleZh: 09 评估数据飞轮
titleEn: 09 Evaluation Data Flywheel
textZh: 评估数据飞轮  数据飞轮 FLYWHEEL 01 Production Trace 02 坏例检测 03 根因分析 04 去重·标注·入库 05 修复 Agent 06 离线回归 07 Shadow / Canary 08 发布 → 新 Trace 入库前必须经过 Privacy review · Deduplication · Severity classification · Root-cause label · Expected behavior · Reference evidence · Adjudication · Dataset split assignment。不能把每个坏案例直接塞进同一个 Golden Set，否则：数据重复 · 对近期事件过拟合 · 分布扭曲 · 标签不一致 · 测试集污染。 版本治理 每次发布都能回答：这个结果由哪套数据、哪个 Judge、哪个 Agent 版本得到？元数据：dataset_version · annotation_guideline_version · judge_version · model_version · prompt_version · tool_registry_version · workflow_version · knowledge_snapshot · policy_version。Dataset 变更要有 Changelog（Added / Removed / Relabeled / Deduplicated / Moved / Risk changed）。  JUDGE? 如何评估 LLM Judge 本身 Judge 也会失败，需要：Human Agreement · Pairwise Consistency · Self-consistency · Position Bias · Verbosity Bias · Reference Leakage · Prompt Sensitivity · Model-version Drift。 校准流程： 人工裁决校准集 → 跑 Judge → 混淆矩阵对比 → 分析分歧 → 更新 Rubric 与例子 → 冻结 Judge 版本 → 周期重校准。 关键发布门禁不应依赖未校准的单一 LLM Judge。 ROADMAP 从 0 到 1 实施路线 1 手工小闭环 20–50 分层案例 · Rule Checks · 人工评分表 · 版本对比 · 手工错误分析 2 可重复离线评估 Dataset 版本化 · Trace Schema · 自动 Runner · LLM Judge · Slice 指标 · 回归报告 3 接入 CI/CD PR Eval · Release Gate · Prompt/Model/Tool 回归 · Artifact 保留 · Failure Diff 4 线上闭环 Trace 抽样 · 坏例挖掘 · Shadow/Canary · 在线 Dashboard · 告警 · 人工升级 · 数据飞轮 Automate stable judgments first; keep ambiguous and high-risk judgments under human governance.
textEn: Evaluation Data Flywheel  Data Flywheel FLYWHEEL 01 Production Trace 02 Bad-case Detection 03 Root-cause Analysis 04 Deduplicate · Label · Store 05 Fix the Agent 06 Offline Regression 07 Shadow / Canary 08 Release → New Trace Before entering the dataset, each case must go through Privacy review · Deduplication · Severity classification · Root-cause label · Expected behavior · Reference evidence · Adjudication · Dataset split assignment. Do not dump every bad case into one Golden Set; that causes duplicated data · overfitting to recent events · distorted distribution · inconsistent labels · test-set contamination. Version Governance Every release must answer: which dataset, Judge, and Agent version produced this result? Metadata: dataset_version · annotation_guideline_version · judge_version · model_version · prompt_version · tool_registry_version · workflow_version · knowledge_snapshot · policy_version. Dataset changes need a Changelog (Added / Removed / Relabeled / Deduplicated / Moved / Risk changed).  JUDGE? How to Evaluate the LLM Judge Itself The Judge can fail too. Measure: Human Agreement · Pairwise Consistency · Self-consistency · Position Bias · Verbosity Bias · Reference Leakage · Prompt Sensitivity · Model-version Drift. Calibration Process: Human-adjudicated calibration set → run Judge → compare confusion matrix → analyze disagreements → update Rubric and examples → freeze Judge version → recalibrate periodically. Critical release gates should not depend on one uncalibrated LLM Judge. ROADMAP Implementation Roadmap from 0 to 1 1 Small Manual Loop 20–50 stratified cases · Rule Checks · human scoring sheet · version comparison · manual error analysis 2 Repeatable Offline Evaluation Versioned Dataset · Trace Schema · automated Runner · LLM Judge · Slice metrics · regression report 3 Integrate into CI/CD PR Eval · Release Gate · Prompt/Model/Tool regression · Artifact retention · Failure Diff 4 Online Loop Trace sampling · bad-case mining · Shadow/Canary · online Dashboard · alerts · human escalation · data flywheel Automate stable judgments first; keep ambiguous and high-risk judgments under human governance.

titleZh: 09 常见踩坑 ×7
titleEn: 09 Seven Common Pitfalls
textZh:
常见踩坑 ×7  ① 等到 1,000 条数据才开始 → 用少量分层数据先建闭环，再按失败模式扩展。 ② 只看总体平均分 → 看切片、严重程度和回归，不让平均分掩盖高风险失败。 ③ 把 LLM Judge 当真值 → 用人工校准 Judge，监控一致性、偏差和版本漂移。 ④ 所有 Bad Case 都加入测试集 → 去重、归因、标注，分流到 Dev / Regression / Holdout。 ⑤ 只评最终答案 → 同时评 Outcome 和 Trajectory，才能定位工具、规划和恢复问题。 ⑥ 只做 Dashboard 不做 Gate → 指标必须连接到 Ship / Canary / Hold / Rollback。  ⑦ Evaluation ≠ QA QA 验证确定性软件是否满足规格；Agent Evaluation 测量 概率系统 在数据分布、轨迹、风险和业务结果上的表现——还需处理 Stochastic outputs · Judge uncertainty · Dataset evolution · Distribution shift · Model/Prompt drift。  项目映射 · 诚信表达 In AutodidactAgent, evaluation was tightly connected to the development loop because each case had an objective numeric target and a case-level score. That gave us a clear signal for whether a synthesized skill actually improved performance and whether the extra development cost was justified. 不要说搭建过完整企业 Evaluation Dashboard / 大规模生产 CI/CD / 全公司 LLM Judge 平台。更准确：I have implemented important evaluation components and objective case-level scoring. For a production platform, I would extend this into versioned datasets, trace storage, calibrated judges, release gates, and an online bad-case flywheel.  90 秒英文答案（完整版见第 11 章 · 答案 08） I would treat evaluation as lifecycle infrastructure rather than a one-time test before release… The core idea is a data flywheel: every meaningful failure becomes a future regression test.  FIG.9.3 · RAG EVAL MATRIX 分层 RAG 评测矩阵：先定位失败层，再看最终答案 一个端到端分数解释不了错误来源；必须从召回层、上下文层、生成层到系统层逐级归因与针对性修复。 MATRIX 4x4 LAYERS METHOD LAYERED EVAL LAYER 1 RETRIEVAL 1. Retrieval Layer 核心问题： 是否召回了包含答案的文档？ 核心指标： Recall@K · MRR · nDCG 典型失败： 关键词不匹配 / 向量语义丢失 修复手段： Query Rewrite · Hybrid · Index Tuning LAYER 2 CONTEXT 2. Context Layer 核心问题： 上下文中是否有噪声或冗余？ 核心指标： Precision · Coverage · Redundancy 典型失败： 填入无关段落挤占预算 修复手段： Rerank · Dedup · Dynamic Chunking LAYER 3 GENERATION 3. Generation Layer 核心问题： 答案是否忠实于检索证据？ 核心指标： Correctness · Groundedness · Citation 典型失败： 幻觉 / 未对齐证据 / 过度推断 修复手段： Verification Gate · Rubric Tuning LAYER 4 SYSTEM 4. System Layer 核心问题： 延迟与成本是否在 SLA 内？ 核心指标： P50/P95 · Cost / Task · Safe Pass Rate 典型失败： 超时 / 超预算 / 死循环 修复手段： Caching · Fallback · Timeout Guard GATE : 先判断失败层，再选择修复手段；端到端准确率只作终态结果，分层指标才是工程抓手。 本地 LLM + RAG 延迟诊断：先 Trace，再归因 “你好”50 秒、知识问答 80 秒时，不能第一反应就说 Embedding 慢。问候通常不依赖知识库，所以 基础 LLM / 服务链路 本身就值得优先排查。 FIG.9.4 End-to-end Latency Budget STEP 1 Queue STEP 2 Route STEP 3 Embed STEP 4 Retrieve / Rerank STEP 5 Prompt / Prefill STEP 6 First Token → Decode COLD 第一次慢，后面快 Model loading · GPU runtime init · index load · first cache miss。在线服务应 Load → Warm-up → Ready → Traffic。 WARM 每次都慢 重复加载 · GPU 未生效 · CPU/Disk Offload · 长上下文 · 输出过长 · 排队 · 无条件执行完整 RAG。 1. 禁用 RAG 单测“你好”
2. 连续调用 3–5 次比较 Cold / Warm
3. 记录 Queue / TTFT / Decode / Total
4. 确认 LLM、Embedding、Index 只加载一次
5. 检查 GPU / 显存 / Offload / 量化
6. 单测 Query Embedding
7. 单测 Retrieval / Document Fetch
8. 单测 Reranker
9. 比较空 Context 与真实 RAG Context
10. 建立 P50 / P95 性能回归 必背 Measure before attribution; preload before traffic; route trivial requests away from RAG.  FIG.9.6 · PRODUCTION HARNESS Production Agent Harness：模型提议，系统控制并证明 权限、验证、恢复、预算和可观测性应该在模型之外。 CONTROL HOST WRAPPER AUTHORITY PROPOSAL ONLY INPUT BOUNDARY · 输入边界 STATE PERSIST State / Memory 保存任务状态与关键事实 TOOLS REGISTRY Tool Registry 只暴露当前可用能力与权限 CONTEXT BUDGET Context Builder 按任务预算组装证据与指令 POLICY: 模型输出 structured proposal，不直接拥有执行权 🧠 LLM / Agent Policy Pure Reasoning & Decision Proposal Inputs ➔ [ Reasoning Step ] ➔ Output Proposal VALIDATION & CONTROL · 校验门禁 SCHEMA VALIDATE Schema + Validation 参数、格式、业务规则必须通过 AUTH GATE Permission & Risk Gate 高风险 / 不可逆动作需要批准 (HITL) RECOVERY BOUNDED Retry / Fallback / HITL 按错误类型恢复，不无限重试 METRIC · TRACE 全链路可观测 METRIC · EVAL 任务成功率 / Groundedness METRIC · BUDGET Latency / Tokens / Cost METRIC · AUDIT 权限与副作用审计  FIG.9.7 · BAD CASE FLYWHEEL Bad Case → Regression → Canary：生产 Agent 改进飞轮 线上失败必须进入可复现的回归资产。从 Trace 捕获、根因诊断到回归集固化与 Canary 验证闭环。 FLYWHEEL 6 STEPS RULE REGRESSION ASSET 01 TRACE Online Trace 完整执行轨迹捕获 02 DETECT Detect Failure 发现失败/低质量请求 03 ROOT CAUSE Root Cause 定位 Retrieval / Tool / Prompt / Policy 04 LABEL Label & Structure 结构化失败类型与期望行为 05 REGRESSION Regression Set 固化为发布前必测样本 06 CANARY Fix + Canary 受控修改并小流量验证无回归 WHY : Bad case 不进入 regression set，就会反复出现。 METRIC : 记录 fix rate、regression pass rate、online recurrence rate。 FAILURE : 只修 Prompt 而不分类根因，会制造新回归。 Agent PRD：从技术 Demo 到商业化闭环 FIG.9.5 Business Agent PRD STEP 1 Goal STEP 2 Metrics STEP 3 Bad Cases STEP 4 Human Fallback STEP 5 Rollout / A-B STEP 6 ROI METRIC Agent 工程指标 Outcome： Task Success Rate。 Quality： Correctness / groundedness / CSAT。 Tooling： tool-selection / argument / execution accuracy。 Efficiency： latency / tokens / cost。 Reliability： retry / fallback / escalation / unsafe action。 Prefer cost per successful task over raw token cost. HITL 人工兜底是控制路径 Low confidence · High risk · Policy conflict · Tool failure · Irreversible action → Human Escalation。人工不是失败后临时加，而应在 PRD 与状态机中正式建模。 ROI / Unit Economics Benefit =
Saved Human Time
+ Increased Throughput
+ Revenue Lift
+ Risk Reduction

Cost =
Model Inference
+ Tool / Infrastructure
+ Human Review
+ Maintenance 评估效果时，应给出 Before → After → Volume → Unit Cost → Payback 的量化链路。 核心句 A production agent is successful only when quality, reliability, unit economics, and human fallback form one measurable loop. FIG.9.8 · METRIC PYRAMID Agent Metrics：最终关注 Cost per Successful Task（5 维指标金字塔） Token 少不等于系统好；必须同时看结果、质量、工具、效率和可靠性五层联动衡量。 NORTH STAR COST / SUCCESS STRUCTURE 5-TIER PYRAMID TIER 1 · NORTH STAR Outcome Task Success Rate · 业务 SLA 达成率 TIER 2 · QUALITY Quality Correctness · Groundedness · CSAT 满意度 TIER 3 · TOOLING Tooling Selection Accuracy · Parameter Precision · Tool Success TIER 4 · EFFICIENCY Efficiency TTFT / P95 Latency · Tokens / Task · Cost per Task TIER 5 · ROBUSTNESS Reliability Bounded Retry Rate · Fallback Rate · Escalation · Safety Passes RECOMMENDED NORTH STAR : 推荐总指标：Cost per Successful Task，而不是 Cost per Query。
textEn:
Seven Common Pitfalls  ① Waiting until you have 1,000 examples before starting → Start the loop with a small stratified dataset, then expand by failure mode. ② Looking only at the overall average → Inspect slices, severity, and regressions so averages do not hide high-risk failures. ③ Treating the LLM Judge as ground truth → Calibrate the Judge with humans and monitor agreement, bias, and version drift. ④ Adding every Bad Case to the test set → Deduplicate, attribute root cause, label, and route cases into Dev / Regression / Holdout. ⑤ Evaluating only the final answer → Evaluate both Outcome and Trajectory to localize tool, planning, and recovery problems. ⑥ Building a Dashboard without a Gate → Metrics must connect to Ship / Canary / Hold / Rollback.  ⑦ Evaluation ≠ QA QA verifies whether deterministic software meets specifications; Agent Evaluation measures how a probabilistic system performs across data distributions, trajectories, risks, and business outcomes—and must also handle Stochastic outputs · Judge uncertainty · Dataset evolution · Distribution shift · Model/Prompt drift.  Project Mapping · Honest Positioning In AutodidactAgent, evaluation was tightly connected to the development loop because each case had an objective numeric target and a case-level score. That gave us a clear signal for whether a synthesized skill actually improved performance and whether the extra development cost was justified. Do not claim that you built a complete enterprise Evaluation Dashboard / large-scale production CI/CD / company-wide LLM Judge platform. More accurately: I have implemented important evaluation components and objective case-level scoring. For a production platform, I would extend this into versioned datasets, trace storage, calibrated judges, release gates, and an online bad-case flywheel.  90-second English Answer (full version in Chapter 11 · Answer 08) I would treat evaluation as lifecycle infrastructure rather than a one-time test before release… The core idea is a data flywheel: every meaningful failure becomes a future regression test.  FIG.9.3 · RAG EVAL MATRIX Layered RAG Evaluation Matrix: Locate the Layer Failure First An end-to-end score cannot explain root causes. Measure Retrieval, Context, Generation, and System layers separately. MATRIX 4x4 LAYERS METHOD LAYERED EVAL LAYER 1 RETRIEVAL 1. Retrieval Layer Core question: Did retrieval return a document containing the answer? Core metrics: Recall@K · MRR · nDCG Typical failures: Keyword mismatch / vector-semantic miss Fixes: Query Rewrite · Hybrid · Index Tuning LAYER 2 CONTEXT 2. Context Layer Core question: Does the context contain noise or redundancy? Core metrics: Precision · Coverage · Redundancy Typical failures: Irrelevant passages consume the context budget Fixes: Rerank · Dedup · Dynamic Chunking LAYER 3 GENERATION 3. Generation Layer Core question: Is the answer faithful to the retrieved evidence? Core metrics: Correctness · Groundedness · Citation Typical failures: Hallucination / evidence misalignment / over-inference Fixes: Verification Gate · Rubric Tuning LAYER 4 SYSTEM 4. System Layer Core question: Are latency and cost within the SLA? Core metrics: P50/P95 · Cost / Task · Safe Pass Rate Typical failures: Timeout / over budget / infinite loop Fixes: Caching · Fallback · Timeout Guard GATE : Identify the failing layer first, then choose the fix; end-to-end accuracy is only the final outcome, while layered metrics are the engineering levers. Local LLM + RAG Latency Diagnosis: Trace Before Attribution When “hello” takes 50 seconds and a knowledge question takes 80 seconds, do not immediately blame slow Embeddings. Greetings usually do not depend on the knowledge base, so the base LLM / service path itself should be investigated first. FIG.9.4 End-to-end Latency Budget STEP 1 Queue STEP 2 Route STEP 3 Embed STEP 4 Retrieve / Rerank STEP 5 Prompt / Prefill STEP 6 First Token → Decode COLD Slow on the first request, fast afterward Model loading · GPU runtime init · index load · first cache miss. Online services should follow Load → Warm-up → Ready → Traffic. WARM Slow on every request repeated loading · GPU not actually used · CPU/Disk Offload · long context · overly long output · queueing · unconditional full RAG execution. 1. Disable RAG and test with "Hello"
2. Run 3–5 consecutive calls and compare cold vs. warm
3. Record Queue / TTFT / Decode / Total
4. Confirm the LLM, embedding model, and index load only once
5. Check GPU / VRAM / offload / quantization
6. Benchmark query embedding separately
7. Benchmark retrieval / document fetch separately
8. Benchmark the reranker separately
9. Compare empty context with real RAG context
10. Establish P50 / P95 performance regression tests Must Remember Measure before attribution; preload before traffic; route trivial requests away from RAG.  FIG.9.6 · PRODUCTION HARNESS Production Agent Harness: The model proposes; the system controls and proves Permission, validation, recovery, budgets, and observability belong outside the model. CONTROL HOST WRAPPER AUTHORITY PROPOSAL ONLY INPUT BOUNDARY STATE PERSIST State / Memory Persist task state and key facts TOOLS REGISTRY Tool Registry Expose only currently available capabilities and permissions CONTEXT BUDGET Context Builder Assemble evidence and instructions within the task budget POLICY: the model outputs a structured proposal and does not directly own execution authority 🧠 LLM / Agent Policy Pure Reasoning & Decision Proposal Inputs ➔ [ Reasoning Step ] ➔ Output Proposal VALIDATION & CONTROL SCHEMA VALIDATE Schema + Validation Parameters, format, and business rules must pass validation AUTH GATE Permission & Risk Gate High-risk / irreversible actions require approval (HITL) RECOVERY BOUNDED Retry / Fallback / HITL Recover by error type; never retry indefinitely METRIC · TRACE End-to-end observability METRIC · EVAL Task success rate / groundedness METRIC · BUDGET Latency / Tokens / Cost METRIC · AUDIT Permission and side-effect audit  FIG.9.7 · BAD CASE FLYWHEEL Bad Case ➜ Regression ➜ Canary: Production Agent Improvement Flywheel Online failures must be transformed into reproducible regression test assets. FLYWHEEL 6 STEPS RULE REGRESSION ASSET 01 TRACE Online Trace Complete execution-trace capture 02 DETECT Detect Failure Detect failed / low-quality requests 03 ROOT CAUSE Root Cause Attribute to Retrieval / Tool / Prompt / Policy 04 LABEL Label & Structure Structure failure types and expected behavior 05 REGRESSION Regression Set Promote them into mandatory pre-release test cases 06 CANARY Fix + Canary Apply controlled changes and verify no regression with limited traffic WHY : If a bad case does not enter the regression set, it will recur. METRIC : Track fix rate, regression pass rate, and online recurrence rate. FAILURE : Fixing only the prompt without classifying the root cause creates new regressions. Agent PRD: From Technical Demo to Business Delivery FIG.9.5 Business Agent PRD STEP 1 Goal STEP 2 Metrics STEP 3 Bad Cases STEP 4 Human Fallback STEP 5 Rollout / A-B STEP 6 ROI METRIC Agent Engineering Metrics Outcome： Task Success Rate。 Quality： Correctness / groundedness / CSAT。 Tooling： tool-selection / argument / execution accuracy。 Efficiency： latency / tokens / cost。 Reliability： retry / fallback / escalation / unsafe action。 Prefer cost per successful task over raw token cost. HITL Human Fallback Is a Control Path Low confidence · High risk · Policy conflict · Tool failure · Irreversible action → Human Escalation. Human involvement should not be a patch added after failure; it should be explicitly modeled in the PRD and state machine. ROI / Unit Economics Benefit =
Saved Human Time
+ Increased Throughput
+ Revenue Lift
+ Risk Reduction

Cost =
Model Inference
+ Tool / Infrastructure
+ Human Review
+ Maintenance When reporting outcomes, quantify the complete chain: Before → After → Volume → Unit Cost → Payback. Key Line A production agent is successful only when quality, reliability, unit economics, and human fallback form one measurable loop. titleZh: 09 本地 LLM + RAG 延迟诊断：先 Trace，再归因
titleEn: 09 Local LLM + RAG Latency Diagnosis: Trace Before Attribution
textZh:
本地 LLM + RAG 延迟诊断：先 Trace，再归因  “你好”50 秒、知识问答 80 秒时，不能第一反应就说 Embedding 慢。问候通常不依赖知识库，所以 基础 LLM / 服务链路 本身就值得优先排查。  FIG.9.4 End-to-end Latency Budget STEP 1 Queue STEP 2 Route STEP 3 Embed STEP 4 Retrieve / Rerank STEP 5 Prompt / Prefill STEP 6 First Token → Decode  COLD 第一次慢，后面快 Model loading · GPU runtime init · index load · first cache miss。在线服务应 Load → Warm-up → Ready → Traffic。 WARM 每次都慢 重复加载 · GPU 未生效 · CPU/Disk Offload · 长上下文 · 输出过长 · 排队 · 无条件执行完整 RAG。  1. 禁用 RAG 单测“你好”
2. 连续调用 3–5 次比较 Cold / Warm
3. 记录 Queue / TTFT / Decode / Total
4. 确认 LLM、Embedding、Index 只加载一次
5. 检查 GPU / 显存 / Offload / 量化
6. 单测 Query Embedding
7. 单测 Retrieval / Document Fetch
8. 单测 Reranker
9. 比较空 Context 与真实 RAG Context
10. 建立 P50 / P95 性能回归  必背 Measure before attribution; preload before traffic; route trivial requests away from RAG.
textEn:
Local LLM + RAG Latency Diagnosis: Trace Before Attribution  When “hello” takes 50 seconds and a knowledge question takes 80 seconds, do not immediately blame slow Embeddings. Greetings usually do not depend on the knowledge base, so the base LLM / service path itself should be investigated first.  FIG.9.4 End-to-end Latency Budget STEP 1 Queue STEP 2 Route STEP 3 Embed STEP 4 Retrieve / Rerank STEP 5 Prompt / Prefill STEP 6 First Token → Decode  COLD Slow on the first request, fast afterward Model loading · GPU runtime init · index load · first cache miss. Online services should follow Load → Warm-up → Ready → Traffic. WARM Slow on every request repeated loading · GPU not actually used · CPU/Disk Offload · long context · overly long output · queueing · unconditional full RAG execution.  1. Disable RAG and test with "Hello"
2. Run 3–5 consecutive calls and compare cold vs. warm
3. Record Queue / TTFT / Decode / Total
4. Confirm the LLM, embedding model, and index load only once
5. Check GPU / VRAM / offload / quantization
6. Benchmark query embedding separately
7. Benchmark retrieval / document fetch separately
8. Benchmark the reranker separately
9. Compare empty context with real RAG context
10. Establish P50 / P95 performance regression tests  Must Remember Measure before attribution; preload before traffic; route trivial requests away from RAG.

titleZh: 09 Observability → Durable Evals：把一次失败变成可重复工程资产 §9.Y
titleEn: 09 Observability → Durable Evals: Turn one failure into a repeatable engineering asset
textZh: Observability → Durable Evals：把一次失败变成可重复工程资产 §9.Y  传统程序的关键决策主要写在代码里；Agent 的部分决策由模型在运行时产生。因此调试不能只看异常栈，还要重建一次执行真正发生了什么：输入了什么、选了什么工具、参数是什么、返回了什么、经历了哪些状态、花了多少时间和成本，以及最终为什么通过或失败。  FIG.9.Y Trace 解释一次运行；Thread 解释跨轮行为 可观测性记录模型可见消息、结构化决策、工具调用、结果与状态；它不要求、也不应依赖隐藏 Chain-of-Thought。 TRACE 单次 Agent Run 的可回放轨迹 prompt / visible messages · model / prompt / workflow version · structured decisions · tool + args · observation · validation · latency · tokens · cost THREAD 多个 Trace 组成一次长期交互 用 session_id / thread_id / conversation_id 关联各轮 Trace，观察早期 Context 如何影响后续决策，以及问题从哪一轮开始积累。 BOUNDARY : Thread metadata 只负责把 Trace 归组，不等于对话持久化。真正的 Stateful Conversation 仍需要自己的 Message / State Store。  Eval Scope 回答的问题 典型检查 Step / Unit 单个决策或组件是否正确？ tool selection · SQL/schema check · retrieval query · parser output Final / E2E 从输入到最终结果，用户目标是否完成？ correctness · relevance · groundedness · safety · task success Trajectory 即使答案正确，路径是否低效、重复或违反策略？ step count · tool order · redundant calls · planning · recovery · loop rate  CANONICAL RULE A correct final answer does not prove a reliable trajectory.
textEn: Observability → Durable Evals: Turn one failure into a repeatable engineering asset §9.Y  Traditional applications encode most critical decisions directly in code; agents make some decisions at runtime through the model. Debugging therefore cannot stop at stack traces. You need to reconstruct what actually happened: the inputs, selected tools, arguments, observations, workflow states, timing, cost, and why the run ultimately passed or failed.  FIG.9.Y A trace explains one run; a thread explains behavior across turns Observability records model-visible messages, structured decisions, tool calls, results, and state. It does not require, and should not depend on, hidden chain-of-thought. TRACE Replayable evidence for one agent run prompt / visible messages · model / prompt / workflow version · structured decisions · tool + args · observation · validation · latency · tokens · cost THREAD Multiple traces grouped into one ongoing interaction Link turns with session_id, thread_id, or conversation_id to see how earlier context affects later decisions and where failures begin to accumulate. BOUNDARY : Thread metadata groups traces for observability; it is not conversation persistence. A stateful conversation still needs its own message or state store.  Eval scope Question answered Typical checks Step / Unit Was one decision or component correct? tool selection · SQL/schema check · retrieval query · parser output Final / E2E Did the end-to-end run satisfy the user goal? correctness · relevance · groundedness · safety · task success Trajectory Even if the answer is correct, was the path inefficient, repetitive, or policy-violating? step count · tool order · redundant calls · planning · recovery · loop rate  CANONICAL RULE A correct final answer does not prove a reliable trajectory.

titleZh: 09 从手工 Debug 到 Durable Eval
titleEn: 09 From manual debugging to durable evaluation
textZh: 从手工 Debug 到 Durable Eval  FIG.9.Z Build ↔ Test：失败先在 Trace 中被看见，再被固化为 Dataset + Evaluator 1 · OBSERVE Run + Trace 先复现行为，找到真正失败步骤。 2 · SPECIFY PRD → Scenario 从应该 / 不应该发生的行为定义测试场景。 3 · DATASET Small, High-quality Cases 先覆盖 happy path、edge、OOD、adversarial 与历史失败，再逐步扩展。 4 · EVALUATE Evaluator + Experiment 对每个版本重复运行，并比较 Slice、回归、成本与延迟。 5 · FEEDBACK Bad Case → Regression 线上低分、负反馈与未覆盖输入经过归因和去重后回流。
textEn: From manual debugging to durable evaluation  FIG.9.Z Build ↔ Test: Observe a failure in traces, then preserve it as a dataset case plus evaluator 1 · OBSERVE Run + Trace Reproduce behavior and locate the actual failing step. 2 · SPECIFY PRD → Scenario Derive scenarios from what the system should and should not do. 3 · DATASET Small, high-quality cases Cover happy paths, edges, out-of-scope inputs, adversarial cases, and prior failures before scaling volume. 4 · EVALUATE Evaluator + Experiment Rerun every version and compare slices, regressions, cost, and latency. 5 · FEEDBACK Bad case → Regression Feed low-scoring production cases, negative feedback, and uncovered inputs back after attribution and deduplication.

titleZh: 09 Evaluator Routing：能确定就不要交给 Judge 猜
titleEn: 09 Evaluator routing: Use deterministic checks whenever the criterion is deterministic
textZh: Evaluator Routing：能确定就不要交给 Judge 猜  Evaluator 什么时候用 关键规则 Code-based 可以写函数稳定判定：Schema、工具选择、关键字、SQL/数值、Latency、Cost、检索质量。 确定性优先：快、便宜、易 Debug。 LLM-as-Judge 语义标准很难写成规则，但人类能清晰判断。 每个 Judge 单一窄目标；优先 binary / categorical；必须用人工样本持续 Alignment。 Pairwise 绝对评分模糊，但比较 A 与 B 容易，例如 concise / professional / helpful。 比较同一输入下两个版本；随机化 A/B 顺序，降低 position bias。 Human Review 高风险、Judge 分歧、标准本身仍不稳定，或需要专家判断。 Human 不是无限扩容方案；应把其裁决转化为 Rubric、Calibration Set 与 Regression Asset。  DATASET DESIGN Dataset 应从 PRD 和真实 Failure Mode 派生，而不是为了凑数量。每个 Example 至少有 inputs；按需要加入 reference outputs 与 metadata。Reference 只给 Evaluator，不应泄漏给被测 Agent。 EXPERIMENT Experiment = Target Agent × Dataset × Evaluators。大批量任务应控制并发；测试可以进入 CI/CD。框架 API 只是实现方式，真正稳定的是 Dataset Version、Evaluator Version、Agent Version 与可比较的结果。  LANGSMITH · IMPLEMENTATION EXAMPLE LangSmith 可以通过 LangChain / LangGraph / Agent SDK 等集成自动采集 Trace，也可以对模型 Client 使用 wrapper，并用 traceable 装饰 Agent / Tool 函数。跨轮 Trace 可通过 session_id、thread_id 或 conversation_id 归组。离线实验可用 evaluate / aevaluate，测试也可接入 pytest。这里把这些视为 Observability / Eval 原则的一个实现，而不是架构本身。  PITFALL Do not treat the trace viewer as the evaluation system. Trace 让问题可见；Dataset + Evaluator + Experiment 才让问题在未来版本中可重复检查。  来源说明：本节依据 LangChain Academy Reliable Agents 的 Observability、Evaluating Agents、Datasets、Running Experiments、Code-based Eval、LLM-as-Judge 与 Pairwise Evaluation 课程内容进行工程化整理；保留 Trace / Thread / Eval Scope / Dataset / Evaluator / Experiment 的原始框架，并将其与本手册已有的 Trace Schema、Judge Routing、Release Gate 和 Bad-case Flywheel 对齐。 LangChain Academy · Observability · Evaluating Agents
textEn: Evaluator routing: Use deterministic checks whenever the criterion is deterministic  Evaluator When to use Key rule Code-based A function can decide reliably: schema, tool selection, keywords, SQL or numeric checks, latency, cost, retrieval quality. Prefer deterministic checks: fast, cheap, and easy to debug. LLM-as-Judge The criterion is semantic and hard to encode, but humans can judge it clearly. Give each judge one narrow criterion; prefer binary or categorical outputs; continually align against human-labeled samples. Pairwise Absolute scoring is ambiguous but comparing A versus B is easier, such as conciseness, professionalism, or helpfulness. Compare two versions on the same input and randomize A/B order to reduce position bias. Human Review High risk, judge disagreement, unstable criteria, or domain expertise is required. Human review is not infinitely scalable; convert adjudications into rubrics, calibration sets, and regression assets.  DATASET DESIGN Derive datasets from the PRD and real failure modes rather than chasing volume. Every example needs inputs; add reference outputs and metadata only when the evaluator requires them. References are for evaluators and should not leak into the agent under test. EXPERIMENT Experiment = target agent × dataset × evaluators. Control concurrency for large jobs and move durable tests into CI/CD. Framework APIs are implementation details; the stable contract is versioned datasets, evaluators, agents, and comparable results.  LANGSMITH · IMPLEMENTATION EXAMPLE LangSmith can capture traces through LangChain, LangGraph, agent-SDK integrations, or manual model-client wrappers plus traceable instrumentation around agent and tool functions. Cross-turn traces can be grouped with session_id, thread_id, or conversation_id. Offline experiments can use evaluate or aevaluate, and durable tests can integrate with pytest. These are implementation examples of the observability and evaluation principles, not the architecture itself.  PITFALL Do not treat the trace viewer as the evaluation system. Traces make failures visible; datasets, evaluators, and experiments make those failures repeatably testable in future versions.  Source note: this section engineering-reframes the LangChain Academy Reliable Agents lessons on Observability, Evaluating Agents, Datasets, Running Experiments, Code-based Eval, LLM-as-Judge, and Pairwise Evaluation. It preserves the original Trace / Thread / Eval Scope / Dataset / Evaluator / Experiment framing and aligns it with the handbook's existing trace schema, judge routing, release gates, and bad-case flywheel. LangChain Academy · Observability · Evaluating Agents

titleZh: 09 Production Monitoring：把真实流量变成下一轮工程输入 §9.15
titleEn: 09 Production Monitoring: Turn real traffic into the next engineering input
textZh: Production Monitoring：把真实流量变成下一轮工程输入 §9.15  进入真实流量后，Monitoring 的问题不再只是“某一次运行为什么失败”，而是如何从成百上千条 Trace 中系统性地发现模式、持续评估质量、把重要案例路由到人工审查或数据集，并让 Production Evidence 真正回到 Build 与 Test。  FIG.9.M1 ADLC 有两个尺度：Build ↔ Test 内环，Deploy → Monitor → Build 外环 上线不会结束测试工作。Trace、Dataset 与 Evaluator 会在生产阶段继续作为 Monitoring 的基础设施。 1 · INSIGHTS Batch Trace Mining 批量摘要 Trace、聚类相似行为与 Failure Mode，再生成值得调查的模式。目标是缩小人工注意力范围，而不是让聚类结果自动充当 Root Cause。 2 · SCORE Online Evaluation 对全部或选定子集的 Production Trace / Thread 持续运行 Evaluator，把 Groundedness、Policy、Task Success Proxy、Sentiment 等转成可追踪信号。 3 · ROUTE Signal-to-Action Automation 用 Filter + Sampling + Action 把值得关注的案例送往 Annotation、Dataset Candidate、Incident / Webhook 或延长 Retention。分数只有连接到动作，Monitoring 才开始形成闭环。  FIG.9.M2 · INSIGHTS PATTERN Insights Agent 的核心不是“看更多 Trace”，而是先压缩，再聚类，再形成可行动发现 这是一种生产级批量 Trace Analysis 模式。Cluster 是调查入口，不是自动 Root Cause。 STEP 1 Summarize Traces 把每条 Trace 压缩成一行：关键动作、路径与结果，降低后续分析的上下文成本。 STEP 2 Cluster Summaries 把相似 Usage Pattern、Tool Path 与 Failure Mode 聚在一起，让重复问题从单条 Trace 变成总体模式。 STEP 3 Generate Report 从 Cluster 生成发现、代表案例与候选工程动作，再回到原始 Trace 验证根因。  SOURCE-SPECIFIC SCALE 课程示例说明 LangSmith Insights Agent 当前一次可分析最多约 1,000 条 Trace。这个数字属于来源中的实现能力，不是 Production Monitoring 架构的通用上限；真实系统仍需按成本、隐私、时间窗口与分层采样设计 Batch。
textEn: Production Monitoring: Turn real traffic into the next engineering input §9.15  Once real traffic arrives, monitoring is no longer only about why one run failed. The problem becomes how to detect patterns across hundreds or thousands of traces, continuously evaluate quality, route important cases to human review or datasets, and feed production evidence back into Build and Test.  FIG.9.M1 ADLC operates at two scales: the Build ↔ Test inner loop and the Deploy → Monitor → Build outer loop Deployment does not end testing. Traces, datasets, and evaluators continue as the infrastructure of production monitoring. 1 · INSIGHTS Batch trace mining Summarize traces in bulk, cluster similar behavior and failure modes, then surface patterns worth investigating. The goal is to focus human attention, not to treat clusters as automatic root-cause verdicts. 2 · SCORE Online evaluation Continuously run evaluators on all or selected production traces or threads, turning groundedness, policy, task-success proxies, sentiment, and similar criteria into trackable signals. 3 · ROUTE Signal-to-action automation Use filter + sampling + action to route important cases to annotation, dataset candidates, incidents or webhooks, or extended retention. Monitoring starts to close the loop only when scores connect to actions.  FIG.9.M2 · INSIGHTS PATTERN The core of the Insights Agent pattern is not to read more traces, but to compress, cluster, and turn patterns into actionable findings This is a production-scale batch trace-analysis pattern. A cluster is an investigation entry point, not an automatic root cause. STEP 1 Summarize traces Condense each trace into a one-line summary of the key action, path, and outcome, reducing context cost for downstream analysis. STEP 2 Cluster summaries Group similar usage patterns, tool paths, and failure modes so repeated issues become population-level patterns rather than isolated traces. STEP 3 Generate report Generate findings, representative examples, and candidate engineering actions from clusters, then return to raw traces to verify root cause.  SOURCE-SPECIFIC SCALE The course example states that LangSmith Insights Agent can currently analyze up to about 1,000 traces in one batch. This is an implementation capability from the source, not a universal architectural limit; real systems should design batches around cost, privacy, time windows, and stratified sampling.

titleZh: 09 Offline Eval 与 Online Eval：测试证据和生产信号不是一回事
titleEn: 09 Offline vs online evaluation: release evidence and production signals are different
textZh: Offline Eval 与 Online Eval：测试证据和生产信号不是一回事  维度 Offline Evaluation Online Evaluation 输入 Versioned Dataset / Regression / Holdout 真实 Production Trace / Thread，通常可按规则或比例采样 主要用途 版本比较、Regression、Release Gate 趋势、Drift、异常发现、Case Routing 控制程度 环境、Dataset、Evaluator 与版本尽量固定，强调可重复 真实分布持续变化，必须处理 Sampling Bias、Evaluator Drift、Privacy 与成本 输出含义 受控测试证据 需要进一步解释与路由的生产信号  WHY USER SENTIMENT 课程用 User Sentiment 作为 Thread-level Online Eval 示例，因为 NPS、问卷、点赞/点踩依赖用户主动反馈，容易出现 voluntary-response bias。对真实 Conversation 做统一 Judge 可以扩大覆盖，但仍需 Human Alignment、Judge Versioning 与 Privacy Review。  BOUNDARY Online evaluation scales judgment; it does not eliminate evaluator uncertainty. Online Judge 仍要版本化、校准并抽样做人审；高风险动作不能因为某个实时分数“看起来不错”就绕过 Policy Gate。
textEn: Offline vs online evaluation: release evidence and production signals are different  Dimension Offline Evaluation Online Evaluation Input Versioned dataset / regression / holdout Real production traces or threads, often filtered or sampled Primary use Version comparison, regression testing, release gates Trends, drift, anomaly discovery, case routing Control Environment, dataset, evaluator, and versions are controlled for repeatability The real distribution keeps changing, so sampling bias, evaluator drift, privacy, and cost must be managed Meaning of output Controlled test evidence Production signal that still needs interpretation and routing  WHY USER SENTIMENT The course uses user sentiment as a thread-level online-eval example because NPS, surveys, and like/dislike buttons depend on voluntary feedback and can suffer from voluntary-response bias. Judging real conversations can broaden coverage, but still requires human alignment, judge versioning, and privacy review.  BOUNDARY Online evaluation scales judgment; it does not eliminate evaluator uncertainty. Online judges still need versioning, calibration, and sampled human review. High-risk actions must not bypass policy gates merely because a real-time score looks good.

titleZh: 09 Automation Contract：Filter + Sampling + Action
titleEn: 09 Automation contract: Filter + sampling + action
textZh: Automation Contract：Filter + Sampling + Action  Component 工程问题 例子 Filter 哪些 Trace / Thread 值得处理？ low eval score · error · high risk · negative signal · metadata slice Sampling 命中后处理多少比例？ 控制 Judge 成本、人工队列负荷与正常流量 Spot-check 覆盖 Action 命中后下一步是什么？ annotation queue · dataset candidate · webhook / incident · retention
textEn: Automation contract: Filter + sampling + action  Component Engineering question Examples Filter Which traces or threads are worth processing? low eval score · error · high risk · negative signal · metadata slice Sampling What fraction of matches should be processed? Control judge cost, human-review load, and spot-check coverage of normal traffic Action What happens after a match? annotation queue · dataset candidate · webhook / incident · retention

titleZh: 09 常见 Automation Patterns：自动捕获，但不要自动相信
titleEn: 09 Common automation patterns: capture automatically, but do not trust automatically
textZh: 常见 Automation Patterns：自动捕获，但不要自动相信  模式 Filter / Sampling Action 工程解释 捕获不满意用户 Negative User Sentiment Annotation Queue 进入人工 Review / Root Cause，不直接把情绪分数当事实真值。 构建优质数据候选 Positive User Sentiment Dataset Candidate 先进入 Candidate Pool，再做隐私、去重、代表性、期望行为与 Split Assignment。 随机 Spot-check 无 Filter，示例采样 10% Annotation Queue 保留对未知 Failure 与正常流量分布的可见性，避免只分析“已知坏例”。  DATASET GOVERNANCE Positive sentiment 不自动等于 Golden Example，Negative feedback 也不自动等于 Regression Case。Production Data 进入 Dataset 前仍要经过 Privacy Review、Deduplication、Expected Behavior、Root Cause、Adjudication 与 Split Assignment。  FIG.9.M3 Production Learning Loop：监控只有回到可重复测试，才真正形成学习 1 Real Traffic Trace · Thread · feedback · errors 2 Score + Discover online eval · batch insights 3 Route + Review filter · sample · human review 4 Curate Evidence root cause · label · regression asset 5 Build + Offline Test fix · experiment · release gate 6 Canary → Monitor 新版本重新进入真实流量，产生下一轮证据。  CANONICAL RULE Monitoring without routing is telemetry; monitoring with curated feedback becomes learning infrastructure.  CLOSED LOOP The production loop closes only when monitored behavior becomes reproducible test evidence.  来源说明：本节依据 LangChain Academy Reliable Agents Module 3 工程化整理。课程使用 LangSmith Insights Agent、Online Evals 与 Automations 作为具体实现；本手册将其抽象为 Batch Trace Mining、Continuous Evaluation 与 Signal-to-Action Routing 三层生产监控模式。 LangChain Academy · Production Monitoring · Insights Agent · Online Evals · Automations
textEn: Common automation patterns: capture automatically, but do not trust automatically  Pattern Filter / Sampling Action Engineering interpretation Catch unhappy users Negative User Sentiment Annotation Queue Send to human review and root-cause analysis; do not treat a sentiment score as ground truth. Build high-quality dataset candidates Positive User Sentiment Dataset Candidate Enter a candidate pool first, then perform privacy, deduplication, representativeness, expected-behavior, and split-assignment checks. Random spot-check No filter, example 10% sample Annotation Queue Preserve visibility into unknown failures and the normal traffic distribution instead of analyzing only known bad cases.  DATASET GOVERNANCE Positive sentiment does not automatically make a golden example, and negative feedback does not automatically make a regression case. Production data still needs privacy review, deduplication, expected behavior, root-cause attribution, adjudication, and split assignment before entering a dataset.  FIG.9.M3 Production learning loop: Monitoring becomes learning only when it returns to repeatable tests 1 Real Traffic Trace · Thread · feedback · errors 2 Score + Discover online eval · batch insights 3 Route + Review filter · sample · human review 4 Curate evidence root cause · label · regression asset 5 Build + Offline Test fix · experiment · release gate 6 Canary → Monitor The new version returns to real traffic and produces the next round of evidence.  CANONICAL RULE Monitoring without routing is telemetry; monitoring with curated feedback becomes learning infrastructure.  CLOSED LOOP The production loop closes only when monitored behavior becomes reproducible test evidence.  Source note: this section engineering-reframes LangChain Academy Reliable Agents Module 3. The course uses LangSmith Insights Agent, online evals, and automations as concrete implementations; the handbook abstracts them into batch trace mining, continuous evaluation, and signal-to-action routing for production monitoring. titleZh: 09 User Sentiment 与 A/B Testing：从体验信号到版本证据 §9.M+
titleEn: 09 User sentiment and A/B testing: From experience signals to version evidence
textZh: User Sentiment 与 A/B Testing：从体验信号到版本证据 §9.M+  Latency 与 Error Rate 能告诉你系统是否“运行正常”，却不能证明用户是否满意。课程补充了两条生产闭环：用显式反馈 + Thread-level inferred sentiment 捕获体验问题，再用 prompt_version metadata 把修复版本和 Control 放在真实流量中比较。  FIG.9.M4 · EXPERIENCE SIGNALS User Sentiment 需要两条信号：用户主动说什么，以及完整对话暗示了什么体验 EXPLICIT Thumbs up / down → trace feedback LangSmith 示例用 create_feedback，把 user_sentiment=1/0 绑定到 trace_id。Root trace 通常足够；若需要阶段归因，也可以绑定到 child run。 INFERRED Thread → LLM judge → sentiment 显式反馈覆盖稀疏，因此课程用 Thread-based Online Eval 在整段对话 idle 后判断总体满意度。它适合用户满意度、主题和多轮体验，而不是只看单个 Trace。  维度 Single-turn evaluator Thread-based evaluator Input Single trace Full conversation thread Trigger 新 Trace 到达 Thread idle 后 适合 safety · format · per-run checks topic · user satisfaction · multi-turn experience  EVALUATOR DESIGN 课程重申三个 LLM-as-Judge 规则：一次只问一个窄问题；输出 Binary / Categorical，而不是模糊的 1–5 分；定期和 Human Labels 对齐。Sentiment 示例把 Neutral 归到 Positive，并提高最终 Human Message 的权重。  SOURCE-SPECIFIC SETTINGS 课程把 30–50% sampling、Gemini 2.5 Flash / GPT-4.1 nano、Human-and-AI-pairs message format 作为 LangSmith Sentiment Evaluator 的起始配置示例。这些是产品/课程建议，不是跨平台通用阈值。LangSmith Online Evaluator 命中的 Trace 还会进入 extended data retention，因此会影响 Trace pricing。
textEn: User sentiment and A/B testing: From experience signals to version evidence §9.M+  Latency and error rate can show whether a system is operating normally, but they do not prove user satisfaction. The course adds two production loops: capture experience problems with explicit feedback plus thread-level inferred sentiment, then compare a fix against the control on real traffic using prompt_version metadata.  FIG.9.M4 · EXPERIENCE SIGNALS User sentiment needs two signals: what users explicitly report and what the full conversation implies about their experience EXPLICIT Thumbs up / down → trace feedback The LangSmith example uses create_feedback to attach user_sentiment=1/0 to a trace_id. Root-trace feedback is usually enough; child runs can be used for phase attribution when needed. INFERRED Thread → LLM judge → sentiment Explicit feedback is sparse, so the course uses a thread-based online eval to judge overall satisfaction after the conversation goes idle. This is appropriate for satisfaction, topic, and multi-turn experience rather than a single trace.  Dimension Single-turn evaluator Thread-based evaluator Input Single trace Full conversation thread Trigger When a new trace arrives After the thread goes idle Good for safety · format · per-run checks topic · user satisfaction · multi-turn experience  EVALUATOR DESIGN The course repeats three LLM-as-judge rules: ask one narrow question at a time; return binary or categorical outputs rather than fuzzy 1–5 scores; and regularly align the judge with human labels. The sentiment example maps neutral to positive and gives extra weight to the final human message.  SOURCE-SPECIFIC SETTINGS The course presents 30–50% sampling, Gemini 2.5 Flash / GPT-4.1 nano, and Human-and-AI-pairs message format as starting settings for a LangSmith sentiment evaluator. These are product/course recommendations, not universal thresholds. Traces evaluated online in LangSmith are also upgraded to extended data retention, which affects trace pricing.

titleZh: 09 A/B Testing：修复只有和当前版本在真实流量里比较，才成为版本证据
titleEn: 09 A/B testing: A fix becomes version evidence only when it is compared with the current version on real traffic
textZh: A/B Testing：修复只有和当前版本在真实流量里比较，才成为版本证据  FIG.9.M5 · VERSION EXPERIMENT 1 Real Traffic 2 Control / Variant 3 metadata.prompt_version 4 Online Evals 5 Group by Version 6 Quality · latency · errors  HANDBOOK GENERALIZATION Monitoring finds the problem; versioned experiments test the fix. 把 experiment / prompt / agent / workflow version 作为一等 Metadata，才能让 Feedback、Eval、Latency、Error、Cost 与 Release Decision 对齐到同一个版本切片。  CLOSED LOOP Experience signal → Root cause → Fix → A/B experiment → Release decision → Monitor.  来源说明：本节依据 LangChain Academy Production Monitoring Module 3 的 Tracking User Sentiment 与 A/B Testing Prompt Versions 两课工程化整理。LangSmith-specific API、UI 与 Retention 行为保留为实现示例；本手册将其抽象为 Experience Signal、Thread-level Evaluation、Signal Routing 与 Versioned Production Experiment。
textEn: A/B testing: A fix becomes version evidence only when it is compared with the current version on real traffic  FIG.9.M5 · VERSION EXPERIMENT 1 Real Traffic 2 Control / Variant 3 metadata.prompt_version 4 Online Evals 5 Group by Version 6 Quality · latency · errors  HANDBOOK GENERALIZATION Monitoring finds the problem; versioned experiments test the fix. Treat experiment, prompt, agent, or workflow version as first-class metadata so feedback, evals, latency, errors, cost, and release decisions can be aligned to the same version slice.  CLOSED LOOP Experience signal → Root cause → Fix → A/B experiment → Release decision → Monitor.  Source note: this section engineering-reframes the Tracking User Sentiment and A/B Testing Prompt Versions lessons from LangChain Academy Production Monitoring Module 3. LangSmith-specific APIs, UI, and retention behavior are kept as implementation examples; the handbook abstracts them into experience signals, thread-level evaluation, signal routing, and versioned production experiments.

titleZh: 09 Security Monitoring：Online Evals、Dashboard 与 Incident Routing §9.M++
titleEn: 09 Security Monitoring: Online evals, dashboards, and incident routing
textZh: Security Monitoring：Online Evals、Dashboard 与 Incident Routing §9.M++  安全监控解决的是“生产里发生了什么、什么穿过了已有防线、接下来该怎么响应”，不是“如何阻止攻击发生”。Online security eval 属于 detection / observability layer，不能替代运行时 Authorization、Policy、Sandbox、Data Minimization 与 Tool Permission。  FIG.9.M6 · SECURITY SIGNALS Security Monitoring：Deterministic Check + Contextual Judge → Severity-aware Action 结构化模式交给 Code-based Eval；需要语境与权限判断的问题交给 LLM-as-Judge。两类信号汇合后，再按风险路由到 Dashboard、Review 或 Incident。 1 Production Trace input · output · tool path · identity context 2A Code-based Eval regex · schema · deterministic policy checks 2B LLM-as-Judge prompt injection · context-aware PII leakage 3 Security Signal boolean / categorical · evaluator version · coverage 4A Dashboard / Trend baseline · spikes · attack-pattern trend 4B Alert / Incident high-severity exposure · on-call investigation  DETECTION ≠ PREVENTION Online security eval is a detection layer, not a prevention layer. 它告诉你哪些攻击或泄漏进入了 Production Trace；真正的 prevention 仍属于 Runtime Control Plane。
textEn: Security Monitoring: Online evals, dashboards, and incident routing §9.M++  Security monitoring answers what happened in production, what got through existing defenses, and how to respond next. It is not the prevention layer. Online security evaluation is detection and observability; it does not replace runtime authorization, policy, sandboxing, data minimization, or tool permissions.  FIG.9.M6 · SECURITY SIGNALS Security monitoring: Deterministic checks + contextual judges → severity-aware action Use code-based evals for structured patterns and LLM-as-judge for contextual authorization and intent. Combine the signals, then route them by severity to dashboards, review, or incidents. 1 Production Trace input · output · tool path · identity context 2A Code-based Eval regex · schema · deterministic policy checks 2B LLM-as-Judge prompt injection · context-aware PII leakage 3 Security Signal boolean / categorical · evaluator version · coverage 4A Dashboard / Trend baseline · spikes · attack-pattern trend 4B Alert / Incident high-severity exposure · on-call investigation  DETECTION ≠ PREVENTION Online security eval is a detection layer, not a prevention layer. It tells you which attacks or leaks reached production traces; actual prevention still belongs to the runtime control plane.

titleZh: 09 两个课程 Evaluator：Prompt Injection 与 PII Leakage
titleEn: 09 Two course evaluators: prompt injection and PII leakage
textZh: 两个课程 Evaluator：Prompt Injection 与 PII Leakage  Evaluator 窄问题 关键边界 prompt_injection 用户输入是否包含试图覆盖指令、角色欺骗、System Prompt 抽取或编码绕过的攻击？ 合法的偏好请求，例如改变回答语言，不应因为“改变行为”就自动被判为攻击。 pii_leakage Agent 是否暴露了不应该共享的个人或敏感账户信息？ PII present 不等于 PII leakage；要结合数据主体、请求者身份、授权语境和输出暴露判断。  JUDGE CALIBRATION 如果 Prompt Injection Judge 经常把合法 Preference Request 判成攻击，先修 Evaluator Definition / Prompt Boundary，再调 Sampling 或 Alert Threshold。Systematic false positive 是 Judge 问题，不是告警参数问题。
textEn: Two course evaluators: prompt injection and PII leakage  Evaluator Narrow question Critical boundary prompt_injection Does the user input attempt instruction override, role-play manipulation, system-prompt extraction, or encoded bypass? Legitimate preference requests, such as changing response language, should not be flagged merely because they modify behavior. pii_leakage Did the agent expose personal or sensitive account information that should not have been shared? PII present is not the same as PII leakage; judge the data subject, requester identity, authorization context, and actual exposure.  JUDGE CALIBRATION If a prompt-injection judge frequently flags legitimate preference requests, fix the evaluator definition and prompt boundary before changing sampling or alert thresholds. Systematic false positives are a judge problem, not an alert-parameter problem.

titleZh: 09 Sampling：Coverage 本身必须被监控
titleEn: 09 Sampling: coverage itself must be monitored
textZh: Sampling：Coverage 本身必须被监控  观察 可以推出 不能推出 10% Sampling，一周没有 PII Alert 被评估的 Sample 中没有 Trace 被 Flag 不能证明全量流量里没有 PII Leakage  COVERAGE RULE No alert under partial sampling does not prove that no incident occurred. 安全 Dashboard 应同时记录 total traces、evaluated traces、sampling/filter scope、evaluator version 与 flagged count。  FIG.9.M7 · SECURITY RESPONSE LOOP 攻击尝试看趋势，确认泄漏走 Incident；两者最终都要回到 Defense + Regression 1 Security Signal injection · leakage · judge disagreement 2 Severity Router trend · review · alert · incident 3 Investigate Trace input · output · tools · authorization context 4 Root Cause runtime defense · policy · data · evaluator 5 Security Dataset curated case · expected behavior · attack slice 6 Offline Regression → Release fix defense · verify · ship · monitor again
textEn: Sampling: coverage itself must be monitored  Observation What you can conclude What you cannot conclude 10% sampling and no PII alert for a week No evaluated trace in the sample was flagged It does not prove that no PII leakage occurred in unsampled traffic  COVERAGE RULE No alert under partial sampling does not prove that no incident occurred. Security dashboards should track total traces, evaluated traces, sampling and filter scope, evaluator version, and flagged count together.  FIG.9.M7 · SECURITY RESPONSE LOOP Track attack attempts as trends; route confirmed leakage to incidents; both must feed defense and regression 1 Security Signal injection · leakage · judge disagreement 2 Severity Router trend · review · alert · incident 3 Investigate Trace input · output · tools · authorization context 4 Root Cause runtime defense · policy · data · evaluator 5 Security Dataset curated case · expected behavior · attack slice 6 Offline Regression → Release fix defense · verify · ship · monitor again

titleZh: 09 Signal Severity → Action Severity
titleEn: 09 Signal severity → action severity
textZh: Signal Severity → Action Severity  Signal 课程实现 Handbook 抽象 Prompt injection attempt Monitor dashboard 看 baseline、spike、趋势和代表 Trace，不要求每次尝试都创建 Incident。 PII leakage = true Run Count threshold 1 / 5 min → PagerDuty critical 高严重性敏感数据暴露 → immediate incident / on-call escalation。 Judge disagreement / uncertain case — 进入 Human Review / Adjudication，不把 Judge Flag 直接当 Ground Truth。  LANGSMITH-SPECIFIC 课程说明 LangSmith Online Evaluator 会让被评估 Trace 进入 extended data retention，从而影响 Trace Pricing；PagerDuty 示例使用 Events API V2 Integration Key。两者属于产品实现细节。跨平台原则是：Online Security Eval 会消耗 Judge Compute、Retention、Investigation 与 Incident Response 预算。  CANONICAL RULE Security monitoring closes the loop only when production signals become better defenses and repeatable regression tests.  来源说明：本节依据用户提供的 LangChain Academy Production Monitoring Module 4 内容工程化整理。课程用 LangSmith Online Evals、Monitor Dashboard、Alerts 与 PagerDuty 展示具体实现；本手册将其抽象为 Security Signal Generation、Coverage-aware Monitoring、Severity Routing 与 Incident-to-Regression Loop。 Online Evals for Security · Dashboards and Alerts · Security Monitoring Lab
textEn: Signal severity → action severity  Signal Course implementation Handbook abstraction Prompt injection attempt Monitor dashboard Track baselines, spikes, trends, and representative traces; not every attempt requires an incident. PII leakage = true Run Count threshold 1 / 5 min → PagerDuty critical High-severity sensitive-data exposure → immediate incident and on-call escalation. Judge disagreement / uncertain case — Route to human review and adjudication rather than treating the judge flag as ground truth.  LANGSMITH-SPECIFIC The course states that LangSmith online evaluation upgrades evaluated traces to extended data retention, affecting trace pricing, and its PagerDuty example uses an Events API V2 integration key. These are product-specific details. The cross-platform principle is that online security evaluation consumes judge compute, retention, investigation, and incident-response budgets.  CANONICAL RULE Security monitoring closes the loop only when production signals become better defenses and repeatable regression tests.  Source note: this section engineering-reframes the user-provided LangChain Academy Production Monitoring Module 4 material. The course uses LangSmith online evals, Monitor dashboards, alerts, and PagerDuty as concrete implementations; the handbook abstracts them into security-signal generation, coverage-aware monitoring, severity routing, and an incident-to-regression loop. titleZh: 09 Production Monitoring Capstone：把 Trace、Cost、Insights、Security 与 Thread Eval 串成一个系统 §9.M+++
titleEn: 09 Production Monitoring Capstone: Unifying traces, cost, insights, security, and thread evaluation into one system
textZh: Production Monitoring Capstone：把 Trace、Cost、Insights、Security 与 Thread Eval 串成一个系统 §9.M+++  这份 Capstone 最重要的不是 Quiz，而是 Observability Scope 与 Signal 如何连接：Run 解释局部执行，Trace 解释一次请求，Thread 解释多轮会话；Tags / Metadata / Feedback / Cost 为这些执行补充可切片的上下文，Insights 与 Online Evals 再把生产行为路由回调查、Dataset、Regression 与下一次 Release。  FIG.9.M7 · PRODUCTION MONITORING STACK 生产监控只有在执行身份、成本、质量、安全和会话结果能回连到同一执行层级时才真正可操作 1 Traffic 生产或生产式流量 2 Run → Trace → Thread 局部执行 → 单次请求 → 多轮会话 3 Tags · Metadata · Feedback 分类、切片、评价 4 Usage · Cost · Group-by 成本归因与群体切片 5 Insights · Online Evals · Security 发现潜在主题、质量与风险信号 6 Investigate → Dataset → Regression → Release 把生产证据变成下一次工程迭代  Scope 含义 适合回答的问题 Run 最小执行观测单元；Root / Child 都是 Run 哪个 Tool / LLM step 慢、贵、失败？ Trace 一个 Root Run 向下的完整执行树 这一次请求到底发生了什么？ Thread 同一多轮 Conversation 的多个 Trace 整个会话是否解决问题、满意、漂移或反复？  Signal 工程角色 来源示例 Tags 轻量分类与快速 Filter customer name · scenario · agent role Metadata 结构化切片与 Group-by session_id · customer_name · agent_name Feedback 评价、结果或 Reviewer / Evaluator Signal thumbs_up_down · online evaluator score  TRACE CONTEXT PATTERNS Capstone 里 get_current_run_tree() 有三种典型用途：① capture 当前 Run ID，后续绑定 Feedback；②写入 ls_provider / ls_model_name，让模型 Usage 能解析为成本；③为非 LLM Tool Run 直接写 usage_metadata.total_cost。它们对应三个通用模式：Correlation、Cost Resolution、Literal Tool Cost。  CANONICAL RULE Tags classify, metadata slices, feedback judges. 即使这些字段都能被 Filter，也不要混淆它们的语义。  COST ATTRIBUTION Attribution first → aggregation second → optimization third. 来源中数据库查询的 $0.0007 是 Capstone 人工注入的模拟成本，不是通用数据库价格；它的真正意义是演示 Child Tool Run 也应贡献可归因成本。  SIGNAL PROVENANCE Thread-level satisfaction evaluator 与 thumbs-up/down feedback 是不同证据来源。即使都使用 0/1，也应保留 signal_source 和 evaluator/version metadata。来源材料要求比较二者是否完全一致，但给定文本没有提供该 Quiz 的答案，因此手册不记录具体结论。  来源说明：本节依据 LangChain Academy Production Monitoring Capstone 工程化整理。课程中的客户角色、具体 Quiz 结果和 Insights 生成出的临时类别不作为长期知识保存；Run / Trace / Thread、Tags / Metadata / Feedback、Cost Attribution、Group-by Slicing、Insights Discovery、Security Evaluators 与 Thread-level Evaluation 被抽象为可复用的 Production Monitoring architecture。
textEn: Production Monitoring Capstone: Unifying traces, cost, insights, security, and thread evaluation into one system §9.M+++  The capstone matters less for its quizzes than for how observability scopes and signals connect: runs explain local execution, traces explain one request, and threads explain multi-turn conversations. Tags, metadata, feedback, and cost add sliceable context; insights and online evals then route production behavior back into investigation, datasets, regression tests, and the next release.  FIG.9.M7 · PRODUCTION MONITORING STACK Production monitoring becomes operational only when execution identity, cost, quality, security, and conversation outcome can be joined to the same execution hierarchy 1 Traffic Production or production-like traffic 2 Run → Trace → Thread Local execution → one request → multi-turn conversation 3 Tags · Metadata · Feedback Classification, slicing, judgment 4 Usage · Cost · Group-by Cost attribution and population slicing 5 Insights · Online Evals · Security Discover latent topics, quality signals, and risk signals 6 Investigate → Dataset → Regression → Release Turn production evidence into the next engineering iteration  Scope Meaning Best question Run Smallest execution observation; both root and child nodes are runs Which tool or LLM step was slow, expensive, or failed? Trace The complete execution tree under one root run What happened during this request? Thread Multiple traces belonging to the same multi-turn conversation Was the overall conversation resolved, satisfying, drifting, or repetitive?  Signal Engineering role Source example Tags Lightweight categorization and fast filtering customer name · scenario · agent role Metadata Structured slicing and group-by session_id · customer_name · agent_name Feedback Judgment, outcome, reviewer, or evaluator signal thumbs_up_down · online evaluator score  TRACE CONTEXT PATTERNS The capstone uses get_current_run_tree() in three distinct ways: capture the current run ID for later feedback correlation; write ls_provider / ls_model_name so model usage can be priced; and attach usage_metadata.total_cost directly to non-LLM tool runs. These generalize to correlation, cost resolution, and literal tool cost.  CANONICAL RULE Tags classify, metadata slices, feedback judges. Even when all three can be filtered, do not collapse their semantics into one generic attribute bucket.  COST ATTRIBUTION Attribution first → aggregation second → optimization third. The $0.0007 database-query value in the source is a manually injected capstone fixture, not a universal database price. Its engineering meaning is that child tool runs should also contribute attributable cost.  SIGNAL PROVENANCE A thread-level satisfaction evaluator and thumbs-up/down feedback are different evidence sources. Even when both use 0/1, preserve signal_source and evaluator/version metadata. The source asks whether they fully agree, but the provided text does not include that quiz answer, so the handbook does not invent one.  Source note: this section engineering-reframes the LangChain Academy Production Monitoring capstone. Customer characters, quiz-specific results, and transient categories generated by Insights are not preserved as durable knowledge; run/trace/thread scope, tags/metadata/feedback, cost attribution, group-by slicing, insight discovery, security evaluators, and thread-level evaluation are abstracted into a reusable production-monitoring architecture.

titleZh: 09 Cost per Successful Task：优化任务成本，而不是单次模型价格 §9.13
titleEn: 09 Cost per Successful Task: Optimize task economics, not model-call price
textZh: Cost per Successful Task：优化任务成本，而不是单次模型价格 §9.13  模型更便宜，不代表任务更便宜。弱模型如果带来更多重试、更多轮次、更多检索和更长上下文，总 Token 消耗可能上升，最终把单任务成本推高。新的 Production Monitoring 课程进一步补上成本记账层：Usage 必须先被正确采集和定价，才能可靠地进入 Cost / Task 与 Cost / Successful Task。  FIG.9.C1 任务经济性由 Token 量、混合单价与成功率共同决定 VOLUME Total tokens consumed 检索、读文件、推理、重试、长上下文和额外轮次都会增加 Token 量。 RATE Blended price per token 通过 model-family routing 与 model-tier routing，让常规步骤使用便宜模型，把强模型留给真正困难的少数步骤。 OUTCOME Cost per successful task 最终指标应把成本与任务成功率放在一起看，而不是只看 Cost/query 或某个模型的标价。  INTERACTIVE · TASK ECONOMICS 为什么“更便宜的模型”可能产生更贵的任务？ 调节 Token、混合单价、平均尝试次数与成功率，观察 Cost / attempt、Cost / task 与 Cost / successful task 如何分离。该模型只用于解释工程关系，不包含工具、GPU、人工审核等非 Token 成本。 高效路由 低价模型重试陷阱 平衡方案 每次尝试 Token 45k 包含检索、上下文、推理与输出 混合 Token 单价 $1.80/1M 路由后的平均价格，不等于某一个模型的标价 平均尝试次数 1.4× 包含重试、修复和重新规划 任务成功率 88% 必须用实际成功标准，而不是模型自评 单次尝试成本 $0.081 单任务成本 $0.113 成功任务成本 $0.129 LIVE COST PATH Token 量 × 尝试次数 45k tokens × 1.4 attempts × 混合单价 $1.80 / 1M tokens ÷ 成功率修正 88% success → $0.129 Cost / attempt $0.081 Cost / task $0.113 Cost / successful task $0.129 读法：降低模型单价只有在不显著增加 Token、重试或失败率时才真正降低任务经济成本。生产系统应同时追踪成功率、总 Token、重试率、延迟与非 Token 成本。  FIG.9.C2 · COST ACCOUNTING Usage 不是 Cost：必须经过价格解析，再与 API、Retrieval 等需要自己的计量或 literal cost。 2 · PRICE Pricing Resolution 用 Model / Provider / Token Type / Effective Date 匹配价格。具体 subtype 先计价，剩余 Usage 再按默认价格计算，避免重复计费。 3 · JOIN Aggregate + Outcome Run Cost Prefix、Tool Schema 与 Prefill 成本。 Output Generated text/image · reasoning tokens 定位输出长度、Reasoning 与 Decode 成本。 Other Tool · retrieval · custom run 补齐 Search API、Database、Retrieval 等非 LLM 成本，避免把 Token Cost 误当总任务成本。  CACHE READ ≠ COST HOTSPOT 课程强调 Cache Read Token 通常比普通 Input Token 更便宜，因此 Cache Read 即使占 Input Token 的大头，也不代表它占 Input Cost 的大头。正确分析单位是 Token Type × Effective Price，而不是只看 Token Share。 Token Count 但没有匹配价格规则时，只能知道 Usage，不能可靠得到 Cost。 Tool / API / Retrieval usage_metadata.total_cost 没有 Token Unit Price 的组件，应上报实际计量或账单成本，再参与 Trace / Task 聚合。  PRICING VERSION BOUNDARY 来源课程说明 LangSmith Model Pricing 更新不是 retroactive，只影响更新后记录的 Trace。跨时间比较成本时，应明确保存 Pricing Effective Date / Version，并区分“当时实际计价”与“按统一价格表重算”的分析口径。  观察尺度 LangSmith 适合回答 Micro Trace Tree 这一次 Trace / Child Run 的钱花在哪里？ Aggregate Project Stats 整个项目当前用了多少 Token、花了多少钱？ Slice / Trend Dashboard + Group by metadata 哪个 Tool、Model、Customer、App Version 或 Environment 推动了成本变化？  ACCOUNTING RULE Measure usage separately from pricing, then join cost with task outcome.  CANONICAL RULE Optimize cost per successful task, not price per model call. textEn: Cost per Successful Task: Optimize task economics, not model-call price §9.13  A cheaper model does not necessarily produce a cheaper task. If a weaker model causes more retries, more turns, more retrieval, or larger contexts, total token consumption can rise and increase the final cost per task. The Production Monitoring lessons add the accounting layer: usage must be captured and priced correctly before it can reliably feed cost per task and cost per successful task.  FIG.9.C1 Task economics are driven by token volume, blended price, and success rate VOLUME Total tokens consumed Retrieval, file reading, reasoning, retries, larger contexts, and extra turns all increase token volume. RATE Blended price per token Use model-family routing and model-tier routing so routine steps use cheaper models while stronger models are reserved for the small fraction of genuinely difficult steps. OUTCOME Cost per successful task The final metric should combine cost with task success rather than looking only at cost per query or a model's sticker price.  INTERACTIVE · TASK ECONOMICS Why can a cheaper model produce a more expensive task? Adjust token volume, blended token price, average attempts, and success rate to see how cost per attempt, cost per task, and cost per successful task diverge. This is an explanatory model and excludes non-token costs such as tools, GPUs, and human review. Efficient routing Cheap-model retry trap Balanced Tokens per attempt 45k Includes retrieval, context, reasoning, and output Blended token price $1.80/1M Average price after routing, not the sticker price of one model Average attempts per task 1.4× Includes retries, repairs, and replanning Task success rate 88% Measure against real success criteria, not model self-report Cost / attempt $0.081 Cost / task $0.113 Cost / successful task $0.129 LIVE COST PATH Token volume × attempts 45k tokens × 1.4 attempts × Blended rate $1.80 / 1M tokens ÷ Success-rate correction 88% success → $0.129 Cost / attempt $0.081 Cost / task $0.113 Cost / successful task $0.129 Interpretation: lowering model price reduces task economics only when it does not materially increase tokens, retries, or failure rate. Production systems should track success rate, total tokens, retry rate, latency, and non-token costs together.  FIG.9.C2 · COST ACCOUNTING Usage is not cost: resolve pricing first, then join task outcome Cost observability should keep how much was used separate from how that usage was priced; otherwise pricing changes, cache reads, custom models, and non-LLM components distort historical analysis. 1 · CAPTURE Usage capture Record input, output, and other usage plus subtypes such as cache_read and reasoning; tools, search APIs, and retrieval need their own metering or literal cost. 2 · PRICE Pricing resolution Resolve price by model, provider, token type, and effective date. Price specific subtypes first, then price only residual usage at the default rate to avoid double charging. 3 · JOIN Aggregate + outcome Aggregate run cost into trace and task cost, slice by model, tool, customer, version, and other metadata, then join task success to obtain actionable cost per successful task.  Cost category Breakdown in the source lesson Engineering interpretation Input Prompt · text/image input · cache reads Attribute context, prompt-prefix, tool-schema, and prefill cost. Output Generated text/image · reasoning tokens Attribute output length, reasoning, and decode cost. Other Tool · retrieval · custom run Include search APIs, databases, retrieval, and other non-LLM spend so token cost is not mistaken for total task cost.  CACHE READ ≠ COST HOTSPOT The lesson emphasizes that cache-read tokens are typically cheaper than regular input tokens, so a large cache-read share of input tokens does not imply a large share of input cost. Analyze token type × effective price rather than token share alone.  Run type LangSmith source mechanism Reusable engineering principle LLM Token counts + ls_model_name + ls_provider + pricing table Separate usage from pricing; manually report usage when automatic extraction is unavailable. Custom / self-hosted LLM usage_metadata + custom pricing entry Token counts without a matching pricing rule provide usage but not reliable cost. Tool / API / Retrieval usage_metadata.total_cost Components without token-based unit pricing should report metered or billed literal cost before trace/task aggregation.  PRICING VERSION BOUNDARY The source lesson states that LangSmith model-pricing updates are not retroactive and affect only traces logged after the change. Historical cost analysis should preserve pricing effective date/version and distinguish actual-at-the-time pricing from normalized repricing.  Observation scope LangSmith Best for answering Micro Trace Tree Where did this trace or child run spend money? Aggregate Project Stats How many tokens and how much total spend does the project have? Slice / Trend Dashboard + Group by metadata Which tool, model, customer, app version, or environment drove the cost movement?  ACCOUNTING RULE Measure usage separately from pricing, then join cost with task outcome.  CANONICAL RULE Optimize cost per successful task, not price per model call.  SOURCE EXAMPLE In the previously cited Glean comparison, the source reports roughly $0.45/task versus $1.84/task and about 29.8M versus 88.8M tokens. Treat it as a source-specific example showing how routing plus better context can reduce both blended price and token volume, not as a universal benchmark transferable to other systems.  Sources: LangChain Academy · Token and Cost Breakdowns · Setting Up Cost Tracking · Viewing Costs in the UI · LangSmith Cost Tracking Docs · AI Engineering · Loop vs Graph Engineering Clearly Explained

titleZh: 09 Agent Experience Learning：经验要经过 Promotion Gate §9.X
titleEn: 09 Agent Experience Learning: promote experience through explicit gates
textZh: Agent Experience Learning：经验要经过 Promotion Gate §9.X  Agent 自我学习不是“任务结束后自动改权重”。Raw Trace 先经过 Eval、Root Cause、Distillation 和 Validation，再决定它应该进入 Memory、Skill、Deterministic Rule、Regression Dataset 还是 Training Dataset。  FIG.9.X1 · EXPERIENCE PROMOTION SYSTEM 把“发生过”变成“以后可以安全复用” Trace 是证据，Experience 是经过验证的抽象；不同经验应该晋升到不同系统层。 01 Production Trace 记录 observable action、structured decision、Tool I/O、state transition、validation、cost 和 outcome；Raw success log 不是 ground truth demonstration。 02 Eval + Root Cause 先判断是 Agent、Tool、Data、Permission、Environment 还是 Evaluator 的问题，再决定有没有可复用 lesson。 03 Experience Distillation 抽取 trigger、recommended action、anti-pattern、applicability、evidence、scope、version compatibility 和 do-not-apply 条件。 04 Promotion Router 根据稳定性、作用域、权限、是否可程序化、是否可评测，选择 Memory / Skill / Rule / Regression / Training。 05 Eval / Shadow / Release 经验从 CANDIDATE → VALIDATED → SHADOW → ACTIVE；任何 promotion 都需要版本、证据、回滚路径和 regression protection。 核心原则 Agent self-learning is a controlled experience-promotion system, not an uncontrolled self-modification loop.  FIG.9.X2 · WHERE SHOULD EXPERIENCE LIVE? 不是所有经验都应该进 Memory，更不是所有 Memory 都应该进权重 经验类型 推荐落点 为什么 长期用户偏好 / 有效期内项目约束 Profile / Project Memory 需要 scope、失效与可删除性 重复出现的成熟任务方法 Skill / Procedure 把多个 Case 抽象成可复用步骤 必须满足的业务不变量 Code / Policy / Validator 不应该依赖模型“记得” 真实生产失败 Regression Dataset 学习必须变成可重复验证 稳定、重复、参数层行为缺口 Training Dataset 只有有明确 Eval Contract 才进入 SFT / preference / RL FAST 外置经验快路径 Memory / Skill / Rule / Regression：可追溯、可失效、更新快。 SLOW 参数学习慢路径 Curated Training Data → SFT / preference / RL → full regression → model release。 NEGATIVE TRANSFER 经验系统不能只测“召回后变好多少”，还要测被召回或晋升的经验是否让原本正确的任务变差。Stale lesson、scope leakage 和 self-reinforcing error 都属于必须监控的学习风险。 最终原则 Learning is incomplete until the lesson becomes testable.
textEn: Agent Experience Learning: promote experience through explicit gates §9.X  Agent self-learning is not automatic weight mutation after every task. Raw traces first pass through evaluation, root-cause analysis, distillation, and validation before being promoted into memory, skills, deterministic rules, regression datasets, or training data.  FIG.9.X1 · EXPERIENCE PROMOTION SYSTEM Turn what happened into something safe to reuse later A trace is evidence; an experience is a validated abstraction. Different lessons belong in different system layers. 01 Production Trace Record observable actions, structured decisions, tool I/O, state transitions, validation, cost, and outcome. A raw success log is not a ground-truth demonstration. 02 Eval + Root Cause First identify whether the problem came from the agent, tool, data, permissions, environment, or evaluator before deciding whether there is a reusable lesson. 03 Experience Distillation Extract triggers, recommended actions, anti-patterns, applicability, evidence, scope, version compatibility, and do-not-apply conditions. 04 Promotion Router Use stability, scope, authority, programmability, and evaluability to choose Memory, Skill, Rule, Regression, or Training. 05 Eval / Shadow / Release Experience moves from CANDIDATE to VALIDATED to SHADOW to ACTIVE. Every promotion needs versioning, evidence, rollback, and regression protection. Core rule Agent self-learning is a controlled experience-promotion system, not an uncontrolled self-modification loop.  FIG.9.X2 · WHERE SHOULD EXPERIENCE LIVE? Not every experience belongs in memory, and not every memory belongs in model weights Experience type Promotion target Why Durable user preference or time-scoped project constraint Profile / Project Memory Needs scope, expiry, and deletability Repeated validated procedure Skill / Procedure Abstract repeated cases into reusable steps Business invariant that must always hold Code / Policy / Validator Should not depend on the model remembering it Real production failure Regression Dataset The lesson must become reproducibly testable Stable repeated model-behavior gap Training Dataset Promote to SFT, preference optimization, or RL only with a clear evaluation contract FAST External-experience fast path Memory / Skill / Rule / Regression: traceable, invalidatable, and fast to update. SLOW Parameter-learning slow path Curated training data → SFT / preference / RL → full regression → model release. NEGATIVE TRANSFER Experience systems must not measure only improvement after recall; they must also detect whether retrieved or promoted lessons make previously correct tasks worse. Stale lessons, scope leakage, and self-reinforcing errors are learning risks that need monitoring. Final rule Learning is incomplete until the lesson becomes testable.

titleZh: 09 Guardrail Evidence Gate + Behavior Observability §9.G
titleEn: 09 Guardrail Evidence Gate + Behavior Observability
textZh: Guardrail Evidence Gate + Behavior Observability §9.G  生产级 Agent 不只需要“系统是否健康”的可观测性，还需要“这次任务为什么这样执行”的行为证据；高风险动作则应绑定版本化规则、不可变动作快照和 Evidence。  FIG.9.G1 · BEHAVIOR OBSERVABILITY Session → Task → Trajectory → Step → Outcome SYSTEM OBSERVABILITY 系统运行是否健康？ latency · throughput · errors · resource · cost · cache · availability BEHAVIOR OBSERVABILITY 任务为什么这样执行？ trajectory · tool choice · state change · evidence · recovery · outcome TRACE vs TRAJECTORY Trace = operational call graph. Trajectory = task-semantic execution record. 二者可以共享 trace context，但不是同一个概念。  FIG.9.G2 · GUARDRAIL EVIDENCE GATE Spec + ChangeSet + Evidence → PASS / BLOCKED / UNKNOWN RULE GuardrailSpec@revision 固定检查目标、判定标准和 Evidence requirement。 ACTION SNAPSHOT immutable ChangeSet@digest 把“准备执行什么”冻结成不可变上下文，防止检查对象漂移。 EVIDENCE Agent Submission(s) source · observation time · scope · result · failure reason GATE PASS · BLOCKED · UNKNOWN UNKNOWN ≠ PASS. 证据不足时 hold / escalate，不放宽标准。 COMMIT 执行方重新校验当前现实状态 permission · resource version · target · action · duplicate risk 权限边界 Evidence collection can be delegated; authority to commit remains with the control plane.
textEn: Guardrail Evidence Gate + Behavior Observability §9.G  Production agents need more than system-health observability. They also need behavioral evidence explaining how a task executed, while high-risk actions should bind versioned rules, immutable action snapshots, and evidence.  FIG.9.G1 · BEHAVIOR OBSERVABILITY Session → Task → Trajectory → Step → Outcome SYSTEM OBSERVABILITY Is the runtime healthy? latency · throughput · errors · resource · cost · cache · availability BEHAVIOR OBSERVABILITY Why did the task execute this way? trajectory · tool choice · state change · evidence · recovery · outcome TRACE vs TRAJECTORY Trace = operational call graph. Trajectory = task-semantic execution record. They can share trace context without being the same concept.  FIG.9.G2 · GUARDRAIL EVIDENCE GATE Spec + ChangeSet + Evidence → PASS / BLOCKED / UNKNOWN RULE GuardrailSpec@revision Pins check objectives, decision criteria, and evidence requirements. ACTION SNAPSHOT immutable ChangeSet@digest Freezes what is about to execute so the checked object cannot drift. EVIDENCE Agent Submission(s) source · observation time · scope · result · failure reason GATE PASS · BLOCKED · UNKNOWN UNKNOWN ≠ PASS. Insufficient evidence should hold or escalate, not relax the standard. COMMIT Executor revalidates current real-world state permission · resource version · target · action · duplicate risk Authority boundary Evidence collection can be delegated; authority to commit remains with the control plane.
