titleEn: 09 FDE evaluation questions: golden sets, agent trajectories and release gates
textZh:
FDE 评估面试：从 Golden Set 到 Agent Release Gate §9.FDE 四道高价值问题：如何验证 RAG 可上线、如何避免测试集泄漏、如何评价 Agent 的执行轨迹，以及如何用 Eval 阻止回归。 SOURCE BOUNDARY 以下是根据 FDE 网站公开考点独立撰写的问题与答案，不是付费题目的官方答案。产品细节以链接的官方文档为准；设计建议属于 Handbook 综合判断。 Q4 · 怎样评估 RAG 才能让客户放心上线？  分开衡量 Retriever 与 Generator，再加入授权、安全和运行指标。正确检索不保证正确回答；流畅回答也不证明有证据。  测试层 指标 / 证据 Retrieval 授权证据 Recall@k、MRR、Freshness Generation Faithfulness、Relevance、拒答是否正确 Security 跨租户泄漏、越权工具调用 Production p95 Latency、Timeout、Cost / Success  核心判断 只对必须基于检索证据回答的任务，Recall@k 才能合理限制下游 grounded success；这不是所有 LLM 输出的普遍数学上界。  Q5 · Golden Dataset 怎么建立？为什么 95% Pilot 可能只有 70% Production？  按真实流量中任务、语言、风险、文档、租户分层采样，建立人工确认的正确答案与证据；Development / Sealed Holdout / Stress Regression 三类样本用途分开。用独立新样本与固定桥接集区分版本提升与分布漂移。  95%→70% 并不能直接证明模型退化：还要排查真实样本构成、索引延迟、OCR、权限、模型版本与评估器变化。反复看 holdout 并针对它调参会污染独立验收。  Q6 · Agent 输出正确，是否就代表执行正确？  不一定。评估有无越权工具、危险参数、无意义循环、预算超限、未经批准的副作用。对必须经过审批的场景验证节点约束，而非强行要求所有合法执行拥有完全相同的工具顺序。  Input + approved identity
 → tool name / args / policy decision
 → tool outcome / state transition
 → artifact checks / final answer
 → outcome + risk + cost evaluator  Q7 · 如何把 Eval 变成能挡住坏版本的 CI Gate？  版本化 prompt、模型、检索器、数据集、grader 和基准分数。先跑 deterministic policy gates，再比较离线质量的关键 slices；严重越权始终阻断。通过后用 Shadow/Canary 观察线上，并保持回滚能力。  自动关卡 何时阻断 Policy gate 任何测试中的越权读取或危险调用 Golden set 关键人群/任务出现不可接受退化 Judge audit 评估器与人工标签偏差没有校准 Release telemetry Canary 错误率、p95 或成本超出约定预算  核心判断 LLM-as-a-Judge 可扩展语义评分，但不能代替确定性权限检查；官方工具支持 Offline/Online 和 Code/LLM 评估，阈值必须根据客户风险自行定义。  官方核验来源 : FDE Golden Set · Google RAG eval · LangSmith evaluations · OpenAI eval graders
textEn:
FDE evaluation questions: golden sets, agent trajectories and release gates §9.FDE Four high-value questions: RAG launch evaluation, test contamination, agent trajectory grading, and enforceable CI release gates. SOURCE BOUNDARY These independently authored questions and answers derive from public FDE topics, not from any private paid answer. Platform facts follow first-party references; design advice is handbook synthesis. Q4 · How do you evaluate RAG before customer launch?  Score retrieval and generation separately, then add authorization, safety and operational gates. Correct retrieval is not enough for a grounded answer.  Test layer Signals Retrieval Authorized evidence recall@k, MRR, freshness Generation Faithfulness, relevance, abstention correctness Security Cross-tenant leakage, forbidden tool calls Production p95 latency, timeout, cost / success  Engineering rule Recall@k constrains downstream grounded success only under an evidence-required answer contract, not every possible model response.  Q5 · How do you build a golden set, and why might a 95% pilot become 70% in production?  Stratify genuine tasks by intent, locale, risk, document and tenant. Separate development, sealed holdout and stress-regression pools; use fresh acceptance samples and a fixed bridge set to distinguish improvements from distribution drift.  A 95%-to-70% drop alone does not identify the cause. Investigate traffic mix, index lag, OCR, permissions, version drift and graders. Repeated tuning against the same holdout contaminates acceptance.  Q6 · If the final Agent answer is right, is the run correct?  No. Evaluate unauthorized tools, dangerous arguments, loops, budget excess and unapproved effects. Enforce necessary invariants rather than demanding one exact tool sequence for every valid trajectory.  Input + approved identity
 → tool name / args / policy decision
 → tool outcome / state transition
 → artifact checks / final answer
 → outcome + risk + cost evaluator  Q7 · How do you turn evaluations into release-blocking CI gates?  Version prompts, models, retrievers, datasets, graders and baseline. Run deterministic policy gates, compare critical offline slices, block all severe authorization violations, then use shadow/canary with rollback.  Gate Block when Policy gate Any tested unauthorized read or dangerous tool use Golden set Unacceptable degradation in essential cohorts Judge audit Judge not calibrated against human examples Release telemetry Canary errors, p95 or cost exceed agreed budget  Engineering rule LLM judges scale semantic grading but cannot replace deterministic authorization tests. Platforms support offline/online and code/LLM evaluation; release thresholds remain workload-specific.  Verified first-party sources : FDE Golden Set · Google RAG eval · LangSmith evaluations · OpenAI eval graders

titleZh: 09 Evaluation Foundations：小样本错误、校准与真实数据
titleEn: 09 Evaluation foundations: imbalanced errors, calibration and valid datasets
textZh:
Evaluation Foundations：小样本错误、校准与真实数据 FDE INDEPENDENT RESEARCH 依据 FDE 公开考点独立研究，不是付费标准答案。示例为教学假设，并非客户性能实测。 模型“99% 准确”并不代表高风险任务可靠。这里先建立错误矩阵和概率约束，再讨论抽样与在线实验。  Q30 · 99% Accuracy 能否漏掉全部安全风险？  990 legitimate + 10 violation requests
Predict ALL as legitimate
Accuracy = 990 / 1000 = 99%
Violation Recall = 0 / 10 = 0%  针对违规风险，至少单独报告 Precision、Recall、F1、混淆矩阵与 FN 负担，不能用宏观均值掩盖关键 slice。  Q31 · 说 0.9 Confidence 就代表 90% 正确吗？  只有经独立数据校准的概率才支持类似解释。Reliability Diagram、Brier/Log Loss 和分桶标注有价值；Brier 同时受分辨能力影响，分数低不能单独证明校准更好。  Q32 · LLM 自己生成题与答案，可以做 Golden Set 吗？  可做压力样本，但必须绑定来源证据和独立审定，不能把自生成标签当作正确事实。开发集、压力集、密封 holdout 必须隔离。  Q33 · Bandit 与 A/B 测试该怎么选？  方法 适用场景 风险边界 固定 A/B 可解释的实验对照 明确分流与评估时窗 Bandit 低风险、可重复试验、快速反馈 偏差与自适应曝光 Shadow / Canary 未曝光对照 / 安全分阶段上线 不能绕过安全门禁  第一手资料 : sklearn recall metrics · sklearn calibration · sklearn cross validation
textEn:
Evaluation foundations: imbalanced errors, calibration and valid datasets FDE INDEPENDENT RESEARCH Independently researched from public FDE topics, not paid answer keys. All scenarios are instructional, not measured customer deployments. A model can claim 99% accuracy yet miss every rare high-risk case. Start with confusion matrices and probabilistic contracts, then design datasets and online experiments.  Q30 · Can 99% accuracy miss every security violation?  990 legitimate + 10 violation requests
Predict ALL as legitimate
Accuracy = 990 / 1000 = 99%
Violation Recall = 0 / 10 = 0%  Report risk-class precision, recall, F1, confusion matrix and false negatives. An average cannot hide critical slices.  Q31 · Does confidence 0.9 mean 90% of predictions are right?  Only a properly calibrated score supports probabilistic interpretation. Reliability diagrams, Brier/log loss and labeled bins are useful, but lower Brier alone does not prove superior calibration.  Q32 · Can one LLM create its own questions and gold answers?  Synthetic samples help stress tests, but gold labels require source evidence and independent adjudication. Separate development, stress and sealed holdout data.  Q33 · When is a bandit preferable to fixed A/B?  Method Best use Risk boundary Fixed A/B Interpretability and planned inference Predeclared cohorts/window Bandit Safe repeated choices and prompt feedback Adaptive exposure and bias Shadow / Canary No-exposure comparisons / staged rollout Never bypass security gates  Primary references : sklearn recall metrics · sklearn calibration · sklearn cross validation

titleZh: 10 10.1 Prefill、Decode 与两种 KV 复用
titleEn: 10 10.1 Prefill, Decode, and two kinds of KV reuse
textZh: 10.1 Prefill、Decode 与两种 KV 复用  机制 复用范围 主要价值 Within-request KV Cache 同一请求已处理 token 避免 Decode 时重复计算全部历史 Cross-request Prefix Cache 不同请求之间兼容且完全相同的 token prefix 避免重复 Prefill，降低 TTFT  没有跨请求 Prefix Cache 时，相同前缀通常仍会被各自 Prefill。现代 serving engine 是否默认启用、如何索引和何时淘汰都取决于 engine、version 与 config，因此不要把“默认不能共享”当成通用事实。
textEn: 10.1 Prefill, Decode, and two kinds of KV reuse  Mechanism Reuse scope Primary value Within-request KV Cache Past tokens in the same request Avoid recomputing the full history during Decode Cross-request Prefix Cache Compatible identical token prefixes across requests Avoid redundant Prefill and reduce TTFT  Without cross-request prefix caching, identical prefixes are typically prefilled separately. Whether modern serving engines enable it by default, how they index it, and when they evict entries depend on the engine, version, and configuration, so 'sharing is disabled by default' is not a universal fact.

titleZh: 10 10.2 Cache Hit 需要 token-level identity
titleEn: 10 10.2 Cache hits require token-level identity
textZh: 10.2 Cache Hit 需要 token-level identity  KEY 常见兼容条件 model / revision · tokenizer · chat template · exact token IDs · position semantics · adapter / LoRA · multimodal identity · cache namespace / salt · block granularity MISS 常见命中率杀手 动态 timestamp / request id · Tool Schema 顺序变化 · 不稳定 JSON serialization · tenant 信息过早注入 · role prompt 过早分叉  PROMPT LAYOUT Prefix Cache 的命中率部分取决于应用层 Prompt Layout。把稳定公共前缀放在前面、动态内容放在后面，通常更容易复用；但绝不能为了命中率破坏语义、权限或租户隔离。
textEn: 10.2 Cache hits require token-level identity  KEY Typical compatibility factors model / revision · tokenizer · chat template · exact token IDs · position semantics · adapter / LoRA · multimodal identity · cache namespace / salt · block granularity MISS Common hit-rate killers dynamic timestamps / request IDs · changing tool-schema order · unstable JSON serialization · tenant data inserted too early · early role-specific divergence  PROMPT LAYOUT Prefix-cache hit rate is partly an application prompt-layout property. Stable common prefixes placed earlier and dynamic content later are usually easier to reuse, but cache efficiency must never override semantics, authorization, or tenant isolation.

titleZh: 10 10.3 SGLang RadixAttention vs vLLM APC
titleEn: 10 10.3 SGLang RadixAttention vs vLLM APC
textZh: 10.3 SGLang RadixAttention vs vLLM APC  Runtime Prefix 索引思路 共同目标 SGLang Radix-style prefix tree / longest-prefix reuse 复用已经计算的精确共享前缀 KV，避免重复 Prefill vLLM Block-oriented APC；使用 prefix-aware block hash 查找已计算 blocks 复用已经计算的精确共享前缀 KV，避免重复 Prefill  RadixAttention 是 SGLang 的具体机制/术语，不应该当作所有 Prefix Caching 的通用名称。不同 runtime 可以使用不同数据结构达到同样的跨请求前缀复用目标。
textEn: 10.3 SGLang RadixAttention vs vLLM APC  Runtime Prefix indexing approach Shared goal SGLang Radix-style prefix tree / longest-prefix reuse Reuse already-computed KV for exact shared prefixes and avoid redundant Prefill vLLM Block-oriented APC with prefix-aware block hashes Reuse already-computed KV for exact shared prefixes and avoid redundant Prefill  RadixAttention is an SGLang-specific mechanism and term, not the generic name for all prefix caching. Different runtimes can use different data structures to achieve the same cross-request prefix-reuse goal.

titleZh: 10 10.4 Prefix Cache ≠ Semantic Cache
titleEn: 10 10.4 Prefix Cache ≠ Semantic Cache
textZh: 10.4 Prefix Cache ≠ Semantic Cache  Cache Key 复用什么 是否仍调用模型 KV / Prefix Cache exact compatible token prefix intermediate K/V computation 是：suffix / Decode 仍需执行 Exact Response Cache exact request key final response 通常否 Semantic Cache embedding / semantic similarity prior response / tool result 命中时可跳过  必须区分 Prefix caching reuses computation. Semantic caching reuses an answer.
textEn: 10.4 Prefix Cache ≠ Semantic Cache  Cache Key What is reused Model call after hit? KV / Prefix Cache exact compatible token prefix intermediate K/V computation Yes: suffix / Decode still run Exact Response Cache exact request key final response Usually no Semantic Cache embedding / semantic similarity prior response / tool result Can be skipped on hit  Must distinguish Prefix caching reuses computation. Semantic caching reuses an answer.

titleZh: 10 10.5 Multi-Agent：先保留边界，再优化共享前缀
titleEn: 10 10.5 Multi-Agent: preserve boundaries first, then optimize shared prefixes
textZh:
10.5 Multi-Agent：先保留边界，再优化共享前缀  Common System Policy
+ Common Tool Schema
+ Stable Safety / Formatting Rules
        ↓ shared prefix

Agent-specific Role / Skill Context
        ↓ divergence

User / Task Context  不要为了 Cache Hit 强行让所有 Agent 使用相同角色定义。先保证责任边界、权限隔离与语义正确，再优化共享前缀。
textEn:
10.5 Multi-Agent: preserve boundaries first, then optimize shared prefixes  Common System Policy
+ Common Tool Schema
+ Stable Safety / Formatting Rules
        ↓ shared prefix

Agent-specific Role / Skill Context
        ↓ divergence

User / Task Context  Do not force all Agents to share one role definition merely to improve cache hits. Preserve responsibility boundaries, permission isolation, and semantic correctness first; optimize shared prefixes second.

titleZh: 10 10.6 Security：Cache sharing 也是隔离策略
titleEn: 10 10.6 Security: cache sharing is also an isolation policy
textZh: 10.6 Security：Cache sharing 也是隔离策略  SHARE 更高复用 更高 prefix hit rate · 更少 Prefill · 更低 TTFT；适合同一 trust group 内大量公共前缀。 ISOLATE 更强隔离 通过 cache namespace / salt 限制跨用户或跨租户复用，牺牲部分命中率换取隐私边界。  vLLM CACHE SALT vLLM 当前支持 request-level cache_salt，把 salt 混入 Prefix Cache key。不同 salt 的请求不能共享缓存 blocks，可用于降低跨租户 prefix timing side-channel 风险。
textEn: 10.6 Security: cache sharing is also an isolation policy  SHARE More sharing Higher prefix hit rate · less Prefill · lower TTFT; useful when a trust group legitimately shares common prefixes. ISOLATE Stronger isolation Use cache namespaces or salts to restrict cross-user or cross-tenant reuse, trading some hit rate for privacy isolation.  vLLM CACHE SALT vLLM currently supports request-level cache_salt, mixing the salt into prefix-cache keys. Requests with different salts cannot share cached blocks, reducing cross-tenant prefix timing side-channel risk.

titleZh: 10 10.7 Serving Metrics：用 workload 证明收益
titleEn: 10 10.7 Serving metrics: prove value with workload evidence
textZh: 10.7 Serving Metrics：用 workload 证明收益  指标 回答什么问题 prefix-cache hit rate 有多少请求真正复用了公共前缀？ cached-prefix tokens / request 每次命中到底省掉多少 Prefill？ TTFT P50 / P95 / P99 首 token 延迟是否真的改善？ prefill / request throughput 释放的计算是否转化成吞吐？ KV utilization / eviction 缓存收益是否被显存压力与淘汰抵消？ cost per successful task Serving 优化最终是否改善业务单位成本？
textEn: 10.7 Serving metrics: prove value with workload evidence  Metric Question answered prefix-cache hit rate How many requests actually reused a common prefix? cached-prefix tokens / request How much Prefill does each hit avoid? TTFT P50 / P95 / P99 Did first-token latency actually improve? prefill / request throughput Did saved computation translate into throughput? KV utilization / eviction Are cache benefits offset by memory pressure and eviction? cost per successful task Did serving optimization improve business unit economics?

titleZh: 10 10.8 面试回答
titleEn: 10 10.8 Interview answer
textZh: 10.8 面试回答  回答结构 多个 Agent 能否复用 KV Cache，要看它们是否由支持 Prefix Caching 的 serving engine 承载，以及请求是否拥有兼容且完全一致的 token prefix。没有跨请求 Prefix Cache 时会重复 Prefill；使用 SGLang Radix-style cache 或 vLLM APC 后，后续请求可以复用已计算的共享前缀 KV blocks，只计算分叉后的 suffix。这里共享的是 immutable prefix computation，不是可变会话状态。它主要优化 Prefill / TTFT，不直接减少 Decode；Semantic Cache 则是另一层的 response reuse。生产上还必须考虑 Prompt 对齐、cache eviction 和 multi-tenant isolation / cache salt。  SOURCE BOUNDARY 本章由用户提供的多 Agent KV Cache 视频总结出发，并用 vLLM、SGLang、Hugging Face 与 Redis 官方资料校正：不把“默认不能共享”当通则；区分 Prefix Cache 与 Semantic Cache；补充 token-level identity、Prefill/Decode 边界和多租户安全。
textEn: 10.8 Interview answer  Answer structure Whether multiple Agents can reuse KV cache depends on whether they are served by an engine with prefix caching and whether their requests share a compatible identical token prefix. Without cross-request prefix caching, Prefill is repeated; with mechanisms such as SGLang's radix-style cache or vLLM APC, later requests can reuse cached KV blocks for the shared prefix and compute only the divergent suffix. What is shared is immutable prefix computation, not mutable session state. This primarily optimizes Prefill and TTFT, not Decode; semantic caching is a separate response-reuse layer. Production systems must also consider prompt alignment, cache eviction, and multi-tenant isolation or cache salts.  SOURCE BOUNDARY This chapter starts from the user-provided multi-Agent KV-cache video summary and is corrected against official vLLM, SGLang, Hugging Face, and Redis material: it avoids treating 'no sharing by default' as a universal rule, separates prefix caching from semantic caching, and adds token-level identity, Prefill/Decode boundaries, and multi-tenant security.

titleZh: 10 Agent Sandbox：把执行能力限制在可证明的 Blast Radius 内 §10.S
titleEn: 10 Agent Sandbox: constrain execution to a provable blast radius
textZh: Agent Sandbox：把执行能力限制在可证明的 Blast Radius 内 §10.S  Sandbox 不是 VM 的同义词，而是受控执行边界。真正需要同时约束 filesystem、network、process/syscall、resource、credential、lifecycle 与 audit；模型只负责提出动作，Host/Sandbox Policy 才拥有真实执行权。  FIG.10.S1 · SANDBOX CONTROL PLANE Approval 控制意图，Sandbox 限制能力 把 Agent proposal、权限决策、运行时隔离、执行证据与验证串成一条可审计链。 01 Agent Proposal run command · install package · write file · connect endpoint；模型表达意图，但没有直接宿主权限。 02 Permission / Risk Gate 根据 action、scope、tenant、risk、approval 与 policy 决定是否允许进入执行层。 03 Sandbox Scheduler 选择 image / template、writable roots、network policy、CPU / memory / disk / PID / timeout 与 secret strategy。 04 Isolated Runtime OS sandbox / container / gVisor-like / microVM / constrained runtime 在技术层强制 filesystem、process 与 egress 边界。 05 Evidence + Validation command、exit code、file diff、network、resource、policy decision 与 artifact validation 回写 Trace；失败可 kill / reset / rollback。 核心原则 The model proposes an action; the sandbox enforces the physical capability boundary.  FIG.10.S2 · ISOLATION PATTERN MATRIX 不要做“process < container < microVM”的单轴排行榜 Pattern 共享 Host Kernel？ 兼容性 启动倾向 典型场景 OS Sandbox Yes 很高 极快 Local Coding Agent Container Yes 很高 快 通用云端执行 gVisor-like 减少直接 Host Kernel 暴露 高 fast–medium 多租户容器 workload MicroVM No 高 fast–medium 高风险不可信代码 / 多租户 Agent WASM / Isolate 由 Runtime 定义 有限–中等 极快 受限计算 / 插件 选型变量 真实安全性还取决于 mounts、credentials、egress、host services、kernel/hypervisor patching、escape hatch、image provenance 与 runtime configuration。隔离技术名词本身不能替代 threat model。  FIG.10.S3 · VERIFIED IMPLEMENTATION SNAPSHOT 把产品事实和通用架构分开 Implementation 已验证边界 不要误写成 Claude Code Local macOS Seatbelt · Linux bubblewrap · filesystem + network policy 统一 VM / container 架构 Codex Cloud / Local Cloud 使用隔离容器；Local macOS 使用 Seatbelt，当前 Linux 使用 bubblewrap + seccomp（历史版本曾用 Landlock） container + microVM E2B Firecracker microVM · snapshot resume · COW rootfs 普通 Docker 容器 CubeSandbox RustVMM + KVM · dedicated guest kernel · E2B SDK compatible 所有环境恒定 <60ms / <5MB Firecracker microVM VMM building block；指定测试条件下 ≤125ms / ≤5MiB 完整 Agent Sandbox 平台 Bubblewrap mount/user/PID/network namespaces · optional seccomp 单独就等于完整安全策略 Sandock Docker-based isolated containers · resource limits · persistent volumes dedicated guest-kernel microVM Secret Rule The safest secret in a sandbox is the secret that never enters it. Benchmark Rule 启动时间与内存数字必须带 workload、hardware、snapshot/template、guest size 与 concurrency 条件；不要把 vendor benchmark 当成跨产品恒定事实。
textEn: Agent Sandbox: constrain execution to a provable blast radius §10.S  A sandbox is not synonymous with a VM; it is a controlled execution boundary. A production design constrains filesystem, network, process/syscalls, resources, credentials, lifecycle, and audit. The model proposes actions; the host and sandbox policy hold actual execution authority.  FIG.10.S1 · SANDBOX CONTROL PLANE Approval controls intent; sandboxing constrains capability Connect agent proposals, permission decisions, runtime isolation, execution evidence, and validation into one auditable chain. 01 Agent Proposal run command · install package · write file · connect endpoint; the model expresses intent but does not directly hold host authority. 02 Permission / Risk Gate Use action, scope, tenant, risk, approval, and policy to decide whether execution is allowed. 03 Sandbox Scheduler Select image/template, writable roots, network policy, CPU/memory/disk/PID/time limits, and secret strategy. 04 Isolated Runtime An OS sandbox, container, gVisor-like runtime, microVM, or constrained runtime enforces filesystem, process, and egress boundaries. 05 Evidence + Validation Commands, exit codes, file diffs, network activity, resource use, policy decisions, and artifact validation return to the trace; failures can be killed, reset, or rolled back. Core rule The model proposes an action; the sandbox enforces the physical capability boundary.  FIG.10.S2 · ISOLATION PATTERN MATRIX Avoid a one-dimensional “process < container < microVM” ranking Pattern Shares host kernel? Compatibility Startup tendency Typical fit OS Sandbox Yes Very high Very fast Local Coding Agent Container Yes Very high Fast General cloud execution gVisor-like Reduces direct host-kernel exposure High fast–medium Multi-tenant container workloads MicroVM No High fast–medium High-risk untrusted code / multi-tenant agents WASM / Isolate Runtime-defined Limited–medium Very fast Constrained compute / plugins Selection variables Real security still depends on mounts, credentials, egress, host services, kernel/hypervisor patching, escape hatches, image provenance, and runtime configuration. The isolation technology name does not replace a threat model.  FIG.10.S3 · VERIFIED IMPLEMENTATION SNAPSHOT Keep product facts separate from general architecture Implementation Verified boundary Do not overstate as Claude Code Local macOS Seatbelt · Linux bubblewrap · filesystem + network policy One universal VM/container architecture Codex Cloud / Local Cloud uses isolated containers; local macOS uses Seatbelt, while current Linux uses bubblewrap + seccomp (historical releases used Landlock) container + microVM E2B Firecracker microVM · snapshot resume · COW rootfs A plain Docker container CubeSandbox RustVMM + KVM · dedicated guest kernel · E2B SDK compatible Universally <60ms / <5MB in every environment Firecracker microVM VMM building block; ≤125ms / ≤5MiB under specified test conditions A complete agent-sandbox platform Bubblewrap mount/user/PID/network namespaces · optional seccomp A complete security policy by itself Sandock Docker-based isolated containers · resource limits · persistent volumes A dedicated guest-kernel microVM Secret rule The safest secret in a sandbox is the secret that never enters it. Benchmark rule Startup and memory numbers require workload, hardware, snapshot/template, guest-size, and concurrency context. Vendor benchmarks are not universal cross-product constants.

titleZh: 10 Production Multi-Tenant Agent：把 Tenant Isolation 做成控制面 §10.T
titleEn: 10 Production Multi-Tenant Agents: make tenant isolation a control plane
textZh: Production Multi-Tenant Agent：把 Tenant Isolation 做成控制面 §10.T  真正的多租户边界不是用 Prompt 告诉模型不要看别人数据，而是：即使模型、Router 或 Tool Arguments 出错，Tenant A 的执行仍然无法读取、修改、调用或推断 Tenant B 的受保护资源。  FIG.10.T1 · TENANT ISOLATION CONTROL PLANE Tenant Context 必须从身份层贯穿到每一个资源访问点 tenant_id 是可信安全上下文，不是允许模型自由改写的 Agent State。 01 · IDENTITY User / Service → Trusted Tenant Context Identity Provider 解析 user / service identity，并绑定 tenant_id、role、entitlement。Prompt 和 LLM output 不能覆盖这个上下文。 02 · POLICY Principal + Tenant + Action + Resource Authentication 只回答是谁；Authorization 判断动作；Tenant Isolation 继续限制这个执行永远只能触达哪个资源宇宙。 03 · RUNTIME State · Memory · RAG · Tools · Cache · Jobs 每个共享面都必须 tenant-scoped：Checkpoint、Retriever、MCP credential、Queue envelope、Cache namespace、Sandbox 与 Trace 都不能丢失租户上下文。 04 · RESOURCE Storage Policy · Credential Broker · Namespace · RLS 最终资源层继续 fail closed：数据库、对象存储、Vector Store 和外部 SaaS 通过 policy、namespace、RLS 或 tenant-scoped credential 做第二道边界。 05 · VERIFY Audit · Negative Tests · Quotas · Fairness 上线验证不只测自己能访问自己，还要主动猜别人的 thread/document、篡改 tenant context、碰撞 cache、重放 checkpoint，并做 per-tenant noisy-neighbor load test。 核心原则 The agent may be wrong; the infrastructure must still make cross-tenant access fail closed.  FIG.10.T2 · ISOLATION SURFACE MATRIX 多租户事故通常发生在主数据之外的共享面 共享面 危险默认 生产控制 State / Checkpoint thread_id only tenant + user/project + thread + authorization Memory / RAG 全局候选后让模型忽略 检索前注入 tenant namespace / ACL SQL / Storage 只靠开发者记得 WHERE app authz + RLS / storage policy Tool / MCP 共享 raw credential host-side tenant-scoped credential broker Semantic / Prefix Cache hash(query) / implicit cross-tenant reuse tenant/permission namespace · cache salt where required Queue / Worker job_id only trusted tenant-aware job envelope + re-authorization Trace / Logs 全局可搜索 Prompt / Tool Output tenant-aware query policy · redaction · audit Compute / Quota 只有全局限流 per-tenant concurrency · token/tool/cost budgets · fair queueing  FIG.10.T3 · DEPLOYMENT SPECTRUM Pooled / Bridge / Silo 是逐资源的选择，不是整个系统一个开关 POOLED Shared Runtime + Logical Isolation 高利用率、低成本；要求强 tenant policy、严格 credential boundary 和持续 cross-tenant test。 BRIDGE Shared Control Plane + Selective Isolation 默认 pooled；按 tenant、risk、tier 或 compliance 给特定 storage / compute / sandbox 独立资源。 SILO Dedicated Resource Boundary 更小 cross-tenant blast radius，但增加成本、容量碎片与 fleet lifecycle 复杂度。 不要漏掉性能隔离 Tenant Isolation 不只防数据越界。共享 LLM、Queue、Tool API、Cache 和 Sandbox 还需要 per-tenant / tier concurrency、token、tool、storage 与 cost budget，避免 noisy neighbor。  外部核验日期：2026-09-23。实现例包括 AWS multi-tenant agentic AI guidance、PostgreSQL Row-Level Security、Pinecone namespaces 与 vLLM prefix-cache salting；这些是具体实现证据，Handbook 的核心规则仍然是 vendor-neutral 的 tenant-isolation control plane。
textEn: Production Multi-Tenant Agents: make tenant isolation a control plane §10.T  A real multi-tenant boundary is not a prompt telling the model to avoid other customers' data. Even when the model, router, or tool arguments are wrong, an execution for Tenant A must still be unable to read, mutate, invoke, or infer Tenant B's protected resources.  FIG.10.T1 · TENANT ISOLATION CONTROL PLANE Tenant context must flow from identity to every resource access point tenant_id is trusted security context, not agent state that the model is allowed to rewrite. 01 · IDENTITY User / Service → Trusted Tenant Context The identity provider resolves user or service identity and binds tenant_id, roles, and entitlements. Prompts and model output cannot override this context. 02 · POLICY Principal + Tenant + Action + Resource Authentication answers who the caller is; authorization evaluates the action; tenant isolation further constrains which resource universe the execution can ever touch. 03 · RUNTIME State · Memory · RAG · Tools · Cache · Jobs Every shared surface must be tenant-scoped: checkpoints, retrievers, MCP credentials, queue envelopes, cache namespaces, sandboxes, and traces must not lose tenant context. 04 · RESOURCE Storage Policy · Credential Broker · Namespace · RLS The resource layer continues to fail closed: databases, object stores, vector stores, and external SaaS use policy, namespaces, RLS, or tenant-scoped credentials as a second boundary. 05 · VERIFY Audit · Negative Tests · Quotas · Fairness Release verification must test more than valid self-access: actively guess another tenant's thread or document, tamper with tenant context, collide caches, replay checkpoints, and run per-tenant noisy-neighbor load tests. Core rule The agent may be wrong; the infrastructure must still make cross-tenant access fail closed.  FIG.10.T2 · ISOLATION SURFACE MATRIX Multi-tenant incidents often occur on shared surfaces beyond the primary database Shared surface Unsafe default Production control State / Checkpoint thread_id only tenant + user/project + thread + authorization Memory / RAG Retrieve globally, then ask the model to ignore Inject tenant namespace / ACL before retrieval SQL / Storage Rely only on developers remembering WHERE app authz + RLS / storage policy Tool / MCP Shared raw credential host-side tenant-scoped credential broker Semantic / Prefix Cache hash(query) / implicit cross-tenant reuse tenant/permission namespace · cache salt where required Queue / Worker job_id only trusted tenant-aware job envelope + re-authorization Trace / Logs Globally searchable prompts and tool outputs tenant-aware query policy · redaction · audit Compute / Quota Global throttling only per-tenant concurrency · token/tool/cost budgets · fair queueing  FIG.10.T3 · DEPLOYMENT SPECTRUM Pooled, bridge, and silo are per-resource choices, not one global system switch POOLED Shared Runtime + Logical Isolation High utilization and lower cost, but requires strong tenant policies, strict credential boundaries, and continuous cross-tenant testing. BRIDGE Shared Control Plane + Selective Isolation Pool by default, but dedicate selected storage, compute, or sandboxes based on tenant, risk, tier, or compliance. SILO Dedicated Resource Boundary Reduces cross-tenant blast radius but increases cost, capacity fragmentation, and fleet lifecycle complexity. Do not forget performance isolation Tenant isolation is not only about data boundaries. Shared LLMs, queues, tool APIs, caches, and sandboxes also need per-tenant or tier concurrency, token, tool, storage, and cost budgets to prevent noisy neighbors.  External verification date: 2026-09-23. Implementation examples include AWS multi-tenant agentic AI guidance, PostgreSQL Row-Level Security, Pinecone namespaces, and vLLM prefix-cache salting. These are implementation evidence; the handbook's core rule remains a vendor-neutral tenant-isolation control plane.

titleZh: 10 Agent Runtime Control Plane：环境上下文 + Identity / Policy §10.R
titleEn: 10 Agent Runtime Control Plane: project runtime context + identity/policy
textZh: Agent Runtime Control Plane：环境上下文 + Identity / Policy §10.R  代码仓库只是显式输入。真正可交付的 Coding Agent 还需要可复现的项目运行上下文，以及独立于模型的身份、授权和凭据控制链。  FIG.10.R1 · PROJECT RUNTIME CONTEXT Repository 之外，还有一整层“让项目真正跑起来”的隐式上下文 TOOLCHAIN runtime · build tools · plugins versioned image / setup CONFIG / DATA env schema · DB baseline · migrations safe defaults · fixtures · seed data DEPENDENCIES services · mocks · network policy allow / deny · upstream / test double FEEDBACK logs · health · exit status structured evidence for repair VERIFICATION test · lint · integration · artifact reproducible completion evidence SANDBOX isolation · lifecycle · resource limits Sandbox 是边界；Runtime Context 是项目语义。 核心原则 Execution environment is part of the task input.  FIG.10.R2 · IDENTITY / POLICY MAIN PATH 模型提出意图，PEP / PDP / Credential Broker 决定真实执行权 IDENTITY user + stable agent + runtime + task delegation 谁在行动、代表谁、为什么行动。 PEP resolve actual resource + requested action 靠近执行点，不直接相信模型提供的 resource id。 PDP policy decision identity ∩ capability ∩ platform ∩ delegation ∩ runtime CREDENTIAL BROKER short-lived · scoped · target-bound 长期凭据留在可信控制面，不进入 Agent Context。 RESOURCE execute + audit + revoke / expire tool · API · DB · deployment · MCP server 最终原则 The model proposes intent; the enforcement point resolves and authorizes the real resource.
textEn: Agent Runtime Control Plane: project runtime context + identity/policy §10.R  A repository is only the explicit input. Deliverable coding-agent work also requires reproducible project runtime context plus identity, authorization, and credential controls outside the model.  FIG.10.R1 · PROJECT RUNTIME CONTEXT Beyond the repository lies an entire implicit layer required to make the project actually run TOOLCHAIN runtime · build tools · plugins versioned image / setup CONFIG / DATA env schema · DB baseline · migrations safe defaults · fixtures · seed data DEPENDENCIES services · mocks · network policy allow / deny · upstream / test double FEEDBACK logs · health · exit status structured evidence for repair VERIFICATION test · lint · integration · artifact reproducible completion evidence SANDBOX isolation · lifecycle · resource limits Sandbox is the boundary; runtime context is project semantics. Core rule Execution environment is part of the task input.  FIG.10.R2 · IDENTITY / POLICY MAIN PATH The model proposes intent; PEP, PDP, and the credential broker determine real execution authority IDENTITY user + stable agent + runtime + task delegation Who acts, on whose behalf, and why. PEP resolve actual resource + requested action Enforce near execution; do not blindly trust model-provided resource identifiers. PDP policy decision identity ∩ capability ∩ platform ∩ delegation ∩ runtime CREDENTIAL BROKER short-lived · scoped · target-bound Long-lived credentials stay in the trusted control plane, not agent context. RESOURCE execute + audit + revoke / expire tool · API · DB · deployment · MCP server Final rule The model proposes intent; the enforcement point resolves and authorizes the real resource.

titleZh: 10 FDE Production：Idempotency 与 Retry Storm §10.FDE
titleEn: 10 FDE production: idempotency and retry amplification
textZh:
FDE Production：Idempotency 与 Retry Storm §10.FDE 两个面试常见生产事故：Tool 超时并不证明操作失败；多层重试可能把故障放大成系统雪崩。 SOURCE BOUNDARY 以下是根据 FDE 网站公开考点独立撰写的问题与答案，不是付费题目的官方答案。产品细节以链接的官方文档为准；设计建议属于 Handbook 综合判断。 Q8 · Agent 创建发票超时，能不能直接重试？  不能假设第一次没执行。由可信 Host 为同一业务操作分配稳定幂等键，先确认下游支持幂等，再用同一键/参数重试，或查询操作状态和人工核对。  Agent request → trusted host + operation ID
  → authorize → durable intent → tool call
  → timeout: outcome UNKNOWN
  → query status / retry SAME operation key
  → reconcile → one business effect  Stripe 文档的首个结果复用（包括 500）、参数一致性检查和至少 24 小时后的 key 清理是该服务自身的行为，不可推广到所有 CRM / Payment API。  Q9 · 为什么用了 Exponential Backoff 仍然造成雪崩？  失败请求仍消耗服务容量。三个独立调用层各自最多三次尝试，理论最大尝试放大到 27 次；这是示意计算而非实测。若客户端同时按固定间隔重试，就会形成同步洪峰。  控制 生产作用 Retry budget 限制尝试数和总耗时 Jitter 打散同步重试洪峰 Circuit breaker 阻止持续向故障依赖发请求 Backpressure / shedding 限制无界队列并显式拒绝过载  核心判断 优先让一个层级拥有 Retry 决策，选择可安全重复的操作，配合 deadline、随机抖动与降级，而不是靠多层无限补救。  官方核验来源 : AWS retry guidance · AWS Builders' Library · Stripe idempotency
textEn:
FDE production: idempotency and retry amplification §10.FDE Two production failure classes: a timeout does not prove a side effect failed, and layered retries can amplify an outage. SOURCE BOUNDARY These independently authored questions and answers derive from public FDE topics, not from any private paid answer. Platform facts follow first-party references; design advice is handbook synthesis. Q8 · An invoice tool times out: can the Agent simply retry?  Never assume the first write failed. The trusted host assigns a stable operation key. Retry only with a documented idempotent contract and unchanged parameters, or reconcile status / escalate.  Agent request → trusted host + operation ID
  → authorize → durable intent → tool call
  → timeout: outcome UNKNOWN
  → query status / retry SAME operation key
  → reconcile → one business effect  Stripe's first-result reuse (including 500 responses), parameter comparison and key pruning after at least 24 hours are product-specific, not a generic CRM/payment contract.  Q9 · Why can exponential backoff still create an outage?  Retries still consume capacity. Three independent layers with three attempts each can amplify one request to 27 downstream attempts—an illustrative upper bound. Identical backoff schedules can synchronize bursts.  Control Production purpose Retry budget Bound attempts and elapsed time Jitter Desynchronize retry waves Circuit breaker Stop calls to repeatedly failing dependencies Backpressure / shedding Prevent unbounded queues; reject overloaded traffic  Engineering rule Prefer one retry-owning layer for safely repeatable operations, with deadlines, jitter and graceful degradation, not unbounded layered retries.  Verified first-party sources : AWS retry guidance · AWS Builders' Library · Stripe idempotency

titleZh: 10 FDE System Design：部署、可靠性、Ontology 与任务成本
titleEn: 10 FDE system design: deployment, resilience, ontology and task economics
textZh:
FDE System Design：部署、可靠性、Ontology 与任务成本 INDEPENDENT FDE RESEARCH 题目由公开 FDE 考点独立扩展，不是会员标准答案。示例阈值和架构是教学设计；供应商事实以链接的官方文档为准。 同一个客户要求“我们的数据必须留在 VPC”，可能涉及五件完全不同的事：网络传输、数据驻留、计算归属、模型处理位置、远程运维。要分别画边界。  FIG.10.FDE · DEPLOYMENT DECISION 从信任边界选择部署模型 01 DATA INVENTORY Prompt / 文档 / 向量 / 追踪 / 备份 02 TRUST & NETWORK 身份 / 密钥 / Egress / VPC DNS 03 DELIVERY MODEL SaaS / Private Link / BYOC / On-prem  Q10 · Private Link、BYOC、On-prem 有什么本质区别？  模式 主要约束 容易误判 SaaS 厂商运营计算及数据平面 隔离不等于专属物理环境 Private Link 部分网络链路使用私网地址 不等于服务搬到客户 VPC BYOC / VPC 指定组件运行在客户云账号 运维/遥测出口仍需审查 Air-gap 无实时外部连接（按合同定义） 云模型 API 不可直接假设可用  工程边界 部署选择的首要证据是一份完整的数据流和 Egress 表，而不是一句“我们支持 Private Link”。  Q11 · 有 Retry 了为什么还要 Circuit Breaker？  重试仍消耗下游资源；Breaker 在依赖持续失败时拒绝新尝试，配合并发上限和有界队列。退避必须有总 deadline、次数预算和 jitter；故障写入先确认幂等。  trusted host → operation safety classification
→ retry budget / deadline → concurrency admission
→ downstream call ├ success
                 ├ transient → bounded jitter retry
                 ├ repeated fault → circuit OPEN / degrade
                 └ unknown write → reconcile  Q12 · 支付 Tool 超时是否表示首次操作没成功？  不。超时只表示调用方不知道提交结果。必须用持久化业务 operation ID、批准权限、下游可验证的幂等契约；结果未知时查询状态或对账，不能盲目生成新 key。  Q13 · Ontology、Knowledge Graph、GraphRAG 是一回事吗？  对象 负责什么 Ontology / Semantic layer 实体、动作、业务规则、单位与指标定义 Knowledge Graph 显式关系与事实存储/遍历 GraphRAG 利用关系进行证据检索与上下文构造 Databricks Metric View 集中维护可查询的 Fields 和 Measures  例如“迟到交付率”的分子、分母和时区必须由业务确认。Metric View 可复用指标，却不会自动定义订单动作权限或完整 Ontology。  Q14 · SLI、SLO、Error Budget 怎么用于 AI Agent？  SLI = authorized, grounded, reviewed results within 8s
      / all eligible investigation requests
SLO = 99.0% over 28 days (hypothetical target)
Example: 10,000 eligible tasks → budget 100 misses
Security leaks: critical blocker, never normalized into budget  明确哪些算 eligible，拒判和超时怎么计数，并把 p95、源数据时效性、越权事件分别作为独立 SLI；上述数字不是产品默认值。  Q15 · 为什么 Cost per Successful Task 比 Token 单价重要？  cost / approved success = (model + retrieval + tools + infra
                      + retries + included human review)
                       / human-approved correct tasks  便宜模型如果带来更多重试和人工修复，整体成功任务成本可能更高。按同一用户群和错误风险分层比较，不把越权或错误解释当作成功。  Q16 · Walking Skeleton 到底证明了什么？  证明一条最小真实路径能够跨过 SSO、数据授权、部署、Trace 和验收关口。它不证明吞吐、稳定性或企业安全认证；模拟身份的本地 Notebook 也不等于部署成功。  一手来源 : Azure private PaaS · AWS Builders Library · Databricks metric view · Google SRE
textEn:
FDE system design: deployment, resilience, ontology and task economics INDEPENDENT FDE RESEARCH Questions are independently written from public FDE topics, not paid-site answers. Example thresholds and architecture are teaching choices; provider facts refer to the linked primary docs. The customer's 'data must stay in our VPC' could mean five different controls: network transport, residency, compute ownership, model processing, and remote operations. Map each boundary separately.  FIG.10.FDE · DEPLOYMENT DECISION Select deployment from trust boundaries 01 DATA INVENTORY Prompt / docs / embeddings / traces / backups 02 TRUST & NETWORK Identity / keys / egress / VPC DNS 03 DELIVERY MODEL SaaS / Private Link / BYOC / on-prem  Q10 · How are Private Link, BYOC and on-prem different?  Mode Boundary Trap SaaS Vendor-operated compute and data plane Logical isolation is not dedicated hardware Private Link Private path for selected links Does not move service compute into customer VPC BYOC / VPC Specified components run in customer cloud account Remote operations and telemetry still need review Air-gap No live external connectivity (by contract) Hosted model API cannot be assumed  Engineering boundary Start with complete data-flow and egress inventory, not a statement that Private Link is supported.  Q11 · Why use a circuit breaker if retries already exist?  Retries consume downstream resources. A breaker stops repeated calls to a failing dependency, combined with concurrency admission and bounded queues. Use total deadlines, attempt budgets and jitter; verify write idempotency.  trusted host → operation safety classification
→ retry budget / deadline → concurrency admission
→ downstream call ├ success
                 ├ transient → bounded jitter retry
                 ├ repeated fault → circuit OPEN / degrade
                 └ unknown write → reconcile  Q12 · Does a payment tool timeout mean the first write failed?  No. A timeout only means the caller does not know the commit outcome. Use persistent operation IDs, approved permissions and an explicit idempotency contract. Reconcile unknown outcomes rather than creating new keys.  Q13 · Are ontology, knowledge graph and GraphRAG interchangeable?  Layer Owns Ontology / Semantic layer Entities, actions, semantics, units, metric contracts Knowledge Graph Stored relationships and graph facts/traversal GraphRAG Relation-aware retrieval and context construction Databricks Metric View Centrally defined queryable fields and measures  A business owner must approve the numerator, denominator and time zone for 'late-shipment rate'. Metric views reuse measures but do not define the full action ontology or authorization model.  Q14 · How do SLI, SLO and error budget apply to an AI agent?  SLI = authorized, grounded, reviewed results within 8s
      / all eligible investigation requests
SLO = 99.0% over 28 days (hypothetical target)
Example: 10,000 eligible tasks → budget 100 misses
Security leaks: critical blocker, never normalized into budget  Define eligible requests and how refusals/timeouts count. Track p95, source freshness and authorization incidents separately. These numbers are illustrative, not platform defaults.  Q15 · Why is cost per successful task better than token unit price?  cost / approved success = (model + retrieval + tools + infra
                      + retries + included human review)
                       / human-approved correct tasks  A cheaper model may increase retries and review, raising real task cost. Compare matched cohorts and risk slices; unauthorized or incorrect answers are never successful tasks.  Q16 · What does a walking skeleton actually prove?  It proves one minimal real route can cross identity, data permissions, deployment, tracing and acceptance. It does not prove scale or security certification; a locally mocked identity is not a deployment.  Primary references : Azure private PaaS · AWS Builders Library · Databricks metric view · Google SRE

titleZh: 10 Production 系统设计：身份、限流、注册、Serving 和合规
titleEn: 10 Production architecture: identity, quotas, models, inference and governance
textZh: Production 系统设计：身份、限流、注册、Serving 和合规 将分布式训练与推理 Serving、授权与认证、模型注册与真正发布，以及监管标准与安全报告明确分开。 FDE VERIFIED BOUNDARY · OCT 2026 根据公开考点独立撰写，不是会员答案。真实平台事实有链接来源；案例与门禁是设计建议，不代表实际客户测试。 Q48 · Rate Limiting / REST APIs 可信 Tenant 身份驱动 Token Bucket 与并发预算。REST 写接口使用稳定操作 ID，429/503 不能触发无限重试。 失败/验收： A 租户耗尽配额不能阻止 B 租户使用独立配额。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ Q49 · Consistency / CAP 不同状态需要不同保证：权限和最终写入须可核验；CDC/索引可以在声明范围内延迟但必须暴露新鲜度。CAP 是分区故障下的取舍。 失败/验收： 付款已提交却丢失响应：不能盲目发起第二次付款。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ Q50 · Model Versioning / Registry Promotion UC Model Registry 的 Champion alias 指向版本，不保证在线端点已切换。需要端点配置校验、Golden Eval、Canary 和回滚。 失败/验收： Tag 看似 Production，但端点仍在服务旧版本。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ Q51 · Enterprise Model Selection 比较安全边界、业务正确率、证据忠实、端到端 p95、成本/成功任务；规则、SQL、小模型与强 LLM 都有合理位置。 失败/验收： 只比较 Token 价格忽略重试、人审和数据驻留。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ Q52 · Quantization / PagedAttention / MoE 量化改变数值精度；PagedAttention 改 KV 分块；MoE 只激活部分专家。三者作用不同，必须按具体 GPU/框架基准测试。 失败/验收： 比较 VRAM、TTFT、p95、输出质量，不把总参数量当单次计算量。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ Q53 · Speculative Decoding Draft 小模型候选必须经 Target 验证；正确的无损接受算法保留目标分布，但不保证每次随机输出字面相同。 失败/验收： 拒绝率高可能反而变慢；观察吞吐与并发条件。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ Q54 · AI Governance / SOC2 / EU AI Act SOC 2 是限定系统/期间的审计报告，不能代替 AI Act 的用例/角色/风险分类。法规日期需参考修订后官方资料。 失败/验收： 客户声称“有 SOC2 所以所有 AI 自动合法”：需要完整责任矩阵与证据。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ Q55 · Enterprise SSO SAML / OIDC 验证 OIDC iss、aud、签名、exp；身份认证不授予订单行级权限。SAML 与 OIDC 的协议形态不同，最终都必须映射可信租户策略。 失败/验收： 错误 Audience、撤权后会话、模型自带 tenant_id 均应拒绝。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ Q63 · Distributed Training FSDP PyTorch FSDP2 分片权重/梯度/优化器状态，通信成本与模型大小有关。分布式训练不等于推理显存优化。 失败/验收： 检查 All-Gather、Checkpoint、world size 和 OOM，而不是只看吞吐。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ Q64 · Palantir Foundry / AIP / Apollo / Gotham 官方三大集成平台为 Foundry 数据/Ontology、AIP Agent/AI、Apollo 交付；Gotham 属领域化应用，不能混作同一层。 失败/验收： 不要把 GraphRAG 当 Ontology，也不要假设 Databricks 组件与 Palantir API 兼容。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ 不能把术语命中当掌握 审计表中的 H 只表示此考点能在所属章节定位。还需逐项检查机制、反例、实现、指标与一手证据。
textEn: Production architecture: identity, quotas, models, inference and governance Separate distributed training from inference, authentication from authorization, registry aliases from endpoint release and legal duties from assurance reports. FDE VERIFIED BOUNDARY · OCT 2026 Independently written from public topic names, not membership answers. Provider facts link to first-party references; examples and gates are engineering proposals, not customer tests. Q48 · Rate Limiting / REST APIs Trusted tenant scopes per-route token/concurrency budgets. Stable operation IDs protect writes; 429/503 must not amplify retries. Failure / acceptance: Tenant A exhausting quota must not starve tenant B. Source / boundary ↗ Q49 · Consistency / CAP Different state needs different contracts: authorization/writes require current checks; CDC/index may lag with explicit freshness. CAP trade-offs apply under partitions. Failure / acceptance: When receipt is lost after commit, reconcile rather than reissue. Source / boundary ↗ Q50 · Model Versioning / Registry Promotion UC Model Registry Champion alias references a version but does not automatically prove which version an endpoint serves. Verify endpoint, eval, canary and rollback. Failure / acceptance: Alias updated while endpoint still serves prior version. Source / boundary ↗ Q51 · Enterprise Model Selection Compare trust boundary, grounded task success, p95 and cost per accepted outcome; rules, SQL, small models and large models all have roles. Failure / acceptance: Comparing only token prices misses review, retries and residency. Source / boundary ↗ Q52 · Quantization / PagedAttention / MoE Quantization changes numerical precision; PagedAttention manages KV blocks; MoE routes expert compute. Different mechanisms need device-specific tests. Failure / acceptance: Compare VRAM, TTFT, p95 and quality; total MoE params ≠ activated compute. Source / boundary ↗ Q53 · Speculative Decoding Target model verifies draft candidates; a correctly implemented lossless algorithm preserves the target distribution, not identical stochastic text. Failure / acceptance: Poor draft acceptance can slow decoding; measure under real batch/load. Source / boundary ↗ Q54 · AI Governance / SOC2 / EU AI Act SOC 2 report covers scoped criteria/period, not automatic AI Act compliance. Classification and amended applicability dates require official/legal review. Failure / acceptance: SOC2 ≠ universal compliance; require role/risk/evidence matrix. Source / boundary ↗ Q55 · Enterprise SSO SAML / OIDC Verify OIDC iss, aud, signature, exp. Authentication does not grant row access; both SAML and OIDC identities require trusted entitlements. Failure / acceptance: Reject wrong-aud tokens, stale revoked users and model-supplied tenant IDs. Source / boundary ↗ Q63 · Distributed Training FSDP PyTorch FSDP2 shards parameters, gradients and optimizer states with communication overhead. Training parallelism is not a general inference optimization. Failure / acceptance: Validate all-gather, restore, world size and OOM, not just throughput. Source / boundary ↗ Q64 · Palantir Foundry / AIP / Apollo / Gotham Palantir documents Foundry data/Ontology, AIP agents/AI and Apollo delivery as the integrated three-platform core; Gotham is domain-specific. Failure / acceptance: GraphRAG is not the Ontology; vendor API parity cannot be assumed. Source / boundary ↗ Terminology is not mastery H in the curriculum audit only means the topic is locatable. Mechanism, counterexample, implementation, metric and primary evidence still require review.

titleZh: 11 11.1 端到端数据路径：从源事件到可信 AI Context
titleEn: 11 11.1 End-to-end data path: source events to trusted AI context
textZh:
11.1 端到端数据路径：从源事件到可信 AI Context  FDE 不该只讨论 RAG 检索策略，还要确认：数据是谁提供的、更新有多快、何时可以查询、出了错是否能重放，以及租户权限在哪里执行。  Source DB / SaaS / events
    ↓ CDC / batch extract
Bronze · raw append + offsets
    ↓ schema / dedup / quarantine
Silver · verified, versioned entities
    ↓ contracts / temporal joins
Gold · governed customer views
    ├── SQL, BI and workflow queries
    ├── model features
    └── retrieval indexing → RAG  边界 必须明确的约束 常见失败 Capture 事件序列、offset、delete 漏更或重复 Normalize 唯一键、schema、时区 跨系统错配 Consume freshness、租户、可追溯 过期或越权读取  工程结论 实时 Agent + 错误的数据 = 快速出错。数据正确性、及时性与授权是不同的验证维度。
textEn:
11.1 End-to-end data path: source events to trusted AI context  An FDE must inspect the data plane behind RAG: source ownership, freshness, query readiness, replayability, and enforcement of tenant permissions.  Source DB / SaaS / events
    ↓ CDC / batch extract
Bronze · raw append + offsets
    ↓ schema / dedup / quarantine
Silver · verified, versioned entities
    ↓ contracts / temporal joins
Gold · governed customer views
    ├── SQL, BI and workflow queries
    ├── model features
    └── retrieval indexing → RAG  Boundary Explicit contract Failure Capture Sequence, offset, delete Missed or duplicate events Normalize Unique key, schema, time zone Cross-system mismatch Consume Freshness, tenancy, lineage Stale or unauthorized reads  Engineering rule A fast agent with incorrect data fails faster. Correctness, freshness, and authorization are independent test dimensions.

titleZh: 11 11.2 ETL / ELT / CDC：选最适合数据边界的路径
titleEn: 11 11.2 ETL / ELT / CDC: choose by data boundary
textZh: 11.2 ETL / ELT / CDC：选最适合数据边界的路径  机制 适用情况 要验证的问题 ETL 先清洗/限制敏感数据再入库 前置逻辑能否重放？ ELT 先安全留存原始数据，再在仓内转换 原始数据访问是否隔离？ CDC 增量变更与删除传播 初始快照、顺序、offset 与 tombstone  Batch 与 Streaming 取决于消费者对事件可见延迟的目标，而不是“实时”是否听起来更先进。
textEn: 11.2 ETL / ELT / CDC: choose by data boundary  Mechanism When useful Verify ETL Transform before governed load Can transforms be replayed? ELT Governed raw landing; warehouse transforms Is raw access isolated? CDC Row-level changes and deletes Snapshot, order, offset, tombstone  Batch versus streaming is driven by the consumer's visibility-lag objective, not by which architecture sounds more advanced.

titleZh: 11 11.3 Idempotency：允许消息重复，不允许业务结果重复
titleEn: 11 11.3 Idempotency: duplicated events must not duplicate effects
textZh:
11.3 Idempotency：允许消息重复，不允许业务结果重复  event(source, event_id, entity, version, operation)
 → durable raw log
 → validate + quarantine
 → dedup(source, event_id)
 → merge if version is newer
 → atomically commit sink and checkpoint  At-least-once delivery 不是异常，而是工程约束。必须明确谁生成稳定的幂等键、何时重试、如何处理 out-of-order 更新与删除，以及跨系统写入如何补偿。
textEn:
11.3 Idempotency: duplicated events must not duplicate effects  event(source, event_id, entity, version, operation)
 → durable raw log
 → validate + quarantine
 → dedup(source, event_id)
 → merge if version is newer
 → atomically commit sink and checkpoint  At-least-once delivery is an engineering constraint. Define who owns stable idempotency keys, retries, out-of-order updates, deletes, and cross-system reconciliation.

titleZh: 11 11.4 Lakehouse / Delta：Bronze、Silver、Gold 各自负责什么
titleEn: 11 11.4 Lakehouse / Delta: Bronze, Silver, Gold ownership
textZh: 11.4 Lakehouse / Delta：Bronze、Silver、Gold 各自负责什么  层 职责 不可误认为 Bronze 可重放原始数据、provenance 原始数据可信 Silver 校验、去重、更新、实体标准化 业务含义已经统一 Gold 业务契约与消费者视图 自动解决跨系统事务  Delta transaction log 提供表层面的快照和原子提交；它本身不能保证 HTTP、消息队列、其他数据库之间的 exactly-once 业务效果。
textEn: 11.4 Lakehouse / Delta: Bronze, Silver, Gold ownership  Layer Responsibility Not a guarantee of Bronze Replayable raw data and provenance Raw data is trustworthy Silver Validated, deduplicated, upserted entities Business meaning is agreed Gold Consumer contracts and business views Cross-system atomicity  A Delta transaction log gives table-level snapshot and atomic-commit behavior; it does not guarantee exactly-once business effects across HTTP, queues, and other databases.

titleZh: 11 11.5 SQL Window 与 SCD2：保留时序真实性
titleEn: 11 11.5 SQL windows and SCD2: preserve temporal truth
textZh:
11.5 SQL Window 与 SCD2：保留时序真实性  WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY tenant_id, entity_id
    ORDER BY source_version DESC, ingested_at DESC
  ) AS rn
  FROM normalized_events
)
SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1;  最新记录查询必须定义版本比较、并列消解、删除语义。SCD Type 2 使用 effective_from / effective_to 维护历史快照；point-in-time join 避免训练时偷看未来。
textEn:
11.5 SQL windows and SCD2: preserve temporal truth  WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY tenant_id, entity_id
    ORDER BY source_version DESC, ingested_at DESC
  ) AS rn
  FROM normalized_events
)
SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1;  Latest-record queries need version precedence, tie breaking and delete semantics. SCD Type 2 preserves effective-time intervals; point-in-time joins prevent training-time future leakage.

titleZh: 11 11.6 Spark / Streaming：先看执行计划与状态边界
titleEn: 11 11.6 Spark / streaming: inspect the plan and state boundaries
textZh: 11.6 Spark / Streaming：先看执行计划与状态边界  症状 排查入口 权衡 Join 很慢 Explain、shuffle bytes、skew Broadcast 对小表有效，过大会 OOM 任务尾部很长 Task skew、spill、文件数 分区数量不是越多越好 Streaming state 变大 Event-time、watermark、checkpoint 迟到数据策略与完整性权衡
textEn: 11.6 Spark / streaming: inspect the plan and state boundaries  Symptom Inspect Trade-off Slow join Explain, shuffle bytes, skew Broadcast small tables; oversized joins risk OOM Long-tail tasks Task skew, spill, file count More partitions are not always better Growing stream state Event-time, watermark, checkpoint Late-data policy versus completeness

titleZh: 11 11.7 Text-to-SQL：能执行 ≠ 有权限
titleEn: 11 11.7 Text-to-SQL: executable does not mean authorized
textZh:
11.7 Text-to-SQL：能执行 ≠ 有权限  User intent
 → approved semantic schema + identity
 → SQL candidate
 → parse / allowlisted operations
 → database RLS / scoped credentials
 → EXPLAIN / row and time budget
 → run / verify / return source freshness  LLM 生成一个 SELECT 不等于安全。权限应由数据库策略或可信服务执行；解析、只读角色、超时、成本预算及结果验证都是独立关卡。
textEn:
11.7 Text-to-SQL: executable does not mean authorized  User intent
 → approved semantic schema + identity
 → SQL candidate
 → parse / allowlisted operations
 → database RLS / scoped credentials
 → EXPLAIN / row and time budget
 → run / verify / return source freshness  An LLM-generated SELECT is not a safety guarantee. Enforce permissions in the database or a trusted service, with parsing, read-only roles, budgets and result verification as separate gates.

titleZh: 11 11.8 订单状态错乱：用可复现的证据交付
titleEn: 11 11.8 Order-status incidents: deliver reproducible evidence
textZh: 11.8 订单状态错乱：用可复现的证据交付  客户发现订单在快递交接前显示“已签收”。第一步不是微调 LLM，而是核对来源事件时间、序列、重复、删除和最终状态定义；再用 golden timeline 验证事实还原。  验收指标 意义 CDC lag p95 变更到可查询的延迟 Duplicate-effect rate 重复消息导致重复业务影响的比例 Reconciliation completeness 源系统与目标结果可核对 Policy-leak tests 跨租户请求无法取数  Source: FDE curriculum topics (not copied course text) ↗
textEn: 11.8 Order-status incidents: deliver reproducible evidence  If an order appears delivered before handoff, audit event times, sequences, duplicates, deletes and canonical state semantics before touching the LLM. Validate reconstructed timelines with labeled historical cases.  Acceptance indicator Meaning CDC lag p95 Delay from source change to query Duplicate-effect rate Rate of duplicated business effects Reconciliation completeness Source and target totals reconcile Policy-leak tests Cross-tenant reads are blocked  Source: FDE curriculum topics (not copied course text) ↗

titleZh: 11 Databricks Data & SQL：CDC、Spark、Streaming、权限与指标语义
titleEn: 11 Databricks data and SQL: CDC, Spark, streaming, governance and semantic metrics
textZh:
Databricks Data & SQL：CDC、Spark、Streaming、权限与指标语义 INDEPENDENT FDE RESEARCH 题目由公开 FDE 考点独立扩展，不是会员标准答案。示例阈值和架构是教学设计；供应商事实以链接的官方文档为准。 数据工程面试不是背几个 Spark API。要能解释：同一数据如何被重复消费、如何按业务次序还原、SQL 为什么结果错误、权限是否真正由存储层执行。  Q17 · AUTO CDC 和 MERGE 在乱序事件中怎么选？  Lakeflow 的 AUTO CDC 基于 SEQUENCE BY 排序，支持 Type 1/2 与 delete；通常优先用它处理满足约束的 CDC 流。自定义 MERGE 需要自己负责顺序、幂等、删除和历史。不能把两个独立来源的 version 任意互相比较。  CREATE OR REFRESH STREAMING TABLE order_status_history;
CREATE FLOW apply_order_cdc AS AUTO CDC INTO order_status_history
FROM stream(ops.silver.order_changes)
KEYS (tenant_id, order_id)
APPLY AS DELETE WHEN operation = 'DELETE'
SEQUENCE BY source_sequence
COLUMNS * EXCEPT (operation, source_sequence)
STORED AS SCD TYPE 2;  工程边界 这是有前提的 Lakeflow Pipeline 教学 SQL；需要合法源表、支持的 Runtime/Edition 和每个主键有效的排序键，不是本地 Spark SQL 命令。  Q18 · Delta CDF 能保证 30 天历史回放吗？  不能。CDF 要先启用，只包含启用后的变更且受到保留窗口限制。历史快照的切点、后续 source offset、归档策略和重放后的业务对账都需要定义。  Q19 · Spark Join 很慢，先看什么？  症状 诊断 长尾 Task 热点 Key / AQE Skew / Spill Shuffle 巨大 Join keys（含 Tenant）/ 广播可行性 结果行数膨胀 一对多 Join 误写、唯一键失效 小文件太多 扫描调度与 Compaction  orders = spark.table('ops.gold.orders')
customers = spark.table('ops.gold.customers')
joined = orders.join(customers, ['tenant_id','customer_id'], 'left')
joined.explain('formatted')  Q20 · Watermark 会自动删除所有旧数据吗？  不会。它表示对事件时间迟到数据的容忍界限，在特定 Stateful Operator 下帮助清理旧状态；不会替代 Checkpoint，也不保证所有迟到事件都被处理。阈值应根据真实延迟分布和损失风险制定。  Q21 · SQL 跑得快但结果错，怎么分析？  MAX(event_time) 只能求最大时间，不能保证得到正确订单状态。检查来源权限、Source Version、Tombstone、时间语义、SCD2 Point-in-Time Join 和 Join Cardinality。  Q22 · Unity Catalog Row Filters 是否已足够保证 Text-to-SQL 安全？  不够。还需要身份可信、对象级 GRANT、SQL 限制、行列权限、审计和结果限制。ABAC 可在更高层级集中应用受控标签规则，但有计算版本和冲突限制；不要假设用共享服务账号查询会自动使用最终用户身份。  Q23 · “迟交率”应该让 LLM 自动定义吗？  不能。业务负责人必须确认分子、分母、时区、取消订单处理和记录版本。用 Metric View/Semantic Contract 统一定义，再用 Golden SQL Case 对比，避免同一概念在 Dashboard 和 Agent 中计算不同。  一手来源 : Lakeflow AUTO CDC · Delta CDF · ABAC requirements · Metric views · Spark tuning
textEn:
Databricks data and SQL: CDC, Spark, streaming, governance and semantic metrics INDEPENDENT FDE RESEARCH Questions are independently written from public FDE topics, not paid-site answers. Example thresholds and architecture are teaching choices; provider facts refer to the linked primary docs. Data engineering interviews ask more than Spark APIs. Explain event replay, business ordering, SQL correctness and whether storage policies truly enforce user authorization.  Q17 · When do you choose AUTO CDC over MERGE for out-of-order changes?  Lakeflow AUTO CDC orders changes by SEQUENCE BY, with Type 1/2 and deletion logic. It is a fit when the source sequencing contract qualifies. Custom MERGE requires self-managed ordering, idempotency, deletes and history. Versions from independent sources are not automatically comparable.  CREATE OR REFRESH STREAMING TABLE order_status_history;
CREATE FLOW apply_order_cdc AS AUTO CDC INTO order_status_history
FROM stream(ops.silver.order_changes)
KEYS (tenant_id, order_id)
APPLY AS DELETE WHEN operation = 'DELETE'
SEQUENCE BY source_sequence
COLUMNS * EXCEPT (operation, source_sequence)
STORED AS SCD TYPE 2;  Engineering boundary This is conditional Lakeflow pipeline SQL. It requires valid source streams, supported runtime/edition and per-key sequence semantics; it is not standalone Spark SQL.  Q18 · Does Delta CDF guarantee a 30-day replay?  No. CDF is opt-in, captures subsequent changes only and follows retention. Specify consistent snapshot cutover, source offsets, archive policy and post-replay reconciliation.  Q19 · What should you inspect first when Spark joins are slow?  Symptom Diagnostic Straggler Hot keys / AQE skew / spill Huge shuffle Join keys incl. tenant / broadcast feasibility Row explosion Unintended many-to-many join, broken uniqueness Many small files Scheduling overhead and compaction  orders = spark.table('ops.gold.orders')
customers = spark.table('ops.gold.customers')
joined = orders.join(customers, ['tenant_id','customer_id'], 'left')
joined.explain('formatted')  Q20 · Does a watermark automatically delete all old data?  No. A watermark sets an event-time lateness tolerance and bounds state in applicable operators. It neither replaces checkpoints nor guarantees inclusion of every late event. Choose it from observed lateness and risk.  Q21 · How do you debug fast SQL that returns wrong business results?  MAX(event_time) only selects a timestamp, not the correct order state. Inspect source authority, versioning, tombstones, temporal semantics, SCD2 point-in-time joins and join cardinality.  Q22 · Are Unity Catalog row filters sufficient for safe Text-to-SQL?  Not alone. You also need trusted identity, object GRANT, SQL policy, row/column enforcement, audit and result budgets. ABAC adds centrally governed tag policies with compute/conflict limitations; a shared service principal does not automatically inherit end-user scope.  Q23 · Should the LLM invent the meaning of late-shipment rate?  No. Owners must approve numerator, denominator, time zone, cancellations and revision. Use metric views/semantic contracts with golden SQL cases to prevent dashboard-agent disagreements.  Primary references : Lakeflow AUTO CDC · Delta CDF · ABAC requirements · Metric views · Spark tuning

titleZh: 11 Coding Craft：性能、解析、窗口、GIL 的工程选择
titleEn: 11 Coding craft: algorithmic cost, parsing, windows and concurrency
textZh:
Coding Craft：性能、解析、窗口、GIL 的工程选择 FDE INDEPENDENT RESEARCH 依据 FDE 公开考点独立研究，不是付费标准答案。示例为教学假设，并非客户性能实测。 Q34 · Top-K 为什么不能把所有结果先排序？  小 K 场景堆选择为 O(N log K)，额外空间可做到 O(K)；排序一般 O(N log N)。但可访问集合必须先过滤，堆排序不能找回上游 ANN 漏掉的候选。  Q35 · CSV 为什么不能直接 split(',')？  引号内可包含逗号或换行，应该使用 CSV Parser 并严格校验 Header、Tenant、时区、重复 ID 和 enum。不合法源数据进入 quarantine，而不是静默丢弃。  Q36 · Sliding Window 如何计算近 15 分钟错误？  already-sorted event times
→ deque append
→ evict timestamp < current_time - 15 minutes
→ maintain eligible request count + failure count  简单双指针在有序事件上为摊还 O(N)，但无序事件必须声明 Watermark / 重排策略；这是两种完全不同的数据契约。  Q37 · GIL 让 Python 线程完全不能并行吗？  标准 CPython 的 GIL 限制 Python 字节码多核 CPU 并行；线程仍适合 I/O 重叠，进程适合重 CPU。Python 3.13+ 有可选 free-threaded 构建；是否真正关掉 GIL 和扩展兼容性都要核查。  可验证的边界 另有真正可运行的 Python stdlib mini-lab：正反向验证 Heap Top-K、CSV、15 分钟窗口与权限隔离。通过单测不代表生产系统安全。  第一手资料 : heapq · csv · threading · free threading
textEn:
Coding craft: algorithmic cost, parsing, windows and concurrency FDE INDEPENDENT RESEARCH Independently researched from public FDE topics, not paid answer keys. All scenarios are instructional, not measured customer deployments. Q34 · Why not always sort the entire corpus for Top-K?  For small K, heap selection is O(N log K) with O(K) extra space; full sorting is typically O(N log N). Authorization must precede eligibility, and a heap cannot fix upstream ANN omissions.  Q35 · Why not parse messy CSV with split(',')?  Quoted fields can contain delimiters and newlines. Use a CSV parser, validate headers, tenant, UTC timestamps, duplicates and enums. Quarantine malformed records.  Q36 · How do you compute a 15-minute rolling failure window?  already-sorted event times
→ deque append
→ evict timestamp < current_time - 15 minutes
→ maintain eligible request count + failure count  Two pointers give amortized O(N) on sorted times. Out-of-order events require watermark or reordering semantics; do not mix the two contracts.  Q37 · Does the GIL mean Python threads can never run in parallel?  The default CPython GIL limits CPU parallelism of Python bytecode, but threads overlap I/O and processes support CPU work. Optional Python 3.13+ free-threaded builds change the runtime boundary and need verification.  Verified boundary A runnable Python stdlib mini-lab tests heap Top-K, CSV, rolling windows and tenant filtering. Unit-test success does not certify production security.  Primary references : heapq · csv · threading · free threading

titleZh: 11 Feature Store 与 SQL/NoSQL：把时间和事务作为主角
titleEn: 11 Feature Store and SQL/NoSQL: temporal and transactional correctness
textZh: Feature Store 与 SQL/NoSQL：把时间和事务作为主角 训练特征必须反映当时可以知道的信息；存储选型先写事务与访问模式，而不是追热点数据库。 FDE VERIFIED BOUNDARY · OCT 2026 根据公开考点独立撰写，不是会员答案。真实平台事实有链接来源；案例与门禁是设计建议，不代表实际客户测试。 Q56 · Feature Stores / Point-in-Time Temporal Join 需要 feature effective_at 和历史 available_at：晚到数据即使事件时间早，也可能是训练时不可用的信息。 失败/验收： 13:00 到的特征不允许进入 12:00 的模型决定；同订单号必须按租户隔离。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ Q57 · SQL vs NoSQL 订单/支付事实优先需要事务/唯一约束；KV 适合简单 Key 访问；搜索索引适合文本召回。SQL 和 NoSQL 都存在扩展和一致性代价。 失败/验收： 不能拿最终一致的检索缓存当退款账本。 来源与边界 / Source ↗ 不能把术语命中当掌握 审计表中的 H 只表示此考点能在所属章节定位。还需逐项检查机制、反例、实现、指标与一手证据。
textEn: Feature Store and SQL/NoSQL: temporal and transactional correctness Training features must match information available at prediction time; choose storage by transactions and access patterns, not popularity. FDE VERIFIED BOUNDARY · OCT 2026 Independently written from public topic names, not membership answers. Provider facts link to first-party references; examples and gates are engineering proposals, not customer tests. Q56 · Feature Stores / Point-in-Time Point-in-time features need effective_at and historical availability; late data may claim an early event timestamp yet remain unknown at prediction time. Failure / acceptance: 13:00 arrival cannot influence a decision made at 12:00; tenant scope is required. Source / boundary ↗ Q57 · SQL vs NoSQL Orders/payments need transactions/constraints; KV supports keyed access; search indexes rank text. Both SQL and NoSQL have scale/consistency trade-offs. Failure / acceptance: Never use an eventual search cache as the refund ledger. Source / boundary ↗ Terminology is not mastery H in the curriculum audit only means the topic is locatable. Mechanism, counterexample, implementation, metric and primary evidence still require review.

titleZh: 12 12.1 FDE 的完整交付链：问题到运行结果
titleEn: 12 12.1 FDE delivery chain: from ambiguous ask to operating outcome
textZh:
12.1 FDE 的完整交付链：问题到运行结果  技术交付不是“模型能回答一个示例”。应把真实工作流、数据权限、业务验收、安全降级和交接放进同一个决策链。  Ambiguous request
 → discover constraints and baseline
 → define success + non-goals
 → walking skeleton
 → evaluated thin slice
 → shadow / canary release
 → operating owner + handoff
textEn:
12.1 FDE delivery chain: from ambiguous ask to operating outcome  Delivery is not a model answering one polished example. The customer workflow, data access, acceptance conditions, safe degradation and handoff belong to one decision chain.  Ambiguous request
 → discover constraints and baseline
 → define success + non-goals
 → walking skeleton
 → evaluated thin slice
 → shadow / canary release
 → operating owner + handoff

titleZh: 12 12.2 Requirements Discovery：问能改变架构的问题
titleEn: 12 12.2 Requirements discovery: ask architecture-changing questions
textZh: 12.2 Requirements Discovery：问能改变架构的问题  维度 客户问题 决定什么 结果 改善谁的哪一步？对比哪个 baseline？ 成功指标 权限 什么数据？谁能读写？ 身份 / RLS / VPC 失败 答错与拒答哪个损失更大？ HITL / gate 运行 多快、多少并发、谁维护？ SLO / cost / owner  记录假设时注明证据、owner、验证动作和决策时间；会议里说过不代表已确认为需求。
textEn: 12.2 Requirements discovery: ask architecture-changing questions  Lens Customer question Determines Outcome Which step improves vs what baseline? Success metric Access Which data, who may read or write? Identity / RLS / VPC Failure Which is worse: wrong answer or abstention? HITL / gate Operations How fast, concurrent, and who operates it? SLO / cost / owner  For each assumption log evidence, owner, validation action and decision date; a meeting remark is not automatically a confirmed requirement.

titleZh: 12 12.3 Walking Skeleton：优先跑通最薄的真实闭环
titleEn: 12 12.3 Walking skeleton: prove the thinnest real end-to-end slice
textZh:
12.3 Walking Skeleton：优先跑通最薄的真实闭环  ONE customer identity
 → ONE authorized data source
 → ONE realistic task
 → ONE production-shaped deployment path
 → ONE trace and acceptance assertion  一份完美 Notebook 不证明集成成功。最小闭环必须尽早跨越网络、认证、数据获取、执行、可观测和回滚边界；再决定是否需要多 Agent。
textEn:
12.3 Walking skeleton: prove the thinnest real end-to-end slice  ONE customer identity
 → ONE authorized data source
 → ONE realistic task
 → ONE production-shaped deployment path
 → ONE trace and acceptance assertion  A polished notebook cannot prove integration. Cross network, identity, ingestion, execution, observability and rollback boundaries early; add multi-agent orchestration only when evidence requires it.

titleZh: 12 12.4 Scope：把 In / Out 与验收写在同一页
titleEn: 12 12.4 Scope: write in/out boundaries beside acceptance
textZh: 12.4 Scope：把 In / Out 与验收写在同一页  项目 In scope Out of scope 用户 指定的已授权支持团队 公司所有团队 工作流 解释一类订单异常并提供证据 修改全部订单及自动退款 评估 标注集、权限测试、延迟预算 “展示时看起来不错”
textEn: 12.4 Scope: write in/out boundaries beside acceptance  Item In scope Out of scope Users Named authorized support team Every team in the company Workflow Explain one order anomaly with evidence Edit all orders or auto-refund Evaluation Labeled evals, access tests, latency budget A demo that merely looks good

titleZh: 12 12.5 Acceptance Contract：把正确、时延、成本、风险分开
titleEn: 12 12.5 Acceptance contract: correctness, latency, cost and risk
textZh: 12.5 Acceptance Contract：把正确、时延、成本、风险分开  维度 指标示例 对应失败 业务 每个已核验任务节省的人工时间 没有实际价值 质量 真实样本 correct/grounded rate 只在演示样本好看 安全 越权读取和工具拒绝测试 模型口头保证安全 可靠性 p95 latency、timeout、rollback 平均数掩盖尾部故障 经济性 Cost per successful approved task 仅优化每 Token 成本
textEn: 12.5 Acceptance contract: correctness, latency, cost and risk  Dimension Example metric Failure caught Business Time saved per verified task No real customer value Quality Correct/grounded rate on held-out tasks Demo-only overfitting Security Unauthorized-read / tool-denial tests Verbal safety promise Reliability p95 latency, timeout, rollback Averages hide tail failures Economics Cost per successful approved task Token cost mistaken for value

titleZh: 12 12.6 向非工程师解释取舍：决策 / 收益 / 风险 / 证据
titleEn: 12 12.6 Explain trade-offs: decision, benefit, risk, evidence
textZh: 12.6 向非工程师解释取舍：决策 / 收益 / 风险 / 证据  示例：发票精确查询优先试用 permission-filtered Exact/BM25 路径，因为来源与权限容易审计；如果评估发现同义改写召回不足，再加入 Dense 检索。不是预设 BM25 永远优于向量检索。
textEn: 12.6 Explain trade-offs: decision, benefit, risk, evidence  Example: start invoice-ID lookup with permission-filtered Exact/BM25 for auditability, then add dense retrieval if labeled tests show insufficient paraphrase recall. This is not a universal claim that BM25 always beats vectors.

titleZh: 12 12.7 Live Demo 故障：透明恢复优于掩饰
titleEn: 12 12.7 Failed live demos: transparent recovery beats performance
textZh: 12.7 Live Demo 故障：透明恢复优于掩饰  时刻 行动 演示前 核对权限、实时服务、数据刷新时间和已知成功请求 发生故障 明确失败步骤与客户影响，记录 trace 降级 回放必须标记为录制/样例，不伪称实时成功 后续 给出 owner、复现步骤和交付决策
textEn: 12.7 Failed live demos: transparent recovery beats performance  Moment Action Preflight Check identity, service health, freshness, and known-good request Failure Explain the failed boundary and impact; capture the trace Fallback Mark prerecorded or simulated paths; never imply live success Follow-up Provide owner, reproduction, and next decision

titleZh: 12 12.8 Handoff：离开后系统仍能被可靠运行
titleEn: 12 12.8 Handoff: reliable operation without the original FDE
textZh: 12.8 Handoff：离开后系统仍能被可靠运行  交接最小集包含：数据契约、租户权限、版本化 Eval Suite、仪表盘、SLO、Incident Runbook、成本预算、发布/回滚说明、明确的值班与升级负责人。
textEn: 12.8 Handoff: reliable operation without the original FDE  A handoff needs data contracts, tenant policies, versioned evals, a dashboard, SLO, incident runbook, cost budget, release/rollback instructions, and an on-call owner.

titleZh: 12 12.9 场景演练：紧急服务响应时间
titleEn: 12 12.9 Case study: emergency-response delay
textZh: 12.9 场景演练：紧急服务响应时间  客户希望降低急救响应时间。先拆成接线、人工分诊、定位、派单、行车和记录延迟，确认决定权必须在合格的人类调度员手中。第一阶段可以是经过审核的辅助转录/信息整理，而非自动调度。  若最大的瓶颈是路况和行车时间，部署 LLM 文本助手很可能没有意义。强 FDE 会证明或否定这个假设，而不是强行套 AI 架构。
textEn: 12.9 Case study: emergency-response delay  A city wants faster emergency response. Measure call intake, human triage, location, dispatch, travel and reporting separately. Keep high-stakes dispatch authority with qualified humans. A first slice may be audited assistive transcription, not autonomous dispatch.  If travel dominates the delay, an LLM intake agent is likely the wrong investment. A strong FDE tests that hypothesis rather than forcing an AI solution.

titleZh: 12 端到端 FDE System Design：企业订单异常调查 Copilot §12.11
titleEn: 12 End-to-end FDE system design: Enterprise Order Investigation Copilot
textZh: 端到端 FDE System Design：企业订单异常调查 Copilot §12.11  合成客户场景：售后团队经常遇到订单“签收时间早于交接时间”的异常。任务不是快速套用 Agent 框架，而是设计一个能被授权、能解释、能复查、能交付的调查流程。  TEACHING CASE · SOURCE BOUNDARY 所有客户、订单、时间及目标均为虚构。架构建议是 Handbook 综合判断；真实平台事实另外列出官方来源。示例代码可运行，但不是生产系统。
textEn: End-to-end FDE system design: Enterprise Order Investigation Copilot §12.11  Synthetic customer scenario: a support team sees 'delivered before handoff' records. The goal is not to reach for an agent framework but to build an authorized, explainable, auditable delivery workflow.  TEACHING CASE · SOURCE BOUNDARY All customers, orders, timestamps and targets are fictional. Architecture is handbook synthesis; product-specific facts link to official documentation. The sample runs locally but is not production software.

titleZh: 12 需求发现：先判断 AI 值不值得做 01
titleEn: 12 Discovery: first establish whether AI solves the bottleneck
textZh: 需求发现：先判断 AI 值不值得做 01  客户要什么 FDE 必须追问 改变的架构决策 调查效率 哪一步最慢？基线多少？ 是否真的需要 LLM 事实准确 谁定义最终订单状态？各来源时钟可靠么？ 来源优先级与不确定性 权限 只能看本租户，还是还要按订单分配？ 可信身份与行级权限 处理异常 只解释，还是允许退款？谁审批？ Read-only / human approval 实时性 源变更多久后必须可查？ Batch vs streaming CDC  关键边界 第一阶段只交付：一个已授权订单、可溯源事件、只读调查、人工确认。自动退款、开放 SQL、多 Agent 都明确排除。
textEn: Discovery: first establish whether AI solves the bottleneck 01  Customer request FDE discovery question Decision changed Investigation time Which step is slow? Baseline? Whether an LLM is needed Factual correctness Who owns final status? Are clocks reliable? Source precedence and uncertainty Access Tenant-only, or per-order assignment? Trusted identity and row policy Action Explain only or refund? Who approves? Read-only / human approval Freshness How soon must updates be queryable? Batch versus streaming CDC  Boundary First slice: one authorized order, traceable events, read-only investigation and human sign-off. Exclude auto-refunds, arbitrary SQL and multi-agent autonomy.

titleZh: 12 四个平面，七个边界：完整系统拓扑 02
titleEn: 12 Four planes, seven boundaries: full system topology
textZh: 四个平面，七个边界：完整系统拓扑 02  FIG.12.FDE-01 · KNOWLEDGE / DATA / EXECUTION 从客户身份到经过核验的订单结论 01 CUSTOMER SSO / 用户身份 / 验收人 02 POLICY GATE Tenant + 工单授权 + 工具权限 03 TASK ROUTE 订单号 → Exact SQL 路径 ↓ 04 DATA PLANE OMS / Carrier → CDC → Bronze / Silver / Gold 05 EVIDENCE 授权 SQL + 事件 ID + 时钟/版本 06 DECISION 确定性核验 → 证据不足则拒判 ↓ 07 DELIVERY 说明 / 人工审核 / 可追溯记录 08 EVALUATION Golden timeline / 权限测试 / CI Gate 09 OPERATIONS p95 / Freshness / 回滚 / Runbook  这些是有先后依赖的工程边界，不是让三个 Agent 分头猜答案。关键原则是：模型不能提供或更改身份，不能代替数据库授权，也不能把自己的解释当成事实来源。
textEn: Four planes, seven boundaries: full system topology 02  FIG.12.FDE-01 · KNOWLEDGE / DATA / EXECUTION From trusted identity to a reviewed order diagnosis 01 CUSTOMER SSO / verified identity / reviewer 02 POLICY GATE Tenant + order assignment + tool policy 03 TASK ROUTE Order ID → exact SQL route ↓ 04 DATA PLANE OMS / carrier → CDC → Bronze / Silver / Gold 05 EVIDENCE Scoped SQL + event IDs + clocks / versions 06 DECISION Deterministic check → abstain if insufficient ↓ 07 DELIVERY Explanation / human review / audit 08 EVALUATION Golden timelines / permission tests / CI gate 09 OPERATIONS p95 / freshness / rollback / runbook  These are ordered engineering boundaries, not three agents free to guess. A model does not supply or change identity, enforce database authorization, or become the source of truth.

titleZh: 12 CDC / Delta：证据的时间与来源比模型更重要 03
titleEn: 12 CDC / Delta: evidence timestamps and provenance matter more than the model
textZh:
CDC / Delta：证据的时间与来源比模型更重要 03  OMS / WMS / carrier source events
  → raw append + source offset (Bronze)
  → schema / event-ID dedup / tombstone / replay (Silver)
  → governed order timeline + business semantics (Gold)
  → index only optional policy documents  字段 为什么必须存在 最容易出错的地方 source_event_id 重试幂等、证据引用 一个 ID 重用不同 payload source_version 某个来源的版本次序 跨来源比较版本号 event_time_utc 业务事件声称发生的时间 把时钟偏差当真实异常 ingested_at_utc 观测到的写入时间 当成 event time 排序 tenant_id 隔离/授权边界 来自模型、缺行级策略  官方 Delta 文档明确说明：CDF 不是默认开启、仅记录启用后的更改，历史受保留策略限制。长期审计必须另行存档；不能把 CDF 当成无限期的原始事实库。
textEn:
CDC / Delta: evidence timestamps and provenance matter more than the model 03  OMS / WMS / carrier source events
  → raw append + source offset (Bronze)
  → schema / event-ID dedup / tombstone / replay (Silver)
  → governed order timeline + business semantics (Gold)
  → index only optional policy documents  Field Reason Pitfall source_event_id Replay dedup and evidence citation Conflicting payload under one ID source_version Order changes within one source Comparing different sources' versions event_time_utc When source says event occurred Mistaking clock skew for fact ingested_at_utc When ingest observed change Using ingestion time as event time tenant_id Isolation and access control Model-supplied scope or missing RLS  Delta's first-party docs say CDF must be enabled, captures only subsequent changes and obeys retention. Long-term audit requires separate archiving; CDF is not a permanent event ledger.

titleZh: 12 路由：订单事实走 Exact SQL，政策才考虑 RAG 04
titleEn: 12 Routing: exact SQL for order facts, RAG only for policy text
textZh:
路由：订单事实走 Exact SQL，政策才考虑 RAG 04  输入 选择的路径 为什么不用另一个方案 订单 42 状态 授权 Exact / SQL 向量相似度不能保证唯一 ID Carrier SLA 条款 权限过滤后 BM25 / Dense SQL 事件表没有非结构化条款 缺少交接事件 拒判 / 人工复核 LLM 不能补造证据 订单退款 草稿 + Host 审批；首期禁用 模型决策不能直接执行业务写入  trusted_identity + allowed_orders
 → authorize BEFORE retrieve
 → SQL WHERE tenant_id = ? AND order_id = ?
 → verify handoff + delivery evidence
 → ANOMALY / CONSISTENT / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
 → explain observed evidence; never issue refund  关键边界 即使查询只返回 SELECT，SQL 也不是自动安全：必须由受信服务实施租户约束，并在数据库层提供真正的行级执行策略。
textEn:
Routing: exact SQL for order facts, RAG only for policy text 04  Input Chosen route Why not the alternative Status for order 42 Scoped exact / SQL Vectors cannot prove exact identity Carrier SLA terms Authorized BM25 / dense Event SQL lacks unstructured policy Missing handoff Abstain / human review LLMs cannot create missing evidence Refund request Draft + host approval; disabled in v1 Model text cannot authorize business writes  trusted_identity + allowed_orders
 → authorize BEFORE retrieve
 → SQL WHERE tenant_id = ? AND order_id = ?
 → verify handoff + delivery evidence
 → ANOMALY / CONSISTENT / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
 → explain observed evidence; never issue refund  Boundary A read-only SELECT is not automatically authorized. Enforce trusted tenant scope in the host and true row-level policy at the storage layer.

titleZh: 12 可运行的 Walking Skeleton：同一订单号、不同租户 05
titleEn: 12 Runnable walking skeleton: one order ID, different tenants
textZh:
可运行的 Walking Skeleton：同一订单号、不同租户 05  在仓库运行纯 Python 标准库测试。案例故意让 tenant-a 和 tenant-b 都拥有订单号 42，分别产生异常与正常结论，验证查询条件和证据引用不会跨租户串线。  cd examples/fde-order-copilot
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
python3 copilot.py  Browse runnable Python and tests  TENANT A 异常订单 42 DELIVERED 10:20 · HANDED_OFF 10:30 记录上的时间顺序异常；不能断言真实物流已经发生逆序。 TENANT B 正常订单 42 HANDED_OFF 11:00 · DELIVERED 11:30 同一个 ID，但数据、身份、证据完全独立。  脚本演示授权过滤、重复事件、乱序到达、证据不足和拒绝未知动作；它不包含生产认证、真实 Delta、LLM 或退款 API，因此不能当作一次生产安全认证。
textEn:
Runnable walking skeleton: one order ID, different tenants 05  Run the stdlib-only Python tests in the repository. Tenant A and tenant B both have order 42 but different timelines; results and evidence must stay separate.  cd examples/fde-order-copilot
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
python3 copilot.py  Browse runnable Python and tests  TENANT A Anomalous order 42 DELIVERED 10:20 · HANDED_OFF 10:30 Recorded chronology anomaly; not proof of physical delivery order.
