titleZh: 12 Failure Injection：出现问题必须知道在哪一层修 06
titleEn: 12 Failure injection: repair the earliest incorrect boundary
textZh: Failure Injection：出现问题必须知道在哪一层修 06  场景 A · Carrier Event 晚到/重复 保留 event time 与 ingest time；重复事件必须幂等，冲突 payload 必须隔离。先修 CDC 数据契约，而不是修改 Prompt。  场景 B · 同一个订单号跨租户重复 没有可信 Tenant Context 的查询必须失败。测试检索候选、最终证据、缓存及可观测日志，不能只检查最终 LLM 回复。  场景 C · HANDOFF 记录缺失 输出 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE、缺失事件与下一步人工核对，不可编造一个完整时间线。  场景 D · 退款 Tool 超时 首期根本不开放退款。若后期接入，超时意味着结果未知；需授权审批、持久化操作 ID、下游幂等契约与对账，不能无限重试。
textEn: Failure injection: repair the earliest incorrect boundary 06  Scenario A · Late or repeated carrier event Keep event and ingestion time distinct; repeated events must be idempotent, conflicting payloads quarantined. Repair the CDC contract before changing prompts.  Scenario B · Same order ID across tenants Deny requests without trusted tenant context. Test retrieval candidates, final evidence, caches and logs, not only the displayed answer.  Scenario C · Handoff event missing Return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, identify missing facts, and direct human reconciliation rather than inventing a timeline.  Scenario D · Refund tool times out Refund is disabled in v1. If enabled later, a timeout means unknown outcome. Require approval, persisted operation IDs, idempotency contracts and reconciliation—not blind retries.

titleZh: 12 验收与发布：正确率不能隐藏权限问题 07
titleEn: 12 Acceptance and release: aggregate accuracy must not hide leaks
textZh: 验收与发布：正确率不能隐藏权限问题 07  Gate 如何测试 Release 判定 Tenant isolation 跨租户、撤权、缓存重用 观察到越权则阻断 Evidence / abstention Golden timeline + 缺失记录样本 无法支持结论必须拒判 Data freshness 每来源源提交→可查询延迟 阈值由客户协商 p95 & failures 端到端、超时、重试、回滚 分阶段 canary Business impact 人工复核后用时与 baseline 确认真实节省时间 Cost per success 所有运行费用 / 正确且被接受的任务 不只看 token 价格  用于估算的示例：若人工平均调查 12 分钟、Copilot 复核总计 5 分钟，则推导节省 7 分钟——这只是算术情景，不是实测结果。真实 Pilot 必须匹配任务难度，记录尾延迟、拒判与安全失败。
textEn: Acceptance and release: aggregate accuracy must not hide leaks 07  Gate How to test Release decision Tenant isolation Cross-tenant, revocation, cache replay Any observed leak blocks Evidence / abstention Golden timelines + missing-source cases Unsupported conclusions must abstain Data freshness Per-source commit-to-query delay Customer-agreed target p95 & failures End-to-end, timeouts, retries, rollback Staged canary Business impact Human-reviewed time versus baseline Prove actual time saved Cost per success All run cost / accepted correct tasks Not just token price  Hypothetical calculation: manual average 12 minutes, reviewed copilot 5 minutes, a 7-minute arithmetic saving. These are assumptions, not measured results; a real pilot must match task cohorts and track tails, abstentions and safety incidents.

titleZh: 12 生产上线、交接，以及五分钟 FDE 答题骨架 08
titleEn: 12 Production rollout, handoff and a five-minute FDE interview answer
textZh: 生产上线、交接，以及五分钟 FDE 答题骨架 08  决策点 推荐起点 什么时候需要升级 部署 满足客户约束的 Managed SaaS VPC/BYOC、数据驻留或合同要求 Agent 确定性 Host Workflow 审批/长期运行/可恢复分支 检索 ID Exact SQL 非结构化合同、政策、SLA 模型 事件分类无需 LLM 已证实需要语言解释或复杂证据推理  交接物必须包含数据契约、身份策略、版本化 Golden Set、Release Gate、SLO、费用预算、告警、Runbook、Rollback、值班人与升级责任。FDE 真正的完工标准是：你离开后其他工程师也能解释并修复故障。  关键边界 面试回答优先级：澄清真实问题 → 明确权限与事实来源 → 最薄闭环 → 拒判/安全关卡 → Golden Eval 与成本 → 逐步上线与交接。不要先背技术栈。  可直接验证的外部来源： Delta CDF · Delta Streaming · Databricks Unity Catalog · Azure Document ACL · AWS Idempotency
textEn: Production rollout, handoff and a five-minute FDE interview answer 08  Decision Recommended default When to change Deployment Managed SaaS if permitted VPC/BYOC, residency or contractual constraints Agent Deterministic host workflow Approvals / long-lived recoverable branches Retrieval Exact SQL for IDs Unstructured contracts/policies/SLAs Model No LLM for event classification Measured need for explanation or ambiguous evidence  Handoff requires source contracts, identity policies, versioned evals, release gates, SLOs, cost budgets, alerts, runbooks, rollback and on-call ownership. Delivery is complete when another engineer can diagnose and operate the service.  Boundary Interview order: clarify outcome → define identity and source truth → build the thin slice → enforce refusal/safety → golden eval and unit economics → staged rollout and handoff. Don't start with a stack.  First-party sources to verify: Delta CDF · Delta Streaming · Databricks Unity Catalog · Azure Document ACL · AWS Idempotency

titleZh: 12 FDE 167 概念审计：定位知识，而非制造完成率
titleEn: 12 FDE 167-concept audit: locate evidence, not manufacture completion
textZh: FDE 167 概念审计：定位知识，而非制造完成率  保留原始 10 Track、167 题的唯一主章节映射，并逐项检查当前 Handbook 章节中是否存在直观的知识证据。以 2026-10-08 当前工作分支为基线；原理正确性和面试准备程度仍需单独审查。  证据等级 数量 应如何解读 H 136 章节标题出现术语或审核过的别名；不是完整覆盖认证。 B 31 正文出现术语或别名，需要继续审查解释深度。 N 0 无直接字面命中；可能确实缺失，也可能因中文同义说法漏检。  不能将命中率当学习进度 即使出现标题，也必须核对机制、案例、取舍、故障、指标、官方来源六个维度。三种等级都不能直接宣称某概念已完全掌握。  下一轮怎么用这张表  优先人工核查 N 类中的真空白；对 H/B 类判断内容是否能承受面试追问。优先顺序：生产架构 → Databricks 数据流 → 客户交付 → 权限与评估。  167-concept evidence ledger ↗ · Q10–Q23 source provenance ↗  本节及两个新专题目前仅位于待审核 GitHub 分支；不得把内容同步构建等同于 Vercel 正式发布。
textEn: FDE 167-concept audit: locate evidence, not manufacture completion  Preserve the original ten tracks and route all 167 concepts to one canonical chapter. Inspect direct terminology evidence on the 2026-10-08 feature branch after stages 05–06; technical correctness and interview readiness still require separate review.  Evidence level Count Interpretation H 136 Owning heading contains concept/approved alias; not full-depth certification. B 31 Owner prose contains the term/alias; depth remains unverified. N 0 No direct text signal; may reflect a gap or an unmatched Chinese synonym.  Coverage is not a keyword count Even a dedicated title still needs mechanism, scenario, trade-off, failure mode, metric and primary source checks. None of these grades alone indicates mastery.  How to use the audit  Manually review N-class entries for true gaps; then check whether H/B concepts survive engineering follow-ups. Prioritize production architecture, Databricks data flow, customer delivery, authorization and evaluation.  167-concept evidence ledger ↗ · Q10–Q23 source provenance ↗  This section and both new deep dives are on a review branch only; generating site assets is not a Vercel production release.

titleZh: 12 FDE 36 核心面试能力：从可读到可辩护
titleEn: 12 36 core FDE interview skills: from readable to defensible
textZh: FDE 36 核心面试能力：从可读到可辩护  本轮不是再计数概念：抽取 36 个最常串联成企业交付问题的考点，逐项核对原始主章节与讲解材料，指出必须补做的工程证据，并提供可自测的追问。  EDITORIAL RUBRIC · NOT A PERSONAL SCORE 这是对教材证据的初步人工审查，不是用户能力得分、招聘通过率或真实生产测试。0=该维度未定位到证据，1=部分解释，2=有具体且可检查的例子或规则；2 也不代表已在客户环境运行。  维度 问题 仍需补强（36 项） M 机制与条件 3 E 可工作的具体案例 18 T 可反驳的取舍 0 F 失败注入和预期行为 21 G 可量化的发布验收 31 P 相应的一手证据 22  优先顺序不是简单相加的分数，而是补齐影响上线安全的 F/G/P 缺口。建议按“画真实边界 → 给出反例 → 测试 → 量化发布条件”来组织每个答案。  四轮 12 分钟模拟面试 A · RAG 撤权时差 Tenant A/B 均有订单 42；向量检索返回后、读取原文前，员工访问权限被撤销。请画可信身份、Exact SQL、向量索引、Cache 与二次授权的调用时序。 验收标准：通过：未授权候选/段落不进入 Context、Trace 或 Cache；分别量化内容新鲜度与撤权到拒绝的延迟。 B · CDC 时序和特征泄漏 Carrier 记录乱序、重复和删除；某特征事件时间 11:00 但 13:00 才到达，预测发生在 12:00。设计 Source Sequence、SCD2、回放与 As-of Join。 验收标准：通过：12:00 预测不得读取 13:00 才可用的特征，且快照+CDC 不重复计数。 C · 支付超时与重试风暴 退款 Tool 在后端提交后响应超时；Carrier API 又连续 503。设计人审、Operation ID、对账、退避/熔断、队列上限及未知结果状态。 验收标准：通过：绝不以新 Key 盲重试；工具授权和副作用有单独审计，重试放大可测且有上限。 D · Pilot 漂移与现场故障 Pilot 平均准确 95%，生产复核仅 70%，一个关键权限切片退化；演示现场依赖服务 503。给出 Golden Set、Release Gate、Canary、真实告知与 Rollback。 验收标准：通过：安全 Slice 失败阻断发布，明确分母和人工裁决，降级样例显著标注而不伪装实时结果。 36 项逐条审查与练习题 Model / API · 模型基础 (3) R01 · Structured Output textEn: 36 core FDE interview skills: from readable to defensible  This review examines 36 strategically selected enterprise FDE concepts against their canonical owner chapters, identifies missing operational proof and offers concrete rehearsal prompts.  EDITORIAL RUBRIC · NOT A PERSONAL SCORE This is a provisional editorial review of study material, not a personal grade, hiring prediction, or production certification. 0 = not demonstrated; 1 = partially explained; 2 = concrete inspectable teaching evidence. Even a 2 is not a customer deployment test.  Dimension Question Needs stronger evidence M Mechanism and conditions 3 E Worked example 18 T Defensible trade-off 0 F Fault and negative test 21 G Measurable acceptance gate 31 P Applicable primary evidence 22  Prioritize risk-critical F/G/P gaps rather than a single sum. Structure each answer as boundary → counterexample → test → measurable release condition.  Four 12-minute mock interview rounds A · RAG revocation window Tenant A/B both have order 42. Revoke employee access after vector search but before evidence fetch. Draw the identity, exact SQL, vector, cache and reauthorization sequence. Pass criteria: Pass: no unauthorized candidate enters context, traces or cache; measure freshness and revocation-to-denial separately. B · CDC and temporal leakage Carrier records arrive out of order with duplicates/deletes. Feature event time is 11:00 but arrives at 13:00; prediction was made at noon. Design sequencing, SCD2, replay and as-of lookup. Pass criteria: Pass: noon prediction cannot access a feature first available at 13:00; snapshot+CDC reconciles without double counts. C · Refund timeout and retry storm Refund tool times out after possible backend commit while carrier API returns repeated 503s. Design human approval, operation ID, reconciliation, budgets, breaker and UNKNOWN outcome. Pass criteria: Pass: never blind-retry with a new key; audit authorization/effects; bounded retry amplification. D · Pilot drift and live failure Pilot mean accuracy 95%, production reviewed accuracy 70%, critical permission slice regressed; live demo dependency is 503. Design golden set, release gates, canary, truthful fallback and rollback. Pass criteria: Pass: critical security regression blocks release, denominators/adjudication explicit, fallback visibly labeled. 36 topic-level reviews and drills Model and API (3) R01 · Structured Output and Schema Validation CH01 · 8/12 Practice gap: A JSON-schema-valid output cites the wrong order; design the end-to-end release gate. Interview challenge: A JSON-schema-valid output cites the wrong order; design the end-to-end release gate. Pass criteria: Wrong order or scope is denied despite valid JSON; preserve traces and negative cases.
